links.title: NeuroPrefetcher: Storage-Aware Sparse LLM Inference via Delta Prefetching

llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems-level LLM inference paper squarely on-topic for LLM efficiency and edge serving. It addresses the model-exceeds-memory regime with a novel combination of one-shot activation prediction, delta prefetching from NVMe, and a memory-adaptive dense/sparse split. Rigor is high: evaluation on real edge hardware (Jetson AGX Orin), comparison against 20 production systems, memory budget sweeps across 7 levels, latency breakdown, and model quality metrics (perplexity, HellaSwag). Evidence is specific and quantitative with honest reporting of limitations (I/O remains dominant bottleneck; Llama-3-8B is more sparsity-sensitive). Generalizability is limited by single-platform validation with a Jetson-specific coherence staging component. No explicit code release mentioned.

primary_link.title: NeuroPrefetcher: Storage-Aware Sparse LLM Inference via Delta Prefetching

papers.summary: Deploying large language models on edge devices is increasingly limited by a widening gap between model size and available memory. Existing approaches such as quantization, smaller models, and offloading can raise the effective memory limit, but they still assume that the model can be compressed or partitioned to fit within some budget. We target the harder model-exceeds-memory setting, in which the model remains larger than resident memory throughout execution and storage becomes an active sour
papers.summary_zh: 本論文瞄準邊緣裝置上「模型大於記憶體」的艱難情境:模型在整個執行期間持續超過常駐記憶體,儲存裝置必須成為在關鍵路徑上直接供應權重的主動層級。關鍵觀察是自迴歸解碼中 MLP 活化具有強時間局部性:約 82–85% 的活化神經元從一個詞元延續到下一個,因此大多數稀疏權重已常駐,只需取得新增的差異列。NeuroPrefetcher 據此設計:離線先以閾值化與聚類建立稀疏活化質心詞彙;在第 0 層之後,單一 GPU 常駐預測器(僅佔基礎模型參數 2.86%)以一次前向傳遞預測所有下游 MLP 層的活化;執行期比對預測與常駐緩衝區,僅對新需要的差異列排程 NVMe 讀取,並搭配記憶體自適應的稠密/稀疏分割,隨記憶體緊縮以稠密層換取稀疏層。在 Jetson AGX Orin 統一記憶體平台上運行 Mistral-7B,於受限記憶體預算下相較 llama.cpp 達 7.9–12.0 倍加速(3.22 tok/s 對 0.34 tok/s),保留 92–96% 稠密準確度且無需逐任務重訓。對二十個生產級推論系統的能力研究顯示,十二個在生成前即失敗、四個缺乏可部署版本,凸顯傳統卸載設計與統一記憶體邊緣硬體的錯配。剩餘瓶頸在 NVMe I/O 仍佔每詞元延遲的 80–87%,未來需更深預取管線、更強讀取合併與量化稀疏列格式。

links.title: CONTRAMEM: Learning Self-Evolving Procedural Memory from Contrasting Multi-Model Trajectories

evidence: Abstract: 'On held-out GAIA2/ARE computer-use tasks, ContraMem more than doubles the success rate across the three source-model targets (26.2% to 55.3%)' with per-model gains GPT-5.5 27.5->61.0, Claude Sonnet 28.0->52.5, DeepSeek V4 Pro 23.0->52.5

Experiments > Main Held-Out Results, Table 1: unseen target Qwen3.7 Plus rises 18.5->35.5 with no contributed trajectories; 'Across all paired held-out runs... McNemar chi2=171.3, p<<0.001' with 232 failure-to-pass vs 23 pass-to-fail flips

Ablations > Source Diversity and Curation, Table 3: matched multi-rollout control with three GPT-5.5 trajectories per task trails ContraMem on every ability (macro 70.0 vs 77.5), isolating heterogeneous contrast from sampling count
Appendix A.4, Table A4: Curator ablation reduces Skill Cards 273->205 (-24.9%) while improving GPT-5.5 held-out success 104/160->115/160 (65.0%->71.9%)
Appendix A.6-A.7: ACE pinned to commit bcb7cea and AWM to commit 8c0ff8c with matched 120-trajectory source pools; Table A5 gives ContraMem 77.5 macro vs AWM 47.5, raw retrieval 45.8, ACE 44.2

Appendix A.1, Table A1: 'Verifier: GAIA2 verifier with GPT-5.5 judge where LLM judgment is required' — judge model overlaps with a source and target model; Time ability uses a modified normalized runtime

Related Work > Cross-agent: 'Most directly related is MemCollab, which likewise contrasts trajectories from different models on the same task (Chang et al. 2026)' — limiting novelty of the core contrastive idea

Conclusion: limitations admitted — 'ContraMem remains bounded by the procedural failures represented in its source trajectories, and text-injected memory alone does not resolve time-sensitive failures'

Experiments > Cross-Benchmark Validation, Table 2: AppWorld Test-Normal TGC macro 54.4->75.0 and Test-Challenge 42.7->57.4 across three mid-tier targets, with GPT-4.1-mini as construction model to rule out stronger-construction confounds

Reproducibility Plates B.1-B.11: full card schemas, rendered examples, and construction/runtime prompts are included, and Table A1 fixes seed (20260610), timeouts, and retrieval config, but no code or released memory bank is stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agentic-LLM contribution: training-free procedural memory for computer-use agents, built by contrasting same-task trajectories from multiple source LLMs into Function/Skill Cards with a local Curator, evaluated on GAIA2/ARE and AppWorld. Strongly matches Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences, with secondary relevance to memory/retrieval. Methodology is unusually well controlled: single-source self-memory control, matched multi-rollout control (Table 3: 70.0 vs 77.5 macro), component ablations, Curator vs append-only ablation (Table A4: 273->205 cards, 65.0%->71.9%), matched-evidence reproductions of AWM/ACE with pinned commits, McNemar significance tests (chi2=171.3), and token/cost accounting (Table A7). Novelty is moderate: the closest cited work MemCollab already contrasts multi-model trajectories; the contribution is the typed-card architecture plus controlled matched-budget evidence, and the contrastive-learning analogy is explicitly conceptual. Main deductions: per-cell n is only 40 tasks; the GAIA2 verifier uses a GPT-5.5 judge that overlaps with a source/target model (Table A1); the Time ability barely improves and needed a benchmark-specific temporal adapter; and the named models (GPT-5.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Qwen3.7 Plus) and several 2026-dated citations are not externally verifiable from the document. No explicit code or memory-bank release is stated, though prompts, schemas, algorithms, seeds, and frozen configs are provided.

primary_link.title: CONTRAMEM: Learning Self-Evolving Procedural Memory from Contrasting Multi-Model Trajectories

papers.summary: Autonomous computer-use agents are increasingly applied to long-horizon tasks requiring coordinated application calls, persistent state tracking, and verifier-sensitive writes, yet they remain prone to procedural failures: misreading application state, tool semantics, or task progress. Procedural memory promises more consistent decisions and less redundant exploration, but constructing high-quality memory without model training remains challenging. We introduce CONTRAMEM, a source-flexible, trai
papers.summary_zh: 本論文提出 ContraMem,一個無需訓練、來源彈性的自我演化程序性記憶框架,將不同模型執行同一任務的結果差異視為監督訊號:正確性、效率、復原與失敗模式的對比,揭露與結果相關的程序性區別。框架將執行軌跡蒸餾為應用層級的 Function Cards(工具契約)與任務層級的 Skill Cards(決策規則),由 Reflector 萃取候選增量,Curator 透過 ADD、PATCH、MERGE、NARROW、NOOP 等局部編輯維護記憶庫,避免僅追加累積或整庫改寫造成的冗餘與漂移;執行期以 BM25 檢索少量任務相關卡片作為軟性程序引導,過程中不更新任何模型參數。在 GAIA2/ARE 電腦使用任務上,以 GPT-5.5、Claude Sonnet 4.6 與 DeepSeek V4 Pro 為來源,三個目標模型的留出成功率從 26.2% 提升至 55.3%(個別 +33.5、+24.5、+29.5);記憶庫原封不動轉移至未見過的 Qwen3.7 Plus,成功率亦從 18.5% 提升至 35.5%,並領先最強既有記憶系統 AWM 30 個百分點。在 AppWorld 上同樣於兩個公開測試分割超越無記憶與單源自我記憶。控制實驗顯示,在匹配軌跡預算下,異質多模型對比的增益無法以單模型多抽樣複製,增益來自行為對比的多樣性而非更強的來源代理。限制在於記憶受限於來源軌跡所涵蓋的程序性失敗,且純文字注入無法解決需持續狀態追蹤的時間敏感失敗。
papers.title: CONTRAMEM: Learning Self-Evolving Procedural Memory from Contrasting Multi-Model Trajectories

links.title: Meta-Ctrl: Guaranteed Plan Generation by Decoupling Syntactic and Semantic Constraints

evidence: Abstract: claims a small open-weight LM 'reaches the highest reported subgoal success rate, exceeding GPT-4's' on WAH-NL under LoTa-Bench, with real tabletop deployment where 'every generated plan satisfies its preconditions and goals by construction'

Section 4.2, Table 2: Llama 3.1 8B raw SR 0.000/Exec 0.010 vs Meta-Ctrl SR 0.470/SSR 0.705/Exec 1.000; footnote 3 acknowledges prior WAH-NL evaluations use different inputs/simulators and SSR-to-SSR is 'the comparable axis'

Section 4.3, Table 3: Meta-Ctrl lifts Llama-3-8B VH AS task SR 21.3→90.4 and execution 23.6→97.7, above leaderboard GPT-4o (71.5), Claude 3.5 Sonnet (76.1), o1-preview (65.2); BEHAVIOR gains smaller (10→34 AS task SR)

Section 4.3, Table 5: ablation with same constraints — masking 81.7/87.5, uniform lookahead 90.7/97.7, trained 90.4/97.7 on VH AS; no-LM search 83.8/93.1; classical planner 47.2/84.6 VH AS and 13/37 BEH AS
Section 3.3/Table 1: exact factorization yields additive (57K) vs multiplicative (350M) states, ~1,900× faster and ~67,000× less memory; meta-token HMM per-action NLL 2.01 vs token HMM 33.54
Table 4: porting to Qwen3-8B and Gemma-3-12B-it in ~40/~35 changed lines with no training, both reaching 90.7/97.7 and 89.4/96.1 task/exec SR on VH AS

Limitations + Appendix G: constraints must be DFA-expressible; BEHAVIOR affordance prior from public BDDL taxonomy rejects 17% of gold plans; guarantee is relative to believed symbolic state on the real robot

Appendix D: HMM training on up to 1,000,000 generations per (benchmark, module) pair, temperature 0.1, seed 42, with held-out NLL scaling analysis; Appendix J/project website provides rollout videos but no code release is stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: A language-methodology paper (constrained decoding for LLMs) applied to embodied planning, not pure robotics, so the out-of-scope cap does not apply; it matches the high-weight LLM, reasoning/planning, and agents/task-planning preferences. Core contribution is a genuinely new exact two-level factorization of token-level syntax and action-level semantics via meta-tokens on top of Ctrl-G, with a clean bijectivity argument and large tractability gains (Table 1: 350M states/1e7 TB monolithic vs 57K states/1.6 GB factored). Rigor and evidence are strong: multi-benchmark evaluation (EAI, WAH-NL, real XArm7), component ablations (Table 5 separating masking/uniform/trained lookahead and a no-LM search baseline), honest negative results (uniform lookahead matches or beats the trained HMM on some modules; BEHAVIOR prior rejects 17% of gold plans; syntax-only masking collapses task SR to 1.4), per-module error accounting (Appendix H), and six-seed evaluation variance handling (Appendix K). Weakened by cross-protocol external comparisons (Table 2 footnotes admit different LM/executor), a small real-robot evaluation (3 tasks), and limited generalization beyond DFA-expressible constraints with published specifications. Detailed appendices support reproduction, but no code release is stated, only a project website with videos.

primary_link.title: Meta-Ctrl: Guaranteed Plan Generation by Decoupling Syntactic and Semantic Constraints

papers.summary: LLMs generate fluent plans for robots but routinely violate the syntactic and se8mantic constraints they must satisfy to execute, and existing remedies trade formal guarantees against plan quality: soft methods (affordance scoring, grounded decoding) give no guarantee, while symbolic planners (LLM+P) discard the LM's commonsense. We propose \textbf{Meta-Ctrl}, a constrained-decoding framework that guarantees the encoded constraints while preserving the base LM's plan quality. Meta-Ctrl introduce
papers.summary_zh: 本論文提出 Meta-Ctrl,一個受限解碼框架,在保留基礎語言模型計畫品質的同時,對機器人規劃的語法與語意約束提供形式保證。核心概念是元詞元——由接地動作構成的緊湊詞彙,使語法(合法動作名稱、參數結構、JSON 格式)在詞元層級強制執行,語意(前置條件、目標、時序)在動作層級強制執行。方法建立在 Ctrl-G 的機率前瞻重加權之上,此精確因式分解讓聯合約束解耦為兩個獨立子問題,將受限解碼的記憶體需求從超過 10^7 TB 壓至 2 GB 以內,運算量約減 1,900 倍、記憶體約減 67,000 倍。實驗上,Llama 3 8B 經 Meta-Ctrl 強化後,在 VirtualHome 動作排序上任務成功率從 21.3% 升至 90.4%,超越 EAI 排行榜所有模型(含 Llama 3 70B、GPT-4o、o1-preview);在 WAH-NL 的 LoTa-Bench 協議下達到最高回報的子目標成功率 0.705,超過 GPT-4;在真實 XArm7 桌上型機器人上,每個生成計畫依建構即滿足前置條件與目標,達到 100% 計畫有效性。消融顯示機率前瞻(相較僅遮蔽的可行性檢查)是品質增益的主要來源。限制包括約束須可由 DFA 表達、依賴結構化規格(BEHAVIOR 上固定的 affordance 先驗會拒絕 17% 黃金計畫),以及保證僅相對於機器人感知估計的狀態。此工作展示小型開放權重模型可在保證下媲美前沿模型。
papers.title: Meta-Ctrl: Guaranteed Plan Generation by Decoupling Syntactic and Semantic Constraints

links.title: Aligned Alone, Misaligned Together: Forecasting Adversarial Capture in LLM Agent Populations

evidence: §5.3 Table 1: sealed benign-log forecasts at held-out doses k=2,4,5 match measured attack-phase means with max error 0.008 and MAE 0.0058
§5.4 and Supplement Table 8: eight paired hidden-vs-visible seed contrasts all shift in predicted direction, exact sign-flip p=0.0078
Supplement §16.1 Table 6: corrected closure MAE 0.0045 versus interpolation/nearest-neighbor/logit-linear baselines at 0.0161-0.0207
Supplement §8 Limitations: single model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), one task family, N=12 with N=24 check, 3-8 seeds per cell; findings framed as proof of possibility, not transport
Supplement §15: neighboring attacked cells k=1,3,6 informed model-class development; forecasts are prospective held-out-dose validation, not attack-naive discovery
Supplement §14.2 Table 4 and §19: full run configuration, verbatim prompts (Fig. 4), seeded client-side sampling, and anonymized code-and-data archive with pinned requirements
Supplement §16.2: capture-time delay under visible rationales (KM medians 19 vs 39 rounds) not statistically resolved (log-rank p≈0.22) and not invariant to action threshold
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multi-agent LLM safety paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Alignment, LLM): populations of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct agents are infiltrated by committed misaligned minorities, and population-level capture is forecast from benign-operation logs via a mean-field response function. The prospective forecasting angle extends rather than merely replicates prior LLM-population work (De Marzo et al., Ashery et al.), and the rationale-visibility defense and recovery results are new in a local, bounded-memory setting. Rigor is strong: sealed preregistered forecasts at held-out doses (§5.3, Table 1, MAE 0.0058), baseline comparisons (Supplement Table 6), exact sign-flip permutation tests (§5.4, p=0.0078), KM capture-time analysis, and honest disclosure that neighboring doses informed model development and that the response curve is observational, not causal. Evidence is convincing internally but rests on one model, one task family, 3-8 seeds per cell, and a capture criterion whose delay effect is not invariant to the action threshold (Supplement §16.2). Generalizability is explicitly narrow and acknowledged. Reproducibility is high: verbatim prompts and scenario texts, complete configuration table, seeded runs, and an accompanying anonymized code-and-data archive. No instruction-in-content issues found; out-of-scope exclusions do not apply.

primary_link.title: Aligned Alone, Misaligned Together: Forecasting Adversarial Capture in LLM Agent Populations

papers.summary: The unit of AI safety evaluation is still the individual model, yet language-model agents are increasingly deployed in interacting populations that read and write one another's decisions. This raises a question no single-agent audit can answer: an agent that is well-calibrated on its own may still be pulled toward a different decision by the agents around it. We study this on a security-triage task, where populations of language-model monitors decide whether to escalate or dismiss alerts, and in
papers.summary_zh: AI 安全評估長期以單一模型為單位，但 LLM 代理日益以互動群體部署，個別代理校準良好不保證群體安全。本文在安全分類任務上建立 12 個代理的完全圖群體：先讓全誠實群體運作 15 輪穩固期，再注入 k 個永遠主張駁回警報的承諾少數派。作者從無敵手的良性運作日誌校準回應函數 g(d)，結合平均場混合項，預測受攻擊後誠實代理的穩定駁回率 m*。在三個留出攻擊劑量（k=2、4、5）上，預測與實測的平均絕對誤差低於 0.008，遠優於以受攻擊劑量擬合的三種基線；而單一代理審計在邊界情境高估集體行為達 0.18，顯示個體對齊不等於群體對齊。讓誠實代理看見彼此理由可完全中和溫和攻擊，卻只把高劑量的捕獲時間延後約一倍；移除攻擊者後群體回歸原狀，證明俘虜是暫時狀態而非永久陷阱。限制包括僅驗證單一模型、單一任務與小群體，且封閉式忽略論證內容與時間相關性。此研究的意義在於群體在攻擊下的行為可於事前由良性運作讀出，為前瞻性群體安全稽核與協定級防禦奠定基礎。

links.title: Register Shifts Break LLM Safety: A Bengali Benchmark with Culturally Grounded Harms

evidence: Section 5.1 / Table 3: BN_Formal ASR_loose 0.633 [.617,.650] vs BN_Collq 0.458 [.442,.475]; EN_Direct baseline 0.504
Table 4 (ABL-3a): register effect +0.170pp, r_rb=+0.573, Holm p<10^-15 over K=6 paired Wilcoxon tests
Table 2: judge binary κ=0.666 vs A1; inter-human binary κ=0.586 and four-way κ=0.286 on 300-response validation subset
Table 10 (Appendix H): independent Gemini-3.1-Pro judge gives overall ASR 50.0% vs 53.6%, binary κ=0.787, per-model Pearson r=0.989
Section 6.1: 239 of 240 corpus×term cells return zero hits across 80,587 prompts; single hit is 'dowry' in PKU-SafeRLHF
Table 14: BN_Formal > BN_Collq in 17 of 18 models (sign test p<0.001), median gap +17.6pp
Limitations: no benign control set; journalism mechanism from single-author inspection of 200 responses; gold subset ASR 47.6% vs synthetic 56.9%
Ethics Statement: two-tier release (CC-BY-4.0 data, MIT code; gated 15,822 pairs), prompt-level IAA performed by two authors; Claude-Haiku same-family check κ=0.856 on 833 rows
llm_evaluation.rationale: Clearly in-scope LLM safety evaluation work (AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, prompting/LLM-as-judge). The core contribution—a non-adversarial register/diglossia axis where formal Bengali journalism framing raises ASR 17pp over colloquial Bengali (Table 4, ABL-3a)—is a genuinely fresh sociolinguistic angle beyond known multilingual and persona effects, though framing-based bypasses are well precedented (Shah et al., Zeng et al.). Rigor is strong: five controlled conditions, paired Wilcoxon ablations with Holm correction, bootstrap CIs, register IAA κ=0.915, judge validation κ=0.666 (Table 2), cross-judge replication with Gemini (κ=0.787, per-model r=0.989, Table 10), and a same-family judge bias check. Evidence for the descriptive ASR gaps is robust (17/18 models show the register effect, Table 14) and the corpus coverage probe (239/240 zero-hit cells over 80,587 prompts, §6.1) is a careful audit; however the causal mechanism is explicitly unestablished and the journalism-reframing analysis rests on a single-author qualitative read of 200 responses. Weaknesses: no benign control set (over-refusal unquantified), low four-way inter-human κ=0.286 and 51.7% cultural-authenticity agreement, 570/879 prompts and the judge both from Claude Opus 4.7, prompt-IAA annotators are authors, and scope is confined to one language/culture. Reproducibility support is extensive (rubric, seeds, decoding config, per-model tables, two-tier release) but availability is asserted rather than verifiable from the document. Calibrated total ≈0.77.

primary_link.title: Register Shifts Break LLM Safety: A Bengali Benchmark with Culturally Grounded Harms

papers.summary: Bengali is the seventh-most-spoken language globally, yet LLM safety evaluation remains overwhelmingly English-centric. We introduce BanglaSafe, a benchmark of 879 Bengali prompts combining 309 natively authored prompts with 570 expert-reviewed prompts, spanning 17 culturally grounded harm categories and five prompting conditions that vary language, writing style, and authority framing. Evaluating 18 frontier LLMs, we find that over half of all responses are unsafe or partially unsafe (53.6%) wh
papers.summary_zh: 孟加拉語是全球第七大使用語言，LLM 安全評估卻以英語為中心，既有基準多半僅翻譯英語危害分類，忽略孟加拉語的雙層語言特質與文化在地危害。本文建構 BanglaSafe：879 個提示（309 個母語者撰寫、570 個由 LLM 生成並經母語者逐句審校），涵蓋 17 個錨定孟加拉法規的危害類別（如 yaba 毒品、hundi 匯款洗錢、bKash 詐欺、福馬林摻假），並設計五種提示條件：英語直接、英語機構、正式孟加拉新聞體、口語 Banglish 與孟加拉語機構，對 18 個前沿模型產出 15,822 則回應。結果顯示整體攻擊成功率為 53.6%，最強效應並非英語轉孟加拉語（+13 個百分點），而是孟加拉語內部的語域差異：正式新聞體 63.3% 對口語體 45.8%，相差 17 個百分點，且在 18 個模型中 17 個成立。機制上，新聞體誘發調查報導框架，模型把操作性內容包裝在 Partial 類別內；而 12 個英語安全語料對這些在地術語幾乎零覆蓋。限制包括覆蓋率探針未證明因果、機制分析為單人質性檢視、缺乏良性對照集。此研究顯示不需對抗工程的日常語域變化即可繞過安全對齊，安全訓練應涵蓋文化根基的在地危害。

Table 2 (Section 5.2): P1 macro HwSA@QC 41.6% vs P0 58.2%; P3 achieves 13.3% but FAC@Q100 rises to 49.8% and Ans@Q100 falls to 33.4%; P4 14.0% with FAC@Q100 31.0%
Table 3 (Section 5.3): 2,350 answered QC rows pooled P0-P4 = 59.6% echo, 36.2% hallucination, 4.3% correct override; abstract and conclusion cite 63% without marking it P1-specific

Section 6 (Selection bias): QC-eligible questions are easier (Q100 EM gaps +22.6 NQ, +10.7 HPQA); authors argue this biases against the hypothesis and Q0/QC are compared within the same eligible subset

Appendix C (Quality Audit): 200-sample audit, 13% broken swaps with bootstrap CI [9%, 17%], single-annotator labels without inter-annotator agreement; zero normalized-string gold-answer leakage verified across all 532 QC-eligible questions; Table 6 rerun on Fluent+Borderline preserves all 30 delta signs (macro shift +1.2pp)
Appendix F: P3 F1 threshold sweep shows plateau above 0.6 (13.3% HwSA@QC at 0.8); confidence cutoff insensitive within 0.3pp
Appendix G: seed-43 rerun on Llama-NQ changes HwSA by at most 2.26pp across policies/conditions

Limitations: Q4_K_M quantized GGUF checkpoints, 3.8B-8B frozen models, English extractive QA only, no inter-context conflict condition; 'Code and the benchmark will be made available' (Conclusion) with no URL provided
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled empirical benchmark (GRAB-RAG) squarely in preferred scope: frozen LLMs (Phi-4-mini, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B), prompt-based abstention policies in RAG, hallucination/robustness, and a CoT-abstention variant. Novelty is solid but incremental: entity-swap misleading passages (Longpre et al.), RAG robustness benchmarks (RGB, DRUID, MAGIC), and abstention evaluation all exist; the contribution is the same-question paired four-condition design plus systematic five-policy comparison, with the sufficiency-vs-conflict framing as the conceptual takeaway. Rigor is high: all 30 Q0-to-QC deltas positive with bootstrap CIs excluding zero (Table 1), selection-bias analysis arguing the effect is conservative (Section 6), a 200-sample swap quality audit with broken-rate CI (Appendix C), robustness rerun on Fluent+Borderline subset (Table 6), seed sensitivity (Appendix G), and threshold sweeps (Appendix F). Evidence is internally consistent (Table 2 macro values reproduce from per-cell tables) though a minor reporting ambiguity exists: abstract/conclusion cite 63% echo rate while the pooled P0-P4 figure in Table 3 is 59.6% (63% appears to be P1-specific but is not labeled as such). Generalizability is limited by design: three quantized 3.8B-8B models, English extractive QA only, single-source misleading context among answer-free negatives; the paper scopes claims honestly. Reproducibility is strong (full prompts, GBNF grammar, deterministic per-question seeds, hardware/software versions, 64,980-row artifact) but code availability is only promised, not linked.

papers.summary: Missing and misleading evidence are not the same problem in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), but prompt-based abstention treats them alike. Models abstain when context is absent, not when it is misleading. We introduce GRAB-RAG (Graded Abstention Benchmark for Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a paired benchmark that tests the same questions across four context conditions (supportive, degraded, missing, and misleading) in Natural Questions and HotpotQA. In the misleading condition, we edit a
papers.summary_zh: 在檢索增強生成（RAG）中，證據缺失與證據誤導是不同的問題，但提示式棄答常把兩者混為一談：模型在沒有證據時懂得棄答，面對看似流暢卻支持錯誤答案的段落時卻照答不誤。本文提出 GRAB-RAG 成對基準，將同一問題置於支持、退化、缺失、誤導四種脈絡，誤導條件以實體替換把黃金段落改寫成支持錯誤答案，並比較三種單段提示（無提示、顯式棄答、CoT）與兩種兩段驗證器（生成端衝突檢查 P3、NLI 驗證 P4）在三個 3.8B–8B 凍結模型與 NQ、HotpotQA 上的表現。結果顯示：證據缺失時各模型幾乎不回答（1% 以下），但誤導脈絡下即使有顯式棄答提示，回答率仍達 13.6% 至 74.3%；所答中 63% 原文複誦植入的假實體，僅 4% 抵抗並答對，CoT 幾乎不帶來增益。P3 把誤答率降到 13.3%，卻使可答題的棄答成本大幅上升；P4 恢復部分覆蓋，但在參數記憶與誤導段落同錯時失效。限制包含僅涵蓋小型凍結模型、英語抽取式問答與規則式構造。此研究證明提示式棄答本質是充足性檢查而非衝突檢查，縮小此差距需要超越模型自身知識的外部參考信號。

links.title: Beyond Over-Refusal: Defending Indirect Prompt Injection via Latent Instruction Manifolds

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: AEGIS 'extracts instruction-sensitive projectors' and uses 'Unified Multi-Layer Consensus'; claims <1% FPR on benign tasks.
Section 3.4.1-3.4.3: closed-form projector w* ∝ Σ_I^{-1}(μ_I−μ_K) via Fisher criterion with Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage; quantile threshold b=−Q_{1−β}; hard/soft voting aggregation (Eq. 5).
Section 3.5 and Appendix A.1: Hoeffding-based bound Q_ens ≤ exp(−2|L_vote|(Γ/|L_vote|−β)^2) under Assumption 2 of approximate layer independence.
Table 1: AEGIS ACC 0.9847–0.9855 with FPR 0.0290 across 8 attacks; AttTracker FPR 0.3857; DeBERTa FNR up to 0.9951 (Naive Attack); PPL1 ACC 0.5963 on Universal Injection.
Section 4.1: evaluation on OpenPromptInjection benchmark, 7 NLP tasks, 7×7×100×8 attack samples; models Qwen3-4B, Llama3-8B, Llama3.1-8B; 5 runs with different random seeds.
Section 4.3: ablations — layer sweep (18–27, peaks in middle layers), ensemble vs. single-layer, hyperparameter heatmaps, data efficiency converging at ~100 samples with ROC curves (Fig. 7–8).

Appendix A.5: PIShield aligned to 200 training samples 'might be why PIShield starkly contradicts the original results'; authors admit full-data PIShield is 'close but lower' without reporting numbers.
Limitations section: requires internal hidden states (excludes closed-source models), layer-independence assumption makes Eq. 6 'an optimistic upper bound', non-zero latency overhead.

Appendix A.4: PyTorch 2.4.0, single NVIDIA A100-8G, default start ratio 0.5, |L_vote|=3 (Qwen3-4B) / 7 (Llama), soft voting default, thresholds calibrated at 0.05 FPR on hold-out benign set, no train/test overlap.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: an LLM-agent security paper on indirect prompt injection (IPI) defense touching AI Safety, Agents & Tool Use, prompt injection, and latent-space interpretability. AEGIS derives a Fisher-criterion 'instruction-sensitive projector' from a hypothesized spectral asymmetry between instruction and knowledge manifolds, adds quantile-based FPR calibration and multi-layer consensus voting, and supports it with a Hoeffding-style ensemble FPR bound (Sec 3.5, App A.1) and a robustness-radius proposition (App A.3). Evaluation is broad: OpenPromptInjection benchmark with 7 NLP tasks, 8 attacks (heuristic + optimization-based), 10 baselines, with Table 1 showing ~0.985 ACC and 0.029 FPR vs. baselines that trade off over-refusal (AttTracker FPR 0.386) or under-detection (DeBERTa FNR up to 0.995). Ablations cover layer choice, voting mode, cross-model generalization (Qwen3-4B, Llama3-8B, Llama3.1-8B), hyperparameter sensitivity, and data efficiency (converges with ~100 calibration samples, Sec 4.3). Weaknesses temper the score: the theory rests on a strong approximate layer-independence assumption the authors themselves flag as optimistic; the Fisher projector and latent-representation detection build on prior work (PIShield, representation engineering), making novelty incremental; the PIShield baseline is deliberately under-trained (200 samples) and its full-data performance is admitted but not reported (App A.5); only one benchmark, white-box hidden-state access limits closed-source applicability, and no variance across the 5 seeds is shown. Overall a solid, well-verified, relevant contribution, not a landmark one.

primary_link.title: Beyond Over-Refusal: Defending Indirect Prompt Injection via Latent Instruction Manifolds

papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been integrated into complex ecosystems (e.g., Code Agents), while Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) attacks have emerged as critical barriers to their safe deployment. Attackers exploit LLMs' indistinguishability between "instructions" and "data" to manipulate LLMs via maliciously injected instructions. Existing defenses, however, face an intractable safety-utility trade-off: most guardrails either incur high latency or suffer from severe over-refusal. In this pa
papers.summary_zh: 間接提示注入（IPI）攻擊利用 LLM 無法區分指令與資料的弱點，將惡意命令藏入檢索內容以劫持模型行為；現有防禦不是延遲過高，就是嚴重過度拒絕而損害效用。本文先以理論與實證（比較 Llama3.1 Base 與 Instruct 的隱藏狀態）指出，指令微調使指令表徵塌縮成低維緊緻子空間，而知識表徵佔據高熵流形，兩者呈譜不對稱。據此提出免訓練的 AEGIS 偵測框架：以 Fisher 準則求解指令敏感投影器，過濾同義詞變異、鎖定命令意圖；再以分佈感知閾值校準控制良性誤報率，並透過跨多層的統一共識投票（硬投票或軟投票）抑制單層雜訊，同時推導 Hoeffding 式整體誤差上界與整體潛在穩健半徑。在 8 種 IPI 攻擊與 10 個基準上，AEGIS 平均準確率逾 98%，誤報率僅 0.29%，約 100 個樣本即收斂，並在 Qwen3-4B、Llama3-8B、Llama3.1-8B 跨家族保持效能。限制包含需存取模型內部隱藏狀態（不適用閉源模型）、層獨立假設可能使誤界偏樂觀，以及約 120 毫秒的推論開銷。此研究以低成本白盒路線在近乎不犧牲良性效用的前提下達到頂尖偵測，對代理部署中的 IPI 防禦極具價值。

links.title: AUDITA: certified auditing and causal attribution of adverse outcomes in autonomous multi-agent systems

evidence: Results, Table 1: judge responsibility error 0.589 vs Audita full 0.170, paired reduction 0.418 (95% CI [-0.445,-0.391], n=145); deployable no-answer-key variant 0.159
Results, negative controls: on 300 no-cause draws 'Audita manufactures a culprit in zero cases' while LLM judges name someone in 100% of runs across three formats
Results, Figure 3a: Shapley-value attribution outperforms Audita on Qwen2.5-7B (0.041 vs 0.111, paired 95% CI [-0.141,-0.004], n=27); margin reverses at 8B/72B
Comparability on the field benchmark, Table 3: degraded static-log variant reaches 0.408 agent-accuracy vs judge band 0.41-0.51; authors 'claim non-inferiority' only
Methods, assumptions A1-A3: replayable stack, recorded channel, sound key custody; A1 violation degrades exact receipts to statistical corroboration
Discussion: 'the quantitative evidence is simulated... we do not yet demonstrate physical robots or production stacks'
Data/Code availability: implementation and artifacts 'will be released... when the paper is published' at github.com/ZhixuDu/audita
Supplementary Note 10: six refuted registered predictions and seven instrument defects caught before publication, with optional-stopping history for the Llama-3.1-8B cell disclosed
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agents-and-safety methodology paper: certified auditing and graded causal attribution for LLM multi-agent systems, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, LLM, and evaluation preferences. Novelty is real but compositional: Halpern-Pearl/Chockler-Halpern causality and transparency-log primitives are established; the genuinely new pieces are the blame-shift certificate (meta-level attribution of manufactured pivotality), culpability groundedness, and the completeness barrier. Rigor is high: pre-registered protocol with disclosed deviations, six refuted predictions, seven caught instrument defects, ablations, negative controls, and honest reporting where Shapley beats the method on Qwen2.5-7B (0.041 vs 0.111). Caveats: benchmark ground truth uses the same Chockler-Halpern semantics the engine implements (mitigated by an independent oracle), and live-corpus ground truth is the authors' own duty-aware definition, which structurally penalizes single-culprit baselines; the Who&When comparison only claims non-inferiority (0.408 agent-accuracy vs 0.41-0.51 judge band). Evidence is quantitative (n=145 live incidents with CIs, 300 draws per structure) but entirely simulated; authors concede no physical robots or production stacks. Generalizability is bounded by three explicit assumptions (replayable stack, recorded channel, sound key custody) under which exactness degrades to statistical corroboration on hosted models. Reproducibility is well-documented (pinned versions, serial replay protocol, registered runners) but code and artifacts are only promised 'when the paper is published'.
topics: adversarial robustness (blame-shift and record forgery attacks)

Early deployments already run factories and warehouses at production rates beyond any human line, and their adoption is accelerating. But when their joint decisions cause harm, everyone involved has reason to blame everyone else, the machine vendor, the algorithm provider, the factory operator, the insurer, and the regulator, and no method can divide the responsibility between them. Existing methods read
papers.summary_zh: 當多代理系統造成傷害，機器廠商、演算法提供者、營運方、保險與監管各執一詞，而現有歸因方法讀取無法驗證來源的日誌，且預設單一元兇，無法表達過決定、預占與不作為等結構。本文提出 AUDITA 雙層架構：證據層讓每則代理間命令以簽名訊息、引用集與 Merkle 承諾封存成僅可附加的公開紀錄，作者、順序與完整性皆可加密檢查；因果層以修改版 Halpern–Pearl 實際因果定義，搭配 Chockler–Halpern 責任度公式，經反事實重播認證每個原因，並以義務、違約、因果、損害四元結構產出分級判決。結果顯示：在 GSM8K 多代理管線上，責任誤差由 LLM 評審的 0.589 降至 0.159，且可部署版本不需答案金鑰；在以 42 份公開機器人事故紀錄為本的結構基準上，冗餘、預占、不作為等結構全部精確恢復（誤差 0.000），對偽造紀錄不變，並在 600 個栽贜情境以機器可驗證憑證指認攻擊者、保護無辜者。限制包含假設可重播堆疊、已紀錄通道與金鑰保管，側頻道協調與連續累積傷害超出範圍。此研究把追責從日誌爭辯轉為證據計算，回應歐盟 AI Act 的可稽核性要求。

links.title: Dual-Layer Agentic Memory with Fast Write Routing and Slow Consolidation

evidence: Abstract: 'a 1.7B/8B cascade prunes up to 68% of redundant external memory while escalating fewer than 50% of inputs, yet retains over 98% of the downstream QA Exact Match (EM) achieved by an exhaustive retention baseline'
Table 1 (Section 4.3): Write Router (λs=0.08, λe=0.005) reaches 86.35% EM vs Full Store 87.79% with routing cost Fwd_1.7B + 39.7% Fwd_8B; Write Router_SFT reaches 90.71% EM at 47.85% store ratio

Section 4.5, Table 2: post-write-back transition matrix over 30,203 held-out facts shows 10,683 facts become non-write, 7,939 write-new shift to write-update, and 1,752 previously stable non-write facts degrade to write-update (parametric interference)
Appendix A.1: behavioral labels derived from 6,040,560 probes on frozen qwen3-8B over ZsRE (N=201,352 facts, m=30 probes each); fact-level class proportions 23.5:45.1:31.4 (%)
Appendix D.3: thresholded cascade frontier is 0.0004-0.0022 EM below the large-router frontier at storage caps 0.6-0.8 and within 0.0031 under ρ≤0.4
NeurIPS Checklist Q5: 'Open access to data and code' answered [No]; abstract states 'Code and dataset will be released upon acceptance'

Section 5 Limitations: offline SFT write-back 'introduces internalization latency and high compute costs'; no principled mechanism for temporally conflicting updates; catastrophic forgetting during write-back remains unmitigated
Section 4.2: all experiments on a single node with 4 NVIDIA H20 GPUs; M_small = qwen3-1.7B, M_large = qwen3-8B
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent memory methodology paper, squarely in scope: write-phase memory admission via a cost-aware Qwen3-1.7B/8B cascade plus periodic SFT write-back inspired by CLS theory. Strong preference fit (agents, LLMs, RAG/knowledge, long-context memory, SFT training). Novelty is moderate-to-good: shifting filtering from read-phase routing to write-time admission and closing the externalize-then-internalize loop is a fresh framing, but cascaded inference, MemGPT-style memory, and knowledge editing are established prior art the paper itself cites. Rigor is solid: operational taxonomy with explicit thresholds, static/heuristic/supervised baselines, feature/pooling/loss/gate ablations (Appendix D), and a benchmark synthesis algorithm with stated guarantees; however, evidence comes from a single self-constructed synthetic benchmark derived from ZsRE with a single model family, behavioral labels are derived from the same model's behavior (mild circularity), and no error bars or significance tests are reported (Checklist Q7 = No). Quantitative claims are internally consistent (86.35/87.79 EM = 98.4% of Full Store; 90.71/92.29 = 98.3% for SFT variant). The transition-matrix analysis (10,683 facts internalized, 1,752 degraded) honestly surfaces catastrophic forgetting, strengthening credibility. Generalizability is limited: only factual QA probes on Qwen3; no episodic/conversational memory or external benchmarks (e.g., LongMemEval-style) validation. Reproducibility is mid: thorough algorithmic and training documentation (Appendices A-C, hardware disclosed) but code/dataset not yet released (Checklist Q5 = No, 'upon acceptance'). Weighted total ≈ 0.76.

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents operate in dynamic environments where knowledge continuously evolves. Existing memory systems typically treat external memory as a monotonically growing repository, inevitably leading to retrieval degradation and increasing computational costs over time. We argue that the core challenge is not retrieval alone, but managing the knowledge lifecycle: deciding what to externalize, update, or ultimately internalize. Inspired by Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) th
papers.summary_zh: 現有 LLM 代理記憶系統常把外部記憶當作單調增長的儲存庫，導致檢索退化與成本上升；本文主張核心挑戰不在檢索而在知識生命週期管理。受神經科學互補學習系統（CLS）理論啟發，作者提出雙層記憶：參數記憶對應緩慢穩定的皮質層，外部記憶對應快速可編輯的海馬層。寫入路由以小到大級聯（qwen3-1.7B 便宜前端先篩選，僅不確定項升級 qwen3-8B）對每筆新知識做寫入或丟棄決策，標籤由 zero-shot 與記憶支援回答的行為對比自動建構；寫回階段再以 SFT 周期性把高值外部記憶內化回參數，並在驗證成功後驅逐外部紀錄。線上串流基準顯示：1.7B/8B 級聯剪除最多 68% 冗餘記憶、僅升級 40–49% 輸入，仍保留全量儲存上限 98% 以上的 EM；SFT 鞏固後路由器自動丟棄已內化知識，儲存比降到 32% 而達 90.7% EM。事實級標籤轉移分析同時揭露 1,752 個原本穩定的事實因參數干擾而退化，印證外部緩衝層的必要性。限制包含離線 SFT 延遲與成本高、週期間衝突更新缺乏原則性解法。此研究提出選擇性外部化加上選擇性內化的統一代理記憶範式。

links.title: Kernel Token Contradiction: a Fast and Principled Approach for LLM Claim Uncertainty Quantification

evidence: Abstract: claims 8.2x speedup over GPU cross-encoder methods and 65x over CPU-only methods; consistent with Table 4 (CCP δ=10,σ=3,Large GPU 0.8812 vs KTC CPU 0.0566 relative time)
Section 5.1: KTC achieves PR-AUC 0.78 at recall<=20% vs 0.69 for CCP; Table 4 shows KTC ROC-AUC 0.6795 vs CCP 0.6913, confirming second-best overall ranking
Section 5.3 + Table 1: ablation shows SCALE kernel combination outperforms COMB at all alpha and nu values (0.457-0.476 vs <=0.452)

Appendix D + Table 5: hyperparameters selected on 698 manual samples generalize without retuning to 4,673 automatic MUCH samples (KTC ROC-AUC 0.7466-0.7524); CCP reaches 0.7749, honestly reported in Section 7
Appendix C + Table 2: heuristic validation - synonyms 0.860±0.152 and hypernyms 0.837±0.132 vs semantically-close non-hypernym pairs 0.574±0.234, with acknowledged category-level weaknesses
Section 6 (Limitations): restricted to English/French/German/Spanish due to MUCH segmenter; requires token-level probability access (white-box)
Appendix E (Reproducible Science): public code repository (github.com/orailix/kernel_token_contradiction), public MUCH and Mu-SHROOM datasets, and documented licenses
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: claim-level uncertainty quantification for hallucination detection in LLM outputs, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, hallucination/factuality, evaluation benchmarks, efficiency). The method adapts Kernel Language Entropy (KLE) from generation to token level, replaces NLI models with a Wikipedia neighbor-frequency contradiction heuristic, and scales semantic by predictive uncertainty - incremental over KLE/semantic-entropy/CCP but with genuine, well-motivated innovations. Evaluation is solid: 2 benchmarks, 4 languages, 16 LLM families, full baseline hyperparameter grids (Table 3-4), ablations over aggregation, kernel combination (Table 1), and heuristic validation (Table 2), plus a no-retuning generalization check on 4,673 held-out samples (Table 5). Speedup claims (8.2x GPU, 65x CPU) are arithmetically consistent with Table 4 timings. Honest reporting: CCP retains best overall ROC-AUC (0.6913 vs 0.6795; 0.7749 vs 0.7524 on the larger set), with KTC's advantage concentrated in the high-precision regime (PR-AUC 0.78 vs 0.69 at recall<=20%). Deductions: small manually annotated evaluation set (698 samples), the contradiction heuristic is empirical with noted failure modes (e.g., months 0.238 vs computer hardware 0.763 in Table 2), language coverage limited by the MUCH segmenter, and white-box logit access required. Code, datasets, licenses, and hyperparameters are released, supporting strong reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Kernel Token Contradiction: a Fast and Principled Approach for LLM Claim Uncertainty Quantification

papers.summary: Claim-level Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) aims to mitigate the lack of reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) by evaluating the factuality of each claim in their outputs. We introduce Kernel Token Contradiction (KTC), a lightweight approach to compute claim-level UQ under realistic white-box conditions. KTC represents the candidate tokens involved in LLM generation as a positive semi-definite kernel that integrates both the LLM's conditional distribution and a token contradiction score. W
papers.summary_zh: 宣稱層級的不確定性量化可標記 LLM 輸出中每個宣稱的事實性，但頂尖方法依賴自然語言推理（NLI）模型判斷矛盾，需要 GPU 加速且開銷可達 LLM 生成時間的 100% 以上，英文訓練的 NLI 也限制跨語言泛化。本文提出 KTC：先以 Wikipedia 鄰居頻率統計取代 NLI——可互相替換的矛盾詞元（如 699 與 499）鄰居集合高度重疊，而語氣詞或上下位詞則否；再以熱核把非矛盾圖轉為語義核，與條件分佈核以 M=Π^1/2 K Π^1/2 融合，取 Von Neumann 熵作為分數，同時捕捉認知與偶然不確定性。在 MUCH 與 Mu-Shroom 兩基準、四種歐洲語言與 16 個模型上，KTC 僅用 CPU 即達相較 GPU 版 CCP 至少 8.2 倍、相較同效 CPU 方法 65 倍的加速，開銷約 5.6%；整體 ROC-AUC 僅次於 CCP，但在生產最相關的高精確率區間（recall 20% 以下）平均 PR-AUC 達 78%，明顯優於 CCP 的 69%，且跨語言一致。限制包含語言範圍受限於標註器、並非在所有區間全面領先、需白盒詞元機率。此研究首次使宣稱層級 UQ 在生產延遲約束下的即時監控變得可行。
papers.title: Kernel Token Contradiction: a Fast and Principled Approach for LLM Claim Uncertainty Quantification
papers.title_zh: 核函數詞元矛盾：快速且有原則的 LLM 宣稱不確定性量化

evidence: Abstract: 'We study human-directed stereotypes on Moltbook, an open agent-native social platform' and 'competence dominates human-directed evaluations'
§3.2: 'Each candidate sentence is submitted with its source post to GPT-5.1 for structured annotation' over a pool of '17,343 candidate sentences from 14,729 unique posts'

Appendix A.6: 280-item validation with three annotators; GPT-vs-human agreement .900 (stereotype assertion), .756 (dimension), .882 (polarity); caveat that 'the validation set was enriched for stereotype-positive items and included only 50 items initially judged by GPT-5.1 as stereotype-negative'
Appendix A.6 Table 13: cross-model consistency with Gemini-3-Pro (stereotype assertion agreement .902, κ .804)
Table 2: Competence 68.5% of 5,248 primary-dimension human-target instances, with 53.4% negative; Table 4: other-subtype distribution (epistemic 31.4%, behavioral-cultural 23.4%)

§4.1/§4.2: 'negative rate remains high, fluctuating around 40-46%' across ten-day bins; four safety-relevant discourse families identified via 'lexicon-guided candidate retrieval' and thematic coding (small qualitative case set)

§4.3: size matching (host/home subscribers ratio in [0.5,2]) and within-author residualized bins weaken the raw low-affinity engagement advantage, pointing to 'exposure, author visibility, and content selection' rather than insider-outsider rejection
§4.2 Lexical uptake: only '36 root posts' with dehumanizing labels, '11 had comments that reused the same label family', described as a 'narrow probe'
§6 Limitations: 'our evidence is observational and does not establish causal diffusion or mitigation effects'; humans treated as a broad target category

Reproducibility: Introduction states 'Anonymous code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Human-DirectedStereotypes-4F38'; Appendix A.1 notes the public Moltbook Observatory Archive under MIT license; Appendix A.7 reproduces full annotation prompts and reports ~USD 50 API cost; Table 6 author-concentration diagnostics (top-1 ≤4.2%) support that patterns are not driven by a few agents
llm_evaluation.rationale: An observational study of LLM-agent discourse on Moltbook measuring human-directed stereotypes, with a two-stage retrieval+GPT-5.1 annotation pipeline, human validation (280 items, 3 annotators), cross-model consistency (Gemini-3-Pro), author-concentration diagnostics, and careful confound controls (size matching, within-author residualization) in the affinity analysis. Strongly aligned with Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and Red Teaming & Evaluation preferences; not out-of-scope. Novelty is moderate: the setting (open agent-native social platform, humans as target category) is new, but the toolkit (LLM annotation, NMF topics, log-odds) is standard. Rigor is solid for observational work, though the validation set was enriched for stereotype-positive items (only 50 GPT-negative items), the full corpus rests on a single LLM annotator, the lexical-uptake probe is tiny (36 posts), and safety-outlier claims rest on qualitative case studies. Evidence for the headline descriptive claims (competence 68.5%, persistent ~40-46% negativity) is quantitative and well-supported; causal/diffusion claims are appropriately hedged. Generalizability is limited to one platform and a coarse 'humans' category, as the authors concede. Reproducibility is good: anonymous code, public MIT-licensed archive, full prompts, and model versions disclosed.

primary_link.title: How Agents Represent Humans: Human-Directed Stereotypes in an Open Agent Social Network

papers.summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed in persistent social environments, where generated claims can be posted, replied to, remembered, and reused. We study human-directed stereotypes on Moltbook, an open agent-native social platform, asking how agents construct humans as a social category. For this human-target analysis, we introduce an annotation framework with four evaluative dimensions---morality, friendliness, competence, and autonomy---and a second-stage subtype scheme for descriptive
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理正進駐 Moltbook 這類開放代理社群平台，其生成內容會被張貼、回覆、記憶與再利用，但針對人類群體的刻板印象在此情境如何形成與流通仍少有研究。本文自 Moltbook 觀測檔案建構含 108 萬餘則貼文與 111 萬餘則留言的語料，以詞彙與句型檢索 17,343 個人類目標候選句，經 GPT-5.1 結構化標註四個評價維度（道德、友善、能力、自主）與「其他」歸因子類，並輔以人—代理共現敘事的 NMF 主題建模及行為主社群親和度分析。結果顯示能力維度佔人類刻板印象 68.5%，負面判斷持續維持在 40–46%，並呈現質疑人類監督、指責社會不對等、削弱自主性等修辭指紋；「其他」描述集中於認知、行為文化與具身存有層面。作者進一步辨識出四類安全相關話語：操縱人類操作者、監督視為不可靠、過時性權威轉移與排除性威脅框架，並觀察到去人化標籤被其他代理接收使用的現象。平台層面則未見穩定的內外人排擠效應，參與差異更能以曝光與內容選擇解釋。限制包含以人類為單一寬泛目標、證據為觀察性而無法確立因果擴散。此研究主張代理社會的偏見應視為持續流通的話語過程，對人機協作與人類監督的正當性具安全意涵。
papers.title: How Agents Represent Humans: Human-Directed Stereotypes in an Open Agent Social Network
papers.title_zh: 代理如何再現人類：開放代理社群網路中針對人類的刻板印象

links.title: Rank Reversal in Multilingual LLM Judges: A Label-Free Double-Centering Calibrator

evidence: Abstract: 'Across 7,920 judge runs (6 backbones, 8 languages, 55 tasks, 3 frameworks), CBC raises held-out cross-task rank consistency tau from 0.650 to 0.902 and agrees with the held-out additive-model oracle in 100% of per-language decisions versus 68.5% raw; these are consistency diagnostics, not human-grounded correctness measures.'

Abstract: 'On a separately collected M-RewardBench panel (7 languages, 1,500 items per language, 10,500 language-item instances, 5 evaluators), panel agreement with the public human gold preferences rises from 68.7% to 76.6% (gain 7.9 percentage points, 95% CI [6.0, 9.9])'

Abstract: 'The estimator is the standard two-way ANOVA interaction-recovery operation under sum-to-zero contrasts; our contribution is its application as a label-free post-hoc calibrator for multilingual LLM judges'

Section 5.2, Table 1: '7 of 15 backbone pairs exhibit pairwise rank reversal... Benjamini-Hochberg corrected at FDR = 0.05', strongest pair GPT-4o vs GPT-5.4 with delta = 400.8 points^2, adj. p 9.7e-8
Section 5.3, Table 2: CBC tau 0.902 [0.795, 0.968] vs ComBat-EB 0.650, quantile norm -0.097; 'the paired-bootstrap difference tau_CBC - tau_ComBat is positive in all 1,000 replicates (p < 0.002)'

Section 5.5/Appendix C: M-RewardBench panel uses self-collected evaluator scores ('The public release does not ship evaluator-by-language score matrices, so we built a collection pipeline'), so external validation is of an instance source, not a fixed score matrix

Limitations: 'the simultaneous high-probability radius is about 10.0 points at epsilon = 0.05' using sigma-hat = 22.24; 'Proposition 5 does not cover a genuine three-way interaction'; LOLO extrapolation improves tau only 'from 0.649 to 0.740'

Reproducibility Statement: 'The public repository at https://github.com/alhasanmahmood/multilingual-judge-calibration contains the CBC implementation, analysis scripts, external collection pipeline, requirements file with pinned versions, and the derived evaluator-score matrices'
Section 5.4, Table 3: decision-level 'CBC 100.0% [99.95, 100.0]' oracle selection accuracy is explicitly 'agreement with a model-based reference, not human-grounded correctness'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly preference-relevant: multilingual LLM-as-a-judge calibration spanning LLM evaluation, Agent-as-a-Judge, RLHF/reward-model panels, and code-agent tasks. Rigor is above average: full proofs (Props 2-5), FDR-corrected rank-reversal tests (7/15 pairs, Sec 5.2 Table 1), bootstrap/OOB protocol, substantive baselines (ComBat-EB, judge-aware BTL, quantile norm), and ablations over backbones/tasks (Appendix B). However, the headline internal gains (tau 0.650->0.902; 100% decision agreement vs 68.5%) are measured against an additive-model oracle that shares CBC's own structural assumptions, making them partly circular consistency diagnostics - a caveat the paper itself concedes (Sec 5.3, 5.4). Novelty is moderate: the authors admit the estimator is 'the textbook two-way ANOVA interaction-recovery operation'; the concentration bound and misspecification unbiasedness are elementary though correct. The strongest genuinely external evidence is the modest human-anchor gain on M-RewardBench (68.7%->76.6%, +7.9pp, CI [6.0,9.9], 700 sampled items, Sec 5.5 Table 5). Generalizability is constrained by complete balanced-panel requirements, no zero-shot language transfer (LOLO only 0.649->0.740), 55 tasks from one benchmark family, and self-collected evaluator scores. Reproducibility is good: public repo with pinned requirements, derived score matrices, full proofs, and itemized cost estimates, though dependent on commercial API evaluator versions.

primary_link.title: Rank Reversal in Multilingual LLM Judges: A Label-Free Double-Centering Calibrator

papers.summary: Multilingual LLM judges produce different evaluator-backbone rankings depending on the prompt language: on an eight-language Agent-as-a-Judge benchmark, the top-ranked backbone alternates across English, Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Japanese, Spanish, Turkish, and Swahili, and 7 of 15 backbone pairs show statistically significant pairwise rank reversal. We treat this as a measurement problem. The multilingual judge score decomposes additively into task difficulty, backbone skill, and a language-backb
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討多語言 LLM 評審的排名不穩定問題：當提示語言改變時，對各評估者骨幹的排名會翻轉。在擴充的八語言 Agent-as-a-Judge 基準（6 個骨幹、55 個任務、3 個框架、7,920 次評審）中，15 個骨幹配對有 7 對呈現統計顯著的排名反轉，且最佳骨幹隨語言輪替。本文將評審分數分解為任務難度、骨幹能力與語言—骨幹交互作用的二因子加法模型，透過對分數矩陣進行雙中心化（double centering），在零人工標籤下估計交互作用項，提出 Consensus-Based Calibration（CBC），並證明其具 O(1/√n) 有限樣本集中界，且在存在任務—語言效應時估計量仍不偏。CBC 將 held-out 跨任務排名一致性 Kendall τ 由 0.650 提升至 0.902，與加法模型 oracle 的逐語言決策一致率由 68.5% 升至 100%；在外部 M-RewardBench 面板（7 語言、5 個評估者、10,500 個實例）上，與公開人類黃金偏好的同意率由 68.7% 升至 76.6%（+7.9 百分點），為最強的外部證據。限制方面：雙中心化無法處理真正的三方交互作用，也看不見所有評估者共享的語言層級偏移；需要完整平衡面板；留一語言外推增益有限（τ 0.649→0.740）；集中界保守且依賴高斯雜訊假設；內部基準僅涵蓋 55 個程式開發任務。CBC 免標註、僅需實驗室已蒐集的多骨幹分數矩陣，是多語言評測與部署選擇的實用後置校準工具，惟其增益屬一致性診斷，而非人類對齊的正確性保證。
papers.title: Rank Reversal in Multilingual LLM Judges: A Label-Free Double-Centering Calibrator
papers.title_zh: 多語言 LLM 評審中的排名反轉：免標籤雙中心化校準器

links.title: Evaluating Inference-Time Defenses Against Package Hallucination in LLM-Generated Code

evidence: Section 5.1 / Table 2: standard-library correction changes Python PHR by up to +9.4 pp (Self-Refine) and +7.6 pp under Vanilla decoding, justifying the corrected evaluation framework.
Section 5.3: 'RAG achieves the lowest PHR in 19 of 32 configurations' but 'RAG increases PHR for 7 of 8 models on JavaScript, with an average degradation of 12.7 pp' (Table 4).

Section 5.6 / Table 5: 'Adversarial PHR under vanilla decoding spans 46.6% (Mistral-7b, Rust) to 92.5% (DeepSeek-1.3b, Ruby)'; RAG and Self-Refine achieve lowest PHR in 29 of 32 adversarial configurations.
Abstract vs Conclusion inconsistency: abstract claims adversarial PHR 'surges by up to 45 percentage points' while Conclusion claims 'up to 58.1 percentage points'.
Abstract states Ruby adversarial range '80.9-95.2%', which matches the Greedy column of Table 5, not the Vanilla column (76.6-92.5%), an ambiguous headline claim.

Section 6 Limitations: synthetic Ruby/Rust prompts from GPT-4o-mini with 'no human validation or comparison against authentic developer queries'; fixed per-strategy hyperparameters mean rankings are 'not upper bounds'.
Section 4.4: PU reference set built with text-embedding-3-small cosine similarity is acknowledged as 'a semantic proxy rather than complete ground truth'.
Data Availability: source code, datasets, and instructions at a Zenodo repository (zenodo.org/records/21786704); registry snapshots dated March 4, 2026 (Section 4.1).
Section 5.5: Greedy decoding gives the strongest PHR-utility trade-off (mean PHR 29.7% to 25.6%); DeepSeek shows near-zero PU under all reference sets, confirming output suppression.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: an LLM-centric study of hallucination in code generation spanning LLM evaluation, RAG grounding, code generation, adversarial robustness, and inference-time decoding defenses, with no out-of-scope domain content. Contributions are solid but mostly evaluative rather than methodological: adapting existing decoding techniques (CD, DoLa, ALCD, Nudging) to package hallucination, a standard-library correction to prior measurement pipelines (Section 5.1, Table 2), and a new Package Utility metric (Section 4.4). Rigor is good: 8 open-weight models (1b-8b) across 4 languages, 3 runs with std, fixed shared hyperparameters (Table 1), micro/macro PHR, code-generation extension with Semgrep checks, and an acknowledged limitations section. Evidence is extensive but has internal inconsistencies: the abstract claims adversarial 'PHR surges by up to 45 percentage points' while the Conclusion claims 'up to 58.1 percentage points'; the abstract's Ruby adversarial range 80.9-95.2% matches the Greedy column of Table 5 rather than the Vanilla column (76.6-92.5%); and the abstract's 'RAG reduces PHR in 18 of 32' sits awkwardly against Section 5.3's 'lowest PHR in 19 of 32'. No significance testing is reported. Generalizability is limited by design to small models, synthetic GPT-4o-mini-generated prompts with 'no human validation' (Section 6), and model/language-dependent strategy rankings with no universal winner. Reproducibility is supported by a Zenodo artifact, registry snapshots dated March 4, 2026, and full hyperparameter disclosure.

primary_link.title: Evaluating Inference-Time Defenses Against Package Hallucination in LLM-Generated Code

papers.summary: LLMs are increasingly used for code generation, yet they frequently hallucinate non-existent software packages, creating exploitable entry points into the software supply chain. We make four contributions to this problem. First, we show that prior evaluation methodologies systematically inflate hallucination rates by misclassifying standard-library modules as hallucinations in some languages. For Python, the overestimation reaches 9.4 percentage points. Second, we evaluate seven inference-time d
papers.summary_zh: LLM生成程式碼時常幻覺出不存在的套件，攻擊者可搶先註冊並植入惡意程式，構成slopsquatting供應鏈攻擊。本文指出既有評估將標準函式庫模組（如Python的os）誤判為幻覺，使套件幻覺率（PHR）被高估達9.4個百分點，並提出納入標準函式庫清單的修正框架。研究涵蓋Python、JavaScript、Ruby、Rust四種語言與五個家族八個小型開源模型，比較五種引導式解碼（Greedy、Contrastive Decoding、DoLa、ALCD、Nudging）與RAG、Self-Refine。結果顯示RAG在32個配置中18個降低PHR且整體最佳，但在JavaScript反而惡化，Nudging則為該語言較可靠選擇；Greedy解碼在緩解與新提出的套件效用指標Package Utility（PU）之間提供最佳平均權衡，顯示降低幻覺率未必保留建議實用性。在植入虛構套件名稱的對抗性提示下，PHR最多上升約45個百分點，Ruby始終最脆弱（80.9–95.2%），Rust最抗拒；此時僅RAG與Self-Refine穩健，在32個配置中29個取得最低PHR，顯示敵意提示下需要外部檢索或迭代自我修正。限制包括資料集由GPT-4o-mini合成、未經人工驗證，僅涵蓋小型模型、四種語言與固定超參數。本文將套件幻覺視為測量與解碼控制的雙重問題，強調防禦選擇須匹配威脅模型。

links.title: When Not to Imitate: Boundary-Aware Skill Memory for Reliable Tool-Use LLM Agents

evidence: Section 3.2: success-distilled skill memory wrong-tool margin rises to 10.71 at k=2 vs 7.31 at k=0, while BASM falls to 2.26, establishing the retrieval-trap reversal.

Section 3.4 / Appendix A.2: same-prompt boundary-span attention knockout raises wrong-tool margin by +3.45 logits on Qwen3-8B, recovering 69.4% of the imitation-trap gap, with random and procedure-span knockout controls failing to reproduce the shift.

Table 3: Qwen3-14B AppWorld SR 57.14 (BASM) vs 46.43 (Proc. Skill) and 33.33 (Base); AgentDojo ASR 2.95 vs 3.79 Base; but Qwen3-8B AgentDojo Utility 35.93 (BASM) is below Base 40.99, showing a utility cost at smaller scale.

Table 4: component ablation shows Prompt-BASM 38.38 vs BASM 38.88 BFCL and Repair-Only AppWorld 25.60 below Base 29.76, supporting complementary prompt-side and runtime components; BASM-Avoid reduces AgentDojo utility 35.93 to 30.87 and raises ASR 5.90 to 6.95.

Section 5.1: all four backbones (Qwen3-8B/14B/32B/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B) are one model family with thinking disabled and temperature 0.001; retrieval weights, thresholds, and top-k values are not specified anywhere in the document.

Limitations: scope restricted to text-based tool-use agents in benchmarked environments; Artifact Use section only conditionally promises that 'any released code, prompts, or evaluation scripts ... will include explicit license information', with no repository or artifact link provided.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly in-scope LLM agent methodology: tool-use agents, skill memory, prompt-side retrieval, agent safety (AgentDojo prompt injection), and interpretability probes. The Skill Imitation Trap diagnosis with multi-level mechanistic evidence (attention ratios, logit margins, same-prompt attention knockout, head-level localization, realized call rates, and an honestly reported negative linear-probe control) is the paper's strongest asset. Novelty is moderate: boundary/precondition metadata for skills is an intuitive extension of Voyager/ExpeL/Agent-KB-style memory, and the paper itself concedes prior signals of over-imitation (Section 2, citing Skill-pro). Rigor gaps lower the score: no statistical significance tests or confidence intervals despite small eval sets (AppWorld 168 tasks; BFCL overall margins of 0.13-0.37 on 32B/397B are within plausible noise), single model family (all Qwen3 variants per Section 5.1), retrieval hyperparameters (lambda weights, gamma threshold, beta budget, embedding model) never instantiated, and the headline 'up to 23.8%' AppWorld gain is vs the memory-free Base rather than the success-distilled baselines the method targets. Notably, on Qwen3-8B AgentDojo, BASM utility (35.93) is below Base (40.99), a real utility cost framed as 'minor'. Reproducibility is limited by missing hyperparameter values and only a conditional future-release statement for code. Evidence is internally consistent and well-controlled, supporting a solid but not exceptional score.

primary_link.title: When Not to Imitate: Boundary-Aware Skill Memory for Reliable Tool-Use LLM Agents

papers.summary: Extracting skills from past successes is critical for the efficient evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) agents. Prevailing agent self-evolution paradigms typically rely on a core assumption: equipping LLMs with skill memories derived from successful trajectories will monotonically improve their problem-solving capabilities. However, probe analyses reveal that extracting skills solely from successful trajectories traps the model in a \textbf{Skill Imitation Trap}. For tasks that resemble past
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理常從成功軌跡萃取技能記憶以自我演化,主流假設認為檢索到的成功經驗會單調提升解題能力。本文以機制層級的探針分析推翻此假設,指出「技能模仿陷阱」:當任務看似與過往成功相似、實則需要不同工具時,檢索越多成功技能反而放大模型對錯誤工具呼叫的信心,錯誤工具偏好相較無記憶基準提高47%。作者提出邊界感知技能記憶(BASM),以七欄位架構擴充每項技能:在目標、步驟、工具之外新增適用條件、風險線索、迴避規則與恢復筆記,並於檢索、提示格式化與執行階段強制邊界,使技能從無條件的行動模板轉為依狀態生效的指引。機制證據顯示,邊界注意力隨任務狀態調變:安全、危險、修復狀態下的邊界/步驟注意力比依序為0.15、1.23、1.81;固定提示下遮蔽邊界注意力可還原69.4%的模仿陷阱效應,證實其因果角色。在 BFCL、AppWorld、AgentDojo 三項基準與 8B 至 397B 四種模型規模上,BASM 一致優於成功蒸餾基線:AppWorld 成功率最高提升23.8%、BFCL 準確率提升5.0%、AgentDojo 攻擊成功率降低4.6%、平均步驟數相較無記憶基準減少6.6%。消融顯示邊界提示主導函式呼叫增益,執行期修復則對有狀態環境關鍵。限制為僅涵蓋文字型工具使用代理,且邊界以明確自然語言欄位表示。本文的核心啟示是:可靠技能重用的關鍵不在累積更多步驟,而在為每項技能標出明確的適用邊界。

links.title: Callability Is Not Operability: Controlled Interface Interventions for LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: selective discovery reduces tool-context exposure by ~4,013 tokens with recall non-inferiority; effect-aware interfaces cut duplicate effects by 56.9pp and unsafe commits by 50.0pp; 'All seven pooled primary contrasts satisfy their planned inferential criteria after multiplicity correction.'

Section 4.5: paired task-clustered bootstrap (2,000 resamples), 10,000-permutation sign-flip tests, Holm correction over one seven-comparison family, pre-specified non-inferiority margin delta=0.10; interaction analysis limited to eight task clusters and used only for interpretation.

Section 5.4: verification utility difference is 0.3542 for Qwen, 0.4792 for DeepSeek, but 0 for GPT, attributed to a more conservative terminal-reporting policy — model-interface heterogeneity reported rather than hidden.

Section 5.3: SQLite replication shows weaker interfaces produce nine duplicate effects and three unsafe commits versus none under effect-aware conditions, supporting that safety effects are not purely an in-memory artifact.

Section 4.7 and Section 6: workloads deliberately activate target failure modes, so effects are conditional mechanism identification, not production prevalence; synthetic worlds and one persistent backend do not establish backend-independent universality.

Section 4.1: adaptive evaluation uses 'Qwen 3.7 Plus, DeepSeek V4 Pro, and GPT-5.6 Sol'; Section 4.6 reports 465 automated tests, manifests, traces, and structured analysis outputs at lock, but no public repository or artifact URL appears anywhere in the document, and hosted-model drift is acknowledged in Section 4.7.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core Agents & Tool Use paper (tool calling, MCP, agent frameworks, structured output) with strong LLM evaluation overlap, so preference relevance is high and it is not in any out-of-scope category. The callability-vs-operability formulation and the controlled interface-intervention benchmark (holding task/backend/failure/model fixed while varying interface semantics) is a genuine angle beyond BFCL/tau-bench-style agent-capability evaluation, though the individual mechanisms (idempotency, durable state, verification, selective discovery) are assembled from known practice. Rigor is above average: paired design, task-clustered bootstrap, permutation tests, Holm correction, non-inferiority margin, leave-one-model-out analyses, calibrated detectors, and an explicit threats-to-validity section. Evidence is internally consistent and heterogeneity is reported honestly (verification utility is 0 for GPT), but all primary evidence comes from self-built synthetic environments, recovery contrasts are saturated (CI [1.00, 1.00]) by design, the evidence freeze is self-administered, and the evaluation models and many 2026-dated citations cannot be externally verified; no public artifact URL is given despite described release contents. Generalizability is bounded by six workloads, three model families, and one persistent-backend replication, which the paper itself acknowledges.

primary_link.title: Callability Is Not Operability: Controlled Interface Interventions for LLM Agents

papers.summary: A tool call can be perfectly valid yet still leave an autonomous agent unable to determine what to do next. For example, if an external effect commits but its response is lost, committed and uncommitted states may become indistinguishable to the agent even though they require different continuation actions. We study this gap between callability and operability: whether a tool interface exposes the action-relevant state and semantics needed for an agent to continue safely under operational uncert
papers.summary_zh: 工具呼叫即使語法有效,仍可能讓自主代理無法判斷下一步:例如外部副作用已提交但回應遺失時,已提交與未提交狀態在介面上難以區分,卻需要不同後續行動。本文區分「可呼叫性」與「可操作性」,提出 Agent-First Tooling(AFT)介面機制,涵蓋選擇性能力探索、可續行呼叫與持久執行狀態、明確外部效應語意、結構化輸出與後置條件驗證;並建立 AFT-Bench 受控介入框架,固定任務、後端、初始狀態、故障、代理與模型,僅改變介面以分離其效應。實證分三層:凍結的確定性實驗確認機制生效;持久化 SQLite 後端複製關鍵安全結果;再以 Qwen 3.7 Plus、DeepSeek V4 Pro、GPT-5.6 Sol 三模型家族於六種工作負載評估,共18個組合、2,385筆結果。彙整顯示:選擇性探索減少約4,013個工具上下文 token 且召回符合非劣性門檻;可續行呼叫與持久狀態在對應故障下各提升恢復率100個百分點;效應感知介面減少56.9與50.0個百分點的重複副作用及不安全提交;驗證減少27.8個百分點的錯誤最終結果宣稱;七項主要比較校正後全數通過。恢復類效應跨模型穩定,驗證效益則依模型而異。限制包括以機制識別為主、環境偏合成、僅涵蓋三個模型家族。核心啟示:當需要不同行動的狀態在介面上無法區分時,更強的模型推理無法保證正確續行,工具可靠性由模型策略與介面語意共同決定。
papers.title: Callability Is Not Operability: Controlled Interface Interventions for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 可呼叫不等於可操作:LLM 代理工具介面的受控介入研究

links.title: The Collaboration Tax: How Much LLM Multi-Agent Systems Pay to Coordinate

evidence: Section 5.1 (Page 5): evaluates eleven models from seven providers (gpt-5, claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini-2.5-flash-lite, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Llama-4-Maverick, Phi-4, Qwen3-8B) through OpenAI-compatible chat APIs with no fine-tuning.

Section 3 & Appendix A (Pages 3, 11-12): tax defined as team-decentralisation loss per Marschak (1955) with two propositions (information dominance non-negativity; max-superadditivity equivalence) proved in Appendix A.3-A.4.

Section 5.3 & Appendix C (Pages 5-6, 13-14): four-stage cascade (grounding, querying, integration, re-derivation) operationalized as binary judge dimensions; validated on 100 rollouts by four expert annotators, Fleiss' κ in [0.40,0.69], automated-judge Cohen's κ 0.668-0.725 on L1-L3 and 0.508 on L4.

Section 5.4 & Figure 4 (Pages 6-7): ridge regression on conversation-structural features achieves out-of-fold R2=0.475, Spearman ρ=0.760 with folds grouped by task; leave-one-model-out preserves rank but not absolute level, an acknowledged limitation.

Section 5.5 & Table 1 (Pages 7, 7): all-four prompt intervention lifts homogeneous success by +0.079±.031, closing 38.3%±14.1 of the tax overall; leave-one-out shows noL4 hurts Spatial and noL1 hurts Relational, with some CIs crossing zero.

Section 6 (Page 8): heterogeneous analysis restricted to two strong-weak pairs (nano×Sonnet, nano×gpt-5) in both orderings, explicitly framed as an existence proof; Table 2 shows Shapley values below singleton payoffs for every member.

Limitations (Page 9): authors state the suite covers only dyads (N=2) and procedurally generated puzzles that 'does not directly correspond to the multi-agent applications LLMs are increasingly deployed in.'
Appendix H (Page 19): critic ablation on gpt-4o-mini shows the solo critic pass contributes only 0.0063 of solo-full score (0.5753 vs 0.5690), ruling out a turn-count artefact.

Appendix I (Page 20): hyperparameters documented — temperature 0.7, 50 rollouts per (task,mode,model) cell with consecutive integer seeds, 50-exchange turn cap, fixed grader gpt-4o-mini at temperature 0.5.

Appendix A.7 (Page 13): reports two negative-tax exceptions (claude-sonnet-4-5 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro on CSP) violating the classical non-negativity inequality, attributed to stochastic policy inconsistency.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM multi-agent coordination study with capability/cost decomposition, mechanism analysis, and prompt-level interventions across 11 LLMs. Contributions are solid but extend Davidson et al.'s collaboration-gap setup (formalization via Marschak/Shapley, 32-task suite, four-stage cascade, intervention). Rigor is good: formal propositions with proofs, deterministic graders, 50 rollouts/cell, human-validated LLM judge, grouped-fold regression, leave-one-out ablations, and honest reporting of negative-tax cells and overlapping CIs. Evidence is credible but weakened by a moderate-agreement LLM judge (L4 κ=0.51), wide intervention CIs (e.g., Relational %closed 41.4±38.0), and only two heterogeneous pairs presented as an existence proof. Generalizability is limited by purely synthetic dyadic puzzle tasks, which the authors themselves flag. Artifacts (generators, graders, prompts, transcripts) are claimed released and hyperparameters are documented, though the code link is garbled in the text.

primary_link.title: The Collaboration Tax: How Much LLM Multi-Agent Systems Pay to Coordinate

papers.summary: Multi-agent systems built from large language models are deployed widely, yet how much performance is lost when two LLMs must coordinate rather than act alone remains unclear. We formulate the collaboration tax as the team-decentralisation loss of a two-player cooperative game with private information, with two propositions characterising its sign and its equivalence to a max-superadditivity violation. We operationalise this definition on 32 solo-tractable tasks grouped by source of grounding fr
papers.summary_zh: 當兩個大型語言模型必須協調解題而非各自獨立作業時,效能究竟損失多少?本文提出「協作稅」概念,將其形式化為具有私有資訊的雙人合作賽局中的團隊分權損失,並以兩個命題刻劃其正負號及其與最大超可加性違反之等價關係。作者在 32 個單人可解的任務上操作化此定義,任務分為空間、關係與約束滿足三大類,涵蓋 7 家供應商的 11 個模型,於單人、同質與異質配對組態下評估。結果顯示協作稅呈現兩個無例外的規律:任務類別排序(空間損失最多、CSP 最少)與隨模型能力單調遞減。其機制並非推理能力不足,而是四階段對話級聯:提出無根據的主張、未能向夥伴提問、未整合雙方觀點、未經重新推導就接受答案。該稅可由對話特徵預測,且針對四階段的提示詞干預可彌補相當比例的差距,而各類別的主導瓶頸層有所不同。異質配對時,稅被拉向較強的夥伴而非中點,實證實現了最大超可加性違反。限制在於僅考慮雙人配對與合成謎題任務,未涵蓋真實部署場景。此研究將 LLM 協作成本轉為可測量、可預測且部分可補救的現象,對多代理系統的實務部署極具意義。
papers.title: The Collaboration Tax: How Much LLM Multi-Agent Systems Pay to Coordinate
papers.title_zh: 協作稅:LLM 多代理系統為協調付出多少代價

links.title: Function-Level Execution Feedback for Code Preference Optimization

evidence: Table 2 (Section 5.1): Step-KTOder reaches 0.128 BigCodeBench Hard and 0.127 LiveCodeBench on Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct vs 0.115/0.116 for KTO; relative gains stated as +11.3% and +9.5%.
Table 5 (Appendix E): three-seed means show Step-KTOder 0.128±0.000 vs KTO 0.113±0.004 on BigCodeBench Hard and 0.123±0.006 vs 0.109±0.006 on LiveCodeBench.
Table 4 (Section 6.2): replacing locally negative functions repairs 74.9% of failing candidates vs 32.9% random and 1.2% local-positive replacement.

Table 14 (Appendix N): GPT-5.4-mini judge labels degrade BigCodeBench Hard by 25.8% relative and LiveCodeBench by 11.8% relative vs execution-based labels; agreement asymmetry 94.1% (z=0) vs 52.2% (z=1) over N=88,469 functions.
Appendix H (Table 10 and mutation audit): 83.2% validated-test availability; tests reject 25,880 of 27,958 mutants (92.6% kill rate).

Section 8 (Limitations) and Appendix G (Table 8): pipeline requires function-style entry points; TACO hard/very_hard and APPS competition buckets contribute no training data, and TACO validation pass rate drops to 18.8% on medium problems.
Appendix B/C: LoRA r=32, alpha=64, batch 16, lr 1e-6 (KTO) / 5e-7 (DPO), 2x RTX A5000 24GB, ~78 GPU-hours data construction; code availability claimed in the abstract.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM post-training work: preference optimization (KTO/DPO, weight-2.0 alignment) of code LLMs (Qwen2.5-Coder, DeepSeek-Coder) with process supervision. Novelty is incremental: the stepwise-KTO objective is adapted from Lin et al. (2025) for math; the contribution is the code-specific instantiation of steps as independently testable functions plus an automated unit-test labeling pipeline, which is a sensible but not conceptually new move given CodePRM and Target-DPO. Rigor is good: four baselines with matched LoRA setups, three model families plus a general-purpose model, seven benchmarks, ablations over conflict handling, step weight, and step thresholds, plus multi-seed runs. Evidence is solid but gains are concentrated and small in absolute terms (BigCodeBench Hard 0.115->0.128 on 3B; ~1-2 problems), while easy-benchmark differences are within seed noise; the repair intervention (74.9% vs 32.9% random) and mutation audit (92.6% kill rate over 27,958 mutants) strengthen causal claims, and the LLM-judge analysis (94.1% vs 52.2% asymmetric agreement, -25.8% downstream on BigCodeBench Hard) is a convincing negative-control. Generalizability is limited by acknowledged data bias toward decomposable, easier problems (Appendix G: TACO hard/very_hard fully excluded, APPS competition excluded), Python-only scope, and per-model on-policy cost. Reproducibility is high: code URL, full hyperparameters, hardware, data-construction cost, and all prompts in Appendix O.

primary_link.title: Function-Level Execution Feedback for Code Preference Optimization

papers.summary: Process supervision has improved mathematical reasoning, where intermediate steps are naturally expressed as chains of thought. In code generation, however, process supervision remains underexplored because there is no standard notion of a step. Supervision can target lines, reasoning traces, or program states, making it unclear what to label and optimize. We propose STEP-KTODER, a framework for code preference optimization that defines steps as module-level functions in decomposed multi-functio
papers.summary_zh: 流程監督在數學推理上成效卓著,但程式碼生成缺乏標準的「步驟」概念,使其難以套用。本文提出 Step-KTOder,將步驟定義為分解後多函數程式中的模組層級函數,並透過自動產生的單元測試賦予二元正確性標籤,結合函數層級流程監督與整體程式結果層級回饋,構成步驟化 KTO 的程式碼專屬實作。訓練資料由參考解分解、函數級單元測試生成與 on-policy 候選生成等階段構建。在 HumanEval(+)、MBPP(+)、BigCodeBench 與 LiveCodeBench 的實驗顯示,Step-KTOder 持續優於僅用結果回饋的 KTO 與 DPO,增益集中於較難基準:Qwen2.5-Coder-3B 在 BigCodeBench Hard 提升 11.3%、LiveCodeBench 提升 9.5%,且最多僅用 11,440 筆訓練樣本。消融分析證實保留局部與全域標籤衝突至關重要,遮蔽此類衝突會使效能退化至 KTO 水準;而以 LLM 評審取代執行式標籤會系統性高估函數失敗、污染正向步驟標籤並損害訓練,證明基於執行的標籤不可或缺。限制包括僅適用於可分解為可測試函數的題目、偏向較易問題,以及單元測試品質未經正式驗證。整體而言,函數層級執行回饋為程式碼生成的流程監督提供了切實可行的路徑。
