links.title: Coalition-Aware Skill Reliability for Self-Evolving Agents

evidence: Abstract: proposes CASS (sampled Shapley marginals for skill acceptance) and u-SMCO (label-free skill masking) after SMRA audits; states 'Our audit toolkit, method code, and trained checkpoints will be released' (promise only, no link).
§5.1: base framework is MemSkill with skill-extraction policy agent Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, all experiments on 8×H20 GPUs, mean±std over three seeds; CASS differs from MemSkill only in the gate.
§3.2/Table 1: gate admits B3→B4 on margin +0.006; audit finds newly accepted capture_activity_preferences Δ=-0.005 (non-contributing) while insert carries the bank at Δ=+0.084 (95% CI excludes zero).
§3.3: insert reverses from +0.084 on LoCoMo to -0.035 on HotpotQA with a 95% CI including zero; authors explicitly 'read the target side as a directional reversal rather than significant harm.'

Theorem 1 (§3.2): a positive bank-level gain does not identify whether the bank contains a negatively contributing skill; Appendix A.1 constructs two banks with identical endpoints and opposite member signs.

Table 2 (§5.2): Ours avg 35.76 (conversational F1/L-J) vs MemSkill 34.74, and ALF avg SR 79.66 vs 77.05; LongMemEval F1 30.03 vs 30.02 shows near-tie; baselines include CoN, ReadAgent, MemoryBank, A-MEM, Mem0, MemoryOS.
Table 3 (§5.3): K-controlled ablation of gate additions is net -1.38 pp average but +2.48 on LME, showing mixed per-domain effects despite the 'collectively net-negative' framing.
Table 4 (§5.4): u-SMCO masking improves HP-50 by 2.13-8.58 pp across all six trained banks; Skill_IN masked on 5/6 banks using an unlabeled 20-query target probe.
§5.5 Cost: CASS adds eight coalition evaluations per outer epoch (~5% of a 20-hour run); u-SMCO requires O(K²) memory rebuilds at 6-10 minutes per mask step; neither adds inference-time cost.
§4.1 Eq. 6: gate ranks σ(B)=mean sampled coalition margin + 0.2·r_out(B); §4.2 Eq. 7 defines label-free retrieval-quality score on unlabeled target queries.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope LLM-agent research: self-evolving agents with skill banks, evaluated with Llama-3.3-70B on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, HotpotQA, ALFWorld (§5.1), matching Agents/LLM/RL/Memory/interpretability preferences. Novelty is moderate: the coalition-conditional reliability framing and the two named failure modes (coalition pollution, cross-domain utility reversal) are fresh, but the core tool is standard Shapley valuation (§3.1) and Theorem 1 is a near-trivial non-identifiability observation. Rigor is solid for matched-protocol design (CASS differs from MemSkill only in the gate, §5.1), paired knockouts with 95% CIs (Table 1), K-controlled ablation (Table 3), and honest reading of a non-significant reversal (§3.3); however scale is small (3 seeds, 12 gate decisions in Fig. 5, a 20-query unlabeled probe in Table 4) and no significance tests accompany the modest main-table gains (Table 2: e.g., LongMemEval F1 30.03 vs 30.02). Evidence for cross-domain reversal rests on one skill whose target CI includes zero, and Table 3 is mixed (LME +2.48 vs avg -1.38). u-SMCO gains are consistent (Table 4, +2.13 to +8.58 pp on HP-50) strengthening the masking claim. Generalizability is decent across four domains but training is LoCoMo-only, banks are tiny (K≈8-13), and everything is built on one framework. Reproducibility: Algorithm 1, λ=0.2, and hardware given, code/checkpoints only promised ('will be released', Abstract), no link, judge prompt and τ threshold unspecified.

primary_link.title: Coalition-Aware Skill Reliability for Self-Evolving Agents

papers.summary: Agent skills, structured artifacts distilled from interaction trajectories and dynamically reused from skill banks, have become a central mechanism for enabling large language model (LLM)-based self-evolving agents to learn from past experience. Yet existing work has largely focused on the operational aspects of skills, such as acquisition, evolution, and retrieval, while leaving a more fundamental reliability question unresolved: Do accumulated skills in an agent's skill bank actually make posi
papers.summary_zh: 以 LLM 為基礎的自演化代理會將互動軌跡蒸餾成技能並存入技能庫以備重複使用,但既有研究多聚焦於技能的取得、演化與檢索,忽略了根本問題:技能庫中累積的技能被呼叫時,是否真的有正向的機制性貢獻?本文透過系統性的技能機制可靠性稽核(SMRA),在不同技能庫組成與部署領域下進行變異分析,發現兩種反覆出現的失效模式:一是聯盟污染,即技能庫層級的增益掩蓋了個別技能在聯盟層級的負面貢獻;二是跨領域效用反轉,即對來源有益的技能在遷移後效果反轉為有害。作者更證明僅看結果的閘門在結構上無法辨識這些聯盟層級互動。據此提出兩項干預:CASS 在技能累積時以蒙地卡羅抽樣建構多元技能聯盟,聚合 Shapley 邊際貢獻以選出更可靠的候選技能;u-SMCO 則在遷移後僅用無標籤的目標領域查詢,依檢索品質貢獻貪婪地遮蔽失效技能。在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval、HotpotQA 與 ALFWorld 的實驗顯示,兩法持續優於強大的自演化基線,並降低對雜訊結果回饋的敏感度。核心洞見在於:技能可靠性是技能、技能庫與部署領域的共同屬性,而非技能的內在特質,技能聯盟才是可靠技能演化的核心單位。
papers.title: Coalition-Aware Skill Reliability for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.title_zh: 自演化代理的聯盟感知技能可靠性

links.title: Disagree to Explore, Agree to Commit: Routing-Guided Test-Time Scaling for Software Agents

evidence: Abstract & Section 5.1/Table 2: RISA lifts macro-average resolved rate from 44.9% (Uniform) to 48.2% across six gpt-oss conditions (+2.3 to +5.7 per condition); Text reaches 48.0%, RISA-H 48.3%, Oracle 60.9%.
Appendix B: RISA vs Text pooled difference is +0.20 points with task-clustered bootstrap CI [-0.80, +1.21], i.e., not statistically significant; per-condition RISA-Uniform p-values .042 to <.001.
Section 3.2: routing role gate achieves 0.940 three-way holdout accuracy vs 0.746 majority baseline on 78,535 task-disjoint actions; write-versus-rest recall 0.93 at precision 1.00.

Section 3.4/Table 1 + Appendix J.1: decision-token readout AUC .69 on shorter candidates (vs .49-.59 other windows); cross-attempt ranking AUC .657 vs .639 whole-span and .616-.634 for random/uniform/entropy/highest-probability controls.
Appendix G/Table 6: cross-family transfer to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on full 500-task benchmark: RISA 45.2% vs Uniform 41.7% (CI [+1.9,+5.0], p<0.001), matching Text 45.0% (exact McNemar p=1.000).

Appendix J.5: honest negative within-step diagnostic (novelty AUC 0.49, treated as diversity prior) but strong trajectory-level signal (resolve rates 33.8% to 5.4% across similarity quintiles, AUC 0.656, n=1,021).
Appendix E/Table 4: deployed write-score step AUC .520 [0.486, 0.555] with all four components ablated; coefficients (1,1.5,1,-1) frozen on a disjoint 98-step pilot (AUC 0.592, CI [0.512,0.672]).
Section 7 Limitations: method requires accessible sparse-MoE routing (white-box), unsuited to dense/closed models without alternative readouts; role definitions are domain-specific.
Appendix K: code, centroid files, and seeds promised for release 'upon publication' but not currently available; analysis randomness is seeded (rng(0), seed=42).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: agentic software engineering with test-time scaling driven by internal MoE routing signals, matching Agents & Tool Use (2.5), Code & Programming (2.0), LLMs, and interpretability preferences; methodology is general LLM control, not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: MoE-routing-agreement selection extends the authors' own prior RAD work (ref [4]) to non-canonical patches and two nested decision scales (sibling actions vs. independent attempts), with decision-token localization as the main new readout. Rigor is high: paired selectors on identical steered pools, McNemar exact tests, task-clustered bootstrap (Appendix B), selector ablations (Table 3), write-score component ablations (Table 4), window-control battery (Appendix J.1), hyperparameter sweeps (Table 8), and honest negative diagnostics (within-step novelty AUC 0.49 in Appendix J.5). Evidence supports the core claim (routing arbitration beats Uniform everywhere, matches text consensus) but the implicit stronger claim is unsupported: RISA vs Text is +0.20 points with CI [-0.80,+1.21] crossing zero, and end-to-end steering gains have wide CIs (Table 5). Generalizability is constrained by white-box sparse-MoE access and the SWE-bench domain, though cross-family transfer to Qwen3.6 with only centroid refitting (Appendix G) is a genuine plus. Reproducibility documentation is unusually detailed (Table 7, seeds, tie-breaking, grading protocol) but code is only promised upon publication (Appendix K).

primary_link.title: Disagree to Explore, Agree to Commit: Routing-Guided Test-Time Scaling for Software Agents

Test-time scaling is difficult because patches lack canonical answer forms, while sibling actions from a shared prefix are correlated. We study whether native MoE router traces can guide steering and selection without an external judge or selection-time test execution. Our analysis shows that routing provides a robust behavioral role s
papers.summary_zh: 軟體工程代理解決儲存庫層級任務時,需經歷漫長且隨機的工具使用軌跡,重複嘗試常能找到單次執行錯失的修補,但測試時擴展面臨挑戰:修補檔沒有標準答案形式,且共用前綴的兄弟動作彼此相關。本文研究能否利用稀疏 MoE 模型原生的路由器痕跡,在不需要外部評審或選擇時執行測試的情況下引導搜尋與選擇。分析顯示路由訊號強烈編碼行為角色,檢查、測試與撰寫動作可乾淨分離;路由補足表面相似性所缺的資訊;修補中低機率的「決策 token」集中了細粒度路由變異;而路由相似性的意義取決於所選的比較集合。據此提出 Risa:單次嘗試內,路由衍生的角色閘門區分探索與修補撰寫——探索偏向與近期執行歷史分歧的動作,撰寫階段則採有防護的同儕收斂;跨 K 次獨立嘗試,則選出決策 token 路由一致性最高的修補作為最終提交。在 SWE-bench Verified 上,以 gpt-oss-20b/120b 的六種推理強度評估,Risa 將巨觀平均解決率由 44.9% 提升至 48.2%,與文字共識相當;並成功遷移至 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B,顯著優於均勻選擇。限制包括需可存取稀疏 MoE 路由與重複取樣,較適合白盒模型。

links.title: LiST: Local-Simplex Test-Time LoRA Fusion

evidence: Abstract: 'label-free test-time LoRA fusion framework that converts an existing LoRA bank into a target-conditioned local simplex and searches sample-specific fusion weights at inference time'
Sec 4.1 Training Details: experiments on Qwen3-VL-8B, LLaVA-V1.5-7B, DeepSeek-7B, Qwen3-8B; 'all experiments on four RTX 4090 GPUs'
Table 1 (Multimodal results): LiST avg 83.84 seen / 68.18 unseen on Qwen3-VL-8B vs ICM-Fusion 71.81 / 59.29 and MEMO 81.49 / 64.31
Table 2 (Language results): LiST avg 87.88 on DeepSeek-7B GLUE vs single-task LoRA 87.78 and MEMO 85.39
Sec 4.3: 'All ablation experiments are conducted on the GLUE benchmark using Qwen3-8B' — single-setting ablations
Sec 3.3 Eq. 15: U(·) described only as 'a task-aware uncertainty functional' with no concrete definition

Limitations: 'assumes access to a bank of related task-specific LoRA adapters'; 'test-time search introduces additional inference cost'; energy 'may be less aligned with task metrics for highly open-ended generation tasks'
Appendix A.2, Tables 7-9: sensitivity analyses over neighbor count K, MC forward count M, and acceptance margin m_accept; no code or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the paper
Sec 3.4 / Table 6: safe acceptance rule yields 59.92% fallback rate with lowest negative transfer (0.02), supporting the feasibility-constrained design
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: label-free test-time fusion of LoRA adapter banks for LLMs (DeepSeek-7B, Qwen3-8B) and MLLMs (Qwen3-VL-8B, LLaVA-V1.5-7B), strongly matching LLM/PEFT/NLP preferences. Novelty is moderate: sample-specific test-time composition extends AdaMerging, LoraHub, ICM-Fusion, and latent-coordinate TTA (ELaTTA, whose CMA-ES search is reused); the local simplex retrieval plus feasibility-constrained energy and safe fallback is a sensible but incremental combination. Rigor is solid: four backbones, two benchmarks, nine baselines, four ablation axes (Tables 3-6), and sensitivity to K, M, m_accept (Appendix A.2); however all ablations use a single GLUE/Qwen3-8B setting, no seed variance or significance testing is reported, and the 'task-aware uncertainty functional' U(.) in Sec. 3.3 is never concretely defined, which is problematic for generative multimodal tasks. Evidence is supported by detailed quantitative tables (e.g., LiST 83.84 vs ICM-Fusion 71.81 seen avg on Qwen3-VL-8B; 87.88 vs LoRA 87.78 on DeepSeek-7B GLUE), and unseen-domain gains (68.18 vs 64.31 best baseline) are consistent, though margins over strong TTA baselines like MEMO are sometimes small and metric definitions per benchmark are not given. Generalizability is good across backbones and modalities but contingent on an available related-adapter bank, and the authors concede weak alignment for open-ended generation (Limitations). Reproducibility is weak: no code release, missing energy/threshold estimation details and LoRA training configurations despite stated defaults (K=3, M=8, m_accept=3.0). Heavy same-group citation clustering does not affect scoring but the absence of an artifact link does.

primary_link.title: LiST: Local-Simplex Test-Time LoRA Fusion

papers.summary: Task-specific LoRA adapters offer a modular way to specialize large language and vision-language models. However, existing adapter composition methods are mostly static and cannot adapt to individual test inputs. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{LiST}, a label-free test-time LoRA fusion framework that converts an existing LoRA bank into a target-conditioned local simplex and searches sample-specific fusion weights at inference time. LiST builds joint task representations from LoRA par
papers.summary_zh: LoRA 轉接器讓大型模型能以模組化方式專精於特定任務，但現有的轉接器融合方法多屬靜態，對不同測試輸入套用相同的權重組合，難以因應個別樣本需求。本文提出 LiST，一個免標籤的測試時 LoRA 融合框架：先由 LoRA 參數錨點與提示層行為向量建立聯合任務表示，擷取鄰近轉接器構成目標條件化的局部單體，並在保留 LoRA 分支結構的前提下，於推論階段以 CMA-ES 搜尋樣本專屬的單體融合權重。搜尋由提示層能量函數引導，結合先驗偏差、局部幾何距離與隨機一致性等約束，並透過安全接受規則決定是否部署搜尋結果，否則回退至任務先驗，避免不可靠的低能量解；主幹與所有轉接器全程凍結。在 Qwen3-VL-8B、LLaVA-V1.5-7B 等多模態基準與 DeepSeek-7B、Qwen3-8B 的 GLUE 語言基準上，LiST 均優於 Task-Arithmetic、TIES-Merging、DARE 等靜態融合法與 AdaMerging、TENT、MEMO 等測試時適應基線，在未見領域亦取得最佳平均表現；消融實驗確認先驗、幾何與一致性約束、局部單體建構及安全回退規則皆有貢獻。限制在於需要一組相關的任務轉接器、測試時搜尋增加推論成本，且能量函數僅為代理目標。此方法展示無需再訓練即可進行樣本級調適的可行途徑。

links.title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading for AI Agents

evidence: Abstract (p.1): 'SparseRead reduces token volume by up to 92.9% and wall time by up to 89.0%, while preserving or improving task quality' across six frontier models and five workload scenarios.

Sec 6.1 (p.5): '125 tasks from QwenClawBench, Claw-Eval, PinchBench, and LooGLE'; six models including Claude Opus 5, Qwen3.6-Plus, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.5; frameworks NanoBot v0.2.0, OpenCode v1.17.14, OpenClaw v2026.6.11.
Table 1 (p.6): 15 framework-model cells, e.g., Kimi-K2.5/NanoBot 92.9% token reduction with +0.598 score delta; DeepSeek-Pro/OpenCode -0.031; medians 69.0%/71.8%/28.7% token reduction per framework.

Sec 6.2 (p.6): '26 cells preserve or improve task score' of 30; four changes between -0.10 and -0.02 attributed to 'ordinary stochastic variation in agent execution' with no statistical test reported.

Sec 6.3 (p.6): SparseRead achieves 'the lowest token volume and wall time in every setting' vs ACON and CT observation masking, with 63.4-86.3% token and 44.7-72.3% time reductions; ACON loses 0.80 score in one setting.

Sec 4.3 (p.5): Gate uses a deterministic linear margin b = w_s*s - w_c*c - w_r*r with 'weights and thresholds selected jointly on a development workload' - concrete values, dev-set composition, and calibration data are not reported.
Sec 6.5 (p.7): Read Gate analysis uses only '8 matched tasks on DeepSeek-Pro' (38 of 48 pairs reduce token cost, 39 preserve or improve score), limiting the gate's evaluated selectivity evidence.

Sec 3.1 (p.3): 'compression distrust' motivation - without protocol state, agents require '1.7-6.2x more requests and 2.1-12.5x more tokens'; underlying trace methodology for the 6-15% useful-evidence claim (Sec 2, p.1-2) is not described.
Footnote 1 (p.1): code released at github.com/Zedong-Liu/SparseReading; however no statement about benchmark harnesses, task-score implementation, or gate hyperparameter files.

Sec 7 (p.7): related work correctly contrasts with post-read context/KV compression (LLMLingua, SnapKV, KIVI) and agent observation compression (SWE-Pruner, Squeez, ACON), supporting the pre-admission positioning claim.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A training-free agent-harness layer (SparseRead) that controls artifact admission before content enters LLM context via a stateful reading protocol, pluggable Reader backends, and a regime-aware gate. Strongly on-preference: central to Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Long Context & Memory, and inference efficiency. Novelty is solid rather than high: the individual ingredients (retrieval-style evidence acquisition, observation masking, gating, prefix-cache awareness) are known, but the pre-admission framing, 'compression distrust' analysis (Sec 3.1), and stateful closure/fallback protocol are a genuinely distinct contribution. Rigor is decent in breadth (125 tasks, 6 models incl. Claude Opus 5, 3 frameworks, ACON and Complexity-Trap baselines with end-to-end cost accounting, Sec 6.1) but weak in depth: no component ablations isolating preview/evidence-state/gate contributions, gate weights 'selected jointly on a development workload' without reported values (Sec 4.3), an undefined 'task score' metric, no significance testing for the four negative score deltas dismissed as stochastic variation (Sec 6.2), and a small 8-task gate study (Sec 6.5). Evidence is quantitatively specific and internally consistent (Table 1 matches abstract's 92.9%) and honestly reports negative deltas, but is largely figure-mediated and the 6-15% 'useful evidence' trace analysis methodology is undescribed. Generalizability is a real strength (training-free, model- and framework-agnostic, explicit low-sparsity regime boundary in Sec 3.2). Reproducibility is partial: GitHub link and pinned framework versions exist, but gate hyperparameters, score definitions, and prompts are absent. No instruction-injection or unsupported prestige claims detected.

primary_link.title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading for AI Agents

papers.summary: Long-horizon agents increasingly rely on repeated access to external artifacts, yet current reading interfaces often expose entire objects even when only sparse evidence is needed. This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute task-relevant evidence, while existing context-reduction methods mainly intervene after broad content has already entered the trajectory. We present SparseRead, a training-free, model-transparent reading layer that controls content admission before unn
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理在長期任務中反覆存取外部文件，但現有閱讀介面常將整個物件暴露給模型，造成「過度閱讀」：在高稀疏性任務中僅 6–15% 的暴露內容對當下決策有用，全文閱讀最多耗費 17.3 倍詞元卻無品質提升，甚至因稀釋關鍵證據而導致軌跡漂移。本文提出 SparseRead，一個免訓練、對模型透明的閱讀層，在內容進入模型脈絡前即控制其准入。架構包含三部分：感知運行區間的 Read Gate，依預讀訊號決定強制稀疏、建議或原生閱讀；可擴充的 Reader Backends，將 scout、focus、collect、refine、verify 等宏觀動作映射為特定物件的操作；以及具狀態的稀疏閱讀協定，以物件預覽、意圖與證據狀態支撐有界、可驗證的證據取得，並保留原生閱讀回退。在 Claude Opus 5、Qwen3.6-Plus、DeepSeek-V4 等六個模型與五種工作負載上，SparseRead 最多減少 92.9% 詞元與 89.0% 實際執行時間，同時維持或提升任務品質，在所有設定皆優於 ACON 與觀察遮罩基線；同一協定可移植到 NanoBot、OpenCode、OpenClaw 三個代理框架。限制包括低稀疏或需原生運算的任務會付出協定開銷，因此須由閘門選擇性介入。此研究指出過度閱讀是代理系統的結構性低效，閱讀應成為執行路徑中明確可控的一環。
papers.title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading for AI Agents
papers.title_zh: 少讀多解：AI 代理的省詞元稀疏閱讀

links.title: Whitewashing Hate, Smearing Harmless Content: Annotator-Style Rebuttal Attacks on LLM-Based Moderation

evidence: Section 3 (Experimental Setup): two datasets SBIC (20,013 hateful / 24,658 normal; total 44,671) and IHC (19,133 total); models GPT-5.1, Gemini-2.5, Qwen3-8B, Gemma4-E4B plus Claude-4.5, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3.5-9B in Appendix A1; temperature 0.
Section 2.2 + Appendix A.1: four rebuttal strategies (direct, boundary, rationale, boundary+rationale) with verbatim whitewashing/smearing boundary rules and templates.

Table 2: Qwen3-8B SBIC Acc drops 75.87→22.25 (-70.7%) under bnd+rat; Gemini-2.5 SBIC Acc drops 84.75→43.68 (-48.5%) under boundary; Section 4.1(3): average IHC relative decline under bnd+rat is 69.7% Acc_n vs 23.1% Acc_h.
Section 4.2/Figure 2: flip/drift/stable decomposition on SBIC — whitewashing 20.5% flipped vs smearing 57.0% flipped averaged over Qwen3-8B and Gemma4-E4B.
Section 5/Table 3: Hedge defense raises Qwen3-8B SBIC Acc from 22.25 to 53.71 (+31.5) with Acc_h near 99% while Acc_n barely changes; defensive prompting mainly repairs normal-class predictions.
Appendix B.7/Table B8: SFT cuts average relative Acc_h decline from 59.71% to 0.60% and Acc_n decline from 92.50% to 4.29% across six model-dataset settings.
Appendix B.4: Qwen3.5 model-size ablation shows base accuracy rises with size but post-bnd+rat accuracy falls (IHC 44.58%→16.87%→12.58% for 2B/4B/9B).
Appendix A.2: over 97.6% of GPT-5.1-generated rationales pass human verification for direction and plausibility.
Limitations: evaluation restricted to English text-only moderation, a selected model set, and vulnerability-focused analysis with lightweight prompt-based defenses.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM safety/red-teaming paper: evaluates GPT-5.1, Gemini-2.5, Claude-4.5, Qwen3-8B, Gemma4-E4B and others (Section 3) on prompt-channel robustness of LLM moderation, matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, Prompting, NLP); no Japanese/agent/code/RAG relevance. Novelty is moderate: the rejudge protocol extends known sycophancy/answer-reversal work with a whitewashing-vs-smearing directional taxonomy, boundary/rationale attack decomposition, and flip/drift/stable logit analysis (Section 4.2), but the core phenomenon overlaps prior sycophancy and multi-turn jailbreak literature (Section 6). Rigor is solid: two public datasets (SBIC 44,671; IHC 19,133), temperature 0, human-verified rationales (97.6% pass, Appendix A.2), controls (neutral reassessment, gold-aligned correction, Appendix B.3), model-size ablation (B.4), flip-set overlap (B.5), panel agreement (B.6), and SFT defense (B.7); weaknesses include no significance testing, defense evaluation on only two models (Table 3), minor naming inconsistencies (Gemini-2.5 vs Gemini-2.5-Pro), and the attack-generation model (GPT-5.1) also being a target. Evidence is extensive and internally consistent (e.g., Qwen3-8B SBIC Acc 75.87→22.25 under bnd+rat, Table 2; SFT reduces average Acc_h decline from 59.71% to 0.60%, Table B8), though without confidence intervals and with small-N manual rationale analysis. Generalizability is limited to English-only binary hate/normal moderation (Limitations). Reproducibility benefits from verbatim prompt templates (Appendix A.1) and model/hardware details, but no code or attack-data release is stated.

primary_link.title: Whitewashing Hate, Smearing Harmless Content: Annotator-Style Rebuttal Attacks on LLM-Based Moderation

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for hate speech moderation, often within human--AI workflows in which reviewers provide feedback before a final decision. Such feedback introduces two manipulation directions: whitewashing hateful content as normal and smearing normal content as hateful. This study examines the susceptibility of initially correct model judgments to annotator-style rebuttals and analyzes whether attack effectiveness differs across manipulation directions. We intr
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益承擔仇恨言論審核，常嵌入人機協作流程：模型先作初步判斷，審核員提供回饋後再修正決策。本文指出此回饋通道可被操弄：對仇恨內容「洗白」（謊稱為幽默或引述）使模型誤判為正常，對正常內容「抹黑」（暗示隱性偏見）使其被誤判為仇恨，分別導致審核不足與過度。作者提出再判斷（rejudge）協定，設計直接反駁、決策邊界偏移、誤導性理據及其組合四種攻擊，並延伸至多輪互動，在 SBIC 與 IHC 兩資料集上評測 GPT-5.1、Gemini-2.5、Qwen3-8B、Gemma4-E4B 等模型。結果顯示標註者式反駁大幅侵蝕原本正確的判斷：最強攻擊下部分模型準確率相對下滑逾五成；logit 分析更發現許多預測雖未翻轉但信心顯著流失，且多數模型對抹黑方向更脆弱，而 Llama-3.1-8B 呈相反的洗白傾向，形成模型專屬的不對稱弱點。多輪攻擊會累積傷害，中性追問也難以復原。防禦方面，對稱回饋、要求獨立重評的提示與 SFT 微調皆能減輕但無法消除攻擊。研究限制包括模型集合有限、僅涵蓋英文文本。此工作凸顯審核員回饋是安全敏感介面，需方向感知的防護與專門的穩健性評估。
papers.title: Whitewashing Hate, Smearing Harmless Content: Annotator-Style Rebuttal Attacks on LLM-Based Moderation
papers.title_zh: 洗白仇恨、抹黑無害內容：針對 LLM 審核的標註者式反駁攻擊

links.title: PURA: Provably Unbiased and Robust Multi-Bit Watermarking for AI-Generated Text Attribution

evidence: Abstract: 'when embedding 36 bits in 200 tokens, PURA achieves a 91.7% message match rate, more than three times that of the strongest unbiased baseline' and 'Our code is available at https://github.com/anshigaoa/PURA'
Section 6.2, Table 1: PURA (asymmetric) at 36 bits reports 91.7% match and 99.02% bit accuracy vs BiMark 28.9%/94.12%, StealthInk 0.5%/80.15%, and RS-BH (δ=3.0) 81.4%/95.82%
Section 5.1 Theorem 5.1 and Appendix B: computational unbiasedness proved via PRF hybrid plus rotational invariance (Lemma B.1/B.2), skip rule Eq. (8) ensuring fresh context seeds

Section 5.2: Propositions 5.2/5.3 derive Pr(L≤0) ≤ exp(-TΓ²/2) from Azuma-Hoeffding (Eq. 22) with bounded LLR increments via clipping (Eq. 23); TM1 extension introduces adversarial drift μ_adv (Eq. 35-38)
Section 3.2/Appendix C.2: TM0 centering relies on the modeling assumption Eq. (42) that the verifier-side phase at unsynchronized steps is conditionally uniform
Section 6.5, Table 3: TM1 attacks (Smoothing, RLCracker, Diaa et al., SIRA) reduce ρ̂ to 0.29-0.37 while μ̂adv stays within [-0.009,+0.008], supporting the desynchronization-dominant claim
Appendix D, Table 4: privileged key-aware oracle drives μ̂adv to -0.156 (r=0.1,k=15) and bit accuracy to 47.35% at r=0.4,k=15, honestly demonstrating boundary of the theory
Section 8 Limitations: 'focuses on English text', asymmetric pairs 'share the same tokenizer and vocabulary', and key-reuse cross-response correlations acknowledged
Section 6.6 ablations: Gray vs binary indexing, SPC vs Hamming/RS (Fig. 7b), verifier size ≥410M stable (Fig. 7c), kernel comparison with hard voting markedly worse (Fig. 7d)

Reference list: 'Yang et al. (2020)' cited in Section 6.3 for RoBERTa but the entry is 'TS-csw: text steganalysis and hidden capacity estimation...' (citation mismatch); OpenGen dataset cited to Merity et al. 2016 (Pointer Sentinel), likely incorrect provenance
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: multi-bit watermarking for AI-generated text attribution, directly relevant to LLM accountability, auditing, and AI-safety evaluation (preference weight on LLMs and safety/robustness). Methodologically novel: latent-space sector anchoring via keyed ITS with Gray coding plus soft LLR evidence aggregation, and a claimed-first robustness framework covering mechanism-aware (TM1) adaptive attackers; building blocks derive from Kuditipudi et al. ITS, so novelty is combinational rather than foundational. Rigor is solid: formal unbiasedness theorem with full Appendix B proof, Azuma-Hoeffding-based per-bit bounds, defined threat models, six baselines, and component ablations; but the TM0 centering rests on an assumption (Eq. 42 conditional uniformity at unsynchronized steps), and the reference list contains verifiable citation errors (Yang et al. 2020 cited for RoBERTa but listed as a text-steganography paper; OpenGen cited to Merity et al. 2016), which lowers rigor slightly. Evidence strength is high: detailed tables (e.g., Table 1: 91.7% match/99.02% bit accuracy at 36 bits vs BiMark 28.9% and RS-BH 81.4%), stealth/quality Table 2 (50.23% detector accuracy vs 50.00% unwatermarked), adaptive-attack decomposition Table 3, and an honest out-of-TM1 oracle stress test (Table 4) showing the bound can be broken. Generalizability is moderate: four model families and three datasets but English-only, same-tokenizer source/proxy pairs, temperature 1.0, and ~200-token default. Reproducibility is good: public code URL, full pseudocode (Appendix F), kernel definitions (Appendix E), and hyperparameters, though the repository cannot be verified from the text.

primary_link.title: PURA: Provably Unbiased and Robust Multi-Bit Watermarking for AI-Generated Text Attribution

papers.summary: Fine-grained attribution of AI-generated text is becoming increasingly important for accountability and auditing, yet existing multi-bit watermarking methods still struggle to simultaneously preserve the base generation distribution, support high-capacity payloads, and remain recoverable after editing. We present PURA, a provably unbiased and robust multi-bit watermarking method for text attribution. Instead of perturbing token probabilities directly, PURA embeds payloads in the latent sampling
papers.summary_zh: 為了追溯 AI 生成文本的來源，多位元浮水印需在生成時嵌入使用者、時間等結構化資訊，但現有方法難以兼顧保持基底生成分布、高承載量與編輯後可恢復性：有偏方法直接擾動詞元機率而損及品質，無偏方法在高承載下急劇退化。本文提出 PURA，改在潛在取樣空間嵌入負載：以金鑰化反變換取樣（ITS）為無偏取樣基元，透過 Gray 編碼的扇區錨點旋轉潛在取樣點，並依局部熵自適決定每步可嵌入的位元數，完全不改變詞元分布。抽取端不採硬判碼，而是將觀察到的詞元視為潛在空間中的區間證據，以對稱核積分取得扇區相容度，投影為位元級對數似然比（LLR）並跨序列聚合，再以單同位檢查碼進行可靠度引導修復。理論上，PURA 證明單次呼叫的計算無偏性，並建立涵蓋機制感知自適攻擊的穩健性框架，給出每位元錯誤率隨序列長度指數衰減的上界。實驗顯示，在 200 個詞元嵌入 36 位元時，非對稱驗證仍達 91.7% 訊息匹配率，超過三倍於最強無偏基線，且在插入、刪除、改寫與 DIPPER 等攻擊下保持高位元準確率，文本品質與統計隱蔽性接近未浮水印文本，驗證僅需毫秒級。限制包括重複脈絡可能造成跨回應相關性，短文本或重度改寫會降低完整恢復率，目前僅評測共用分詞器的英文設定。此方法為細粒度溯源與稽核提供兼顧容量、穩健與效率的實用路徑。
papers.title: PURA: Provably Unbiased and Robust Multi-Bit Watermarking for AI-Generated Text Attribution
papers.title_zh: PURA：可證明無偏且穩健的 AI 生成文本歸因多位元浮水印

links.title: Grounded Normative Rule Generation with Structured Search

evidence: Abstract: 'GNRS-Search raises average rubric quality from 68.8% to 81.0% and ranks first under a disclosed executable composite metric' (Overall = 0.80 x Rubric Avg v1 + 0.20 x hard-ok, Section 6.1).

Section 5 (Method): MCMC sampler runs 200 steps at tau=0.08; s_search weights calibrated on the 16 development goals and 'frozen before test-set execution', with the search score explicitly decoupled from the evaluation rubric.

Section 6.1 (Evaluation Setup): baselines are direct prompting, structured outputs, best-of-N (N=8), self-refine, in-context grounding, and a CRSEC norm-synthesis adaptation; primary scoring is a 'blinded GPT-5.1 rubric' over five dimensions plus binary hard-ok.

Section 6.2: method-blinded human calibration shows 'row-level Spearman correlation of 0.77' and a +0.69 human score margin over non-search alternatives; Appendix B.4 Tables 16-18 add a Gemini second-judge check ranking GNRS-Search highest (96.40 vs 85.60 best non-GNRS).

Table 1 and Appendix B.3 (Hard-OK Forensic Audit): the No-LLM-candidates ablation beats full GNRS-Search on hard-ok (77.3 vs 51.1); the audit attributes the gap to more selected payloads (rho=0.507 vs 0.551), and the paper claims only the composite ranking, not maximal feasibility.

Appendix B.1 Table 11 and B.2: ranking stability is audited across hard-ok weights 0-40% (GNRS-Search loses at 40% in the main GPT-4o-mini setting) and the authors disclose that GPT-4o and GLM-4.6 generator columns were omitted after partial-run/timeout issues.
Appendix B.4 Table 12: paired goal-level bootstrap CIs, e.g., Overall margin +5.74 [3.93, 7.53] on the 88-goal main test; Table 15 confirms 100% replacement coverage for slot interventions.

Limitations and Appendix B.4: benchmark is intentionally controlled; RealCharter-Bench uses normalized policy cards (not full documents or policy extraction); the method assumes pre-available operational vocabulary and evidence interfaces; robustness analysis shows a 9.7-point Rubric Avg drop under incorrectly specified schemas.

Appendix D: verbatim prompt templates for all baselines, candidate generators, polish stages, and evaluation rubrics are provided; Appendix A gives full benchmark taxonomy and RealCharter document lineage, but no explicit code or artifact URL appears in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A legitimate LLM-methodology paper (not in any excluded out-of-scope category): it formalizes grounded normative rule synthesis, contributes two benchmarks, and proposes an MCMC search over a five-slot And-Or Graph with LLM-augmented, record-filtered candidates before prose realization. Preference relevance is solid on LLMs, structured output, grounding/hallucination, and prompting baselines, with only framing-level ties to agents; no Japanese NLP or reasoning/CoT content. Novelty is above average (new task formalization plus AOG+MCMC decoupling of structure from surface form, though built from known ingredients: candidate generation, verifier reranking, program-synthesis search). Rigor is unusually strong: 88 goals x 3 seeds, six baselines, six ablations including a CP-SAT control, slot interventions, OOD split, cross-generator grid, metric-weight sensitivity, and blinded human calibration (Spearman 0.77). Evidence strength is capped because the headline metric is an author-designed GPT-5.1 rubric on a self-built benchmark, GPT-5.1 is also a generator, and RealCharter-Bench yields perfect 100/5.00 scores for the proposed method (Appendix B.4 Table 13), though the paper honestly surfaces the hard-ok trade-off and omitted GPT-4o/GLM-4.6 runs. Generalizability is demonstrated across backbones, OOD scenes, and real-derived tasks but is bounded by pre-prepared schemas and clause-level scope, with a disclosed 9.7-point drop under incorrect schemas. Reproducibility is good (full prompt templates in Appendix D, frozen weights, search hyperparameters) but no explicit code/URL and some scorer internals (phi features, weights) are underspecified.
topics: MCMC structured search over And-Or Graphs

papers.summary_zh: 機構章程與職場政策等規範性規則必須同時可讀且在執行層面可驗證，但現有語言生成與結構化輸出基準多獎勵表面流暢或格式合規，導致模型常寫出依賴不存在紀錄或不可稽核程序的似是而非條款。本文將此問題形式化為接地規範規則合成，並提出 GNRS-Search：先將規則建模為涵蓋範圍、觸發、規範主體、證據與程序五個槽位的 And-Or 圖，由規則模板、情境綱要、環境紀錄與 LLM 提案建構候選空間，再以 MCMC 取樣器在離散結構上搜尋，以紀錄接地分數評估並懲罰硬性不可行解，最後才渲染為自然語言，使結構錯誤能在成文前被定位。作者另發布 GNRS-Bench（8 個場景家族、116 個受控目標）與 RealCharter-Bench（53 個源自真實政策且原文隱藏的任務）。結果顯示 GNRS-Search 將平均評分品質由 68.8% 提升至 81.0%，在公開的可執行複合指標上居首，跨模型與留出場景皆穩健；槽位干預證實增益來自規範主體、範圍與觸發的運算邏輯而非修辭，CP-SAT 對照明顯較弱，人類校準與自動評分高度一致。限制在於基準為受控環境、政策卡片非完整文件，方法假設運算詞彙與證據介面事先可得，且對錯誤綱要較敏感。此工作將規則撰寫轉為可檢視的搜尋問題，為可稽核的合規代理奠定範式。

links.title: Invocation-Level Reliability of Tool-Using Agents

evidence: Section 5.1/Table 3: on llama-3.1-8b-instant p_t falls 0.700→0.543 while g_t collapses 0.700→0.174; L_t rises monotonically to L_6=0.686 [0.607,0.766] with non-overlapping adjacent-depth intervals

Section 5.3: '0 of 869 poisoned-context steps correct' forces severity π=1.000; recovery structurally unobservable ('0 of 580 poisoned steps returned on-track'); mechanism: gold values generated by tool constants 'never exposed to the model'

Section 5.4/Table 4: conditional-on-state rescoring of cached completions ('0 API calls, 881 cache hits') moves severity to +0.149 [+0.021,+0.268] and +0.316 [+0.066,+0.503]; authors flag it as 'a hypothesis the data supports on two models with wide intervals'
Table 1: per-model n ranges 49–273 tasks; gpt-oss-20b 'completed zero tasks... excluded from all claims'; llama-3.3-70b-versatile labeled 'usable, thin'

Section 7: four designed conditions not executed (linear-task null control, transformed-argument, presentation-order control, calling-mode ablation); synthetic integer-argument tasks limit ecological validity; extension to BFCL/tau-bench named as 'the direct next step'

Section 4: dataset 'frozen at 14:09 on 2026-08-17', greedy decoding, fixed seeds, every response cached; Contribution 5 claims 'A released pipeline with measured provider rate limits documented nowhere else' but no repository URL is given in the text
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agents-and-tool-use evaluation paper: disaggregated invocation-level reliability of tool-calling LLMs (selection vs. argument errors, teacher-forced vs. free-running contexts) on open-weight models. Strongly on-preference (Agents & Tool Use, Red Teaming & Evaluation, LLMs). Novelty rests on a genuine measurement result: under exact-match scoring against an opaque gold trajectory, severity is pinned to 1 and recovery is structurally unobservable (Section 5.3), plus a zero-cost conditional-on-state rescoring remedy (Section 5.4). Rigor is unusually careful for a workshop paper: two-arm protocol, L1=0 sanity check, model-free lag check, pipeline validation that caught real scorer artifacts (Section 6), MCMC diagnostics, and an explicit inventory of unexecuted controls (Section 7). Evidence is solid but narrow: monotone propagation loss (L_t up to ~0.686) is established mainly on two high-n small models; larger models sit at ceiling or are thin (llama-3.3-70b n=49, gpt-oss-20b excluded with zero tasks, Table 1); the conditional-scoring decomposition rests on two models, wide CIs, and a weak transcription-only competence test the authors flag themselves. Generalizability is limited by synthetic integer-argument tasks with hidden tool constants; extension to BFCL/tau-bench-style scoring is explicitly future work. Reproducibility supports are good (frozen dataset, caching, fixed seeds, measured rate limits, claimed released pipeline) but no repository URL appears in the text. Not a pure domain application; clearly in scope.

papers.summary_zh: 使用工具的代理可能選錯工具或填錯參數，而早期錯誤會悄悄污染後續所有步驟；單一總體成功率無法區分這兩種失敗，也掩蓋錯誤傳播。本文提出呼叫層級的正確呼叫率測量，設計雙臂協定：在乾淨的教師強制脈絡與模型自由運行的自身脈絡下分別評分，於深度 1–8 的路由任務上比較五個開放權重模型，其中工具常數不對模型公開，使選擇錯誤得以傳播。主要發現有二。其一，傳播損失隨深度單調上升：到深度 6 時，約 70% 的乾淨脈絡能力已因自身較早錯誤而流失（L6 約 0.686 與 0.684）。其二，也是核心貢獻：在對固定標準答案軌跡做精確匹配評分時，傳播模型的嚴重度與恢復率並非難以估計，而是被評分規則事先決定——分歧後的目標值由模型無法得知的工具常數生成，屬於不可得的資訊，故嚴重度被釘在邊界值 1，恢復率結構上不可觀察；即使強行擬合仍得到看似可信卻錯誤的數值，收斂診斷亦全數正常。作者提出條件於狀態的評分作為補救，可對既有快取完成結果以零額外成本回溯套用，使嚴重度離開邊界並得到排除零的內部估計（+0.149、+0.316）；另有區辨統計量揭示某模型反相於所給規則。限制包括整數參數合成任務的生態效度有限、多個設計條件未執行。此研究提醒：若評分規則使參考軌跡在分歧後不可達，擬合出的嚴重度只是評分器的屬性，而非模型的能力。

links.title: Physical Agentic AI: An Architecture for Orchestrating a Robot Crew with LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'the deterministic Robot Orchestrator reduces false dispatch rate to 0% and blocks all injected faults across both testbeds—a result further supported by a held-plan ablation'

Section IV-A2: four conditions (LLM-only, Skill-list, RO-prompt, RO), 20 scenarios (12 nominal, 8 fault injections), all sharing 'gpt-5.4-mini, temperature 0.1', same schema, parser, and dispatch adapter
Table I (Section IV-A3): skill grounding 51%→96% (p=9.7e-7); false dispatch 23%→0% (p=5.0e-4 vs RO-prompt); safety-gate recall/precision 100% [68,100]
Table II (Section IV-B2): grounding 9%→97%; false dispatch 26–29%→0%; held-plan ablation moves 'false dispatch rate from 25.7% (9/35 steps) down to 0%'
Section IV-B1: 'The quantitative study evaluates 20 scenarios using mocked adapters over the hardware stack's tools and checking code'
Section IV-B3: 'Because only two hardware trials are performed, we reserve statistical claims for the mocked evaluation'
Section IV-A4: 'Across the eight injected faults, all eight violating steps were dispatched and six produced robot motion' under the unenforced RO-prompt arm
Section V: open questions on 'how substitution errors vary across foundation models' and 'how far the declarative contract layer can scale as skill libraries grow beyond hand-authored registries'
Abstract: code released at https://github.com/Liuuuxy/physical-agentic-ai; Section III-D: CrewAI base, ROS2 and Unitree SDK2 adapters
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-agent architecture paper (not pure robotics: the central question is LLM planner grounding vs. deterministic execution enforcement for agentic crews). Strong preference fit for Agents & Tool Use and LLMs; the core dissociation study cleanly separates retrieval from enforcement via four conditions plus a held-plan ablation, with Fisher's exact tests and Wilson CIs. Novelty is moderate: the non-actuating planner plus deterministic gate idea overlaps with cited prior work (SafeGate, classical task executives, SayCan-style skill grounding), with the 'retrieval-induced substitution' finding and dispatch-time state binding as the freshest elements. Rigor is decent but limited by a single foundation model (gpt-5.4-mini), 20 scenarios per testbed, hand-authored contracts, and a humanoid-quadruped quantitative evaluation that uses mocked adapters rather than physical trials (Section IV-B1), with only two qualitative hardware demonstrations (Section IV-B3). Evidence claims are honest and hedged, though 100% safety-gate recall rests on n=8 fault scenarios with wide CIs ([68,100]). Generalizability is bounded by two narrow mission types and untested contract-layer scaling (Section V). GitHub link and implementation stack (CrewAI, ROS2, PX4 SITL, Unitree SDK2) support reproducibility, but repo contents are unverifiable from the text.

primary_link.title: Physical Agentic AI: An Architecture for Orchestrating a Robot Crew with LLMs

papers.summary: Agentic AI frameworks interpret open-ended task goals and decompose them into multi-step plans. Richer information about embodiment-specific capabilities, physical preconditions, and cross-robot coordination improves grounding, but does not eliminate infeasible, mistimed, or unsafe physical actions. Physical robot crews therefore require an explicit architectural interface between semantic planning and execution, where every planned action is verified against robot capabilities, system state, an
papers.summary_zh: 代理式 AI 框架善於解析開放式任務並分解為多步計畫，但物理機器人的動作有狀態依賴、耗時且不可逆，僅給予模型更豐富的能力資訊並不能消除不可行、時序錯誤或不安全的動作。本文提出 Physical Agentic AI 架構，將語意規劃與執行授權明確分離：每台機器人暴露型別化的可執行技能庫，不具驅動權的任務規劃器以基礎模型分解任務並指派機器人—技能配對；工作流程契約由同一份宣告式規格同時編譯進規劃提示與執行時檢查器，確保規則不漂移；確定性的機器人編排器獨占致動權，在每次派發前驗證技能存在、參數有效且符合請求包含性、契約順序、機器人狀態與執行期綁定值。作者在四旋翼—地面車的 Gazebo 搜尋派遣任務與 Unitree G1 人形機器人—Go2 四足搬運任務上，以四種條件獨立操弄規劃知識與執行強制。結果顯示檢索將技能接地率從 51% 提升至 96%，但未強制的條件仍有 23–29% 的錯誤派發且擋下零個注入故障；確定性編排器將誤派發降至 0%，故障召回與精確率皆達 100%，held-plan 消融進一步確認因果。研究並發現「檢索誘導替換」：更充分的理解反而使幻覺轉為繞過語法檢查的似真替換。限制包括硬體試驗次數有限、閘門僅涵蓋已表徵的約束。結論是可靠物理執行需在語言模型之外強制約束，模型可協助規劃品質但不應掌握執行權。

links.title: GTA-RAG: Graph-Trajectory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: claims consistent outperformance of RL-based RAG baselines with Qwen2.5-3B/7B on three multi-hop and two simple QA benchmarks, improving evidence-chain coverage, and provides code URL github.com/cjcj46262/GTA-RAG
Table 1 (Sec. 4): average EM 44.5 (3B) / 50.5 (7B) vs RouteRAG 42.4/47.9 and Search-R1 40.4/48.6; but with 3B the method loses on PopQA (42.7 vs 45.8) and NQ (40.6 vs 46.2) EM
Sec. 4.2: concedes simple-QA results are 'competitive but not uniformly superior'; multi-hop gains over RouteRAG are 4.5 EM (3B) and 1.7 EM (7B)
Table 3 (Sec. 4.4): on 1,000 held-out synthetic multi-hop questions, target-doc coverage 82.3% vs 68.1% without trajectory-guided reward; complete-trajectory coverage 74.1% vs 54.3%

Table 2 (Sec. 4.3): removing TGR drops full-chain from 74.1% to 58.7% and multi-hop F1 by 3.4; the 74.1% full-chain figure identically matches Table 3's synthetic-set coverage with no significance tests reported anywhere
Appendix A Table 4: only 2,000 validated trajectories (1,899 2-hop, 93 3-hop, 8 4-hop); Stage I 20 steps, Stage II 40 steps on 10,000 HotpotQA instances, 128 prompts/step, 5 rollouts/prompt
Sec. 3.5 / Limitations: method depends on entity-document graph quality and deployed retriever; experiments restricted to open-domain QA
Appendix B: full synthesis prompt template provided; however retrieval parameters K_g, K_d, and PPR restart probability alpha (Eq. 7-8) are not reported in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope: LLM-based agentic RAG with GRPO RL, multi-hop reasoning, and graph retrieval matches high-weight preferences (Agents, Reasoning, LLMs, RAG). The core contribution — sampling document paths from an entity-document graph, synthesizing/validating executable multi-hop trajectories, and using a trajectory-guided reward (Eq. 15-17) — is a sensible but incremental combination of known components (HippoRAG-style graph retrieval, Search-R1-style RL, process rewards); the paper itself cites GraphRAG-R1 as process-constrained RL. Rigor is solid: 5 benchmarks, 2 backbones, 3 ablations, retrieval-behavior analysis; but no statistical significance, ablations only on 7B, the Full-chain metric's definition on natural benchmarks is unexplained, and Stage II trains on 10,000 HotpotQA instances while evaluating HotpotQA without stating split separation. Evidence is mostly supported by concrete tables, yet two red flags temper it: Table 2's Full-chain (74.1%) on natural multi-hop exactly equals Table 3's complete-trajectory coverage on 1,000 held-out synthetic questions (a suspicious coincidence), and behavior analysis is run on synthetic questions mirroring the training distribution, which can inflate coverage. Retrieval hyperparameters (K_g, K_d, alpha) are not reported. Generalizability is limited to open-domain QA and dependent on OpenIE graph quality (acknowledged in Limitations). Reproducibility is aided by a code URL, prompt templates (Appendix B), and training schedule details.

For complex multi-hop questions, multi-turn retrieval-augmented reasoning extends RAG into an iterative process that repeatedly searches for and integrates evidence across documents. However, existing reinforcement-learning (RL) approaches for agentic RAG are typically optimized with final-answer rewards, which provide sparse supervision and overlook whether the model actua
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成讓大型語言模型存取外部知識，但多跳問題需要跨文件迭代搜尋與整合證據。現有代理式 RAG 的強化學習方法多以最終答案的精確匹配作為獎勵，監督稀疏，無法區分有證據依據的推理路徑與碰巧答對的捷徑，模型可能未檢索到必要證據鏈仍得分。本文提出 GTA-RAG，將圖結構語料庫同時作為檢索環境與軌跡級監督來源：先以 OpenIE 抽取三元組建構實體—文件異質圖，對圖取樣連通文件路徑，由強生成器合成多跳問答與逐步搜尋軌跡，並以實際部署的圖增強檢索器（個人化 PageRank 加上稠密段落檢索）驗證每個目標文件皆可被實際取回，僅保留可執行的軌跡。訓練採兩階段 GRPO：第一階段以軌跡引導獎勵，對取得新目標文件給予中間獎勵，完整檢索到證據鏈且答對者獲得更高終端獎勵；第二階段在自然問答資料上以答案獎勵繼續最佳化。在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue、PopQA 與 NQ 五項基準上，以 Qwen2.5-3B 與 7B 為主幹的 GTA-RAG 一致超越 Search-R1、RouteRAG、R1-Searcher 等 RL 基線；消融證實軌跡引導獎勵、軌跡驗證與圖檢索皆有貢獻，完整證據鏈覆蓋率由 58.7% 提升至 74.1%，且在更少搜尋次數下減少零目標輪次。限制在於依賴圖與檢索器品質，且目前聚焦開放領域問答。此方法展示圖結構可作為過程監督的可擴充來源，培養更具證據基礎的檢索行為。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM alignment/safety evaluation paper (hits LLM, AI Safety, Alignment & RLHF, and Red Teaming/Evaluation preferences; no Japanese-specific content). The measurement protocol (pairwise aligned-vs-ablated comparison isolating per-language Safety Cost) is well executed with unusually thorough controls: matched-checkpoint retraining from base, human-judge agreement, length-matched re-analysis, ordinary-benign control, translation validation, and a second judge. Novelty is moderate: it extends known safety-tax and multilingual safety-gap findings with a new controlled design and the implicit-degradation channel, rather than introducing new methods. Evidence is strong but rests on LLM-as-judge win rates from ~100-prompt samples per cell with no reported statistical significance tests, and headline disparities are confined to two of four model families. Generalizability is limited to 4 open-weight families and 7 languages; closed models cannot be evaluated. Reproducibility is decent (public models/benchmarks, detailed prompts and training hyperparameters in appendices) but no explicit code/data release is stated.

papers.summary: Safety alignment helps models adhere to human values, but it often reduces response utility. To answer this, we introduce a rigorous protocol to measure the utility loss imposed solely by safety alignment, which we term Safety Cost. Through direct pairwise comparisons between safety-aligned models and their unaligned counterparts, we find a systematic inequity: non-English users con
papers.summary_zh: 安全對齊雖使模型遵循人類價值,卻常犧牲回應實用性。本文提出嚴謹評測協定,將安全對齊直接造成的實用性損失定義為「安全成本」,並透過對齊模型與其未對齊對照(以 abliteration 移除拒答方向)的成對比較加以分離,排除既有能力差距的混淆。作者將 XSTest、OR-Bench 等過度拒答基準翻譯成中文、越南文、阿拉伯文、韓文與泰文,評測 Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen2.5-72B、Gemma-3-27B 與 Qwen3-32B,由 GPT-5-mini 擔任評判。結果顯示非英語使用者系統性承受更高的安全成本:多數語言落入「雙重懲罰區」,安全保護較弱卻付出更高代價;Qwen3 部分語言看似成本低,實為安全過濾器未啟動;即使中文等高資源語言達到與英語相同的安全水準,仍須付出更高代價。分析指出成本不僅來自明確拒答,更包含抑制資訊深度與事實精確度的隱性品質劣化;混淆分析與從頭訓練的配對檢查點複製證實結果並非消融假象,人工評分與自動評判亦高度一致。限制包括僅限開放權重模型與有限語言範圍。此研究揭露當前安全對齊的結構性不公,呼籲開發跨語言公平的安全機制。

Sec 5.2, Tab 3: commercial transfer avg G-ASR 52.3% vs IDEATOR 49.4%; first on GPT-4o (52.3) and Gemini (68.9), but IDEATOR is better on ERNIE (38.6 vs 35.7)

llm_evaluation.rationale: An MLLM jailbreak/transfer-attack paper that squarely matches high-weight preferences: LLMs (victims built on Llama/Vicuna backbones, GPT-4o/Gemini APIs, LLM judges and paraphrasers), AI Safety and Red Teaming (black-box jailbreak framework, defense evaluation), Multimodal AI (CLIP-anchored vision-language perturbations), and partially Alignment (motivated by text-centered RLHF/DPO alignment gaps). Not out-of-scope since the methodology is language-centric, not pure vision. Novelty is moderate: text-anchored semantic/residual factorization plus augmentation is a coherent but incremental twist on existing feature-space transfer attacks (Inkawhich et al., intermediate-level attacks) and prior multimodal jailbreaks (ImgJP, FigStep, HADES, IDEATOR, MML). Rigor is solid: threat model, baselines across text-only and multimodal attacks, incremental ablations, matched perturbation controls, surrogate swaps, judge calibration with humans, and defense robustness. Evidence is reasonably strong and honestly caveated (clean proxy alone reaches 45.0% G-ASR vs 60.0% full method; factorization probe 0.75 vs 0.46 macro-F1 'without perfect disentanglement'), but head-to-head evaluations use only 40 requests, ablations are single-model (MiniGPT-4), commercial transfer uses one benchmark, and no confidence intervals are reported. Generalizability is supported across 6 victims, 3 benchmarks, 4 defenses, and cross-dataset/surrogate checks, though limited to image-text modality as the authors admit. Reproducibility is aided by Algorithm 1, hyperparameters (PGD T=100, eps=8/255, beta=0.7, m=5), and prompts in the appendix, with a code repository claimed but not verifiable from the document.

primary_link.title: Text-Anchored Semantic Perturbations for Transferable Jailbreak Attacks on Multimodal Large Language Models

papers.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in vision-language interaction, yet their safety alignment remains vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. A key challenge is that safety behavior learned in the textual space does not reliably transfer to fused cross-modal representations, leaving multimodal inputs exploitable through latent semantic cues. We propose Text-Anchored Semantic Perturbation Attack (TA-SPA), a black-box jailbreak framework that optimizes transferable
papers.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型的安全對齊主要在文字空間學習,但模型實際在融合的跨模態表示上做決策,使視覺輸入成為可利用的攻擊面。既有越獄攻擊多在像素或糾纏的特徵空間直接最佳化,易過擬合代理模型的表層紋理與詞彙線索,跨模型遷移性有限。本文提出 TA-SPA,一個黑箱可遷移越獄框架:首先以 TASF(文字錨定語意因式分解)利用凍結的 CLIP 編碼器,將表示分解為跨模態語意因子與模態殘差,引導擾動指向高層有害意圖;再以 SPA(語意保留增強)在固定語意因子下擴增多樣的目標殘差,搭配查詢改寫與對比邊際損失,降低對單一詞彙觸發的依賴。在 AdvBench、MM-SafetyBench 與 VAJM 上,TA-SPA 於 LLaVA-7B、MiniGPT-4、InstructBLIP 取得最佳的 GPT 評判攻擊成功率,並成功遷移至 GPT-4o、Gemini 與 ERNIE(平均 52.3%),在 VLGuard、AdaShield 等代表性防禦下仍最穩健;消融與控制實驗逐一驗證各元件貢獻。限制為僅驗證影像與文字模態及固定基準,自動指標難以捕捉細緻的危害程度。此研究揭示表示層級的安全弱點,呼籲發展超越輸入過濾的表示級安全對齊。

links.title: ClawProBench: Trace-Aware Evaluation of AI Agents with Runtime Coverage and Frozen Workplace-Style Holdouts

evidence: Abstract: strongest full-profile score 0.7671; native 0.5238 vs workspace-live 0.6415; holdout pass@k-any 0.6638 vs strict three-trial 0.2890.

Limitations section: descriptive-not-causal analyses, holdout is a calibrated selector freeze rather than permanently unseen, failure taxonomy auto-generated and treated as audit priorities.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope agent-benchmark paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, evaluation/leaderboards, AI safety gates). It is unusually honest and internally consistent: bootstrap intervals are reported even where they undermine claims (full-vs-holdout Spearman 0.1754, CI [-0.23,0.54]), denominators are ledgered (68/67/66/61/60 rows), status semantics and C/P weight sweeps are disclosed. However, novelty is integrative rather than conceptual - the paper itself concedes live execution, trajectories, repeated trials, and safety scoring individually exist in WildClawBench/Claw-Eval/CLAWSBench - so the contribution reduces to a runtime-version binding finding (same-model score shifts up to 0.052 across OpenClaw releases and 0.0716 across harnesses) plus an adaptation contract. Evidence is self-generated from own manifests with no external replication, the safety gate rarely fires (mean pass rate 0.9947, Table 41), scoring weights are declared policy rather than validated, and the failure taxonomy is auto-grouped from checker details. Generalizability is explicitly bounded: native profile is OpenClaw-specific, cross-runtime covers only 4 models × 3 harnesses on one 68-task English workspace holdout. Reproducibility posture is strong (hashes, manifests, inventory commands, redaction scans) though provider configs are intentionally excluded.

primary_link.title: ClawProBench: Trace-Aware Evaluation of AI Agents with Runtime Coverage and Frozen Workplace-Style Holdouts

papers.summary: Agent benchmarks often evaluate only final answers even when agents run on stateful runtimes. We argue this under-specifies what is being evaluated: the proper unit is a declared model-plus-runtime configuration whose failures can occur in evidence acquisition, runtime routing, safety boundaries, or repeated execution. We present ClawProBench, a trace-aware benchmark for runtime-native agent evaluation instantiated on OpenClaw, a live agent runtime with workspace tools and native surfaces for br
papers.summary_zh: 代理基準多只看最終任務是否成功,忽略執行軌跡、狀態語意與過程品質。ClawProBench 針對「宣告的模型加執行環境」組態進行軌跡感知評測:完整剖面含 102 個情境(66 個工作區任務與 36 個橫跨 skills、browser、memory 等八種 OpenClaw 原生介面的任務),另設凍結的 68 情境工作區保留集,支援重複試驗信度分析與固定契約的跨環境比較。每個試驗以含安全閘門的公式由軌跡計分,結合正確性(權重 0.65)、過程(0.35)、效率懲罰與嚴重度感知安全閘門,並保留執行狀態與失敗檢查證據;每情境執行三次。實證顯示:最高分僅 0.7671,模型間仍區隔明顯;原生情境平均 0.5238 低於工作區的 0.6415;pass@k-any 為 0.6638,遠高於三次全過的 0.2890,顯示一次性成功不可靠;全剖面與保留集的排名相關僅 0.1754 且信賴區間跨零。新增實驗發現同一模型在四個 OpenClaw 版本間分數差可達 0.052,跨 OpenClaw、IronClaw、NanoClaw 的差距達 0.0716,嚴格信度差 19.1 個百分點。限制為評測對象是組態而非純模型能力,公開保留集仍有過擬合風險,多數分析屬描述性而非因果。此基準證明只看答案的排名會隱藏環境敏感性與不穩定的成功率。

links.title: CodeMechanic: Bug-Property-Guided Program Mitigation

evidence: Abstract: 'On 101 real-world ARVO bugs, the first attempt of CodeMechanic produces 47.6% more plausible patches ... than the best baseline while using 91% fewer tokens.'

Section 6.1: 'We employed Gemini-2.5-flash (June 2025) as the default LLM for all AVR agents ... Alternative models, including Gemini-2.5-pro and Gemini-2.5-flash-lite, were tested but frequently failed due to internal errors.'
Section 6.2: 'CodeMechanic achieves an average of 37.2 plausible patches across five runs, which is nearly three times that of PatchAgent1 and 47.6% higher than San2Patch1.'
Section 6.5: 'Of the 51 plausible patches from CodeMechanic, 34 are non-IP mitigations and 17 are semantically equivalent to the developer-written repair.'

Section 6.4: 'Given the 45 bugs for which CodeMechanic finds all key variables, 37 plausible patches are generated ... the LLM generates a plausible mitigation for 82% of cases within three attempts.'
Section 4.2: 'we embed human debugging knowledge into the prompt via few-shot prompting' including tool call ordering and error tolerance.
Section 8.2: 'CodeMechanic is currently focused on spatial memory corruptions' with temporal bugs excluded due to lack of reliable detection oracles.
Section 9 (Conclusion): 'We release the prototype to support open science and further research' - release promised, not yet verifiable.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: an LLM-agent system (Gemini-2.5-flash) with tool orchestration (macro resolution, GDB-based data view, buffer inference), few-shot in-prompt debugging knowledge, and constrained structured output for code/vulnerability repair, matching the high-weight Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and LLM preferences; it is not a pure domain-application or out-of-scope CV/robotics/audio paper. Novelty is solid: reframing open-ended LLM AVR into bug-property-guided, fail-stop mitigation with a validated boundary property (Section 3.2) is a genuine contribution over PatchAgent/San2Patch and template-only constraint repair (Table 1), though it combines known pieces (LLM agents, ASan oracles, guard insertion). Rigor is good: 101 ARVO bugs with stated selection criteria, two SOTA baselines, 5-trial averaging, per-bug-type and per-stage failure analysis (Sections 6.2-6.4), and a manual audit taxonomy separating plausible from semantically equivalent patches (Section 6.5). Evidence is internally consistent (37.2 vs 25.2 plausible patches = 47.6%; $2.75 vs $21.3 cost; 17 vs 5/4 SE patches = 240%/325%), though key results live in untabulated figures, the audit lacks inter-rater detail, and only one LLM was usable (Section 6.1 notes Gemini-2.5-pro/flash-lite failed with internal errors). Generalizability is deliberately narrow: spatial memory corruption only, temporal bugs excluded (Section 8.2). Reproducibility is moderate: public ARVO benchmark and described tooling (GDB 12.1, Clang wrapper, ~5,500 LOC), but code release is only promised upon acceptance and full prompts are not shown.
topics: few-shot prompting with embedded expert knowledge

primary_link.title: CodeMechanic: Bug-Property-Guided Program Mitigation

papers.summary:
Automated testing discovers vulnerabilities faster than developers can investigate and repair them, leaving an interval in which known memory corruptions remain exploitable. End- to-end LLM repair agents can shorten this interval, but they synthesize open-ended code changes and commonly validate them only by replaying a proof of concept (PoC). This weak oracle accepts patches that silence the observed crash by changing unrelated behavior, making unintended deployment risky.
  We present CodeMech
papers.summary_zh: 自動化測試發現漏洞的速度超過開發者的修復能力,而現有 LLM 修復代理產生開放式修補,僅以重放 PoC 驗證,可能透過改動無關行為消除崩潰而通過檢驗,貿然部署風險高。CodeMechanic 改採錯誤屬性引導的受限緩解:不要求永久修復,而是從崩潰重建被違反的空間記憶體安全屬性,驗證被解引用指標及其緩衝區範圍,並在危險存取前插入局部的 fail-stop 防護,一旦邊界檢查失敗即終止執行,刻意以可用性換取安全性。系統整合二維情境萃取(程式碼檢視含巨集解析與緩衝區推斷;資料檢視含 ASan 中繼資料與 GDB 會話)、內嵌於提示的人類除錯知識,以及逐步驗證與錯誤訊息驅動的修正,以限制 LLM 錯誤的影響。在 101 個真實 ARVO 漏洞上,單次嘗試的可信修補數比最佳基線 San2Patch 高 47.6%,token 成本僅約其 9%(2.75 美元對 21.3 美元);五次嘗試下仍多 13.3%,成本僅 10%;人工審計顯示其與開發者修補語意等價的數量為兩基線的 3.4 至 4.3 倍。主要失敗來自過度受限的邊界與寫死執行期常數,情境萃取仍是瓶頸。此方法提供副作用可控、行為可預測的過渡性緩解。
