links.title: OmniCAD: A Large-Scale Benchmark for 3D Spatial Reasoning in Robotics Assemblies

evidence: Abstract: benchmark of 25k industrial assemblies with component-level 3D spatial reasoning, part-to-part relational reasoning, and tool-augmented agentic assembly reasoning tasks; results show VLMs produce incorrect poses, invalid mating relationships, and part interpenetration.
Table 1: OmniCAD row lists 25K assemblies, avg. 12 components, 8 views, 21 mate types, with mate graph, 3D object, B-Rep, and mesh all available, versus prior datasets lacking one or more of these.

Experimental Setups > Direct One-shot Evaluation: five input configurations (SameColor, RefOBJ, ColorView, MG+Color, MG+OBJ+Color) used to isolate appearance, geometry, and connectivity cues across nine proprietary/open-weight LMMs.

Main Results and Findings: average ID-NR 95.1% vs ID-R 26.4% under ColorView; best one-shot Pos@10 27.9% vs best agentic 34.6%; best C-Free 43.8% under agentic conflict feedback, i.e., more than half of predictions still contain conflicts.
Verification: ColorView ID-R values across the nine models in Table 2 (57.10, 15.00, 24.10, 6.50, 25.20, 24.40, 53.20, 28.60, 3.30) average to 26.4%, matching the claimed 26.4%.

Inconsistency: Abstract states 'renderings from 20 distinct viewpoints', while Experimental Setups describes 'eight target views rendered from fixed cube-vertex directions' and Table 1 lists #View = 8.

Evaluation Metrics: defines Pos@10mm, Rot@10°, PairF1, TypeAcc, GSim, C-Free, RT, PR, but the document never reports the number of evaluated assemblies per table, and this section contains a duplicated sentence fragment.

Reproducibility: Abstract/conclusion only promise 'We will open-source the benchmark, evaluation code, and tool interfaces'; Benchmark Construction states annotation extraction via the proprietary SolidWorks API from GrabCAD, 3D ContentCentral, TraceParts, and GitHub.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark paper evaluating nine frontier LMMs/VLMs on industrial 3D assembly reasoning, including a tool-augmented agentic evaluation with iterative visual/conflict feedback. It aligns well with high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents & tool use, reasoning, multimodal evaluation), though the CAD-assembly domain is niche. Novelty is moderate-to-good: Table 1 shows it is larger and more richly annotated (mate graphs, B-Rep, mesh, multi-view) than prior assembly datasets, and the agentic constraint-aware setting is new for this task. Rigor is mixed: metrics are carefully defined and the five input configurations act as ablations, but the evaluated subset size is never stated, no significance testing or error bars are given, and there are editorial defects (a duplicated sentence in Evaluation Metrics; the abstract claims 20 viewpoints while the body uses 8 cube-vertex views; Qwen3.5-9B MG+OBJ+Color row is empty). Evidence strength is decent because spot-checks of headline claims against Tables 2-3 are internally consistent (ColorView ID-NR mean 95.1% vs ID-R 26.4%; 6/9 models improved ID-R with color views; 7/9 improved Pos@10/Rot@10 with mate-graph conditioning), yet small metric denominators (e.g., values like 11.10%, 57.10%) suggest a tiny eval subset relative to the claimed 25K assemblies. Generalizability is moderate: findings on repeated-part reuse, metric localization, and interpenetration plausibly extend to spatial/multimodal reasoning broadly. Reproducibility is limited: open-sourcing is only a future-tense promise, the annotation pipeline depends on the proprietary SolidWorks API, and evaluation relies on commercial model APIs.

primary_link.title: OmniCAD: A Large-Scale Benchmark for 3D Spatial Reasoning in Robotics Assemblies

papers.summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) show strong capabilities in robotic perception and spatial reasoning, yet their ability to reason about complex mechanical assemblies remains underexplored. We introduce OmniCAD, a large-scale benchmark for assembly-aware 3D spatial reasoning across diverse industrial systems, including robotic mechanisms, automotive components, aerospace structures, and agricultural machinery. OmniCAD contains 25k mechanical assemblies, with an average of 12 parts per assemb
papers.summary_zh: 視覺語言模型在機器人空間關係推理上表現亮眼,但對複雜工業機械組裝的推理能力仍未被檢驗。既有資料集多聚焦家具組裝,零件少、連接簡單,無法涵蓋真實工業場景的幾何複雜度、零件歧義與稠密配合約束。本文提出 OmniCAD,首個大規模、組裝感知的三維空間推理基準:包含 25,000 個真實工業機械組裝,涵蓋機器人機構、汽車、航太與農機等領域,平均每個組裝 12 個零件、21 種配合關係,附 SolidWorks 原生檔、B-Rep、網格、八視角渲染、去重零件庫,以及由人類工程師建置驗證的 6-DoF 真值與配合圖。基準評估三項任務:元件層級的 3D 空間推理(辨識含重複使用的零件並估計 6-DoF 姿態)、零件間配合關係推理,以及迭代選擇視角並自我修正的工具增強代理式推理。評測 GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.1 Pro 等九個模型顯示:非重複元件辨識尚佳(約 95%),但重複零件的重用僅約 26%;平移精度遠差於旋轉,最佳 Pos@10mm 僅 27.9%,代理式為 34.6%;配合圖恢復與無碰撞率偏低,零件互相穿透常見;代理回饋僅能粗略修正。此基準揭露 VLM 在物理有效且可擴展組裝推理上的關鍵缺陷,為後續研究建立標準化基礎。
papers.title: OmniCAD: A Large-Scale Benchmark for 3D Spatial Reasoning in Robotics Assemblies
papers.title_zh: OmniCAD:用於機器人組裝三維空間推理的大規模基準

links.title: MCP-Universe RL: A Framework for Training MCP Tool-Use Agents via Reinforcement Learning

evidence: §4.1: software-engineering training on R2E-Gym raises success rate from about 0.11 to about 0.43 (peaking near 0.6) over 60 steps; mean response length grows from 13k to 33k tokens.
§4.1: deep-research training on DeepDive raises success from about 0.22 to about 0.52 (peak 0.65); general tool use on AgentWorldModel-1k rises from 0.48 to about 0.55.
§4.2 + Appendix C: decoupled per-stage concurrency raises rollout throughput from 147 to 410 tokens/s (2.8x) with acquire fixed at 24 workers and live environments held at 120.
Table 1: fully asynchronous placement achieves 572 s/step (6.3 steps/h) vs colocated 1164 s/step (3.1 steps/h) at matched concurrency 120 on 3x H200 without NVLink.
§3.2: the three-stage pipeline design 'follow[s] prior agentic-RL rollout systems' (citing SkyRL-Agent), indicating the scheduling contribution is incremental.
§2: closest work OpenPipe MCP-RL 'trains a model to use a single MCP server's tools' and MiroRL 'targets the single deep-research domain'; MCP-U RL claims cross-domain training from one framework.
Appendix A: released under Apache-2.0 with runnable configurations for all three domains of §4.1; Appendix B gives GRPO, lr 2e-6, n=8 trajectories/task, binary evaluator rewards, max seq len 128k.
Appendix E: rewards come from task evaluators (hidden test suite in-container, LLM judge for deep research, deterministic SQL/code verifier for general tool use).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Open-source systems framework for RL training of MCP tool-use agents; directly on-target for agentic LLM research (tool calling, GRPO training, multi-domain agents). Novelty is moderate rather than high: the rollout pipeline explicitly follows prior agentic-RL systems (cited in §3.2), and the related-work section (§2) concedes neighboring MCP-RL efforts (OpenPipe MCP-RL, MiroRL, MCP-Flow); the differentiator is MCP as a single environment interface plus reusable orchestration layers. Rigor is limited by no head-to-head baselines against competing frameworks, a single policy model (gpt-oss-20b), single-run training curves reported with approximate values and no variance. Throughput ablations are well controlled (memory budget held fixed at 120 live environments, matched concurrency in Appendix C). Evidence is concrete but entirely self-generated; the paper disclaims SOTA aims. Reproducibility is strong (Apache-2.0 release, per-domain configs, Appendix B hyperparameters, HF dataset links), with a minor caveat that the deep-research domain requires paid web-search/scraping APIs.

primary_link.title: MCP-Universe RL: A Framework for Training MCP Tool-Use Agents via Reinforcement Learning

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective way to improve the tool-use ability of large language models (LLMs), but most existing RL frameworks stop at the policy update. For every new domain, the user is left with two hard systems problems: standing up an isolated environment for each of hundreds of concurrent trajectories and connecting it to training, and scheduling the rollout so that the GPU stays busy across long, multi-turn episodes that spend much of their time stalled on slow t
papers.summary_zh: 強化學習已證明能提升大型語言模型的工具使用能力,但既有框架多止於策略更新:使用者仍須為每個新領域自行搭建隔離環境並排程 rollout,系統工程門檻高。MCP-Universe RL(MCP-U RL)是開源框架,以 Model Context Protocol(MCP)作為環境的單一介面,任何既有 MCP 伺服器皆可免改接入訓練。框架分三層:環境編排層在可插拔的容器後端上供給、隔離並回收數百個並行 MCP 環境;rollout 編排層以「取得環境、執行、評分」三階段重疊管線,隱藏工具呼叫造成的 GPU 閒置,並以分階段並發控制(執行階段工作者數至少為取得階段的兩倍)在不超過記憶體預算下維持 GPU 忙碌;訓練層透過 veRL 與 slime 介接既有 RL 後端。使用者僅需撰寫任務規格即可切換領域。以單一組態訓練 gpt-oss-20b:軟體工程成功率由 0.11 升至 0.43,深度研究由 0.22 升至 0.52,通用工具使用由 0.48 升至 0.55;解耦 rollout 使輸送量提升 2.8 倍,全非同步 GPU 配置再快約 2 倍。限制為不以追求基準最佳表現為目標,策略更新採一步離線。此框架大幅降低在 MCP 生態系上訓練工具使用代理的成本。
papers.title: MCP-Universe RL: A Framework for Training MCP Tool-Use Agents via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: MCP-Universe RL:透過強化學習訓練 MCP 工具使用代理的框架

links.title: Beyond Dense Adam States: Adaptive Log-Space Quantization for Memory-Efficient Optimizers

evidence: Abstract: 96 runs / 214.7 GPU-hours; AdamW with AL8 second moments + uniform 8-bit momentum reaches 72.90 PPL vs 72.48 FP32 and 73.54 Dyn8 baseline, with optimizer-state storage reduced 8392.7 to 2119.2 MiB
Section 6.2, Table 3: CAME all-AL8 reaches 90.19 PPL vs 86.68 FP32 reference; AL16 recovers 86.16 at 1069.8 MiB state vs 4203.2 MiB reference
Section 6.4, Table 4: Adafactor late-loss gap +0.1185 (G0, B=256) reduced to +0.0159 under G1; G1/B=2048 cell absent, so grouping-block-size interaction explicitly not identified
Section 5.2, Table 2: 90%-sparse probe shows no-zero-code variant yields >100% no-clip update error vs 0.122% with reserved zero code
Section 7.4 Limitations: seed 921 only, one 1.1B and one 124M architecture, one corpus, single device; endpoint differences described as 'measurements rather than uncertainty estimates'
Section 7.1/7.3: public artifact yanfeiwong/al-quantization with frozen revision 4f544d8; smoke run reports 171 PASS, 0 FAIL, 4 WARN, 0 SKIP; scripts and manifest for every table and figure

Section 2.1: acknowledges 'Logarithmic second-moment quantization is therefore prior art' (SOLO), framing contribution as block-adaptive interval plus bidirectional exact-zero invariant plus structured-state evaluation
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM training/efficiency methodology (optimizer-state quantization for TinyLlama-1.1B and GPT-2 pre-training), not a domain application. Core technique (log-space coding of second moments) is acknowledged prior art (SOLO, 4-bit optimizers); the genuine increments are the block-adaptive nonzero interval, bidirectional exact-zero invariant, and the topology/update-semantics analysis across factored (Adafactor), confidence (CAME), and projected (APOLLO) states. Rigor is strong: controlled state/update-domain diagnostics, exact-zero ablation, block-granularity sweep, LR/batch sensitivity, and unusually honest bounded claims; weaknesses are single-seed end-to-end comparisons, modest scale (20K/100K steps, WikiText-103 only, single RTX 3090 Ti), a confounded G1 grouping, and a missing 100K G1/B=2048 cell. Evidence supports only the carefully hedged conclusions; the paper itself declines to overclaim (e.g., 86.16 vs 86.68 PPL not framed as improvement). Generalizability is explicitly limited to tested architectures/corpus/device. Reproducibility is excellent: pinned artifact commit (Adafactor8Bit v0.4.3 @ 4f544d8), per-table/figure scripts with manifest, smoke tests (171 PASS, 4 WARN), environment and package pins, TensorBoard exports.

primary_link.title: Beyond Dense Adam States: Adaptive Log-Space Quantization for Memory-Efficient Optimizers

papers.summary: Low-precision optimizer-state methods are commonly designed and evaluated for dense Adam-style first and second moments. Memory-efficient optimizers depart from this setting: Adafactor factorizes second moments, CAME adds factored confidence states, and APOLLO maintains statistics in a projected gradient space. Consequently, an equal amount of state reconstruction error can induce different update errors depending on state topology and update semantics. We first characterize this heterogeneity i
papers.summary_zh: 低精度最佳化器狀態方法多針對稠密 Adam 式的一、二階動量設計,但 Adafactor、CAME、APOLLO 等記憶體高效最佳化器的狀態具有因式分解、置信與投影等不同拓撲與更新語意,等量的重建誤差可能導致不同的更新誤差。本文先由語言模型預訓練軌跡刻畫各狀態的數值範圍與精確零分布,再提出自適應對數空間(AL)量化:逐區塊擬合非零值的對數區間,並保留代碼零專屬於精確零,確保 q=0 ⇔ x=0,避免正的二階動量塌縮為零,也避免休眠狀態被賦予虛假的正歷史。AL8 與 AL16 搭配獨立的有符號動量編碼與各狀態專屬的精度選擇。在 96 次實驗、共 214.7 GPU 小時的評測中:TinyLlama-1.1B 預訓練 20K 步,採 AL8 二階動量與均勻 8 位元動量的 AdamW 達到 72.90 困惑度,優於 8 位元動態量化基線的 73.54,最佳化器狀態儲存由 8392.7 降至 2119.2 MiB;CAME 需將非負狀態提升至 AL16 才能接近全精度(86.16 對 86.68);GPT-2 100K 步實驗顯示拓撲感知的參數保護將量化 Adafactor 的後期損失差距由 +0.1185 縮小至 +0.0159。限制涵蓋規模與架構、單一種子以及耦合的分組干預。核心啟示是:最佳化器狀態量化應追隨狀態的拓撲與更新語意,沒有單一量化器在所有路徑上皆最佳。
papers.title: Beyond Dense Adam States: Adaptive Log-Space Quantization for Memory-Efficient Optimizers
papers.title_zh: 超越稠密 Adam 狀態:記憶體高效最佳化器的自適應對數空間量化

links.title: Auditing the Synthetic Memoir: Measuring Scene-Level Confabulation in LLM-Generated Autobiography Against the Documented Record of the Life It Describes

evidence: Section 5.1 / Table 1: 354 of 366 days (96.7%, Wilson 95% CI 94.4-98.1%) fail positive scene-level verification; only 12 VERIFIED; 19 (5.2%) CONTRADICTED.

Section 5.6 / Table 4: blind re-rates of 60-day samples give binary raw agreement 95.0% (rater B) and 98.3% (rater C); four-way agreement kappa 0.387 and 0.573, with 21 of B's 22 disagreements involving the WEAK cell.

Section 5.7 / Table 5: 2026 ungrounded arms (gpt-5.4, claude-sonnet-5) fail verification 100% (Fisher p=1.0 vs originals); grounded Arm C reduces failure to 83.3% (B vs C p=0.0013), corroborated scenes 0 to 10.

Section 7.1: all 366 verdicts were assigned by an LLM auditor (Claude-based agents) with only four explicit author rulings; paper prose and analysis scripts were LLM-drafted, disclosed per arXiv policy.

Section 9 / Reproducibility Statement: public package reproduces headline distribution, CIs, and monthly cross-tab via analysis/02_analyze_public.py from a 366-row date+verdict dataset, but day-entries, replication entries, and audit fields are deliberately withheld, so premise screens and source-class coverage cannot be regenerated publicly.
Section 7 (Limitations): single subject precludes population estimates; unverified conflates 'invented' with 'real but unrecorded'; LLM re-raters establish inter-model consistency, not correctness.

Appendix B: fully specified replication methods (sampling seed 20260821, verbatim archived prompt, keyword-window retrieval for Arm C, anonymized rater prompt) and disclosure that a first non-blind rating pass was discarded wholesale.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-confabulation measurement paper squarely within scope: it audits LLM-generated autobiography at scene level against a subject-specific ground-truth corpus, tests a grounding/RAG-style remediation, and studies LLM-as-judge reliability of its own rubric. Methodological hygiene is unusually strong for a case study (pre-fixed rubric dated before tallying, Wilson CIs, Fisher exact tests, blind re-raters, a compromised non-blind rating pass disclosed and discarded, explicit confound disclosures). Key weaknesses: the dependent variable is LLM-assigned labels with only four author rulings (circularity acknowledged in Sections 4.6/7), raters judged from retrieved excerpts rather than the full corpus, finite ground truth makes 'verified' a lower bound and inflates easy binary agreement at a near-zero verified base rate, the replication is a 60-day sample, and everything rests on one life and one generator deployment, so no population estimate is possible. Reproducibility is partial: headline numbers, verdict dataset, stats., and scripts are public, but the day-entries and audit fields are withheld for privacy, so several published outputs cannot be regenerated. Novel but narrow; solid evidence within its stated limits.

primary_link.title: Auditing the Synthetic Memoir: Measuring Scene-Level Confabulation in LLM-Generated Autobiography Against the Documented Record of the Life It Describes

papers.summary: When a large language model (LLM) is asked to write a person's life, how much of what it writes actually happened? We present a scene-level case-study audit - the first quantified audit of LLM-generated autobiography against a subject-specific ground-truth corpus that we are aware of, based on an unsystematic literature search. The subject and the author of this paper are the same person: a 366-day "page-a-day" book of first-person anecdotal entries was drafted with a conversational LLM whose do
papers.summary_zh: 當大型語言模型被要求撰寫一個人的一生,寫出的內容有多少真的發生過?本文作者即受試者本人,對一本 366 天、由對話式 LLM(輸入僅含範本、兩個範例日與當日引言,不含其語料庫)草擬的每日一頁自傳,逐日在獨立驗證語料庫(回憶錄、公開著作、演講紀錄等)上,以預先固定的四級評分(verified、weak、unverified、contradicted)進行場景層級審計。結果顯示 354/366 天(96.7%)未通過正面場景驗證,19 天(5.2%)被紀錄正面駁斥,主要失敗模式為「有根據的漂移」— 真實的雇主、城市與人物被放進虛構場景。兩位獨立盲評者複製了整體結論(二分一致性 95% 至 98.3%),但四分類信度僅 fair 至 moderate(κ 0.387 至 0.573),問題集中在 WEAK 與 UNVERIFIED 邊界對「設定」的定義不清。以 2026 年模型(gpt-5.4、claude-sonnet-5)在相同輸入下重跑,未接地時驗證失敗率達 100%;僅在接地語料庫後才降至 83.3%。限制包括單一受試者、標籤由 LLM 指派的循環性,以及有限真值使 unverified 不等同虛構。此研究首次量化人像模擬的情境層風險,提供可重用的審計工具與接地補救流程。
papers.title: Auditing the Synthetic Memoir: Measuring Scene-Level Confabulation in LLM-Generated Autobiography Against the Documented Record of the Life It Describes
papers.title_zh: 審計合成回憶錄:對照真實紀錄衡量 LLM 生成自傳的場景層級虛構

links.title: CausalCache: Conditional High-Fidelity Restoration for Long-Horizon GUI Agents

evidence: Abstract: CausalCache improves zero-shot MobileWorld from 30.2% to 36.8% over Recent-4, concentrated on the pre-defined cross-app memory-candidate split (30.6% vs 19.4%, +11.2) with no detectable difference on single-app controls (43.6% vs 42.4%).

Method > Policy-Preserving History-Gated KV Adapter: rank-8, alpha=16 low-rank residuals added only to K/V projections of the last eight layers, masked to restored history-image tokens, bitwise-identical to the frozen policy at B=0.

Experiments > Results, Table 1: at the official 15-step OSWorld-Verified cap the allocation contrast is +0.3 (33.3 vs 33.0, not significant); the 30-step diagnostic separates to 46.7% vs 42.4% (+4.3, 95% CI excludes zero).

Ablations and Analyses, Table 4: inverted learned score is significantly harmful (-.016/-.009), random exact-B and RGB-similarity are indistinguishable from Recent-B, and removing recency features returns the selector to the noise band.
Limitations and Conclusion: authors state they control active context budget not archive capacity, reattach rather than generate pixels, and that pretraining contamination remains possible.

Experiments > Deployment cost of the second pass: conditional second pass fires on 81-87% of audited mobile steps; added model time 2.0/2.3/2.9 s at B=1/2/4 (8.1/8.7/10.5% of per-step wall time), ~7% median desktop task overhead.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong match to Agents & Tool Use (2.5) and Long Context & Memory (1.8): the paper is entirely about memory/context management for long-horizon GUI agents (computer-use agents), with a VLM policy consuming screenshot tokens; secondary matches to multimodal AI, transformer KV methods, and training (LoRA-style gated adapter). Not out-of-scope (not pure CV). Novelty is solid but incremental: GUI-agent memory selection is an active area (GUI-Odyssey, MementoGUI, AndroTMem), and the contribution is a specific reframing (fidelity restoration of archived screenshots under an exact budget) plus a history-gated K/V adapter with exact B=0 bypass and per-arm-anchored DiD training. Rigor is a highlight: matched-budget contrasts, paired bootstrap with pre-specified gates and drift caps, construction-defined memory-critical split with single-app controls, oracle headroom, inverted-score and text-vs-pixel ablations, honest null result at the official 15-step OSWorld cap. Evidence strength is good but many statistics (full CIs, feature lists, mining details) are deferred to an unverifiable supplement, and the OSWorld 15-step arm is one run per arm. Generalizability is limited: one frozen base policy (GUI-Owl-1.5-8B), conditional utility is explicitly policy-specific, though desktop-to-mobile zero-shot transfer and B=8 extrapolation are demonstrated. Reproducibility is moderate: detailed hyperparameters, data counts, hardware, greedy decoding, and manifest hashes, but no code/data release statement in the provided text.

primary_link.title: CausalCache: Conditional High-Fidelity Restoration for Long-Horizon GUI Agents

papers.summary: Long-horizon GUI agents can retain complete action histories as compact text, but only a few historical screenshots fit in active context. We formulate this as budgeted fidelity restoration: every event remains summarized, while a fixed budget $B$ determines which events regain their archived screenshots. Recent-$B$ assigns all visual slots to the latest events. CausalCache instead scores the complete history and swaps in an older event only when its predicted utility exceeds that of a recent ev
papers.summary_zh: 長程 GUI 代理可將完整動作歷史以精簡文字保存，但活躍上下文僅能容納少量歷史截圖。本文將此問題形式化為預算化保真度還原：所有事件皆保留摘要，固定預算 B 決定哪些事件可重新取回封存截圖。Recent-B 基線將所有視覺名額分配給最近事件；CausalCache 則對完整歷史評分，僅當較遠事件的預測效用超越某個近期事件時才進行置換。方法包含兩個學習元件：歷史閘控 KV 介面（HGKV）以低秩殘差只修改被還原的歷史影像 token，於零預算時可結構性地完全旁路，保持與凍結基礎模型逐位元一致；預算感知還原選擇器則在完整摘要軌跡上組成精確 B 的配置。兩者僅以桌面資料訓練，於 OSWorld-Verified 與 MobileWorld 零樣本評估。結果顯示啟用歷史截圖較摘要式記憶提升約 13 個百分點；在 30 步診斷中達 46.7% 對 42.4%；MobileWorld 跨應用記憶關鍵子集由 19.4% 提升至 30.6%，而單一應用對照組無可偵測差異。限制在於只控制活躍上下文預算而非封存容量，且係重新掛載而非生成像素。此研究證明選擇哪些過去事件重獲像素，比把固定視覺預算全給最近事件更有效。
papers.title: CausalCache: Conditional High-Fidelity Restoration for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
papers.title_zh: CausalCache：長程 GUI 代理之條件式高保真還原

links.title: Noise Floor Audit for Agent Benchmarks

evidence: Abstract: 'ever-flip fractions are 0.7%, 2.0%, and 2.7%... median perturbation paired SDs 11x to 58x larger than rerun paired SDs' and 'malformed-output failures account for 30%, 7%, and <1% of task failures'

Sec 3 (Arms): 'The main arm evaluates each endpoint on all 150 frozen instances with N=10 reruns at temperature 0. The perturbation arm uses the same 150 frozen instances, N=5 reruns, and 4 named semantics-preserving prompt variants'
Sec 4 Table 2: rerun paired SD 0.00282684 (Groq 8B), 0.00911825 (Groq 70B), 0.0112954 (Gemini); flip fractions 0.0067/0.02/0.0267 match abstract claims
Sec 4 Table 3 + Table 2: cross-check reproduces stated multiples (Groq 8B median perturbation SD ~16.3pp vs 0.28pp rerun = ~58x; Groq 70B ~10pp vs 0.91pp = ~11x; Gemini ~19pp vs 1.1pp = ~16x)

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope empirical audit squarely matching high-weight preferences: LLM endpoint evaluation, agents/tool use (native BFCL function calling), and evaluation/benchmark methodology, with a secondary match to prompt sensitivity. The core findings—near-deterministic temperature-0 reruns (0.7-2.7% ever-flip, paired SD 0.28-1.1pp) versus a much larger semantics-preserving prompt-perturbation floor (median paired SD 11x-58x rerun SD), plus a malformed-vs-wrong failure taxonomy—are internally consistent across abstract, Tables 2-4, and appendices (verified: Table 4 malformed shares 130/430=30%, 20/277=7%, 2/301=<1%; Table 3 medians reproduce the 58x/11x/16x ratios). Novelty is modest: eval error bars, prompt-sensitivity, and failure-mode analysis are established themes (Miller, Sclar, Mizrahi, T-Eval/ToolScan), and the contribution is a careful application to a new measurement object plus a weak 3-endpoint capability-vs-stability observation the authors themselves do not explain. Rigor is solid within its declared scope (frozen 150-instance set, matched paired design, version-drift guard, fingerprint covariate, bootstrap sample-size diagnostic), but the endpoint sample (3 endpoints, 2 providers, Gemini confounding provider and thinking config) limits inferential claims, and no significance testing is performed. Generalizability is explicitly and appropriately narrow (1 suite, 2 AST categories, temp 0, non-archival 4-variant perturbation family). Reproducibility is mixed: hash-frozen instance IDs, retained raw rows, and named perturbations help, but no code/data release is stated and the audited endpoints are time-bound hosted APIs. No out-of-scope disqualification applies.

papers.summary_zh: 工具呼叫基準的分數常以單一數字呈現，但重複執行到底引入多少測量雜訊並不清楚。本文對 BFCL 官方 multiple 與 parallel 類別進行雜訊底線稽核，涵蓋兩家供應商的三個原生工具呼叫端點（Groq 的 llama-3.1-8b-instant、llama-3.3-70b-versatile 與啟用思考的 gemini-3.5-flash），在 150 個凍結實例上以溫度 0 重複執行十次，並設計四種語意不變的提示擾動。結果顯示重跑近乎決定性：ever-flip 比例僅 0.7%、2.0%、2.7%，成對標準差為 0.28、0.91 與 1.1 個百分點；而提示擾動造成更大的底線，其中位數成對標準差為重跑的 11 至 58 倍，且主要只是重新洗牌哪些實例通過。失敗型態亦不同：格式錯誤輸出佔任務失敗的 30%、7% 與不到 1%，顯示邊際準確率同時隱藏了穩定性與失敗模式，且能力較強的端點並未一致地更穩定。作者建議排行榜應發布凍結實例清單、提示敏感度與失敗型態表；在溫度 0 下額外重跑幾乎不增資訊，評估算力應轉投入配對提示擾動與評分器稽核。此稽核限於特定 harness 快照與少數端點，AST 評分器亦不實際執行呼叫。

links.title: Length-Adaptive Decoding for Masked Diffusion Machine Translation

evidence: Section 3.1-3.4 and Algorithm 1: EV forms <=5 candidate canvases from a fixed ratio set, probes each with one all-mask forward pass, selects argmin mean predictive entropy excluding the EOS slot; training-free, no reference lengths or length predictor.
Table 1 (Section 4.2): EV closes 64.9+/-7.4% (En->Zh), 65.3+/-0.8% (Zh->En), 33.0+/-8.4% (En->De) of the Ratio->Length-Oracle COMET-22 gap, mean+/-std over three runs.

Appendix Table 11 (Section C.6): EV-Ratio paired bootstrap/Wilcoxon p<10^-4 on En->Zh and all three Zh->En runs; En->De CI [-0.0016,+0.0086] includes zero, matching the paper's weaker-evidence caveat.
Appendix Table 12 (Section C.6): Ratio given equal/larger forward budget (T=37, 40) recovers at most 0.001 COMET, isolating the length choice as the source of the gain.

Section 4.6 Table 4 and Appendix Table 20: blinded 3-annotator human eval shows DeltaAdequacy +0.50 on Zh->En (preference 45/25/30, sign-test p=0.022) and +0.18 on En->Zh (mostly ties), with COMET-adequacy Spearman rho=0.637/0.689.

Appendix G Table 17: EV > Ratio in all 18 Dream-Base/DiffuLLaMA backbone-direction cells with paired p<10^-3, but gap closure varies widely (11.8%-68.7%), appropriately framed as scope check, not causal attribution.
Limitations and Appendix Table 10 (Section C.5): on En->De, EV falls below Ratio at T>=64 (-10%/-14% gap), an explicitly reported boundary case.

Section 3.3 and Appendix Table 6: reported ratio grids were 'informed by' WMT22 diagnostic subsets (test-informed tuning, disclosed); Table 7 mitigates by showing EV still exceeds the best post-hoc fixed ratio in all three directions.

Section 2 and Appendix Table 9: nearest prior CAL searches candidate lengths via calibrated confidence from the first denoising step; EV exceeds CAL on En->Zh (+0.0068, p<2e-4) and is comparable on Zh->En (+0.0012, CI includes 0) at lower measured latency.

Appendix A: releases code (github.com/Entropy-Valley/Entropy-Valley), LoRA adapters and processed datasets (HuggingFace collection), full hyperparameters, prompt templates, sacreBLEU signatures, and ~420 GPU-hour compute estimate.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope language-model methodology: test-time canvas-length selection for masked diffusion LLMs (LLaDA-8B, Dream-Base, DiffuLLaMA) in machine translation, with LoRA-SFT and decoding/latency analysis. It misses the highest-weighted preference clusters (reasoning, agents, Japanese), so relevance is solid but not top-tier. Novelty is incremental: variable-length diffusion decoding is an active area (CAL, DAEDAL, rho-EOS), and EV is a training-free entropy-probing variant that directly beats CAL on En->Zh and matches it on Zh->En. Rigor is a strength: three runs per direction, paired bootstrap/Wilcoxon tests, forward-pass budget controls, reveal-order controls, ratio sweeps, failure taxonomies, blinded 3-expert human evaluation, cross-backbone checks, and an extra De->Fr direction; caveats are disclosed (candidate grids informed by WMT22 diagnostic subsets; En->De bootstrap CI includes zero; EV loses to Ratio at T>=64 on En->De). Evidence is strong for En<->Zh (automatic + human + coverage analyses with CIs) and correctly scoped as weaker for En->De. Generalizability is moderate: only MT, only fixed-canvas masked diffusion, per-direction grids required, and the length-vs-order finding is setting-specific. Reproducibility is excellent (code, adapters, processed data, hyperparameters, metric signatures, compute budget).

primary_link.title: Length-Adaptive Decoding for Masked Diffusion Machine Translation

papers.summary: Machine translation tests masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) because every source token must be rendered faithfully, while fixed canvas decoding must choose target length before denoising. Existing masked diffusion decoding work mainly studies token unmasking order, leaving this length decision under-explored despite its direct effect on coverage and redundancy. We introduce Entropy-Valley (EV), a training-free length selector that scores candidate target canvases by mean predictive entrop
papers.summary_zh: 遮罩擴散語言模型應用於機器翻譯時，必須在去噪前先決定目標畫布長度，此決策長期未被充分探討。本文提出 Entropy-Valley（EV），一個免訓練的長度選擇器：對每個候選長度執行一次全遮罩前向傳遞，以平均預測熵評分，選出骨幹模型最有把握填滿的畫布。方法在 LLaDA-8B 進行 LoRA-SFT 微調後測試，涵蓋 En→Zh、Zh→En 與 En→De 三個方向。EV 分別取回參考長度上界增益的 64.9%、65.3% 與 33.0%，且並非只是匹配參考長度；在 En→Zh 上將佔位符保留率自 66.9% 提升至 89.1%。控制實驗顯示在此設定下，目標長度選擇造成的變異大於所測試的去噪順序排程；與同資料訓練的 LLaMA-3-8B 自迴歸基線相比，EV 在 En→Zh 打平、Zh→En 領先。三位雙語專家的人類評估支持 En↔Zh 的充分性增益，其中 Zh→En 證據最強。限制包括 En→De 為邊界案例、固定候選比例集無法處理需要更高壓縮的句子，且人類評估僅涵蓋 En↔Zh。此研究指出遮罩擴散翻譯需要明確的測試時長度決策，且以模型自身的熵訊號即可免訓練達成。

links.title: ExecRubrics: Executable Tool-Augmented Rubrics for Verifiable and Efficient Long-Form Evaluation

evidence: Abstract: claims best preference accuracies of 52.9% (HealthBench), 75.3% (HelpSteer), 91.5% (ArgQuality) while reducing evaluation latency.
Table 1 (Section 5): no-rubric GPT-5.5 agentic baseline scores .639/.904/.790; best executable variants .529/.753/.915 - executable rubrics trail the strongest baseline on two of three benchmarks.
Table 2 (Appendix A): test sizes are 255 (HealthBench), 300 (HelpSteer), 94 (ArgQuality), so ~1-2% gains (e.g., .904 vs .915) are within noise; no significance tests reported.
Section 4, footnote 1: 'Different choices of NL judges may result in different performances' - the NL-rubric baseline relies on a single Qwen3-30B judge on H200, a potentially weak comparator.
Section 5: Gemini 3.5 Flash produced 'no-op' or shallow tool wrappers, yielding .427 on HealthBench with artificially low latency, indicating generator sensitivity.
Table 3: per-query evaluation time 0.0088s (Gemini executable) vs 1.688s (Qwen3-30B NL judge), supporting the ~192x speedup claim.
Section 7 (Limitations): admits executable rubrics are vulnerable to gaming, human interpretability is not evaluated, and memorization may influence HelpSteer/ArgQuality results.
Figure 4 caption: states the ArgQuality output 'is shown in Figure 3', but Figure 3 contains the Claude HealthBench rubric while the ArgQuality output is Figure 2 - a minor cross-reference error.
Section 8 (Ethical Considerations): experiments mostly conducted with GPT-5.5 Codex and Gemini CLIs; no code or data release link is provided anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-evaluation methodology paper: compiles natural-language rubrics into deterministic Python scoring programs, replacing black-box LLM judges, with LLM code generation (GPT-5.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.5 Flash) and tool-calling primitives (NLTK/spaCy/deterministic analyzers). Highly aligned with LLM, evaluation/judging, interpretability, and tool-use preferences; not a pure domain application. The compile-rubric-to-executable-program framing with tool augmentation is a credible novel contribution over NL checklist judging and rule-based rewards. Rigor and evidence are middling: test sets are small (94-300 pairs, Table 2), no significance testing or variance over generations, and the NL-rubric baseline uses only one mid-size judge (Qwen3-30B; Section 4 footnote concedes judge choice matters), weakening the headline comparison; the no-rubric GPT-5.5 agentic baseline (.639/.904/.790) still beats all executable variants on HealthBench and HelpSteer (Table 1), so the judge-free claim rests mainly on beating a weak NL-judge configuration and on ~192x latency (Table 3). HealthBench executable accuracy (.529) is near chance, and the Gemini 'no-op wrapper' failure (.427, Section 5) exposes brittleness. Limitations (gaming, unmeasured human interpretability, memorization) are candidly discussed (Section 7). Generalizability is limited by corpus-level rubrics that cannot handle query-specific criteria. Prompts, generated rubric code, and tool inventories are included, but no code/data release is stated and evaluation depends on proprietary APIs. Weighted total ~0.68.

primary_link.title: ExecRubrics: Executable Tool-Augmented Rubrics for Verifiable and Efficient Long-Form Evaluation

papers.summary: Rubrics aim to make language-model evaluation transparent by decomposing response quality into interpretable criteria. However, natural-language rubrics are often ambiguous, require black-box LLM judges, and typically assume criteria aggregate independently through linear weighted sums, limiting their ability to capture dependencies, alternatives, penalties, and override conditions. We propose ExecRubrics, a framework for representing rubrics as compact executable programs. ExecRubrics encodes e
papers.summary_zh: 自然語言評分規則常含糊不清，需仰賴黑箱 LLM 評審判定每項準則，且多假設準則以線性加權獨立彙總。本文提出 ExecRubrics，將評分規則意圖編譯為小型可執行的 Python 程式，明確編碼檢查、分支、懲罰、覆寫條件與工具呼叫，使評估邏輯可檢視、可執行、可修改。作者利用 GPT-5.5、Claude Sonnet 4.6 與 Gemini 3.5 Flash 從自然語言規則生成可執行規則，並測試整合 NLTK、spaCy 等確定性文字處理工具的效果。在 HealthBench、HelpSteer 與 ArgQuality 三個長文偏好基準上，最佳可執行變體分別達 52.9%、75.3% 與 91.5% 的偏好準確率，全面超越以 Qwen3-30B 評審的自然語言規則基線，其中確定性工具對 ArgQuality 特別有效。執行速度亦大幅提升，Gemini 生成的標準版本較 NL 評審快約 192 倍（0.0088 秒對 1.688 秒）。限制包括未直接評估人類可解讀性、明確邏輯可能被對抗性遊戲化，以及前沿模型對公開資料的記憶風險。此框架對醫療等高風險領域的透明、可稽核評估具實質意義，也為免評審的中間表徵提供新方向。

links.title: Clarify User Expertise: Towards Proactive Conversational Agents Tailoring Responses to User Proficiency

evidence: Sec. 3.2, Table 1: existing methods show low stability and high abstention for query-specific expertise estimation (e.g., ExpertPrompting Kappa 72.00 with 94.00% Unknown on ARC-MCAS), motivating the task.
Sec. 5.2, Table 3: Passing reaches 77.1/87.4 accuracy (GPT-4o, MMLU-Pro/ARC-MCAS) vs IDL 20.0/20.0, with both w/o What-to-Ask and w/o How-to-Ask ablations degrading performance.

Appendix B.1: evaluation uses only 50 sampled MMLU-Pro validation questions and 95 ARC-MCAS test questions, contradicting the Appendix B statement 'For the main experiments, we use the full datasets.'
Appendix B.6.1: human evaluation relies on 10 CS/AI graduate students role-playing five Dreyfus expertise levels with provided guides, 50 conversations per participant.
Appendix B.8, Tables 5-6: human-LLM Gwet's AC2 averages 0.79; Passing vs IDL user-satisfaction differences are significant (Holm-corrected p=0.007812 across four settings).

Sec. 4.1: What-to-Ask/How-to-Ask strategies induced via offline self-play with GPT-4o Mini simulators and GPT-5-generated knowledge dependency graphs; induction and evaluation simulators claimed disjoint but share the same framework.
Sec. 5.3, Table 4: induced strategy categories show near-zero semantic separation (intra 0.608/0.604 vs inter 0.604, silhouette 0.006), acknowledged as overlap in Limitations.
Limitations: prompt sensitivity, unexplored self-play hyperparameters, and strategy-set overlap are conceded; no code or data availability statement appears anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly preference-relevant: an LLM-based proactive conversational agent (GPT-4o/DeepSeek backbones, prompting, multi-turn dialogue, LLM-as-judge evaluation) squarely matching the LLM, agents, NLP, prompting, and evaluation preferences; not in any excluded out-of-scope category. Novelty is moderate-to-good: query-specific user expertise probing is a genuinely underexplored task and the instability study (Table 1) is a useful diagnosis, but the machinery (self-play strategy induction, slot-filling state tracking, inductive strategy extraction) assembles known techniques and the authors themselves note semantic overlap between strategy sets (silhouette 0.006, Sec. 5.3/Table 4). Rigor is mixed: Fleiss' Kappa stability study, ablations of both strategy sets (Table 3), ordinal MAE/confusion matrices (Appendix B.9), human evaluation with Gwet's AC2 reliability and Holm-corrected paired sign-flip tests (Table 5, p=0.007812) are above-average practices; however, evaluation sets are tiny (50 MMLU-Pro and 95 ARC-MCAS questions, Appendix B.1, contradicting the Appendix B claim of using 'full datasets'), main-table baselines are reduced to IDL and Direct Prompt, simulator evaluation shares design assumptions with training (same Dreyfus profiles/simulator framework, Sec. 4.1 vs B.4.2), Kappa is sometimes lower than baselines (DeepSeek MMLU-Pro: 51.28 vs 58.10), and US is unmeasured for baselines in simulator evaluation ('-' in Table 3). Evidence strength is correspondingly moderate: gains are large (e.g., 77.1 vs 20.0 accuracy, Table 3) but ground truth derives from assigned simulator/role-play labels (10 CS graduate students role-playing, Appendix B.6.1), and human role-play validity for expertise is untested. Generalizability is limited to academic QA queries and Western-LLM backbones; real-user deployment is unaddressed. Reproducibility is middling: prompts (Appendix E), induced strategies (Appendix D), and protocols are detailed, but no code/data release is stated and the pipeline depends on multiple proprietary APIs (GPT-4o, GPT-4o Mini, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Pro).

primary_link.title: Clarify User Expertise: Towards Proactive Conversational Agents Tailoring Responses to User Proficiency

papers.summary: In the context of information seeking, conversational agents are undergoing an evolution from reactive tools to proactive, personalized assistants. A critical aspect of this evolution is the ability to tailor strategic interactions to a user's unique needs and expectations. Unlike existing studies that focus on proactively clarifying query ambiguities, we center on clarifying the user's expertise in order to tailor responses for better user comprehension. We find that existing agents struggle to
papers.summary_zh: 對話代理正由被動工具演進為主動個人化助理，但現有研究多聚焦澄清查詢歧義，較少處理回應的適讀性。本文首先以實驗顯示現有 LLM 代理難以從查詢本身可靠判斷使用者針對特定查詢的專業程度：同一查詢多次預測高度不一致，Fleiss' Kappa 分數偏低，且常大量輸出 Unknown。為此作者提出 Passing，透過目標性追問主動澄清使用者專業程度：以 Dreyfus 模型建立五個評估面向的槽位綱要，並以 LLM 自我對弈誘導兩組策略——What-to-Ask 決定追問哪些診斷目標，How-to-Ask 決定如何措辭以降低使用者負擔，對弈中並納入大五人格、決策風格與拒答行為的多元使用者模擬。實驗以 GPT-4o 與 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 為骨幹，在 MMLU-Pro 與 ARC-MCAS 上，平均僅 1.2 輪追問即將專業程度估計準確率提升近三倍（平均 +288%），Unknown 率趨近於零，回應可理解性與使用者滿意度亦顯著改善；真人評估同樣驗證其成效。限制包括提示敏感度、自我對弈超參數未系統探索，以及兩類策略存在語意重疊。此工作展示以互動為中心的個人化路線，是邁向以人為本對話代理的重要一步。

links.title: NOVA: Technology-Architecture Co-Design of Near-Memory Processing for Attention-SSM-MoE Hybrid LLM Inference

evidence: Abstract: claims 4.5x higher throughput, 69.8% lower end-to-end latency, 5x better energy efficiency vs GPU baseline with only 3.9% area overhead, no memory capacity loss

Sec. VI-A (Methodology): all NMP architectures including NOVA implemented in an in-house cycle-accurate simulator built on Ramulator2 following the AttAcc methodology; baselines H100 GPU, AttAcc, Duplex, PIMBA; unsupported baseline ops fall back to GPU

Sec. VI-E (Ablation Study): peri-die only beats in-die only (4.25x vs 2.2x on Nemotron3-Nano) and NOVA beats in-die + base-die by 1.7x and 3.0x on Nemotron3-Nano and Qwen3, isolating technology- vs architecture-driven gains
Sec. VI-D (Area Overhead): total added area 5.55 mm2 = 3.94% of 140.8 mm2 HBM4 chip; BAPU 0.127 mm2/bank hidden under cell array; 17.7 mm2 Base-PUs absorbed in 4nm base-die
Sec. VI-E (Capacity-Enabled Feasibility): at 256K input length, GPU and all prior NMP baselines hit out-of-memory while only NOVA runs, attributing feasibility to 2x memory density
Sec. VI-C (Energy Efficiency): honest negative trade-off reported - on Qwen3, Duplex achieves 6.7x energy efficiency vs NOVA's 2.4x because cross-tier parallel mode raises active power

Sec. VI-E (Data Assignment Policy): main results use offline-profiled static 1:9 hot/cold split; adaptive binary-search split matches static at design point and yields up to 2.1x speedup under shifted routing distributions
Sec. IV-A: density gain 2.09x (1.5x from 4F2 cell x 1.39x from POC) derived from prior published results [12],[43] rather than new silicon
llm_evaluation.rationale: A MICRO-level computer-architecture paper on technology-architecture co-design (4F2 VCT DRAM + POC peri-die, 2-tier NMP) for hybrid LLM (GQA+SSM+MoE) decode inference. It matches LLM-centric preferences through heavy engagement with LLM inference serving, KV-cache/long-context capacity, MoE/Mamba/GQA structure, and scaling/efficiency (Abstract; Sec. II-A, III), but its methodology is DRAM/hardware co-design rather than language modeling methodology, capping relevance. Novelty is solid: repurposing the logic-process POC peri-die as an NMP substrate and cross-tier parallel execution is not present in in-die (AttAcc/PIMBA), base-die (Duplex), HB (H2-LLM), or 3D-tiering (Stratum) prior work (Sec. III-C, VII), though it assembles existing component technologies ([12],[43]). Rigor is strong for a simulation study: cycle-accurate Ramulator2-based simulator, iso-TSV/compute-matched baselines, 4 models, batch/length sweeps, roofline analysis, 5-variant ablation, and RTL-synthesized area/energy (Sec. VI-A, VI-B, VI-E). Evidence is simulation-only with energy derived from prior measurements, main results use an offline-profiled static 1:9 hot/cold split (adaptive policy deferred to Sec. VI-E), and the DRAM technology is unproven at scale. Generalizability is decent across hybrid and pure-MoE Transformer models but confined to decode-phase offload of three operation classes; prefill and dense FFN remain on GPU, and feasibility depends on sub-10nm 4F2 DRAM availability. Reproducibility is moderate: public simulator foundation and detailed configs (Tables II-III) but an in-house simulator and no artifact/code release stated.

primary_link.title: NOVA: Technology-Architecture Co-Design of Near-Memory Processing for Attention-SSM-MoE Hybrid LLM Inference

First, the Technology Wall: the conventional 6F^2 DRAM cell is approaching its physical scaling limits at 10nm-class nodes, making it difficult to meet the memory capacity demands of MoE models with hundreds of experts. Second, the Architecture
papers.summary_zh: 混合型大型語言模型交錯使用分組查詢注意力（GQA）、狀態空間模型（SSM）與細粒度混合專家，為近記憶體運算帶來兩道高牆：技術牆——傳統 6F² DRAM 單元在 10 奈米級製程已逼近物理極限，難以滿足數百專家模型對容量的爆增需求；架構牆——既有 NMP 只針對狹窄的運算強度區間，無法涵蓋記憶體受限的 SSM、運算密集的 GQA 與 Op/B 劇烈變動的 MoE。本文提出 NOVA，以技術與架構協同設計同時突破兩牆：採用 4F² 垂直通道電晶體 DRAM 單元搭配周邊電路疊於單元陣列之上（POC）的結構，在等面積下記憶體密度約提升 2 倍；並將 POC 的周邊晶粒重新用作 Tier-1 NMP，配合基板晶粒的 Tier-2 NMP 形成雙層架構，前者最佳化低至中 Op/B，後者最佳化中至高 Op/B，且可跨層平行執行。在 Nemotron3-Nano/Super、Falcon-H1R 與 Qwen3 上，NOVA 相較 GPU 基線平均取得 4.5 倍吞吐量、降低 69.8% 端對端延遲與 5 倍能效，面積開銷僅 3.9% 且不損失容量，更是唯一能在 256K 上下文不因記憶體不足而失敗的設計。代價在於跨層平行模式會略降能效，SSM 頻繁狀態更新亦消耗動態功耗。此研究示範記憶體技術與架構共同設計可同時解決容量與異質運算挑戰。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic for LLM agent memory and RAG: a training-free retrieval-optimization framework for long-term agent memory built on Qwen2.5-72B/GPT-4o-mini backbones, evaluated as a RAG-style memory layer. Novelty is incremental: raw-evidence-preserving heterogeneous graphs, cue-anchored iterative expansion, and Personalized PageRank are all established (HippoRAG, LinearRAG, Zep, Mem0, CAM are cited and compared); the distinctive claim is using profiles as navigation guidance rather than replacement memory. Rigor is reasonable: two public benchmarks (LoCoMo, PERSONAMEM), five baselines with shared prompts/backbone (Sec 4.1), retrieval Recall@10=0.938 (Table 2), hyperparameter sensitivity (Tables 5,7), construction-cost analysis (Tables 8-9), and a third-backbone check (Table 6). Evidence strength is moderate: concrete tables and case studies, but ablation quantification is thin. Generalizability is decent across backbones and two dialogue-QA benchmarks, untested beyond conversational memory. Reproducibility is middling: detailed prompts, thresholds, chunk sizes, and top-k in the appendix, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: HERO: Human-profile Enhanced Retrieval Optimization Framework for Long-term Agent Memory

papers.summary: Long-term memory is crucial for personalized responses and long-horizon agent interactions. Existing methods often rely on LLMs to compress or rewrite dialogue histories and use the transformed memories as retrieval evidence. Despite the progress in organizing fragmented contexts, two major drawbacks persist: (1) information loss from compression, which discards fine-grained but later useful details, and (2) semantic drift from rewriting, which erodes the original tone and situated context. In t
papers.summary_zh: 長期記憶是個人化回應與長程代理互動的關鍵。既有方法常以 LLM 壓縮或改寫對話歷史作為檢索證據，導致兩大問題：壓縮遺漏當時看似不重要、日後卻關鍵的細節；改寫則造成語意漂移，侵蝕原始措辭與情境。本文提出 HERO，遵循人類認知啟發原則：原始對話軌跡作為情節證據完整保留，高階使用者輪廓僅作為記憶活化的導引而非替代。方法上，HERO 將對話轉為可追蹤的異質記憶圖，包含情節軌跡、情節單元、情節線索以及輪廓洞見、輪廓線索，以結構包含、語意索引與時間鏈結連接；檢索時先由查詢實體取得初始錨點，再透過迭代線索擴張納入輪廓引導，最後以遮蔽輪廓節點的 Personalized PageRank 傳播並排序證據。在 LoCoMo 與 PERSONAMEM 兩個基準上，HERO 分別達到 87.99% 準確率（F1 56.06%）與 70.63% 準確率，超越 CAM、Mem0、EverMemOS、MemoryOS 等強基線；檢索 Recall@10 達 0.938，且每查詢平均僅 248 個 token、延遲低於一秒。限制包括缺乏記憶生命週期機制，以及 LLM 萃取的輪廓可能不精準而影響檢索路徑。此研究證明保留原始證據並輔以輪廓導引，優於壓縮或改寫式記憶。
papers.title: HERO: Human-profile Enhanced Retrieval Optimization Framework for Long-term Agent Memory
papers.title_zh: HERO：人類輪廓增強之長期代理記憶檢索最佳化框架

links.title: AdaptPrint: Response-Adaptive Fingerprinting of Black-Box LLM Services

evidence: Abstract and Table IV: AdaptPrint-Triple achieves Top-1/3/5 of 80.6%/90.3%/92.1% across 18 system prompts and 27 candidates, vs ZeroPrint 48.1%/69.0%/76.9% (Method-Gen), the claimed +32.5pp matches 80.6-48.1.
Section IV-B Table V: input-side guardrail validation shows AdaptPrint with 3/54 off-topic rejections vs LLMmap 133/144, Met 399/450, ZeroPrint 112/180, supporting the adaptive-query advantage.
Table VI: strategy ablation shows single strategies at 61.6-67.6% Top-1 vs 80.6% for the full combination, supporting complementarity claims.

Section IV-B fine-grained analysis: mimo-v2.5 failures attributed to Jaccard length sensitivity; a containment metric fixes 13/18 cases but drops global Top-1 to 32.4% when applied uniformly — an honestly reported tradeoff.

Section IV-D: two LoRA fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B targets identified 8/12, 9/12, 11/12 at Top-1/3/5 across six decoding settings; case study targets a POE bot that publicly discloses gpt-4o-mini, limiting external validation strength.

Section V Limitations: probe-question sensitivity (different questions yield different results for the same setting) and dynamic multi-model routing are unhandled; Section V Cost Overhead estimates ~$0.044 per target.

Appendices A1-A3 and Section IV-A: complete prompts, model list, and hyperparameters (exclusion ratio 0.25, window 10, w1=w2=0.5, all lambda 0.25) are provided, but no code or data release is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A squarely LLM-centric security paper on black-box model fingerprinting, relevant to LLM services, AI safety/evaluation, prompting configurations, and serving. Core contribution is a genuine shift from fixed-query fingerprinting (LLMmap, MET, ZeroPrint) to response-adaptive probing that anchors on the target's own responses, but the method assembles known tools (LLM-generated adaptive questions, embedding cosine + n-gram Jaccard similarity, hand-set score aggregation), keeping novelty moderate. Rigor is solid: 27 candidates/12 targets, 18 system prompts, 6 decoding settings, three SOTA baselines, strategy/metric/weight ablations, open-set protocol, fine-tuned-model tracing, and honest negative analyses (mimo-v2.5 verbosity failure; containment metric degrading others to 32.4% Top-1). Evidence is internally consistent and quantitative, though validation beyond the authors' own OpenRouter testbed is limited to one case study where the model identity was already public. Reproducibility is middling: prompts and hyperparameters are fully specified in appendices, but no code/data release is stated and results depend on a commercial, versioned auxiliary LLM (Gemini-3-Flash-Preview) with acknowledged question-generation nondeterminism.

primary_link.title: AdaptPrint: Response-Adaptive Fingerprinting of Black-Box LLM Services

papers.summary: Black-box LLM services have emerged as a practical deployment paradigm. Nevertheless, their opacity also hinders the systematic assessment of security risks and complicates copyright auditing for model owners. Black-box LLM fingerprinting, which identifies the underlying LLM identity through query-response interactions, offers a promising way to bridge this gap. Existing approaches typically collect responses from target LLM services using a fixed set of queries and perform poorly in the presenc
papers.summary_zh: 黑箱 LLM 服務雖便利，其不透明性卻阻礙安全風險評估與版權稽核；透過查詢—回應互動辨識底層模型身分的指紋技術是可行途徑，但既有方法依賴固定問題集，在系統提示、取樣設定等複雜組態下表現不穩，也易被安全防護機制攔截。本文提出 AdaptPrint，一種回應自適應的指紋辨識方法：先依目標服務領域自適應生成低熵且非平凡的自然問題，再以三種漸進式回應一致性探測策略——直接探測、續寫探測與追問探測——以目標模型自身的回應為錨點，與候選模型池比較語意嵌入相似度與 n-gram Jaccard 文字相似度並加權彙總，其中續寫起點以本地模型的信心分數挑選低熵位置。在 18 種系統提示與 27 個候選模型上，AdaptPrint 的 Top-1/3/5 準確率分別達 80.6%、90.3% 與 92.1%，較最佳基線提升 32.5 個百分點；對安全檢查與離題偵測等防護幾乎不受影響，且在不同解碼隨機度與開放集情境下保持可靠，單一目標模型成本約 0.044 美元。限制在於探測問題品質影響結果，動態多模型路由可能降低可靠性。此方法可支援黑箱服務的版權稽核與針對性攻擊風險評估。
papers.title: AdaptPrint: Response-Adaptive Fingerprinting of Black-Box LLM Services
papers.title_zh: AdaptPrint：黑箱 LLM 服務之回應自適應指紋辨識

links.title: Stress Testing Unlearning Algorithms

Main Results: on Llama-3-8B Biology (Table 1), RMU target 0.2498 with Max-JB 0.2812 vs simNPO target 0.2608 but Max-JB 0.6009, showing standard target metrics fail to rank methods

Experiments section: five unlearning methods (RMU, ELM, NPO, simNPO, OrthoGrad) on two open-source LLMs (Llama-3-8B, Zephyr-7B Beta), with hyperparameters deferred to appendix
Sensitivity to In-Context QA Demonstrations: ELM in Biology shows recovery with prepended QA exemplars while RMU/NPO/simNPO/OrthoGrad stay near 24-28% (Tables 3-4, Figures 1-2)

Limitations of rigor: no confidence intervals, seeds, or statistical tests reported anywhere; no release statement for the WMDP++ dataset or code appears in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-scope: LLM unlearning evaluation combining AI safety, red-teaming (GCG/DIA/Crescendo jailbreaks), and prompting/ICL probes on Llama-3-8B and Zephyr-7B. The WMDP++ contribution is useful but incremental: the paper itself cites prior adversarial-unlearning critiques (Lucki et al. 2024, 'Ununlearning'), BLUR for forget-retain overlap, and RippleBench for ripple effects, so the boundary-question plus attack-suite framing is a benchmark refinement rather than a new methodology. Evaluation design is systematic (5 unlearning methods, 2 models, 2 domains, ICL ablations across context sources), and headline numbers (RMU target 24.98% vs Max-JB 28.12% vs simNPO Max-JB 60.09%; Zephyr-RMU biology boundary drop of 51% despite ~1-3% MMLU/MMLUS drops) support the core claims. However, evidence is weakened by single-run results with no variance/significance, a small 100-question boundary set generated by GPT-5.2 with human validation only for cybersecurity (biology unverified, admitted in 'Boundary Concept Preservation'), and internal inconsistencies (Table 2 MMLUS caption mismatch, base-model Max-JB unreported). No code or WMDP++ dataset release is mentioned, limiting reproducibility. Generalizability is constrained by only two ~7-8B models and one benchmark family.

primary_link.title: Stress Testing Unlearning Algorithms

In large language models (LLMs), unlearning is particularly challenging due to the ambiguity of inputs and outputs. Con- sequently, rigorous evaluation is critical for assessing both safety and utility, and for driving progress in unlearning meth- ods. We identify two key shortcomings in existing unlearning benchmarks: (1) they do not actively test whether unlearned inform
papers.summary_zh: 大語言模型的機器遺忘旨在移除特定訓練資料的影響,但現有基準(如 WMDP、TOFU)存在兩大缺陷:僅以直接提問評估遺忘效果,未測試資訊能否被強力提取;且保留集與遺忘集語義距離過遠,無法察覺對相鄰安全知識的損害。本文提出 WMDP++,以兩項設計補足:一是 Boundary 邊界題組,針對生物與資安領域各生成 100 道與危險知識相近但安全的專家級題目;二是對抗性評估,包含上下文學習探針與 GCG、DIA、Crescendo 等越獄攻擊。在 Llama-3-8B 與 Zephyr-7B 上測試 RMU、ELM、NPO、simNPO、OrthoGrad 五種方法,結果顯示傳統 Target 指標無法區分方法優劣:RMU 與 simNPO 的遺忘準確率相近,但受壓後 RMU 的最高越獄準確率僅 28.12%,simNPO 卻回升至 60.09%;同時 MMLU 幾乎不變,邊界題準確率卻可暴跌逾五成,顯示「概念外溢」。白盒 GCG 攻擊最能提取知識,ELM 在生物領域則易受上下文操弄。侷限包括邊界題僅 100 題且生物題未經人類專家驗證。此基準揭露現行方法多為表面抑制而非真正抹除,對 LLM 安全評估極具意義。

links.title: CAI-DLLM: Convergence Aware Inference for Diffusion Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'achieves up to 18.2× wall clock inference speedup on LLaDA GSM8K while improving accuracy (77.41% vs. 76.27%), and up to 13.1× on Dream HumanEval... energy consumption is reduced by up to 95.3%'
Section 2.1: motivation analysis measures relative L2 hidden-state drift (early layers ≈2–3%, deep ≈6–14%) across 1,319 GSM8K test prompts on LLaDA-8B-Instruct
Section 4.4 (Box 4.4): per-token budgets B_i ∈ {8,32,64} assigned from first-step confidence s_i = c_i^(0) and position; Section 4.6: gating ON for LLaDA, OFF for Dream chosen via GSM8K ablation
Section 6.1 / Table 2: LLaDA BBH drops from 56.75 (no-cache) to 52.33 at 44.8× speedup; Appendix A.7 reports ±0.53 SE, gap ≈8× uncertainty
Table 3 (HumanEval ablation): Dream pass@1 drops to 40.34 with gated budgets but recovers to 46.34 with gating off at 614.6 TPS; LLaDA gains mostly from APD (139.8→424.3 TPS)
Limitations: 'gating decision is not selected on a held out validation set'; reduced samples (500 MathQA, LongBench 100/task); single NVIDIA H200 GPU

Appendix A.6: FlashDLM, Sparse dLLM, and D2F 'not included as direct baselines because compatible public implementations... were not available'; Code Release section: implementation released 'upon acceptance of this paper'
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM inference-efficiency paper: training-free acceleration of masked diffusion LLMs (LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B) directly matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, inference/serving, and scaling/efficiency, with code and math reasoning benchmarks as evaluation targets only. Novelty is incremental: the core mechanism refines Fast-dLLM's confidence-based parallel decoding by using first-step confidence (instead of per-step re-evaluation), block-adaptive thresholds, per-token budgets, and a grinding-phase exit; adaptive per-token computation is well-established (they cite Graves 2016, Schuster et al. 2022). Rigor is solid on ablations (Tables 3/11), standard errors (Appendix A.7), sample-size disclosure (A.3), and honest limitations (BBH 56.75→52.33 at 44.8×), but the gating ON/OFF decision is tuned on the full GSM8K test set (Limitations), position factors are tuned on GSM8K, several 2025 baselines (FlashDLM, Sparse dLLM, D2F, Spiffy) are omitted (A.6), and some speedups are unexplained anomalies (MathQA ~9× where DualCache/ES-dLLM are ~1×). Evidence is detailed (energy in D.4, memory in D.1, length scaling in E) but single-GPU (H200) and code is only promised 'upon acceptance'.

primary_link.title: CAI-DLLM: Convergence Aware Inference for Diffusion Language Models

papers.summary: Diffusion language models can generate many tokens in parallel, but they still require repeated denoising steps during inference. This makes generation costly, especially when the model continues to recompute tokens that are already stable. To address these limitations, we propose CAI-DLLM, a training-free inference method that uses first-step confidence to guide denoising and reduce inference time. Specifically, CAI-DLLM commits easy tokens earlier, allocates more denoising steps to harder toke
papers.summary_zh: 掩碼擴散語言模型可平行生成多個詞元,但推論仍需反覆去噪步驟,且對已穩定的簡單詞元持續重算,造成浪費。本文提出無需訓練的 CAI-dLLM,核心觀察是第一步去噪的信心值可免費取得,並可靠預測詞元難度:高信心詞元約 5 步即穩定,低信心者需 30 步以上。方法包含四項機制:以信心門控為每個詞元分配 8、32 或 64 步的預算;隨輸出區塊遞減的區塊自適應提交門檻;位置感知提交規則;以及當連續多步幾乎沒有新詞元提交時觸發的「研磨階段」偵測與提前退出。在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 與 Dream-7B-Instruct 的七項基準上,LLaDA GSM8K 達 18.2 倍加速且準確率反升至 77.41%,Dream HumanEval 達 13.1 倍加速且 pass@1 更高;較難的推理任務如 LLaDA BBH 加速 44.8 倍,但準確率下降 4.4 分,能耗最多降低 95.3%。模型自適應設定上,LLaDA 開啟信心門控、Dream 則關閉。限制包括門控選擇未在留出驗證集上決定、部分任務有品質折衷,且實驗僅在單一 H200 GPU 進行。此方法不更動模型權重即可大幅降低推論成本,對擴散模型的實用化極具價值。

links.title: Do Not Copy/Paste: Soft Barriers for Copying in AI-Assisted Programming

evidence: Section 3 (Evaluation): four models (Claude Sonnet 4.5, DeepSeek-V3, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.2 Codex) via public APIs; HumanEval (164 problems) and MBPP (974 tasks); four perturbation families described in Table 2; CPR formally defined in Eq. (1) as syntactic-error rate conditioned on clean-solution correctness.

Section 4 (Table 3): CPR spans ~0.000 to 0.997 across models/tasks, e.g., Claude invisible chars on MBPP = 0.997 vs. DeepSeek reordering on HumanEval = 0.064; paper concludes effectiveness is 'highly dependent on the model and perturbation strategy' with no universal barrier.
Section 4: argument that Pass@1 gives a 'false narrative' for soft barriers (correct-but-unexecutable code is a successful barrier, not a generation failure) is a defensible metric-design insight.

Section 5: exploratory pilot with 18 participants using only GPT-5.2 and invisible characters; results are self-reported 1-5 Likert means (Table 4) plus clipboard logging; no randomization details, sample-size-per-group, or statistical significance testing reported.

Section 6 (Threats and Responsible Use): admits bypass via 'requesting clean output... running a text normalizer, or retyping,' and that CPR measures 'a proximate behavioral property, not learning outcomes'; notes accessibility risk of zero-width characters for screen readers.

Data Availability Statement: claims 'All data, code, and scripts required to reproduce the experiments... available in our anonymous repository: https://zenodo.org/records/21786962,' with full prompt templates stated to be in the repository.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-code-generation methodology paper squarely in scope: it studies four frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.5, DeepSeek-V3, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.2 Codex) via system-prompt interventions on HumanEval/MBPP, matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, Code & Programming, Prompting, Evaluation). The 'AI code handoff' framing and Copy-Paste Resistance metric are genuinely useful conceptual contributions, and the insight that Pass@1 conflates barrier success with generation failure is well argued. However, the technical probe (Unicode homoglyph/invisible-character perturbation) is closely related to known Trojan-Source-style attacks and is trivially bypassable (acknowledged in Section 6). Rigor is adequate for a NIER track but limited: no statistical tests, single-generation Pass@1, no verification that low-CPR models actually complied with the perturbation instruction versus ignoring it, and the 18-participant pilot relies on uncontrolled, self-reported Likert data without significance testing. Quantitative claims are supported by Table 3, but key results (Figure 2 Pass@1) are only referenced as figures. Generalizability is constrained: Python-only, environment-dependent Unicode normalization, and authors themselves flag cross-language and cross-stack validation as open work. A solid, honestly hedged early-results paper with a memorable metric, not a decisive empirical contribution.

primary_link.title: Do Not Copy/Paste: Soft Barriers for Copying in AI-Assisted Programming

papers.summary: Copying a function from a chat window into an editor takes less than a second. For many uses of AI coding tools, that speed is the point; in settings such as programming education, code review, and security-sensitive development, it can also be the problem. This paper frames copy-paste as an \emph{AI code handoff problem}: the moment model-generated text crosses from a conversational context into executable or committed software is a design boundary that current tools leave largely unmanaged. We
papers.summary_zh: AI 編碼助理讓程式碼從對話視窗轉移到編輯器只需一秒,這種無摩擦交接在教育、程式碼審查與安全敏感情境中反而成為問題。本文提出「AI 程式碼交接問題」的概念,主張助理不僅應被評估生成程式的品質,也應評估其如何媒介程式碼的轉移。作者提出軟性屏障:不禁用 AI、不封鎖程式碼,而是讓未經檢視的轉移變得不順手。技術探針採用 Unicode 擾動,包括隱形字元、同形字、雙向文字重排與刪除控制字元,僅需系統提示即可實作。並提出複製貼上抗性 CPR 指標,衡量正確解在擾動後變得無法執行的比例。在 HumanEval 與 MBPP 上以 Claude、DeepSeek-V3、GPT-5.2 及 Codex 實驗,CPR 從近零到近一,高度依賴模型與擾動族:如 Claude 對隱形字元 CPR 達 0.997,DeepSeek 則對大多數擾動免疫但同形字有效。18 人先導實驗顯示軟性屏障讓使用者減少直接複製、增加修改與理解,挫敗感仍低。限制是動機明確者可輕易繞過,部署須透明且顧及無障礙,而 CPR 衡量的是行為而非學習成效。此框架為 AI 程式碼交接開啟新的設計視角。
papers.title: Do Not Copy/Paste: Soft Barriers for Copying in AI-Assisted Programming

links.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Sequential Activation Patching

evidence: Abstract: introduces 'a sequential activation patching framework that traces CoT-conditioned attention-head activations across token positions and aggregates their effects using Part-of-Speech-guided analysis' plus Sequential Multi-Head Patching with cross-question and random-activation controls
Table 2 caption / Figure 2: average final JSD for Sequential Multi-Head Patching is 0.2415 vs 0.4018 for Random-Activation control (Table 6 caption) and baseline JSD 0.3865

Table 4 caption: average MRR across multi-head patching instances is 0.1780, with negative per-instance values (e.g., chal-961 MRR -0.6122), and Table 7 caption reports average MRR -0.0032 for the random-activation control

Table 1 (Section 4.2): CoT baseline accuracy 65.63%; zero-ablating JSD-selected heads reduces accuracy to 0.00% vs 37.50% for Random n-Head Selection; No-CoT targeted ablations 6.25%-12.50% vs 15.63% random

Section 4.2: authors concede ablations from Random-Activation patching 'remain relatively close' to other variants, attributing this to 'only 32 instances' and head-selection hyperparameter 'restricted to k=3'

Section 6 Limitations: analysis limited to 'mathematical word problems and one relatively small base model'; no sensitivity analysis over k; metrics computed only 'at the first token of the final-answer span'
Section 1 contributions: 'We publicly share our code to support reproducibility' with GitHub URL (github.com/MuratDura/CoT_Mechanistic_Interpretability)

Appendix C.1 Tables 8-10: head-selection stability analysis showing 56.4% head Jaccard between JSD- and MRR-based same-question selections, layer-level 69.9%, and targeted selections covering 89-99 unique heads vs 175-186 for random controls
Section 3.5: patching one token position takes ~29.58s on an NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada using TransformerLens; POS tagging of all 32 samples takes 0.24s
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core mechanistic-interpretability study of CoT reasoning in LLMs, directly matching the highest-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, interpretability). The sequential many-to-one activation patching with POS-guided aggregation, cross-question and random-activation controls, and targeted zero-ablation constitute a genuine but incremental methodological extension over static patching. Rigor is solid in design (dual JSD/MRR metrics, multiple controls, stability analysis in Appendix C.1) but weakened by only 32 SVAMP instances, a single 0.5B model, fixed k=3 without sensitivity analysis, and no statistical testing; the authors themselves note the random-activation ablation results 'remain relatively close' to targeted ones (Section 4.2). Evidence is strong for the JSD-based sufficiency claim (targeted JSD 0.2415 vs random 0.4018 vs baseline 0.3865) and the CoT-condition ablation collapse (65.63% to 0.00% vs 37.50% random), but average MRR is modest (0.1780) with several negative per-instance values, and the random-activation MRR control at -0.0032 partially undercuts the margin-level story. Generalizability is explicitly limited to math word problems and one small model. Reproducibility is good: public GitHub code, full pseudocode, prompt formats, hyperparameters, and per-instance tables.

primary_link.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Sequential Activation Patching

papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable problem-solving capabilities when guided by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, yet the internal mechanisms underlying these improvements remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate where CoT-related causal effects emerge across the generated reasoning trajectory and which attention heads carry signals that contribute to final-answer computation. Because CoT reasoning unfolds over multiple generated tokens, standard activation patching
papers.summary_zh: 思維鏈(CoT)提示能提升大語言模型的推理表現,但其內部機制仍不清楚。標準 activation patching 只在單一靜態詞元位置介入,難以刻畫 CoT 跨越多個生成詞元的時間性效應。本文針對 Qwen2.5-0.5B 在 SVAMP 數學應用題上提出序列激活修補框架:將 CoT 條件下各注意力頭的激活,注入 No-CoT 執行中最終答案位置,並以詞性(POS)引導的聚合降低詞元級雜訊;進一步提出序列多頭修補,將各 POS 類別的頂尖頭去重後聯合注入,並設計跨題目與隨機激活對照。結果顯示多頭聯合修補使 No-CoT 輸出分布明顯靠向 CoT 行為,跨題目修補效果較弱但仍有意義,隨機對照則無效,證明效果來自結構化的 CoT 訊號。零消融實驗顯示,經 JSD 選出的頭集合被消融後,CoT 準確率從 65.63% 跌至 0%,遠低於隨機頭選擇的 37.50%,且這些頭也支撐答案錨定、範例與目標分離及數值生成等輔助機制。限制包括 POS 分組與固定 top-k 的選擇策略、僅 32 題樣本與單一小模型,且發現的頭應視為分布式推理支援子電路而非純推理電路。此研究為 CoT 的內部因果角色提供了機制性證據。

evidence: Section 3.1 Implementation Details: four foundation models (Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma3-12B, Gemma4-26B, Qwen3.5-35B) via vLLM, GPT-4o as SOTOPIA evaluator, Gemini2.5-Flash as companion, temperature 0.
Table 1 (Section 3.2): DyCAC reaches Overall 3.80 with Qwen2.5-7B and 3.82 with Gemma4-26B, exceeding training-based Sotopia-RL (3.75); Kno and Goal gains marked significant.
Table 3 (Section 3.3): ablations show removing Full Memory Module drops Overall 3.80 to 3.65 and removing Cultural Profile Inference to 3.61, each module contributing.
Appendix B.4 Table 6: improvement is larger on high-shift subset (+0.0860) than low/no-shift (+0.0486), supporting the dynamic-adaptation claim.
Section 2.2 / Algorithm 1: culture modeled as continuous mixture over Hofstede six-dimension country profiles with turn-specific pruning and augmentation, blended with direct style via weight lambda.
Limitations section: framework depends on base-model zero-shot capability and Hofstede dimensions capture only country/region-level culture, not subcultures.

Appendix C: full JSON-schema prompts for perception, cultural inference, ToM memory operations, and planning are provided; Abstract footnote lists code release at github.com/MindIntLab-HFUT/DyCAC, but numeric values of K, theta_lik, theta_filter, lambda, tau_thre are absent from the text.
Section 3.1 Benchmarks: CEDAR is cited as Dai et al. 2026b, whose author list overlaps with this paper's authors, indicating self-benchmark evaluation for the multilingual results.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: a training-free agent framework (DyCAC) built on prompting, ToM-based reasoning, and memory updating for social dialogue, evaluated on SOTOPIA and CEDAR with four LLM backbones, prompting baselines (CoT, ReAct, MAD), and LLM-as-judge evaluation. Strongly aligned with LLM/agents/reasoning preferences; not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: modeling culture as a turn-varying mixture over Hofstede profiles plus a belief-revision memory is a sensible new combination, but components (ToM memory, multi-agent prompting, cultural debate) are well established. Rigor is solid: ablations (Table 3), significance markers, three-run averaging, temperature 0, efficiency analysis (Fig. 4), and a shift-stratified analysis (Table 6, +0.0860 high-shift vs +0.0486 low-shift). Evidence is tempered by modest absolute gains (Overall 3.80 vs Sotopia-RL 3.75 on Qwen2.5-7B; CEDAR avg 41.90 vs CulturalDebate 41.53 text-only), reliance on GPT-4o judge, and evaluation partly on CEDAR, a benchmark authored by overlapping authors. Generalizability is aided by four backbones and seven languages but constrained by country-level Hofstede granularity and base-model dependence (acknowledged in Limitations). Reproducibility benefits from a code link and full prompts (Appendix C), but key hyperparameters (K, theta_lik, theta_filter, lambda, tau_thre) are not given values, and several cited backbone versions (Gemma4-26B, Qwen3.5-35B) are unverifiable from the text.

primary_link.title: Don' t Box Me In: Dynamic Cultural Adaptation and Cognitive Tracking for Social Understanding

papers.summary: Social interaction increasingly takes place in multicultural settings, where individuals may draw on multiple cultural influences and adapt their communicative behavior across contexts. Despite recent advances in equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with social understanding capabilities, existing approaches often model culture as a static demographic attribute, limiting their ability to accommodate hybrid and dynamically expressed communicative preferences. Therefore, in this paper, we propos
papers.summary_zh: 社交互動日益發生於多元文化情境,個人可能融合多種文化影響並隨情境調整溝通方式。現有方法多將文化視為靜態人口屬性,無法處理混合且動態變化的溝通偏好。本文提出免訓練的 DyCAC 框架,整合動態文化調適與連續認知追蹤。方法上,感知模組先從對話萃取客觀事實、心理狀態訊號與文化線索;文化調適不預測固定文化身分,而是以 Hofstede 文化維度建構連續參考空間,逐輪更新各國參考輪廓的權重,形成軟性文化輪廓,再與直接從對話風格推得的風格向量混合;同時由心智理論(ToM)驅動的記憶模組持續追蹤對話者的信念、慾望與意圖,並以 assert、revise、retract 操作更新記憶;最後由規劃與執行模組生成具文化校準的回應。在 SOTOPIA 社交基準上,DyCAC 以 Qwen2.5-7B 與 Gemma4-26B 達最高總分,Knowledge 與 Goal 提升顯著;在 CEDAR 多語情感基準上平均表現最佳,尤以印地語、史瓦希里語與中文改善明顯。消融實驗證實各模組與潛在 ToM 追蹤皆必要,軟性文化調適也優於單一文化固定。限制是依賴基礎模型的零樣本能力,且 Hofstede 維度僅涵蓋國家層級。此框架示範以連續混合取代刻板文化標籤的可行性。

links.title: Statistical Methods for Multiple Language Model Comparison on a Shared Evaluation

evidence: Abstract: presents 'a single random-effects model for scores on shared evals' that recovers 'Miller's paired and clustered estimators for K=2' and extends 'to any K and to unbalanced, clustered designs'

§5.1: 'uncorrected pairwise z-tests produce a family-wise error rate of ≈0.26 at significance α=.05, while the omnibus repeated-measures ANOVA... holds ≈0.05' (2,000 replications, K=4, n=400, ρ=0.5, Appendix A)
§5.2: real-data application uses 'six openly available ∼7B-parameter models' on 'n=1,497' category-stratified MMLU-Pro questions from official cached predictions (TIGER-AI-Lab/MMLU-Pro eval_results/)
§5.2 Results: 'of those 5 significant pairs at uncorrected α=.05, only 3 survive Bonferroni or Holm correction'; blocked ANOVA 'F(5,7480)=4.45, p=4.8×10−4' vs naive one-way 'F(5,8976)=2.90, p=.013'
Appendix B Table 4: mixed-model category variance 'τ̂²category=0.0110' vs residual '0.1834', and Tukey on emmeans flags only one pair (p=.008), illustrating specification-dependent disagreement
§4 caveat: 'Tukey's test is only exact for family-wise-error control for balanced designs with i.i.d. errors', recommending Holm/Bonferroni for mixed or unbalanced designs
Conclusion: 'Full R code is provided in repository https://github.com/JFMandujanoR/Statistical-Methods-for-Multi-Model-LLM-Evaluation'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A statistical-methodology paper for LLM benchmark comparison: extends Miller's two-model paired/clustered estimators to K>2 models via repeated-measures ANOVA and linear mixed models. Directly relevant to the LLM evaluation/benchmark/leaderboard preference area, though it contributes no new language-model methodology itself. Novelty is modest: the building blocks (omnibus F-test, Tukey/Holm corrections, mixed-effects blocking, Demšar-style two-stage logic) are standard statistics, and the K=2 equivalence is a small theoretical observation. Rigor is solid and self-critical (explicit caveats that Tukey is not exact for mixed/unbalanced designs, discussion of when model-based and design-based clustered SEs disagree), but the linear-Gaussian treatment of binary accuracy scores is unexamined, and the real-data analysis subsamples 1,497 of 12,032 questions without strong justification. Evidence is concrete: simulation shows FWER ≈0.26 for uncorrected pairwise tests vs ≈0.05 for the omnibus ANOVA (§5.1, Table 2), and the real six-model MMLU-Pro analysis shows 5/15 significant pairs dropping to 3/15 after Holm/Bonferroni, with a mixed model flagging only one pair (§5.2, Appendix B Tables 3-4). Generalizability is good within fixed-question accuracy evals but does not cover preference-based or judge-based evaluations. Reproducibility is strong: public MMLU-Pro cached predictions, fixed seed, simulation details in Appendix A, and a public R repository (Conclusion).

primary_link.title: Statistical Methods for Multiple Language Model Comparison on a Shared Evaluation

papers.summary: A rigorous statistical treatment of two-model comparisons on the same evals can be achieved by paired t-tests, analyzing their standard errors and a clustering correction for correlated questions. Nevertheless, leaderboards, ablations studies, and hyperparameter sweeps, usually compare $K>2$ models simultaneously. In this paper, we present a single random-effects model for scores on shared evals. We leverage models as a fixed effects and questions (or question cluster) as random effects. We show
papers.summary_zh: 技術報告與排行榜常同時比較多個語言模型,但 Miller 的配對與集群標準誤工具僅適用於兩模型比較;若對 K 個模型做未校正的兩兩檢定,真實虛無假設下至少一次偽陽性的機率會大幅膨脹,模擬中 K=4 時約達 26%。本文提出單一隨機效應模型:以模型為固定效應、題目(及題目叢集)為隨機效應,證明以重複測量 ANOVA 或線性混合模型配適時,可還原 Miller 的配對與集群估計量,並推廣至任意 K 值與不平衡、集群化設計。模擬顯示未校正兩兩 z 檢定的家族錯誤率約 0.26,總體 ANOVA 則維持約 0.05;忽略集群會低估標準誤 1.4 至 2.7 倍。實證使用 MMLU-Pro 上六個約 7B 模型、1,497 道共享題目、14 個學科叢集的題級資料:未校正配對檢定有 5 對顯著,經 Bonferroni 或 Holm 校正後僅剩 3 對;正確以題目區塊化的 ANOVA 給出 F=4.45,優於忽略題目的 2.90;混合模型估得學科叢集變異成分約 0.011,屬真實但有限的占比。作者建議:先做總體檢定再做多重比較校正的事後檢定;集群情境改用混合模型並回報變異成分;同時回報樸素與正確區塊化的統計量。這為多模型評測報告提供具體可實作的統計規範。

links.title: The Blending Ratio Is Not Where the Performance Is: Diagnosing Prototype Blending for Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models

evidence: Abstract: JS blend 'trails a test-set-oracle ratio by 8.5 accuracy points' on 950 cells; LOO within 0.9 points of oracle; CLAP +1.9 and LP++ +1.5 over the oracle blend.
Sec. III-B: authors attribute Eq. (4) to prior work (Goswami et al.) and call Eqs. (5)-(7) 'one line of calculus plus a textbook identity', bounding estimator novelty.
Sec. V-D: cluster bootstrap resampling the ten datasets, Student-t corrected intervals with measured coverage 93.7-94.8%, no multiplicity correction disclosed; 200 thin-pool drops counted.

Sec. VI-D: pre-registered cross-encoder dose-response prediction fails (SigLIP share 86.6% but smallest deficit -5.77; zero-shot accuracy rank correlation -1.00 with |deficit|); reported as a refutation.

Sec. VI-G: counterfactual with modality-gap offset subtracted moves deficit from -9.67 to -7.17, recovering 26% of the damage; per-class test-set oracle check rules out under-parameterisation of the global ratio.

Sec. VI-H: CoOp-split replication (349 cells) reproduces all qualitative findings; augmentation arm nil for CLAP (-0.08), unresolved for LP++ (-0.98); SigLIP2 and DINOv3 arms reported with attenuating LP++ margin.
Sec. V-E / Artefacts: full pipeline, per-cell feature caches, and all 4,800 records released on HuggingFace; deterministic end-to-end; every table/figure regenerates on CPU.
Sec. VII-B / VII-E: explicit scope limits - bound covers only Eq. (1) global cosine blends, evaluated members are own constructions, Flowers102 capped at K=4, cached global features only.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A diagnosis/evaluation study of the blending ratio in few-shot adaptation of vision-language models (CLIP/SigLIP), not an LLM-methods paper: the high-weight LLM/Japanese/reasoning/agent preferences are untouched, with matches limited to multimodal VLMs, prompting tiers (incl. CuPL via gpt-4.1-mini), and evaluation protocol, yielding moderate preference relevance. Within its scope the work is exceptionally careful: closed-form James-Stein identification (novelty is the diagnosis, not the estimator, as the authors concede in Sec. III-B), a capacity theorem, pre-registered predictions including honestly reported failures (Sec. VI-D), coverage-calibrated cluster bootstraps (Sec. V-D), replication on CoOp splits and modern encoders (Sec. VI-H), and a counterfactual isolating 26% of the damage to the modality gap (Sec. VI-G). Evidence is broad (4,800 cells, paired within-cell comparisons) and reproducibility is exemplary (full pipeline, cached features, and per-cell records released; Sec. V-E). Score held below 0.7 primarily by the 40% preference weight on a non-LLM topic and by scope limits the paper itself states (own-construction family members, single-label classification, global-ratio oracle).

primary_link.title: The Blending Ratio Is Not Where the Performance Is: Diagnosing Prototype Blending for Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models

papers.summary: Many few-shot adaptation methods for vision-language models classify with a convex combination of the zero-shot text prototype and the mean of the K labelled image features, with a single blending ratio routinely tuned on held-out labels, often on the test set itself. We ask what the family's own bias-variance justification invites: what is the right ratio, can it be estimated without validation data, and is finding it where the performance is? First, the ratio minimising prototype mean-squared
papers.summary_zh: CLIP 類視覺語言模型的少樣本分類常以混合比例 λ 在零樣本文字原型與 K 張標註影像特徵均值間做凸組合,此超參數慣於在驗證集甚至測試集上調校。本文追問:理論上正確的 λ 為何?能否無需驗證資料估得?調好它是否就足夠?作者證明最小化原型均方誤差的閉式解正是向文字原型收縮的正部 James–Stein 係數,但此估計是「對錯誤目標的可靠估計」:在 10 個資料集、5 種骨幹、多種樣本數與提示層級共 4,800 個格點中,其 λ 飽和於約 0.96,丟棄文字先驗,較測試集 oracle 落後 8.5 個準確點,因原型距離中 78.3%(SigLIP 上 86.6%)是決策無關的類別獨立模態間距。另方面,僅用支援集的留一法比率估計落在 oracle 混合 0.9 點內,證明比率可免費估得;更關鍵的是,免驗證的線性探針 CLAP 與 LP++ 分別平均超越 oracle 混合 1.9 與 1.5 點,且 K≥4 時信賴區間排除零。理論上混合路徑只能沿固定方向分類,容量受限定理解釋了此落差。結論:瓶頸在模型類別而非超參數;實務應改用 CLAP 或 LP++。此研究重新框定了少樣本視覺語言調適文獻的解讀方式。
