links.title: Benchmarking the Titans: A Multi-Dimensional Empirical Evaluation of LLM Code Generation Quality in the .NET Ecosystem

evidence: Abstract: '85 algorithmic tasks derived from HumanEval, generating and evaluating 340 solutions in total... functional correctness via automated unit testing, static code quality via Roslyn AST analysis, and runtime efficiency via adversarial BenchmarkDotNet profiling... Pearson r = 0.075'.

Sec 3.3 Phase 1: 'harnesses were generated by an independent DeepSeek instance rather than any evaluated model, preventing input bias and ensuring all four solvers were profiled under identical conditions'.
Sec 4.1: models evaluated are 'GPT-4 (OpenAI API), Gemini 1.5 Pro (Google Vertex AI), Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Anthropic API), and Grok 3 (xAI API)' at temperature = 0.

Sec 5.2: 'because Norm_C (normalized correctness) is itself one of the five components of the Composite Quality Score (Equation 1), the reported r = 0.075 specifically reflects the near-zero association between raw correctness and the four remaining structural and performance components'.

Sec 6 Construct validity: 'The equal weighting of the five Composite Quality Score sub-components may not reflect real-world priorities... a robustness check excluding Norm_C is identified as future work'.

Sec 6 External validity: 'The 85-task HumanEval subset does not reflect complex, multi-file enterprise .NET architectures... The orthogonality finding (RQ3) should not be assumed to generalise unconditionally to other languages or task types.'

Sec 4.5: 'Claude allocated approximately 3.94 GB of heap memory while all other models allocated near zero, suggesting a fundamentally different and pathological algorithmic strategy for these specific tasks'; median memory 156.6 MB vs Grok 6.0 MB.
Replication footnote: 'The evaluation harness, adapted task specifications, and raw results dataset are publicly available on GitHub' (github.com/mohammadmehdighalandarian/llm4se.git).
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope empirical LLM evaluation paper with strong alignment to LLM (2.5), Code & Programming (2.0), and Red Teaming & Evaluation (1.8) preferences: it benchmarks GPT-4, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Grok 3 on C# code generation across correctness, static quality, and runtime dimensions. Novelty is moderate: integrating correctness testing, Roslyn AST analysis, and BenchmarkDotNet profiling in one harness for .NET is a genuine gap-filler, but the core qualitative insight (correctness does not imply maintainable code) largely confirms prior findings the paper itself cites (Dou et al., Sec 2). Rigor is solid but limited: temperature=0 controlled setup, independent DeepSeek-generated profiling harnesses, a structured threats-to-validity section, and median-based outlier handling are strengths; single-run sampling, an ad hoc equally-weighted composite score, and a partly self-referential headline correlation (Norm_C is a component of the Quality Score, acknowledged in Sec 5.2 and Sec 6) weaken it. Evidence is concrete and internally consistent (Table 2, specific anomalies on csharp_12/csharp_16), but no significance testing beyond a bare 'not statistically significant' claim and figures are unverifiable from text. Generalizability is explicitly restricted: 85 function-level HumanEval-derived tasks, one language/ecosystem, no enterprise or multi-file tasks (Sec 6). Reproducibility is aided by a public GitHub repository with harness, adapted tasks, and raw results, though API model-version drift is a risk. Not a pure domain application or out-of-scope area, so the 0.20 cap does not apply.

primary_link.title: Benchmarking the Titans: A Multi-Dimensional Empirical Evaluation of LLM Code Generation Quality in the .NET Ecosystem

papers.summary: Evaluating Large Language Model (LLM) code generation quality requires examining not just whether the generated code is correct, but whether it is maintainable, efficient, and stylistically sound, all of which are qualities of direct importance to software engineering practitioners. Existing benchmarks reduce evaluation to a single Pass@k metric, which obscures critical trade-offs between functional correctness and structural quality. A further limitation is the near-exclusive focus on Python, l
papers.summary_zh: 現行程式碼生成基準以 Pass@k 為主,忽略可維護性等品質維度,且幾乎只關注 Python,企業常用的 C#/.NET 缺乏專屬評估。本文建置全自動的多維度評測框架,從 HumanEval 取 85 道演算法任務,對 GPT-4、Gemini 1.5 Pro、Claude 3.5 Sonnet 與 Grok 3 共生成 340 份 C# 解答,分別以單元測試衡量功能正確性、以 Roslyn AST 靜態分析衡量迴圈複雜度、巢狀深度、命名違規與專業度,並以 BenchmarkDotNet 在最壞情況輸入下剖析執行時間與記憶體配置。核心發現是正確性與複合品質近乎正交,Pearson r 僅 0.075,顯示 Pass@k 排名無法代表整體工程表現。結果上,Gemini 正確率最高(98.53%,僅 2 次失敗),GPT 最低且變異最大,呈雙峰失敗行為;Claude 程式結構最簡潔(複雜度 2.47)但記憶體中位數高達 156.6 MB,GPT 執行最快(4,823 ns);跨模型複雜度相關係數 0.63–0.69,顯示任務本身難度才是結構複雜度的主因。限制包括僅 85 題、單一語言,複合分數的等權設計未必通用。此框架提醒工程實務:正確性與結構品質必須視為獨立且並重的評估維度。

links.title: GeoRisk-RAG: A Hierarchy-Aware Risk Framework for Improving RAG Reliability through Selective Answering

Sec. 3.4.2: DAG distance via Lowest Common Ancestor over Wikidata p131/p361 edges; 98.2% entity-to-QID resolution
Sec. 3.4.3: retrieval defined as permutation maximization of f(t)=(-delta, cos theta) with k=6 via elbow point (Appendix D)
Table 5 (Sec. 4): GeoRisk-RAG GDR 0.946 location-dependent / 0.974 non-location-dependent, false confidence 0.009 (0.000-0.023) with 95% CIs

Table 7 (Sec. 4.4.1): correctness by geographic error type; Granularity Match scores 1.000 under Geo Mismatch; No Geo context correctness averages 0.404
Table 6 (Sec. 4.2): CC-CoSim stability across bge-small/bge-base embeddings and gpt-oss-120b/gemma-4-31B generators

Sec. 7 (Limitations): dataset 'modest in size... U.S.-based'; framework 'relies heavily on the coverage and correctness in external knowledge graphs like Wikidata'
Sec. 7: 'The code base, benchmark dataset, and experiments can be found at this GitHub repository' - no URL given in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/RAG-reliability contribution: hierarchy-aware retrieval over a Wikidata-derived DAG plus selective answering (answer/warn/abstain) to cut hallucinated geographic validity, aligning well with RAG, AI-safety/hallucination, and LLM-evaluation preferences. It is not a pure domain application since the retrieval-validity and selective-answering methodology is general, though it is instantiated only for wildfire QA. Novelty is moderate: geographic granularity similarity and abstention exist in prior work (Sec. 2.2, 3.4 cite granular computing and GeoRAG); the DAG-based LCA distance combined with warn/abstain behavior is a sensible but incremental composition, and the 'rank optimization' framing reduces to deterministic sorting (Sec. 3.4.3). Rigor is decent: 449-pair annotated benchmark (Sec. 3.1, Table 1), four baselines (Table 4), six metrics with 95% bootstrap CIs over 1,000 resamples (Sec. 4.3.2), cross-configuration stability analysis (Table 6), and NER model selection on out-of-sample GeoVirus data (Table 2). Weaknesses: all headline metrics (GDR, faithfulness, false confidence) come from an unvalidated LLM-as-judge (Nemotron-3-Super, Sec. 4.3.2) with no human audit of judge labels; human evaluation covers only preference on 50 questions with 2 annotators (Sec. 4.5); no component ablations of the distance measure. Evidence strength is moderate: non-overlapping CIs support the false-confidence drop 0.009 vs 0.090 (Abstract, Table 5), but results are single-domain, U.S.-only, with odd cells (e.g., Granularity Match correctness 1.000 under Geo Mismatch, Table 7) left unexplained. Generalizability is limited by acknowledged reliance on Wikidata coverage and U.S./wildfire scope (Sec. 7). Reproducibility is partial: detailed configs in Appendix E (Table 10) and dataset construction, and Sec. 7 claims a GitHub repo, but no URL is actually provided.

primary_link.title: GeoRisk-RAG: A Hierarchy-Aware Risk Framework for Improving RAG Reliability through Selective Answering

papers.summary: Current work on improving reliability in large language model (LLM)- generated answers has primarily leveraged Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), knowledge-graph augmentation, and reinforcement learning. While these methods are adept at enhancing and measuring reliability through semantic similarity and faithfulness, they often struggle to distinguish semantic similarity from geographic validity. This is especially critical in natural hazard management domains where geographic granularity (i.
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）在問答中常產生語義相似但地理上不適用的回答，對自然災害管理等領域尤其危險，因為在某個行政區成立的防災指引未必適用於鄰近地區，而「自信但錯誤」的回答風險高於棄答。本文提出 GeoRisk-RAG，一個階層感知的檢索增強生成框架。方法上，系統以 Wikidata 知識圖譜建構有向非循環圖（DAG），計算查詢目標地點與候選段落地理範圍間的階層距離，將關係分為精確符合、範圍較廣、範圍較細與不同地點四類，並據此實施選擇性回答：完全符合時直接回答、範圍相近時附警告回答、屬於不同行政區時棄答。實驗建構了 449 題的野火問答基準資料集，顯示 GeoRisk-RAG 在位置相依問題上將「錯誤自信率」從基線的 0.090 降至 0.009，良好決策品質率達 0.946，人類評估者在盲測中約七成偏好其回答。限制在於資料集規模較小且僅涵蓋美國，並依賴 Wikidata 的覆蓋度與正確性。此研究凸顯地理有效性與語義相似性的差異，為地災領域的可靠問答提供兼具解釋性與安全性的架構。

links.title: Unveiling the Depth-Performance Dilemma in Split-Federated Fine-tuning of LLMs

evidence: Section 3.2, Table 3: GPT-2 Small deep-cut AVG5 = 0.570 (SVD), 0.528 (Stack), 0.498 (Average), 0.310 (Freeze), all above FL baseline 0.435, supporting an aggregation-sensitive deep-cut regime
Table 2 (Section 4.1): Llama-3-8B GSM8K accuracy degrades shallow→deep (0.595→0.500 Average; 0.600→0.521 SVD) while exceeding FedB (0.420-0.428)
Section 4.2, Table 4: perturbation ratios never below 1.0 across models and deepest cuts (e.g., 1.89±0.08 for GPT-2 S at ℓc=L−3), supporting the near-isometric propagation claim
Section 4.3, Figure 8: attention collapse thresholds ℓ≈6/11/19 for GPT-2 S/M and Llama-3-8B, claimed to align with the acceleration point in Figures 7 and 4
Appendix A: exhaustive sweeps (48/92/140 SFF runs per GPT-2 model; stride-3, 44 runs for Llama-3-8B, ~396 GPU-hours on NVIDIA H200), Dirichlet α=0.5 non-IID, rank configs {4,8,16}
Appendix A.2, Table 6: 100-client GLUE results corroborate the dilemma (MNLI Average 77.44→73.37 shallow→deep; Freeze 73.87→63.37)
Appendix G: privacy measured only via a token-wise MLP inversion attacker; EP saturates at 100 for deep cuts, but no stronger adversaries (e.g., optimization-based) are tested

Section 3.2 vs Appendix A.3: LoRA applied to query/value in GPT-2 experiments but key/value stated for Llama-3-8B, an unreconciled inconsistency; no code or seed release is mentioned anywhere in the paper
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid empirical systems study of split-federated LLM fine-tuning: strongly matches LLM/LoRA/training-optimization preferences, though its GSM8K 'reasoning' usage is only as a benchmark and the core contribution is distributed-systems characterization rather than language-modeling methodology. Novelty is moderate: the Depth-Performance Dilemma framing and the first audit of Avg/Freeze/Stack/SVD aggregation in the split setting fill a real gap, but the headline finding (deep cuts hurt Transformer fine-tuning) is not surprising. Rigor is above average: exhaustive cut-layer sweeps across GPT-2 S/M/L and Llama-3-8B, four aggregation methods, an FL lower-bound baseline, homogeneous/heterogeneous LoRA ranks, and mechanistic verification (perturbation propagation with std, effective-rank attention collapse). Weaknesses: primary E2E setup uses only N=3 clients with no multi-seed variance or confidence intervals on headline results, a custom AVG5 metric, an inconsistency in LoRA placement (Section 3.2 says query/value; Appendix A.3 says key/value for Llama), and no code release. Evidence is internally consistent and quantitative but unverified externally; the privacy attacker is a simple token-wise MLP, possibly underestimating leakage. Generalizability is supported across four scales, three task types, and 3-100 clients, with collapse thresholds scaling at ~50-60% depth. Reproducibility benefits from full hyperparameters, pseudocode, and compute accounting (~396 GPU-hours on H200) but lacks artifacts and seeds.

primary_link.title: Unveiling the Depth-Performance Dilemma in Split-Federated Fine-tuning of LLMs

papers.summary: Split Federated Fine-tuning (SFF) is a promising paradigm for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) by partitioning model depth between resource-constrained clients and a centralized server. While system incentives for throughput and privacy favor deep partitions, the impact of such configurations on model utility remains poorly understood. In this work, we identify and characterize the Depth-Performance Dilemma: the regime that maximizes system efficiency is precisely where fine-tuning quality c
papers.summary_zh: 分割聯邦微調透過在客戶端與中央伺服器之間切分模型深度，讓資源受限的裝置也能微調大型語言模型，而系統層面的吞吐量與隱私保護都偏好較深的切割層，但其對模型品質的影響先前並不清楚。本文發現並刻劃「深度—效能困境」：吞吐量與隱私最佳的切割深度，正是微調品質崩壞的區間。作者在 E2E NLG、GSM8K、GLUE 三項基準上，對 GPT-2 Small/Medium/Large 與 Llama-3-8B 全面掃描切割層，並評估 Average、Freeze、Stack、SVD 四種聯邦 LoRA 聚合方法，結果顯示沒有任何聚合策略能倖免於深度造成的退化，其中 SVD 與 Stack 較穩健，Freeze 崩壞最劇。機制診斷指出三個複合因素：聚合雜訊、Transformer 殘差架構近乎等距的雜訊傳遞（擾動比不低於 1.0），以及深層伺服器層的注意力崩壞，後者約在總深度五至六成處出現，與效能斷崖位置吻合；所有分割設定皆優於標準聯邦學習。局限是本文屬診斷性研究，並未提出完整解法。此發現挑戰了「切割深度是效用中立旋鈕」的既有假設，為穩定的分散式 LLM 微調奠定結構性基礎。
papers.title: Unveiling the Depth-Performance Dilemma in Split-Federated Fine-tuning of LLMs
papers.title_zh: 揭開 LLM 分割聯邦微調的深度—效能困境

links.title: Aggregation-Aware Synthetic Text Generation Against Authorship Re-Identification

evidence: Section 5.1.1 / Table 3: at K=16 on Reddit, AAST-Phi attains 39.8 MRR vs 54.7 (JAMDEC), 92.7 (KiP), and 99.8 (Private); private R@8 reaches 100 by K=8, motivating the aggregation threat model.

Section 5.4 / Appendix L.2 Table 16: NoBundleSel-Phi raises Reddit R@8 to 75.1 at K=16 vs 60.7 for AAST-Phi, with NLI/CoLA remaining close (72.0/95.0 vs 72.9/94.7), isolating bundle-level selection as the privacy source.

Appendix E Table 5: under an independent classical n-gram stylometric attacker, AAST variants take lowest and second-lowest MRR and R@8 at K=16 on both datasets, with 95% bootstrap CIs (e.g., Reddit MRR 12.6 [9.8, 15.6] vs KiP 44.6 [38.0, 51.6]).
Limitations section: the LUAR-based episode encoder used in bundle-level selection makes same-genre LUAR attribution not fully independent; adaptive attackers are deferred to future work.
Appendix A.2-A.3: the DP guarantee is explicitly limited to the noisy abstraction score selection step; no end-to-end DP claim is made for the selected abstraction or final synthetic corpus.

Appendix O.1: at K=16 on Blog, AAST completes generation in 5.8 hours vs 11.3 hours for KiP and ~120 hours for JAMDEC on the same three GPUs, with output length differences (1.1-1.3x) far smaller than runtime gaps.

Conclusion section: all code available at https://github.com/masonmq/aast; Section 4.1.1 states the collected Reddit corpus (103,587 posts, Jan 2011-Mar 2026) will be limited to verified researchers under use restrictions.

Table 1: cross-genre attribution on CROSSNEWS, AAST-M achieves lowest Accuracy/R@8 in all four attack settings (e.g., Tweet-Article SELMA+LIP: R@8 5.0, Avg.Rank 192 vs KiP 8.4/165 and JAMDEC 10.8/125).
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope NLP/privacy work where LLMs (Mistral-Small, Phi-4) are the generative backbone, giving moderate LLM preference fit, plus NLP (authorship analysis) and safety-adjacent (privacy attack/defense) relevance; but the core contribution is a selection framework over authorship embeddings rather than LLM methodology, so preference relevance is mid-range. Novelty is solid: the shift from per-document obfuscation to bundle-level, aggregation-aware selection is a genuine new problem formulation. Rigor and evidence are strong: two same-genre datasets, cross-genre CROSSNEWS, four attack families (LUAR, PAN22, classical stylometric, SELMA), component ablations, a controlled NoBundleSel comparison, cost analysis, and bootstrap CIs; the main caveat is that bundle-level selection uses the LUAR encoder that is also the primary attacker, which the authors honestly flag. Generalizability is limited by English-only text and untested adaptive attackers. Reproducibility is good: public code link, full hyperparameters (Table 2), though the collected Reddit corpus is restricted-access.

primary_link.title: Aggregation-Aware Synthetic Text Generation Against Authorship Re-Identification

papers.summary: Online users often release multiple texts under the same identity, giving attackers an author profile that can reveal more than any single text. Existing authorship obfuscation methods optimize privacy independently for each document, leaving them blind to cross-document correlations that make aggregation dangerous. We propose Aggregation-Aware Synthetic Text Generation (AAST), a framework that addresses this gap by jointly selecting synthetic texts at the bundle level rather than optimizing eac
papers.summary_zh: 網路使用者常以同一匿名帳號發布多篇文章，攻擊者可聚合這些文字建立作者風格輪廓，即使每篇都經過混淆處理，帳號層級仍可能被重新連結識別。現有作者混淆方法多逐篇最佳化隱私，忽略跨文件的聚合風險。本文提出 AAST，一個聚合感知的合成文字生成框架：先將私人文字抽象化，再由 LLM 生成候選改寫，經候選預選過濾後，於「束」層級聯合選取每篇文字——目標函式同時降低同帳號兩個束之間的相似度，並將束拉近其他使用者的束分布，另可在抽象選擇步驟加入高斯雜訊，提供有限的差分隱私保證。在 Reddit、Blog 語料與跨文體 CROSSNEWS 基準上，面對 LUAR 歸因攻擊、PAN22 驗證攻擊及古典風格計量攻擊，AAST 隨束大小成長持續壓低歸因與驗證風險，同時維持 NLI 語義品質、CoLA 語言接受度與情感一致，生成效率亦優於 KiP 與 JAMDEC 基線。限制包括無法保證完全匿名、對極短推文式輸入效果較弱，且尚未測試自適應攻擊者。此工作將作者隱私防護目標從單篇改寫轉向帳號層級的連結風險，具實務防禦價值。

links.title: Context-Aware Cluster Decoding: Semantic Anchor-Driven Coherence in dMLLMs

evidence: Abstract: training-free decoding scoring masked positions by multiplicative composite of softmax confidence and neighbor proximity, block-free, with code at https://github.com/zhaoyk-sysu/CACD-dMLLM
Section 3.1: positions with both neighbors decoded achieve average entropy 0.49 vs 2.60 for isolated positions (5.3x gap, 295,629 masked positions from 1,000 MathVista samples)
Table 1: CACD improves LLaVABench-COCO from 51.1 to 88.7 on LaViDa and MathVista from 23.5 to 28.0 on MMaDA; best ScienceQA on all three models
Section 5.2: Wavefront outperforms CACD on MMaDA CHAIRs (18.62 vs 19.76), showing hallucination gains are not uniformly strongest
Table 5 (Section 5.5): component ablation on MMaDA LLaVABench-COCO — w/o Ctx 46.4, w/o Dyn τ 46.7, w/o EOS 48.2, full CACD 49.0
Section 5.3: text-only extension to LLaDA-8B-Instruct gives GSM8K 61.00→63.00 and IFEval instruction-strict 64.74→68.59
Appendix E Table 10: CACD NFE 45.9 vs Original 512.0 on MMaDA LLaVABench-COCO with 11.2x measured speedup; Figure 6 admits ~1.4–2.0 GiB more peak memory than Original
Section 7 (Limitations): per-model threshold calibration required, model-dependent runtime/memory benefits, and no cross-scale evaluation beyond ~8B dense dMLLMs
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM inference methodology paper: a training-free decoding method (CACD) for diffusion (multimodal) LLMs, with a text-only extension, so it is not excluded as pure CV/image diffusion. Directly matches LLM (2.5), inference/serving (1.5), multimodal (1.8) and efficiency (1.3) preferences, but does not engage the highest-weight agent/reasoning/Japanese-LLM topics. Novelty is moderate: the neighbor-proximity composite score is a simple multiplicative heuristic operationalizing prior findings (Kim et al.; Kang et al.) and is close to WavefrontDiffusion's spatial modeling, though block-free cluster commitment plus architecture-aware calibration is a sensible delta. Rigor is solid: three models, four benchmarks, three baselines, full component ablation (Table 5), and extensive β/τ/δ/ρ sensitivity (Appendix D); but no significance testing, single-seed results, LLM-judge scoring without stated judge details, and possible baseline under-tuning weaken confidence. Evidence is credible and honestly reported (Section 5.2 admits Wavefront beats CACD on MMaDA CHAIR; Appendix E admits no uniform runtime/memory superiority), with length-confound controls (Table 4). Generalizability is demonstrated across three architectures and text-only LLaDA-8B-Instruct but is capped at ~8B scale, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is good: public code link in the Abstract and fully specified hyperparameters.

primary_link.title: Context-Aware Cluster Decoding: Semantic Anchor-Driven Coherence in dMLLMs

papers.summary: Diffusion multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) frequently produce long-form outputs marred by semantic drift and repetition, with quality generally degrading as output length increases. We identify two structural deficiencies in existing decoding methods as primary drivers of these failures: confidence-based scoring ignores decoded-neighbor support, and block partitioning prevents access to high-readiness semantic anchors, together causing tokens to be committed before their local context i
papers.summary_zh: 擴散多模態大型語言模型（dMLLM）在長文生成中常出現語義漂移與重複，且品質隨輸出長度下降。作者發現兩個結構性缺陷：純信心度評分忽略已解碼鄰居提供的局部語義支援，而區塊分割使最高準備度的語義錨點在七成半的首輪步驟中無法被存取。本文提出免訓練的解碼方法 CACD：為每個遮罩位置計算「信心度乘以情境放大項」的複合分數，以調和衰減量測左右已解碼鄰居的距離，讓具雙側鄰居支援的低信心詞元也能被提升，同時避免孤立雜訊被錯誤提前承諾；解碼全程不設區塊，每輪以叢集方式承諾超過動態門檻的多個位置，並加入動態門檻排程與 EOS 抑制等架構感知校準。在 MMaDA-8B、LaViDa、LLaDA-V 與 MathVista、LLaVABench-COCO、ScienceQA、CHAIR 四項基準上，CACD 一致提升生成品質並減少幻覺，例如 LaViDa 的 LLaVABench-COCO 由 51.1 升至 88.7，前向評估次數大幅下降，最長任務加速達 11.2 倍。限制包括門檻需逐模型校準、記憶體略增，且未驗證更大規模模型。此研究凸顯鄰居支援與視覺整合策略對 dMLLM 解碼設計的重要性。

links.title: FPGAgent: An LLM-Assisted Framework for Autonomous HLS Code Generation and Verification in FPGA Environments

evidence: Abstract: FPGAgent 'improves synthesizable rate by 16.9% on average, executability by 26.7%, and functional correctness by 30.6%' versus zero-shot; recomputation from Section 4.3/5.1 Table 1 across five models confirms 16.9 and 26.7, with functional-correctness deltas summing to ~30.3, a minor discrepancy vs the claimed 30.6.

Section 4.3 Implementation: five backbones (ChatGPT 5.2, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5, DeepSeek V3.2, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B), Vitis HLS 2022.2, Xilinx U200 at 200 MHz; zero-shot evaluated with pass@10 to match multi-candidate search (Section 5.2).

Section 5.2 Table 2 (RQ2): ablation on Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B only; FPGAgent_base/eoh/reflect/full reach 37.2%/48.7%/46.2%/66.7% functional correctness; Table 3 failure totals (49/40/42/26) are internally consistent with the solved-instance counts.
Section 5.1 (RQ1): comparison baseline is zero-shot generation only; cited agentic prior work (LAAFD, TimelyHLS, HLSPilot in Sections 2 and 7) is discussed but not empirically compared on HLS-Eval.

Section 6 Threats to Validity: single-benchmark reliance (78 of 94 HLS-Eval instances retained per Section 4.2), hardware-stack coupling for host code, and 3-5 hour xclbin build times motivating a one-shot build strategy.

Section 9 Data Availability: 'source code, scripts, benchmark instance list, and documentation... will be available upon the acceptance of this paper'; full reproduction requires a Xilinx FPGA board and Vitis HLS environment.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM multi-agent code-agent framework (Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, LLMs) for HLS/FPGA code generation, with training-free agentic orchestration, prompting with error pools, and knowledge injection. Quality is solid but bounded: novelty is mainly engineering integration (evolutionary search adopted from EoH, standard reflection/repair loops), with the headline novelty being board-level (xclbin) validation on real hardware plus a public benchmark. Rigor is reasonable (78-task HLS-Eval subset, 5 backbones, internally consistent ablation and failure-count tables, pass@10 fairness matching, threats-to-validity section) but the only baseline is zero-shot generation; no head-to-head comparison with cited agentic systems (LAAFD, TimelyHLS, HLSPilot) on the same benchmark, ablations use only the weakest model, and no significance testing. Evidence is quantitative and verifiable (verified averages: synthesizability +16.9 and executability +26.7 check out; functional-correctness average computes to ~+30.3 vs claimed 30.6, a minor rounding-level discrepancy), but rests on a single benchmark, one FPGA platform (U200, 200 MHz), and self-reported outcomes. Generalizability is limited by Vitis/Xilinx coupling, especially host-code generation, though kernel-side modules are claimed portable. Reproducibility is weak: code promised only 'upon acceptance' and full reproduction needs a U200 board and 3-5 hour xclbin builds per case. In-scope (LLM-for-code agents, not a pure domain application), moderately valuable, not top-tier.

primary_link.title: FPGAgent: An LLM-Assisted Framework for Autonomous HLS Code Generation and Verification in FPGA Environments

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown substantial promise for high-level synthesis (HLS) code generation, but most existing approaches validate only simulation or synthesis results. Because of timing and place-and-route constraints, \emph{HLS code that passes simulation and synthesis may still fail to produce deployable, runnable designs on real FPGA platforms}. Moreover, the lack of public benchmarks has limited many evaluations to small, self-curated test suites. We propose FPGAgent, a multi
papers.summary_zh: 現有 LLM 產生高階合成程式碼的研究多著重於模擬與綜合階段的驗證，但受時序收斂與布局繞線等硬體限制，通過模擬的 HLS 程式碼未必能在真實 FPGA 上編譯、部署與執行，且公開基準不足使方法難以被公正評估。本文提出 FPGAgent，一套針對真實 FPGA 環境的多代理端對端框架：先注入 Vitis HLS 領域知識，以演化搜尋迭代產生效能可靠的核心程式碼，並用多層錯誤回饋機制累積失敗經驗；接著由功能反思模組產生 C++ 驗證程式檢查功能正確性、診斷缺陷並驅動修復；最後生成主機端程式碼，於真實 Xilinx U200 板上編譯成可執行檔並進行板級驗證。在包含 78 項任務的 HLS-Eval 基準上，以五種主流模型評估，相較零樣本基線，FPGAgent 平均提升可綜合率 16.9%、可執行率 26.7%、功能正確率 30.6%，使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 時正確率最高達 92.3%。局限包括僅以單一基準評估、主機端程式碼與特定硬體堆疊耦合，且 xclbin 建置需 3 至 5 小時。此工作首次在公認基準上驗證從任務規格到可執行 HLS 的端對端生成，深具工程實用意義。

links.title: The Variance of Thought: Policy Variance, Critical Forks, and Local Credit Assignment

evidence: Abstract: frames multi-step reasoning and tool-using agents as limited by credit assignment, with policy variance σ²_π(s) as the central object
Section 3.2, Theorem 6 + Corollary 8: Cantelli/Chebyshev bounds give Ω(c²/σ²_π(s)) discovery budget; exactness attained on the canonical fork per Proposition 7 and Appendix C equality condition
Section 3.1, Corollary 5: rollout-free screen σ²_π(s) ≤ 1−‖π(·|s)‖²₂ from logits, with the paper noting it is 'necessary but not sufficient' for value-equivalent actions

Section 4, Proposition 9 (proof Appendix E.2): MC advantage SNR = (1−p_j)√(P_{j+1}/(1−P_{j+1})), so unit SNR costs exp(Σ log(1/p_k)) rollouts; states branching/tree search inherits the same 1/P_{j+1} cost

Section 5: four-stage fork detection procedure (dispersion screen, rollout budget c²/τ, bias-corrected variance estimator, EWMA+entropy classification) described in detail but never implemented or evaluated on any task
Section 5 'Stochastic environments': variance-decomposition-based fork detection for agents left as 'the open problem we consider most substantive'
Section 6: log-value critic dominance at long horizons explicitly framed as 'a falsifiable prediction', i.e., empirically untested
Appendices A–F: full proofs provided; Lemma 4 (advantage–probability bound) and Appendix F.2 gradient SNR √ε(1+O(ε)) at Type II forks verified as correct
Appendix D: argues Bernstein's inequality is vacuous for a single draw (bound ≥ 2e^{−3/2} ≈ 0.446), contrasting with the sharp second-moment bound
References: grounds claims in RLVR near-zero-pass-rate behavior, PPO/GAE, and Tree of Thoughts, but no experiments, code, or benchmarks are reported anywhere in the paper
llm_evaluation.rationale: A pure-theory paper on credit assignment for LLM reasoning/agent RL, squarely matching high-weight preferences (Reasoning & CoT, RL, RLHF-style post-training, Agents), though no LLM is trained or evaluated. Mathematically it is careful and self-contained: the Cantelli-based discovery bound (Thm 6, Cor 8) with exactness on the two-point fork (Prop 7), the rollout-free Gini-Simpson screen (Cor 5), and the exponential Monte Carlo cost on fork chains (Prop 9, App E) all check out on inspection, and Appendix F's gradient-SNR computation is correct. Limitations are honestly flagged (dispersion screen necessary-not-sufficient, stochastic-environment sample cost an open problem). Novelty is moderate: the ingredients (total-variance recursion, Cantelli/Chebyshev, 1/P Bernoulli estimation cost) are standard, with the value added in framing and the log-value additivity argument, which is presented only as an untested 'falsifiable prediction'. Evidence strength is limited by the complete absence of experiments: the four-stage fork-detection algorithm (Section 5) is never run, and the headline practical claim (log-value critics dominate at long horizons) is unvalidated. Generalizability is constrained by the deterministic-MDP/terminal-reward idealization and the binary-fork chain model. No code or implementation details, so reproducibility rests on proof verifiability alone.

primary_link.title: The Variance of Thought: Policy Variance, Critical Forks, and Local Credit Assignment

papers.summary: Long-horizon language-model tasks --- multi-step reasoning and tool-using agents alike --- are limited by credit assignment. We analyze it through the policy variance $σ_π^2(s)=\operatorname{Var}_{a\simπ}[Q_π(s,a)]$, which in a deterministic MDP is the sole source of return variance and is injected in discrete pulses at states we call critical forks. Three results follow. (i) Policy variance is a discovery budget: observing an action of advantage $c$ requires $Ω(c^2/σ_π^2(s))$ draws, a bound tha
papers.summary_zh: 長時程推理與工具使用代理的學習瓶頸在於信用分配。本文以理論分析切入：在確定性環境中，報酬變異完全源自策略自身的選擇，可用策略變異數量化，並以離散脈衝的形式集中在作者稱為「關鍵分岔」的狀態上。文章提出三項結果：其一，策略變異數是「發現預算」——要觀測到優勢超過 c 的動作，至少需 Ω(c²/σ²) 次抽樣，且此下界在典範兩點分岔上可被精確達成；其二，策略變異數受策略的 Gini 分散度上界約束，可僅由 logits 直接計算，提供免輪詢的分岔必要性篩選；其三，在下游成功機率為 P 的分岔上，蒙地卡羅優勢估計的訊噪比約為 √P，樣本成本隨剩餘時程呈指數成長，分支搜尋亦無法避免，唯有自助法搭配乘法精確的價值表示才能將連乘轉為加總，故主張採用對數值函數參數化。文章進一步給出分岔分類（不確定型與探索型）與免費首階段的偵測程序。局限在於整體屬理論框架，隨機環境下變異分解的歸因樣本成本仍未解決。此分析為長時程強化學習的信用分配提供可證偽的實證預測與原則性的輪詢預算。
papers.title: The Variance of Thought: Policy Variance, Critical Forks, and Local Credit Assignment
papers.title_zh: 思維的變異數：策略變異數、關鍵分岔與局部信用分配

links.title: Can Large Language Models "Hyper-Thread"?

evidence: Abstract: 'Concurrent Functional Loading achieves the highest accuracy... providing preliminary behavioral and correlational evidence'; within-step concurrency and causal mechanism explicitly not tested.
Section 5.1 / Table 2: accuracy 23/30 (Concurrent) vs 17/30 (Serial) vs 16/30 (Baseline); mean tokens 4,117.47 vs 2,689.83 vs 2,932.73 — mean resource cost is higher, not lower.
Section 5.2 / Table 3: Concurrent − Serial is +20.00 pp, McNemar p=0.0703 (not significant at 0.05); Concurrent − Baseline p=0.0391.

Section 5.3 / Table 4: Concurrent − Serial mean length difference +1,427.63 tokens (bootstrap [−420.2, +3,683.0]); median difference −165.5; shorter on 17/30 problems — no universal lengthening but no mean savings.
Section 5.6 / Table 6: attention metrics are group means (e.g., H_norm 0.580 vs 0.530) with no confidence intervals; Section 6.2 concedes only 'coexistence, not a causal effect'.
Section 4.1 / 4.3: single closed-source model deepseek-v4-flash with thinking disabled; one generation per condition; temperature, top-p, and seed not explicitly passed.

Section 7 (Limitations): nine limitations including 30 problems, single run, confounded granularity/repair factors, post hoc tail handling, and inability to distinguish internal concurrency from alternative search/path changes.

Reproducibility Statement: raw API responses, run manifests, SHA-256 checksums, and no-API-key analysis scripts claimed in supplement; Section 4.1 notes complete prompt templates are only in the supplement, not the main text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM reasoning/attention paper squarely matching top-weighted preferences (LLMs, chain-of-thought, attention mechanisms, interpretability, test-time scaling). The 'Model Hyper-Threading' framing — serial token output does not imply serial functional computation, and dispersed attention can be beneficial when functions share state — is a genuinely novel, falsifiable hypothesis that reframes inference scaling as per-step functional load. However, the empirical support is thin: a single exploratory run on 30 AIME 2025 problems with one generation per condition on one closed-source API model (deepseek-v4-flash, thinking disabled; Section 4.1). The hypothesis-critical contrast (Concurrent vs Serial) is non-significant (McNemar p=0.0703, Table 3), and the concurrent condition costs more mean tokens (+1,427.63 vs Serial, Table 4), weakening the efficiency narrative; the claimed contribution reduces to 'no universal per-problem lengthening' plus heavier tail risk (Tables 2, 5). Attention evidence is group-mean descriptive only (+0.03 to +0.10 differences, Table 6) with no reported uncertainty, no layer/head analysis, no intervention, and acknowledged confounding between scheduling granularity and immediate repair (Sections 4.2, 6.2, 7). The paper is unusually disciplined about claim boundaries (Claim Checklist, Table 8; nine limitations in Section 7), paired McNemar/bootstrap statistics, and separating output entropy from self-attention, which lifts rigor above typical exploratory work, but the design cannot establish the mechanistic claim. Generalizability is minimal (one math dataset, one model, one run). Reproducibility claims are extensive (raw responses, checksums, no-key scripts) but templates and fixed sampling parameters (temperature/seed follow API defaults, Section 4.3) are not in the main text and the model is a black-box API.

primary_link.title: Can Large Language Models "Hyper-Thread"?

papers.summary: Large language models generate tokens sequentially, but can they execute multiple tasks concurrently while forming each token? Broader attention allocation may provide a mechanism for such task concurrency. Existing approaches to scaling inference primarily rely on longer generations, more samples, or additional verification stages, while attention dispersion is often treated as a signal of interference or error. Task concurrency within serial generation therefore remains underexplored. We propo
papers.summary_zh: 自迴歸大型語言模型逐 token 序列輸出，但序列生成是否必然意味著功能計算也是序列的？先前研究多將注意力分散視為干擾或錯誤訊號。本文提出「模型超執行緒假說」：更分散的注意力或可在單一生成步驟內同時推進多項相互關聯的功能計算，使每步承載更多功能而不需等比例增加輸出長度。作者設計三種提示條件——基線、序列功能排程（每段落後分組檢查）與並行功能載入（全程維持解題、邏輯驗證、邊界與閉合檢查、計算驗證及輸出控制，並即時修復錯誤），在 AIME 2025 開發集 30 題上以 deepseek-v4-flash 單次生成比較。結果顯示並行功能載入準確率最高（76.67% 相對序列排程的 56.67%），其中位數輸出長度相近且多數題目未變長，但平均長度與尾部風險較高；直接量測的自注意力指標（歸一化熵、有效支援大小、邊密度與任務相關覆蓋率）也較高。局限包括單一模型、每題僅一次生成、缺乏因果干預，證據僅屬探索性與相關性質。此研究挑戰「生成更多 token」的推論擴展慣例，提出「讓每個生成步驟承載更多功能」的新研究方向。

links.title: STAGE: Stateful Translation to Agentic Graph Execution with Policy-Scoped Context and Deterministic Control

evidence: Abstract: STAGE confines model judgment to policy-scoped nodes while deterministic code owns procedural control; evaluated on SOP-Bench Referral Abuse, two tau2-bench domains, and proprietary Smart Dispute, with Pass^3 gains of 7.5-55.0 and 57.2-65.7 points on Telecom and Smart Dispute.

Section 2.2 / Section 4.2: Three research questions with controlled conditions; RQ2 holds the graph fixed and varies only node-level policy context, isolating localization from control structure; all conditions use the same DeepAgent scaffold.
Section 5.1 Table 1: Telecom GPT-5.6 Luna Pass^1 47.5->90.0 and Pass^3 32.5->87.5; Smart Dispute Sonnet 5 Pass^3 14.3->80.0; results reported without confidence intervals or significance tests.
Section 5.2 Table 2: Fixed-graph comparison on 40 Telecom cases; node-scoped context raises Pass^3 by 27.5 (Haiku) and 22.5 (Sonnet) points while cutting total tokens 37.8% and 56.8%.

Section 5.4 Table 3: Token trade-off is openly reported; STAGE increases input tokens in most public settings (e.g., Haiku Telecom 254.78K -> 1173.36K per case), with authors stating it should be seen as a reliability mechanism rather than a token-reduction method.

Section 5.3 Figure 2: Smart Dispute errors stratified by realized chain length; STAGE cuts chain errors to at most 6.7% (Haiku) and 3.3% (Sonnet), with remaining failures concentrated in execution/end errors on long chains.

Section 4.1: Smart Dispute is proprietary banking knowledge evaluated only with Claude Haiku 4.5 and Sonnet 5 in an approved internal environment, limiting external verification; no code or graph release is stated anywhere in the paper.

Section 6: Related workflow-compilation systems (JourneyBench, Compile-Then-Page, Declarative Skills, COVENANT) are cited and differentiated conceptually but none are used as empirical baselines, leaving the comparison to a single monolithic full-policy baseline.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM agent framework for policy-governed workflow orchestration with tool use, deterministic control, and multi-model evaluation, matching the high-weight Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences. The controlled design is above average: three research questions, a fixed-graph ablation (RQ2) isolating policy localization from control structure, Pass^1/Pass^3 reliability metrics, an error taxonomy, chain-length stratification, and honest token trade-off reporting. Novelty is only moderate because policy/workflow compilation into executable graphs is a crowded space the paper itself documents (JourneyBench, Compile-Then-Page, COVENANT, AgentSpec), and the contribution is a refinement (compliance-carrying scoped nodes) rather than a new capability. Rigor and evidence are limited by small and unstated case counts (Smart Dispute percentages move in 14.3% steps, implying ~35 cases), only three trials, no confidence intervals or significance tests, a single weak monolithic baseline with no comparison to the cited competing workflow-compilation systems, and an unverifiable proprietary benchmark. Generalizability is tempered by the need for per-policy offline graph authoring with human review; reproducibility is poor given no code/data release, a proprietary benchmark evaluated in an internal environment, and only high-level graph-construction details.

papers.summary_zh: 受政策治理的代理必須在解讀案件證據的同時遵循授權程序，但單體式代理需同時處理語義推理與流程控制，隨情境增長易漏步驟、誤路由或讓未經驗證的判斷擴散。本文提出 STAGE，一個可執行圖框架：離線將政策分解為經人類審核並凍結的動作與決策節點圖，線上執行時每個節點僅接收任務相關的政策情境與案件資訊，模型回傳型別化結果，而由確定性協調器負責路由、重試、升級與終止，實現「模型管局部意義、程式碼管控制」的分工。評估涵蓋 SOP-Bench Referral Abuse、τ²-bench 的 Retail 與 Telecom，以及內部銀行爭議工作流程 Smart Dispute。結果顯示相較單體式全政策執行，STAGE 普遍提升任務成功率與三次重複執行的可靠性，在較深的 Telecom 與 Smart Dispute 上，Pass³ 依模型分別提升 7.5 至 55.0 與 57.2 至 65.7 個百分點；固定圖比較也證明節點範疇政策情境可再降錯，並減少 37.8% 至 56.8% 的總詞元消耗。局限包括部分設定輸出詞元增加、超長流程仍具挑戰，且圖需離線建置與審核。此研究顯示政策執行可靠性取決於情境與控制權的結構化安排。

links.title: Training-Free VLM Personalization via Calibrated Residual Decoding

evidence: Abstract: proposes training-free calibrated residual decoding with three evidence conditions E+, E-, E0 and normalized-entropy-based uncertainty calibration, evaluated on MMPB, YoLLaVA, MyVLM.

Motivating Observation, Table 1: on the combined MMPB subset (2848 samples), 24.09% of E+ prompting errors are prior-aligned (y_hat+ = y_hat0 != y*), i.e., 84.26% of errors agree with the empty-profile prediction.
Experiments, Table 2: results across five backbones (Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B, Qwen3-VL-2B, InternVL3-2B/8B); e.g., Qwen2.5-VL-3B avg improves from 83.84 (E+ Prompting) to 89.19 (Ours).
Table 2 (Experiments): full method does not always dominate the E- Contrast baseline, e.g., Qwen2.5-VL-7B MMPB 72.91 (Ours) vs 73.89 (E- Contrast) and InternVL3-2B MMPB 72.03 vs 72.47.
Ablation Study, Table 4: with an irrelevant textual profile on MME, uncalibrated residual decoding degrades the base model by -9.60 while the full entropy-calibrated method reduces the drop to -3.25.
Implementation details: alpha=1.25, beta=1.25, T=1.25, K=24, with prompt templates and hyperparameter sensitivity deferred to Appendix B & C; no code release statement appears in the document.
Extension to Open-ended Personalized Generation, Table 6: 100-example self-constructed benchmark evaluated by an external LLM judge, 63.0% overall win rate, average score 3.54 to 4.70.
Conclusion: acknowledged limitation is additional inference cost from evaluating multiple evidence conditions, especially in token-level open-ended generation.

Baselines (Experimental Setup): comparison is limited to decoding baselines (No Profile, E+ Prompting, E0/E- Contrast); contextual comparison to prior personalized VLM systems is relegated to Appendix D.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal VLM decoding-methodology paper (in scope via Multimodal AI, Prompting, Inference; not pure CV), so no out-of-scope cap applies, but it does not strongly hit the highest-weight preference areas (no reasoning/agent/Japanese focus; LLM relevance is indirect through VLM backbones). Novelty is moderate: the core machinery extends known contrastive decoding (CAD, VCD, DoLa) to personalization with a positive-anchored three-condition residual and entropy gating; the reframing of personalization as evidence to preserve rather than suppress is the main new idea. Rigor is solid in breadth (5 backbones, 3 benchmarks, ablations, MME robustness check) but weakened by absent significance testing, no head-to-head with training-based personalization systems in the main results, a small self-constructed 100-example LLM-judge open-ended eval, and the fact that the simpler E- Contrast baseline beats the full method on several cells (e.g., Qwen2.5-VL-7B MMPB: 73.89 vs 72.91), undercutting claims that both references plus calibration are jointly necessary. Evidence strength is decent given the motivating 84.26% prior-aligned error analysis and consistent ablation direction, though gains on near-saturated MyVLM cells are marginal and the alpha=beta=T=1.25 defaults look underexplored in the main text. Generalizability is good (model-agnostic, text-profile and image-reference, MCQA and open-ended) but limited by the stated 3x inference cost. Reproducibility is fair: public benchmarks/models and hyperparameters are given, with templates deferred to appendices, but no code release is stated in the document.

However, direct personalized prompting does not guarantee that the model will reliably exploit such evidence. The predictive distribution under the positive user profile often mixes two sources: personalized signals genuinely supported by the current profile, and the model's generic visual or linguistic p
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討視覺語言模型（VLM）的免訓練個人化問題。直接在推論時提供使用者個人檔案雖可避開微調成本，但正向檔案下的預測分布會混雜真正受個人證據支持與模型通用先驗兩種訊號，難以判斷高信心答案的來源。作者提出校準殘差解碼框架：對同一影像與問題，建構三種證據條件——正向個人檔案 E+、反事實檔案 E− 與空檔案 E0，以 E+ 為基準，從三者分數差估計個人化的邊際貢獻，並引入基於正規化熵的不確定性校準，使增強強度隨殘差訊號可靠度自適應調整。實驗在 MMPB、YoLLaVA 與 MyVLM 上顯示，無需微調即可提升個人化多模態理解，身份敏感的視覺個人化任務增益最明顯（YoLLaVA 最多提升 35.90 個百分點）；消融顯示反事實對比比空檔案對比更能分離使用者特定訊號，熵校準在 MME 上可緩解不相關檔案造成的退化。開放式問答的 token 層級版本亦透過 LLM 評審獲得 63% 勝率。限制是需對多個證據條件重複評分，推論成本較高；未來可透過快取與候選剪枝降低開銷。此工作為凍結模型可靠利用個人證據提供了可校準的解碼途徑。

evidence: §5.2 Table 1: 'Graft reaches R@20 0.326, recovering 91% of the dense-graph retriever (0.357)' with per-component supervision block 0.296→0.307→0.322→0.326
§5.3 Table 2: out-of-corpus 500 queries, Graft leads at every cutoff (R@5 0.367 vs dense-graph 0.218; R@20 0.548 vs 0.501)
§5.5 Table 3: graph-RRF 0.322 R@20 vs uniform RRF 0.284 (+13.38%); attribution precision 0.922 against graph labels

§5.1: 'Gold for each query is its neighbour set in the full paper graph' — in-corpus gold derived from the same graph used as teacher, a circularity the out-of-corpus citation-gold eval (Appendix D.1, 2,095 pairs) partially addresses
Appendix A.4: groundedness study with 280 ratings, 96.5% items ≥4, Gwet's AC1 0.91, ordinal Krippendorff's α 0.30 reported honestly
Appendix D.2: 47.4% of Graft's correct out-of-corpus retrievals are non-obvious, 7.1% cited by query vs 0.23% for dense-graph (30.8× lift), 4.2× precision over a most-cited popularity baseline

Limitations: corpus restricted to *ACL venues 2019–2026, k-core sampling 'favours well-connected papers', graph construction 'quadratic in the number of nodes', retriever 'limited by memorisation capacity', new papers require retraining

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope NLP/IR methodology paper (facet-aware scientific related-paper retrieval via graph-distilled generative retrieval), not a pure domain application. Preference relevance is moderate-to-good: LLMs appear as components (gpt-5-mini facet extraction, Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct retriever fully fine-tuned, per §5.1 and Appendix A.3), and the work aligns with RAG/knowledge-retrieval and NLP preferences, but the core contribution is retrieval architecture rather than LLM methodology. Novelty is solid: typed-facet graph as distillation teacher, coverage-aware distillation (reverse-neighbour fallback plus K_min floor solving the no-in-edge target starvation problem) and graph-weighted RRF are genuine, well-motivated new pieces on top of established DSI/MINDER, aspect-based similarity, and citation-signal lines. Rigor is strong: seven baselines (Table 1), extensive ablations (identifier schemes Table 13, coverage-floor sweep Table 14, supervision alternatives Table 17, LoRA/capacity Tables 18-19, facet removal Table 15, edge-weight sweep Table 7, walk depth Table 9), temporal splits with query-side supervision held out, and a transparent 3-annotator groundedness study (Appendix A.4, Gwet's AC1 0.91, honestly reporting low Krippendorff alpha 0.30). Evidence is internally consistent and arithmetically checkable (0.326 vs 0.357 R@20 = 91% of teacher; graph-RRF +0.038; out-of-corpus +0.149 R@5, Table 2), but rests on a single self-constructed 11k-paper corpus with no significance testing; the in-corpus gold is the graph's own neighbourhood, making the teacher-matching claim partly circular, though the out-of-corpus citation-gold evaluation mitigates this. Generalizability is limited by the ACL-only, k-core-biased corpus and quadratic graph construction plus memorization-capacity scaling concerns (Limitations). Reproducibility is above average (hyperparameters Appendix F, package versions Table 20, prompts, code implied released) but facet extraction via a closed API with no temperature/seed control is acknowledged as not fully reproducible (Appendix A.3), and annotators were authors.

primary_link.title: GRAFT: Graph-Distilled Generative Retrieval for Facet-Aware Scientific Literature Exploration

papers.summary: Scientific papers may relate by problem, method, result, or contribution, but document-level retrievers collapse these into a single similarity score without saying why they are related. Citation- and similarity-based retrieval alone also confines search to the neighbourhood of what is already known, whereas generative retrieval generates document identifiers directly, enabling the exploratory retrieval that scientific discovery depends on. We connect papers in a graph whose edges are typed by t
papers.summary_zh: 科學論文可能因問題、方法、結果或貢獻而相關，但文件層級檢索器把這些異質關係壓縮成單一相似度分數，無法說明為何相關。論文首先建構 LitWeave：從 S2ORC 取得 11,359 篇 NLP 論文，以 LLM 抽取問題、方法、結果、貢獻四種面向，結合共引與書目耦合訊號，組成帶權重的型別化論文圖譜。接著提出 GRAFT，將圖譜蒸餾到生成式檢索器，讓模型本身成為索引，文件識別碼即論文自身的面向文字。針對兩個蒸餾後會遺失的圖譜性質，作者設計覆蓋感知蒸餾（邊權重取樣、最低覆蓋下限與反向鄰居補救，把可學到的目標從 84% 提升到全語料）與圖形加權倒數排名融合（graph-RRF），後者依查詢—候選邊權重縮放排名項並過濾無圖譜支持的候選。在 LitWeave 上，GRAFT 以單一 1B 模型恢復密集圖教師 91% 的 Recall@20，推論時不需最近鄰索引或編碼器；對語料外論文查詢，GRAFT 在所有截斷點都超越教師，且近半的正確檢索屬於相似度無法觸及的「非顯而易見」論文。限制包括語料僅涵蓋 ACL 類會議、圖譜建構為二次方成本，以及模型記憶容量限制使新增論文需重新訓練。此工作展示把結構化關係與可解釋的面向歸因一同編入生成式檢索的可行路徑。
papers.title: GRAFT: Graph-Distilled Generative Retrieval for Facet-Aware Scientific Literature Exploration
papers.title_zh: GRAFT：圖形蒸餾生成式檢索，實現面向感知的科學文獻探索

llm_evaluation.rationale: A training-free sampler correcting a diagnosed train-inference mismatch in self-conditioned flow-matching language models. In scope (language-model text generation, not image/video diffusion), touching LLMs (GPT-2 evaluator, DeepSeek V4 Pro judge), NLP text generation, and inference efficiency (few-step sampling, 95.5% throughput retained per Appendix C.10). Strengths: a genuinely careful causal isolation of the coupling mechanism (Section 5.3/Table 7: MSE-optimal coefficient drops monotonically 0.88 to 0.30 at 8 NFE as correlation varies with marginals fixed), matched-condition comparisons with six seeds and standard errors (Tables 3-4), a 2x2 placement ablation (Table 1: 45.63 vs 157.77 GenPPL), matched baseline samplers (Table 13: beats HiGS 56.90 and Momentum 74.72), and order-verification against high-resolution trajectories (Appendix C.7, exponents 1.04/2.02). Deductions: per-configuration hyperparameters in Table 6 raise test-set tuning concerns (sensitivity only at ELF-B 8 NFE); quality judged mainly by GenPPL and a single unvalidated LLM judge; Rep-4 repetition rises sharply for the method (Table 15: 1.82 vs 0.11 at 8 NFE OWT) in unexamined tension with the cited 'low perplexity is repetition' work; evidence limited to two small model families and unconditional generation on OWT/LM1B; no code release statement despite extensive protocol detail.

primary_link.title: Improving Few-Step Language Flows with Untied Self-Conditioning

papers.summary: Flow-matching language models refine all token positions in parallel and can trade sampling steps for latency, yet generation quality still degrades sharply with few sampling steps. We trace a source of this degradation to a train--inference mismatch in previous-prediction self-conditioning: during training, the self-conditioning input is computed from the current noisy state with no intervening solver step; during sampling, the solver folds the previous prediction into the latent before that sa
papers.summary_zh: 流匹配語言模型可平行精修所有 token 位置，以取樣步數換取延遲，但步數少時生成品質急劇下降。論文把此退化追溯到先前預測自條件化的訓練—推論不一致：訓練時自條件化輸入直接由當前帶噪狀態計算，中間無求解器步驟；取樣時求解器卻先把前一預測摺入隱狀態，同一預測又作為顯式輸入再次出現，這種訓練中不存在的耦合隨步寬增大而放大冗餘。作者從凍結投影權重的主角度譜辨識出自條件化輸入與隱狀態冗餘集中的方向，設計衰減轉換；並由求解器積分結構推導出精確更新需要步平均預測，以預測歷史（EMA 殘差與求解器加權平均）近似之，尺度由離線軌跡統計決定。所得的 Untied Self-Conditioning 取樣器免重訓、每步僅一次模型評估，校正後預測只進入求解器、原始預測仍供自條件化使用。實驗顯示在 8 步取樣下，LangFlow 於 OpenWebText 的生成困惑度從 531 降至 62（8.6 倍），LLM 評審在 96.3% 的成對比較中偏好本方法；ELF-B 上從 71 降至 43，改進從 8 到 256 步皆成立；控制實驗證實跨步相關本身即為病因。限制是需離線預先計算統計量，且貢獻主要針對特定自條件化架構。此工作為少步數平行文字生成提供了不動模型權重的實用修正。
papers.title: Improving Few-Step Language Flows with Untied Self-Conditioning
papers.title_zh: 以解耦自條件化改善少步數語言流

llm_evaluation.rationale: A small-substrate (4-6M param) cognitive-architecture program with genuinely LLM-relevant chapters: a frozen Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct actuator is used to measure the self-consistency lever's dynamic range (+0.0236 [+0.0150,+0.0326], below the 0.04 relevance threshold, §6), a GSM8K anchor cell (acc1=0.905, §6), and a cliff-family test-time compute allocation experiment (§9). Reasoning/test-time compute themes fit the preferences, but much of the paper (homeostatic PDE field, S5 permutation tasks, value routing on a toy substrate) is peripheral to LLM/agent research. Novelty is high: the readout audit showing PonderNet-style halting's apparent +0.223 advantage is a mixture-readout artifact (readout +0.383, residual execution regime +0.000, §5), the computed-decision thesis (gradient coupling captures zero; explicit allocator captures +0.151, §4), and the 'measure the lever first' precondition are fresh, mechanized findings. Rigor is exceptional: preregistrations with verdict branches, kill-gates, planted-signal positive controls, matched-compute paired contrasts with CIs, and honest reporting of a failed preregistered hypothesis (H2, §9) and unadjudicated claims (§9-10). Evidence strength is solid but scope-limited: some numbers are single-run or post-hoc with wide intervals (fraction difference -0.004 [-0.150,+0.241], §9), and the T=0.7 ceiling is admitted to come from a findings document not re-derived (§8/Reproducibility). Generalizability is deliberately limited—toy algorithmic tasks, one actuator, value orthogonal to content by construction, audit specific to PonderNet-style halting—all acknowledged in §10. Reproducibility claims are strong (MIT-licensed repository with preregistrations, artifacts, and macro-traced numbers), though unverifiable from the text alone.

primary_link.title: Where Cognition Lives: Dissecting Emergent from Computed Function in a Minimal Complete Cognitive Architecture

papers.summary: A cognitive architecture is more than the module that reasons: it must also decide how long to think and what deserves the effort. We built a minimal but complete system - a recurrent reasoner with adaptive halting, a homeostatic control field, and a value module - and asked of each part: does this function emerge from gradient descent, or must it be computed? Competence emerges. Stopping appears to emerge too, and to be worth more than everything decidable in advance, but that appearance is ins
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文以一個最小但完整的認知架構（含 PonderNet 式自適應停止的循環推理器、穩態控制場與價值模組），逐一追問每個功能是從梯度下降湧現，還是必須由顯式機制計算。任務為難度與資訊結構可控的 S5 置換合成演算法題，報酬為以 stake（賭注）加權的準確率。核心發現：能力與停止由訓練湧現，但自我觀察看似 +0.223 的優勢經讀出審計後證實只是混合狀態讀出的產物，在相同讀出與等預算下，知道哪個實例需要多少算力僅值 +0.0011；資訊層級在匹配算力下為均勻 0.467、難度 0.546、事前價值 0.698，顯式分配器以學到的自我模型完整達成此上限；梯度耦合對價值訊號無反應（訓練使狀態捨棄任務無關資訊），故價值形狀的二階決策必須計算。在凍結 Qwen2.5-14B 上，自我一致性投票的槓桿範圍極小（上限 +0.0236，低於相關性門檻），樣本間一致度幾乎無法作為停止訊號，因錯誤多為系統性。斷崖成本族的預註冊實驗顯示承諾下的價值分配值 +0.1312，但主因是可達範圍擴大五倍而非資訊結構改變。預註冊、對抗審查與 kill-gate 的方法論本身亦是貢獻；此研究為「認知何在」提供了嚴謹的測量邊界。

links.title: TRACE: Temporal Retrieval with Anchored and Convergent Evidence for Long-Horizon Video Understanding

evidence: Section 3 / Algorithm 1: TRACE is a training-free agent where Temporal Proposal, Evidence Assembly, and the Trajectory Reconciler are backbone (LLM) calls exchanging structured JSON records, with STOP rule-triggered from the answer trajectory.
Section 5.2 / Table 2: under the same Gemini-3-Flash backbone, TRACE reaches ECA@2=50.7 at 98.7 frames vs AVP 39.7 at 101.3 frames and uniform-128 at 40.2, with AR=2.12 vs AVP AR=1.00.

Section 5.3 / Table 4: ablations show removing the growth trajectory drops ECA@2 from 50.7 to 27.5 and EP from 29.1 to 19.4; removing final answer replay drops ECA@2 to 42.0 with Cov@2 roughly unchanged.
Appendix E / Table 6: 1,000-resample bootstrap CIs reported; paired bootstrap shows TRACE vs AVP differences in EP, Cov@2, and ECA@2 significant at p<0.01.
Section 5.2 counterfactual check: masking one annotated interval flips 78.0% of the 304 covered-correct answers vs 6.9% for random non-evidence segments of equal frame count.

Section 4.2 / Appendix H: five-stage semi-automatic pipeline reduces 1,024 candidates to 600 items, with per-stage rejection counts, 0.83 inter-annotator IoU, and 91.3% human-LLM leave-one-out agreement; annotators are four of the authors (~470 person-hours), an internal-annotation limitation.

Limitations section: audit uses only Gemini-3-Flash; VES-Bench covers only Temporal Ordering and Event Counting; Event Counting Acc plateaus near 40% across 64-256 frames, indicating a recognition bottleneck frame budget cannot fix.

Table 1: TRACE (Gemini-2.5-Pro) reports 86.1 on Video-MME, 75.6 on LVBench, 75.1 on LongVideoBench, positioned as a competitiveness check rather than the central study; Appendix D states reproduced AVP lands within 0.6 points of published numbers.

Section 4.3 'Timestamp requirement' and Appendix K: end-to-end compression methods cannot report EP/Cov/ECA without exposing source-frame timestamps; annotations, observation logs, and source videos are released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, but no explicit statement that TRACE's code is released.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic, LLM-driven test-time framework (Gemini backbones, structured JSON trajectories, prompt-based planner/reconciler) for long-video QA plus a new audit benchmark. It is not pure CV: language-model methodology (agent orchestration, prompting, LLM-based probes, benchmark construction with LLM shortcut filters) is central, so it stays in scope, but its domain (video understanding) aligns mainly with lower-weighted preferences beyond Agents & Tool Use, LLM, and Multimodal. Novelty is moderate: the frame-log audit of actually decoded timestamps against jointly necessary evidence intervals is a genuinely new evaluation angle, and trajectory-based stopping is a distinct alternative to self-confidence stopping, though agent-based long-video frameworks are crowded. Rigor is comparatively strong: same-backbone comparisons, a uniform frame sweep, component ablations, bootstrap CIs with paired significance tests, a counterfactual masking check, and a blind-LLM validation. Evidence is solid but the headline audit rests on a single backbone (Gemini-3-Flash), and generality claims to other backbones are asserted, not shown. Generalizability is limited by the two evidence-closed question families, the recognition-bottleneck plateau in Event Counting, and the timestamp-exposure requirement that excludes compression methods. Reproducibility benefits from prompts, cost accounting, per-stage annotation statistics, and a stated data/observation-log release, though explicit code release for TRACE itself is not clearly stated.

primary_link.title: TRACE: Temporal Retrieval with Anchored and Convergent Evidence for Long-Horizon Video Understanding

papers.summary: A long-video answer is evidence-supported only when the frames decoded from the video cover every event the answer depends on. Existing evaluations score final-answer correctness or predicted evidence intervals, but the frames a method decodes before answering are rarely audited, so correct answers can still rest on incomplete observation. We introduce VES-Bench, a 600-question benchmark of Temporal Ordering and Event Counting items over 348 public long videos. Each item carries a jointly necess
papers.summary_zh: 長影片問答中，正確答案唯有在解碼的畫面涵蓋答案所依賴的每個事件時才算有證據支持，但既有評測只看最終答案正確率或預測的證據區間，鮮少審計方法實際解碼的畫面。論文提出 VES-Bench：600 道四選一的時間排序與事件計數題，基於 348 段公開長影片，每題附帶聯合必要的證據區間集合，並在三個嚴格度層級（每區間至少 1/2/3 幀）審計解碼畫面的覆蓋率，配以證據精確率 EP、分配比 AR 與證據覆蓋正確率 ECA@k 等指標。同時提出 TRACE，一個免訓練的代理：將影片轉為視覺錨點，逐輪建構證據成長軌跡，對每個前綴束獨立作答形成答案軌跡，由軌跡調和器依答案穩定、無未滿足證據需求與最終答案重放來決定停止，並以 DROP/REFINE/EXPAND 持續擴充或修正證據。在同骨幹審計下，TRACE 以每題 98.7 幀達到 63.5% 準確率與 50.7% 的 ECA@2，高於 128 幀均勻解碼（40.2%），並以 0.39 倍幀成本逼近 256 幀解碼（53.3%）；反事實遮罩顯示覆蓋的區間確為答案所依賴（遮罩證據區間使 78% 的答案改變）。限制包括僅涵蓋兩種證據封閉題型、事件計數存在辨識瓶頸，以及前綴束重推理帶來的額外呼叫成本。此基準使「答案是否有證據支持」成為可直接測量的性質。
papers.title: TRACE: Temporal Retrieval with Anchored and Convergent Evidence for Long-Horizon Video Understanding

links.title: Small Reasoning Models are Instruction Followers in Function Calling

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/agent methodology paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning, Prompting): it studies function calling in small reasoning models with a decoupled instruction-following framework, Think/No-Think ablations, and quantization robustness. Novelty is moderate: instruction-based (prompt-based) tool calling and decoupled SLM tool routing exist in cited prior work (Natural Language Tools, Factored Agents, TinyAgent); the contribution is a recombination plus an empirical claim that instruction-following beats native tool calling. Rigor and evidence are weakened by an overclaim contradicted by the paper's own Table 2 (PFC beats IFFC for Phi-4 Mini Live 62.5 vs 44.3; NFC beats IFFC for Qwen-3 1.7B Live), admitted benchmark-specific prompt tuning against BFCL evaluation criteria (Appendix A.3) that disadvantages untuned proprietary NFC baselines, no significance testing or seeds, and missing table cells (FP16 Live Parallel omitted 'due to time constraints', Granite only at Q4KM). The 'outperforms GPT-5.2/Claude' claim rests on cherry-picked Non-Live categories while proprietary models lead in Live Parallel (Table 10). Single-benchmark (BFCL V3) evaluation limits generalizability; the reasoning-trace-as-error-correction hypothesis lacks mechanistic support. Reproducibility benefits from the full system prompt (Appendix B) and Algorithm 1, but decoding parameters and code release are absent.

primary_link.title: Small Reasoning Models are Instruction Followers in Function Calling

papers.summary: Function calling represents the core capability of agentic large language models (LLMs). Existing research has focused on enhancing LLMs function-calling accuracy through fine-tuning, reinforcement learning (RL), and multi-agent frameworks, particularly for native function-calling LLMs. This work demonstrates that LLMs achieve superior accuracy in function calling in instruction-following contexts (i.e., standard user-assistant interactions) rather than a tool calling context. We introduce Instr
papers.summary_zh: 函式呼叫是代理式 LLM 的核心能力，既有研究多透過微調、強化學習或多代理框架提升原生函式呼叫的準確率。本論文反其道而行，主張模型在一般指令遵循情境（標準使用者—助手對話）下呼叫函式的表現優於原生工具呼叫情境。作者提出 Instruction-Followed Function Calling（IFFC）框架，把函式呼叫邏輯與主要問答 LLM 解耦，交給一個 0.5B 至 15B 級距的專屬小型模型（SRM），以純自然語言提示定義工具並以 ReAct 方式執行，兩者情境完全隔離，避免複雜 API 結構污染主模型對話，也讓 SRM 的上下文不會被冗長回應撐大。在 BFCL V3 上，IFFC 一致優於原生函式呼叫與提示式基線：Qwen-3 4B（Think）達 Live 86.7%、Non-Live 94.1%，在 Non-Live Simple 與 Multiple 類別甚至超越 GPT-5.2、Claude 4.5 Sonnet 與 Gemini 2.5 Pro；「思考」模式對小模型增益最大（0.6B 從 22.9% 升至 57.7%）。更關鍵的是，推理模型在激進 Q4KM 量化下幾乎不損失（4B Think 僅降 0.6 點），而一般指令模型大幅退化，顯示推理軌跡本身具錯誤修正作用。限制是兩階段架構引入序列推理延遲，對嚴格延遲預算的即時應用仍是取捨。此工作為邊緣裝置上可靠且省資源的函式呼叫提供了新範式。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Solid, in-scope LLM methodology paper on claim-level confidence calibration combining self-verification and cross-sample consistency with post-hoc TS/PS, evaluated across six models and seven baselines on TriviaQA and TruthfulQA. Preference relevance is high (core LLM uncertainty/hallucination work, not a pure domain application). Novelty is modest: the closest prior work (Yuan et al. fact-level calibration, HalluMeasure, LMvsLM, Appendix B) already covers claim-level confidence/detection, and the delta is applying standard post-hoc calibration at claim granularity plus a convex signal mixture. Rigor benefits from an unusually honest failure-mode analysis (TruthfulQA consensus failure) but is undermined by an overstated abstract claim of ECE reduction that Table 1 contradicts for several models (e.g., Llama/TriviaQA Ours 0.200 vs PS 0.013), a missing 'Ours' row for GPT-4, many dashed AURC cells, no significance testing, and a 50-example manual inspection. Evidence strength is mixed: cited comparisons are internally verifiable, but the headline GPT-4o/TriviaQA win (0.006 vs TS 0.096) occurs at alpha=1.0, i.e., consistency-only, so it does not evidence the value of claim-level decomposition itself, and Appendix C.6 reports 'consistent improvement' for final-answer-only extraction with no numbers. Generalizability is moderate (two English factual-QA datasets, model-agnostic closed-box design, but acknowledged failure on adversarial inputs). Reproducibility is partial: appendices give dataset sizes, verbalized-confidence mapping, and cost (~6x) but no code release and no stated sample count N in the main text.

primary_link.title: Claim-Level Confidence Calibration for Reliable Decision Making with Large Language Models

papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly support decision-making in high-stakes domains, but they often hallucinate and express confidence that is misaligned with factual correctness. Response-level confidence is a coarse signal: a single generation can mix correct and incorrect statements, so a single number is not actionable for users that must accept, reject, or verify individual pieces of information. We study claim-level confidence calibration as a decision-relevant uncertainty signal: eac
papers.summary_zh: LLM 日益用於高風險決策支援，但常產生幻覺且表達的信心與事實正確性脫節。回應層級的單一信心分數過於粗糙：一段回應可同時包含正確與錯誤陳述，決策者無從得知該信任哪一句。本論文研究主張層級的信心校準：把回應分解為原子、可驗證的主張，每個主張結合自我驗證與跨樣本一致性兩種推論時訊號，再在主張層級直接套用溫度縮放或 Platt 縮放等事後校準，全程閉盒（不需 logits、不需微調），可支援對低信心主張進行證據檢索或人工複核等選擇性介入。作者在 TriviaQA 與 TruthfulQA 上以六個模型對比七個基線（含 HalluMeasure、LMvsLM）。結果顯示在混合正確性的事實問答中，主張分解加事後校準能降低期望校準誤差，例如 GPT-4o 在 TriviaQA 的 ECE 僅 0.006，約為溫度縮放基線（0.096）的 1/16。然而在對抗性的錯誤前提題上方法失效：模型流利且系統性地自信犯錯，管線忠實反映其錯誤信心（GPT-4o ECE 升至 0.412），此時需要 LMvsLM 式交叉詰問或外部檢索。論文也區辨了校準與選擇性預測排名是不同目標，並建議推理模型的宣稱抽取應限制於最終答案段。整體而言，本研究界定了主張層級信心在決策中的適用條件與失敗模式，對閉盒 API 部署尤具實用意義。
papers.title: Claim-Level Confidence Calibration for Reliable Decision Making with Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 面向可靠決策的大型語言模型主張層級信心校準

papers.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) capable of thinking with images often rely on external tools for fine-grained perception. However, this reliance introduces significant inference latency and fails to effectively resolve the spatial-structural gap-a fundamental challenge in text-dense and structurally relational visuals (e.g., charts and visual tables) where strict relative spatial arrangements bind textual elements. Without external tools, standard MLLMs struggle with such fine-grained v
papers.summary_zh: 圖表與視覺表格是文字密集且具結構關聯的視覺媒介，存在「空間—結構落差」：文字元素被嚴格的相對空間排列約束。現有「以圖思考」方法依賴外部裁切工具，造成視覺 token 爆炸、推論延遲與多輪誤差累積，自然語言也難以精確導航密集版面。論文提出 TwSG，把多步推理與微裁切的好處蒸餾進單次前向傳遞：由教師模型依問題定位關鍵區域並生成高品質 VQA 資料，以 think—observation—answer 交錯格式構成 12,674 筆冷啟動 SFT 資料，再以提出的 TL-GRPO 進行強化微調。TL-GRPO 引入標籤層級重要性取樣（TL-IS），在各功能標籤內獨立正規化重要性權重，避免長推理段稀釋簡短答案的梯度貢獻；配合裁剪組取樣（CGS）過濾優勢離群值，以及格式、答案正確率與以專家 MLLM 判定中間觀察正確性的可驗證獎勵。以 Qwen3-VL-8B 為骨幹，TwSG 在 ChartQA、ChartQAPro 與 TableVQA-Bench 共 11 個子集中有 10 個最佳，平均 73.70%，超越 Chart-R1（68.12%）；在 CharXiv-R 上以 67.8% 勝過 GPT-4.1 等閉源模型，同時維持約 1.75–2.00 樣本/秒的吞吐量，無需外部工具呼叫。消融證實各獎勵元件與標籤皆屬必要。限制為僅訓練至 8B 規模、依賴冷啟動資料品質，且純 CoT 對複雜算術仍不足，未來將探索內化的程式化視覺推理。

papers.summary_zh: 本文提出 ProBel，一套阿拉伯語與英語對齊的可解釋宣傳偵測資源，將二元標籤、23 種宣傳技術的多標籤註記（歸入六大粗類）、標註技術的文字片段以及參考解釋，對齊到同一批新聞句子與社群貼文，共約 4.8 萬筆實例，並大幅擴充英語部分。研究在控制設定下比較零樣本提示、任務專屬微調與多任務聯合訓練。主要結果顯示：單一雙語多任務模型（以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 搭配 LoRA 微調）整體表現最佳；跨任務遷移取決於監督層級，聯合分類訓練可保留二元表現，但僅訓練片段任務會削弱句級預測；阿拉伯語與英語聯合訓練最穩定，單語微調反而可能損及另一語言。蒸餾實驗顯示，模仿 GPT-5 思考軌跡的 off-policy 蒸餾與 on-policy 自我蒸餾（OPSD）都不及直接微調；作者診斷出已發表的硬裁切會移除決策詞元上的梯度，提出飽和裁切函數予以修復，但蒸餾仍僅是互補而非替代。限制方面，資源僅涵蓋阿英兩語的新聞與社群內容，稀有技術的長尾 F1 接近零，解釋品質僅以參考為本的指標評估。資料、程式碼與評測腳本將公開釋出，對可解釋宣傳偵測及跨任務、跨語言遷移的受控研究極具價值。

primary_link.title: Semantics or Structure? Auditing Text Sensitivity in Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting

papers.summary: Multimodal time-series forecasting has emerged as a promising paradigm in which natural-language context is expected to improve predictive performance. Recent multimodal foundation models, including Aurora, as well as early- and late-fusion approaches such as MM-TSFlib and TaTS, report substantial gains over unimodal baselines on the Time-MMD benchmark, attributing these improvements to textual information. However, whether these models are actually sensitive to the semantic content of the text
papers.summary_zh: 多模態時間序列預測近來宣稱自然語言文字能提升預測效能，包括基礎模型 Aurora、晚期融合的 MM-TSFlib 與早期融合的 TaTS，皆在 Time-MMD 基準上回報相較單模態基準的顯著增益，並歸因於文字資訊。本文質疑模型是否真的對文字語意敏感，設計受控的文字擾動協定：將每列文字替換為空字串、固定佔位句、同域洗牌文字、跨域文字，以及嵌入未來真值的 oracle 句，同時保持所有數值輸入不變。結果顯示，五種替換在三家架構上造成的平均 MSE 變動皆小於 0.5%。進一步剖析發現，文獻回報的增益其實來自資料集隨文字一併提供的數值欄位 prior_history_avg：它在 TaTS 與 MM-TSFlib 中與文字編碼器共享同一融合殘差，關閉文字路徑時被一併移除；針對 Aurora 的梯度、注意力與預測分歧探針則顯示其文字路徑受過訓練，但在前向傳遞中對內容無感。限制包括僅稽核 Time-MMD 與三種凍結編碼器架構，且數值型 oracle 受次詞切詞限制，無法完全代表語意敏感度。此研究說明，僅比較「關閉文字」的單模態基準無法驗證模型真正使用文字，嚴謹的多模態評測必須直接干預文字內容，並隔離與文字共乘融合路徑的數值特徵；其釋出的擾動協定可作為可重複使用的診斷工具。

Appendix A / Table 4: full training hyperparameters (LoRA rank, LR, focal loss gamma=2, epochs) for both SFT and ClsHead modes.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM/NLP system paper: fine-tuned (4-bit QLoRA) LLM ensembles with error-independence voting for German harmful-content classification, hitting the LLM, NLP, AI-Safety-adjacent (harmful/toxicity/moderation), Training, Prompting and Data preferences, while missing the Japanese-LLM, Reasoning and Agents clusters. Evidence is solid for a shared-task report: first place on all four subtasks on the hidden test, a leakage-free out-of-fold internal estimate that correlates r=0.9468 with test scores, per-fold result tables, latency/cost accounting, and honest limitations. Novelty is incremental: the multi-axis voter ensemble extends the authors' own prior work (Steigerwald et al. 2026b), with only the positive-class specialist described as new, and the core 'error independence' lever rests on known ensemble theory applied to a competition. No significance testing or seed variance backs composition differences, the decisive claim is supported only by a four-winner agreement analysis the authors themselves call 'a marker... not a proof', and the VIO internal-estimate inversion (r=-0.61) shows the selection signal can fail. Generalizability is explicitly bounded to one German Twitter network and legal framework. Reproducibility is good: hyperparameters, full prompts, per-fold scores, and synthetic data/models released openly.

primary_link.title: Nürnberg NLP @ GermEval Shared Task 2026: Harmful Content Detection in German Social Media through Error-Independent LLM Voters

papers.summary: Harmful content in German social media does real-world damage, from calls to action to criminal defamation. The GermEval 2026 shared task scores its detection in four subtasks. The technical challenge is a severe class imbalance. The harmful classes are rare and share surface language with the dominant majority class, yet under macro-F1 they decide the score. The decisive lever is then not a stronger single model but error independence. This insight becomes a per-subtask nine-voter ensemble span
papers.summary_zh: GermEval 2026 共享任務要求在匿名化的德語推特上偵測四類有害內容：號召行動（C2A）、攻擊民主基本秩序（DBO）、暴力相關內容（VIO）與刑事誹謗（DEF）。挑戰在於有害類別稀有（多數類佔 87–97%）且與之共用表層用語，卻在 macro-F1 中決定名次。紐倫堡 NLP 團隊的核心主張是「誤差獨立」比更強的單一模型更關鍵：為每個子任務組建九個投票者的多數決集成，沿三個軸引入多樣性——五種 LLM（含 128B 的 Mistral-Medium）、兩種訓練方式（生成式 SFT 與 4-bit QLoRA 上的判別式分類頭 ClsHead）、三種類別範圍（通用型 G、專家型 S 與僅訓練少數類的正向專家 PCS），並以 GPT-5.4 生成 2,634 則合成少數類推文，投票者經五折交叉驗證選出。最終以 macro-F1 89.56（C2A）、71.63（DBO）、54.84（VIO）、83.02（DEF）在四個子任務全數奪冠。分析顯示微調全面勝過 OPRO 最佳化提示，連 128B 模型平均也提升約 20 分；投票者分歧集中於分支之間，第三分支在少數爭議推文上發揮仲裁作用，VIO 則是內部估計唯一失準的子任務。限制包括每個組合僅有一次隱藏測試觀察、無種子變異與顯著性檢定、訓練耗費約 4,000 GPU 小時，且系統僅在單一極右翼網路的德語資料上驗證。此工作示範多樣化微調投票者集成是處理類別不平衡有害內容偵測的有效策略。

links.title: A survey detection channel overrides the pixels in an astronomical foundation model, and biases tomographic mean redshifts

evidence: Abstract & §3.1 Table 1: altering only the segmentation map with pixels byte-identical moves every readout 110–4400× a matched RA-token placebo; mask displaced 25 px cuts g-band flux estimate 79% (§3.1).

§3.2–3.3: within-object correlation r=0.474 with central mask coverage vs r=0.298 with enclosed light; on 322 real blends R=-0.0064 [-0.0075,-0.0046], showing deblending decisions do not propagate (detection gating, not aperture photometry).
§3.6 Table 3: mask-swap vulnerability grows with scale (flux-g 0.147→0.237 mag, redshift 0.0327→0.0441 from aion-base 314M to aion-large 860M); the paper correctly flags this as two-point evidence.

§4.2 Table 4 and assumptions: 3.68% measured miss rate over 5000 cutouts gives worst-bin median 0.71× the LSST DESC requirement over 40 assignments (12/40 exceed); miss representation choice changes the answer fourfold (all-zero field breaches 2.7×), and positional displacements take the worst bin to 8.3×.
§4.3: magnitude-dependent miss selection measured (0.33%→7.62% across octiles, Mann–Whitney p=5e-24) but re-drawing misses by p(miss|mag) leaves tomographic bias unchanged (Wilcoxon p=0.50).
§4.4 Table 5: withholding the detection channel removes the vulnerability at no measurable cost while a generic disc mask is +220% on flux-g.

§7 Table 8: 15-dictionary sweep shows recovery 26.0–74.7%, seed-only spread up to 18.4 points, 13/15 lose to difference-in-means (64.3%) and PCA at matched sparsity reaches up to 73.4%; reconstruction quality does not predict steering utility.
§5 Tables 6/Fig. 5: image codec uses 28 effective states on source patches vs 934 for spectra, forming a one-dimensional brightness ladder; utilisation unchanged at 2.7× parameter count.

§6.1–6.2: posterior-mean readout unusable under linear quantisation (median |Δz| 0.236 vs 0.050); pre-registered line-brittleness prediction falsified (Hα ablation breaks 6.1% of correct redshifts, only 5.7% of failures are aliases vs 43.4% null).

Data and code availability & Appendix A: claims-to-code.md maps every claim to script and JSON key, figures regenerate from stored JSON without model calls, weight revisions pinned, environment requirements and data-rebuild docs supplied; §2 sampling note (healpix-ordered contiguous draw R²=0.48 vs 0.91 random) shows protocol self-correction.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A rigorous mechanistic-interpretability audit of AION-1, a multimodal astronomical transformer, showing catalogue-metadata channels override raw pixels, the failure grows with scale, and sparse dictionaries are unreliable causal handles. Strong match to Interpretability & Explainability and Multimodal AI preferences, with genuine methodological carry-over to the LLM SAE literature, but zero contact with the highest-weight preferences (LLMs, Japanese NLP, reasoning, agents); it is an interpretability study, not a pure domain application, so the 0.20 out-of-scope cap does not apply, though topic fit is moderate. Research quality is high: matched placebos, pre-registered intervention norms, bootstrap intervals, sensitivity analyses of miss representation, and a falsified pre-registration. Evidence is quantitatively strong within one model family and one survey; generalizability is explicitly limited. Reproducibility is exemplary (claims-to-code mapping, JSON-regenerated figures, pinned revisions).

primary_link.title: A survey detection channel overrides the pixels in an astronomical foundation model, and biases tomographic mean redshifts

radar.summary:
Foundation models for astronomy are trained on survey pixels together with the catalogue products derived from those pixels. Those catalogues are incomplete at a measurable rate, and a model trained on both inherits that incompleteness as a systematic. We audit AION-1, a 39-modality transformer trained on more than 200 million objects, using causal interventions on its inputs.
  Holding the image tokens byte-identical and editing only the survey segmentation map changes every quantity the model
radar.summary_zh: 本文稽核開源天文多模態基礎模型 AION-1（跨五個巡天、逾 2 億天體、39 種模態），以因果干預檢驗其是否真正使用原始像素。核心發現：模型優先依賴由星表衍生的中繼資料而非像素，且兩者矛盾時並不折扣。在像素完全不變下，僅更動偵測分割圖就使通量、大小、橢率與紅移的輸出變動達匹配安慰劑的 110 至 4400 倍；將遮罩平移 25 像素使 g 波段通量估值下降 79%。機制是「偵測閘門」而非孔徑測光：反應取決於遮罩是否在視場中心斷言有源，而非其包住的光量；在 322 個嚴重混疊系統上，模型完全忽略管線的解混疊決策。竄改星表測光值使讀值偏移 0.61 星等，比完全不提供中繼資料還差九倍，且此弱點隨模型規模擴大而加劇。後果量化：Legacy Survey 管線有 3.68% 目標缺少涵蓋其位置的分割，將此實測失誤率傳遞到測光紅移，會使分層平均紅移偏移中位數達 LSST DESC 規範的 0.71 倍、40 次實現中 12 次超出規範；加入位置誤差則最差分層達 8.3 倍。完全不供應偵測通道即可在無可測代價下消除此系統性。限制包括僅針對單一模型家族與 DESI BGS 亮星系樣本，規模證據僅兩個檢查點。另發現 tokenizer 的限制：影像 codec 在源星補丁僅約 28 個有效碼且呈一維亮度階梯，紅移受限於量化，擴大規模也不改善；稀疏字典作為因果把手不可靠，15 個字典中 13 個輸給簡單的差值均值方向。此研究對「同時以原始觀測與衍生星表產品訓練」的設計模式提出重要警示。

links.title: "I want to be pushed, I want to grow": Enabling social workers to design evaluations of LLM augmentation in their work

evidence: Abstract: workers collaboratively design an LLM-as-a-judge rubric; validation reports strong worker-judge agreement and differentiation across six state-of-the-art LLMs

Section 4.4: 'we found a 96% correlation between worker and judge ratings across the set of 12 held-out test cases'; Table 3 reports per-criterion Pearson correlations, with criterion 7 low (AI-Avg Worker 0.470, Worker1-Worker2 0.569) and authors noting possible overfitting to refinement test cases
Section 4.4 Table 4: benchmark differentiates six models under custom vs. minimal system instructions (e.g., gemini-3.1-pro-preview 4.777 vs. 2.736; gpt-4o 2.996 vs. 2.581)

Section 3.5 (Limitations): validation does not test whether high-scoring systems actually improve worker outcomes, test-case count is small, and pre-post survey findings admit no causal claims; single small organization limits generalizability
Appendix A.6 Table 6: participation declines across workshops (Workshop 1: 8 participants to Workshop 8: 1 participant), indicating attrition not discussed as a limitation

Appendix C.2/C.3: complete initial (5-criterion) and final (10-criterion) rubrics provided; Appendix C.1 links full test cases via a shared Google Doc; Appendix A.4 provides the custom system instruction, though company-tailored instructions are withheld for confidentiality
llm_evaluation.rationale: An HCI/participatory-design case study whose subject matter is squarely LLM evaluation: workers co-design an LLM-as-a-judge benchmark measuring a novel construct ('people challenging' vs. 'people pleasing'), validated against worker judgments and used to differentiate six LLMs. This aligns with LLM, evaluation/benchmark, and alignment preferences, keeping it in scope (not a pure domain application), though the contribution is process-oriented rather than a technical language-methods advance. Novelty is solid: end-to-end worker-driven measurement design and a positive-vision construct absent from existing sycophancy benchmarks. Rigor and evidence are moderate: structured 8-workshop protocol, two-coder qualitative analysis, held-out test cases, and quantitative validation tables, but tiny samples (12 validation workers, 12 held-out cases, pre-post survey n=10), no uncertainty estimates, judge circularity risk (GPT-5 used for both refinement and scoring), and acknowledged overfitting on criterion 7 (correlation 0.470). Generalizability is limited to one ~30-person organization and one use case, as the authors admit. Reproducibility is fair: full 10-criterion rubric, test cases via shared link, and system prompts provided, though company-tailored instructions are withheld and no code is released.

primary_link.title: "I want to be pushed, I want to grow": Enabling social workers to design evaluations of LLM augmentation in their work

radar.summary: Workers are increasingly asked to adopt AI systems to assist their work, yet are rarely given a voice in defining what meaningful AI augmentation should look like or how to evaluate for it. In this paper, we propose worker-driven AI measurement---a bottom-up approach to AI evaluation where workers collaboratively shape decisions about which tasks AI should augment, what "successful" augmentation looks like, and how it should be measured. We explore how to support this through a case study with 1
radar.summary_zh: 第一線工作者日益被要求採用AI輔助工作,卻很少能參與定義何謂有意義的AI增強以及如何評估。本文提出「工作者驅動的AI測量」,主張由工作者由下而上共同決定AI應增強哪些任務、成功的增強是什麼樣貌,以及如何測量。研究與美國賓州一所學校社工組織合作,透過八週共八場工作坊與19名工作者,分三階段進行:辨識真實LLM使用情境、建立對「好表現」的共識,並將其操作化為基準測試。工作者設計了16個貼近日常觀察的測試案例,並提出現有業界評測欠缺的測量目標——衡量LLM能否扮演「挑戰者」而非「討好者」,引導工作者反思自身假設與偏見、拓展視野。他們反覆迭代LLM-as-a-judge評分準則,由5條擴充至10條,融入專業與在地知識及邊界案例。驗證顯示工作者與LLM評審評分高度一致(相關係數96%),且該基準能有效區分六個最先進LLM的表現;使用客製系統指令可提升多數準則得分,但仍有改善空間。限制包括組織規模小、測試案例數量有限,且未驗證高分系統是否真改善實際工作成效。此研究顯示讓工作者主導評估設計,可補充現行由上而下的AI評測,挖掘產業評測忽略的測量目標,並提升工作者對AI能力與限制的認識。
