links.title: SchemaGUI: A Schema-Driven Benchmark for Controllable GUI Generation Evaluation

evidence: Abstract: 'scaling Qwen3.5 from 4B to 27B improves Schema Feasibility from 91.56% to 99.63%, the Geometry score improves more modestly (from 67.05% to 75.30%)'

Section 5.4/Figure 4: 'Enabling thinking mode for Qwen3.5-27B reduces the Overall GUI Score by 9.72 percentage points in EN and 12.36 percentage points in ZH'; only positive change is 2.12 points on EN Info Card
Table 1 (Sec. 5.1): Qwen3.5-27B best Overall 84.61% EN / 81.78% ZH; five models, six scenarios, 1,000 instances per scenario-language
Appendix A.6: human evaluation of 1,200 GUIs by three evaluators, 'Kendall's τ=0.80 and Spearman's ρ=0.90' between automatic GUI Score and human score
Appendix A.3/Table 5: severe-overlap threshold varied 0.1-0.9, overall Geometry variation only 0.00080 (max 0.00191 Doc Editor)
Limitations: benchmark is 'static structural synthesis', 'text-to-schema setting', may 'not fully capture the visual diversity... of real-world interfaces'
Abstract/Conclusion: 'Our code is available at github.com/xdong2002/SchemaGUI'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark paper evaluating five LLMs on schema-constrained GUI generation via function calls, squarely within LLM-evaluation/agents/code-generation scope (strong hits on LLM, function calling, structured output, benchmark, synthetic data; no Japanese, safety, RAG, or multimodal methodology). Novelty is moderate: schema-driven deterministic annotation is a genuine, useful contrast to noisy crawled or LLM-synthesized GUI benchmarks, but conceptually incremental over prior controlled-evaluation ideas the authors themselves cite (e.g., StrucText-eval). Rigor is decent for a benchmark paper: formal metric definitions (Sec. 3.2, App. A.2-A.3), threshold sensitivity analysis (Table 5, range ≤0.00191), error taxonomy (App. A.4), bilingual analysis (App. A.7), and a 1,200-GUI blind human validation (App. A.6, Kendall τ=0.80, Spearman ρ=0.90). Weaknesses: only two model families (four Qwen variants + DeepSeek-R1) limit scaling and thinking-mode conclusions; equal metric weights are unjustified; rank correlation is computed over only five model-level points, which is weak statistical evidence; the anomalous DeepSeek-R1 Doc Editor EN score (39.41 vs 75.00 ZH, Table 1) is not investigated. Generalizability is constrained by the template-based, static text-to-schema setting, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is aided by deterministic seeded generation, detailed metric math, and a stated code release (github.com/xdong2002/SchemaGUI), though the release is unverified and one evaluated model is cited only via a link. Overall a competent, relevant mid-tier benchmark contribution.

primary_link.title: SchemaGUI: A Schema-Driven Benchmark for Controllable GUI Generation Evaluation

radar.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential in graphical user interface (GUI) generation, but reliable evaluation remains challenging due to uncontrolled data distributions, noisy annotations, and limited layout scenario coverage. To address this, we propose SchemaGUI, a template-based benchmark for controllable GUI generation evaluation. By synthesizing paired natural language instructions and deterministic function-call references from parameterized interface schemas, Schem
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在圖形使用者介面(GUI)生成上展現潛力,但現有評測面臨資料分布不受控、標註雜訊與版面情境涵蓋不足等問題。本文提出SchemaGUI,一個以模板為基礎的可控評測基準:從參數化介面Schema合成自然語言指令與確定性函式呼叫參考答案,可在數秒內產生免人工標註的大量樣本。基準涵蓋計算機、登入表單、音樂播放器、文件編輯器、影像編輯器與資訊卡六種雙語(中英)情境,每情境每語言評測1,000個實例,以幾何、元件F1、文字比對、空間順序與版面和諧度五項指標計算GUI Score。作者評測Qwen3.5-4B/9B/27B、Qwen3-Coder-30B與DeepSeek-R1五個主流模型,獲得三項洞察:其一,精確幾何空間控制仍是瓶頸,模型由4B擴至27B時Schema可行性從91.56%升至99.63%,Geometry分數卻僅從67.05%升至75.30%;其二,生成難度對版面複雜度極為敏感,密集網格(如計算機)與多區域組合明顯退化;其三,開啟thinking模式普遍增加token消耗卻降低GUI Score,對較小模型傷害更大,而大型模型反而能以簡潔輸出達到最佳表現。限制在於僅涵蓋靜態結構合成、模板化設計難以反映真實介面的視覺多樣性,且未評估美學等主觀因素。此基準以確定性標註提供乾淨、可控且可擴充的評測,有助釐清模型在結構與幾何能力上的真實短板。

links.title: SANE: State Anomaly Neutralization for Stable Extreme-Context Delta-Rule Models

evidence: Abstract: after a 100M-token prefix (over 24,000x training length) SANE retains 33.46-35.56 average accuracy while the baseline encounters numerical overflow.
Section 4.2 / Table 1: for alpha>=3 short-context averages 43.30-44.23 vs baseline 43.88 with all p>=0.154; alpha<=2 significantly degrades (p=0.006, p<0.001).

Section 4.1: mixed_chat (~100M tokens) is built by concatenating DeepMath-103K and Chinese-DeepSeek-R1-Distill-data-110k, the same distribution families as the training data and the math evaluation domains.
Section 3.3: SANE adds ~0.39M parameters (<0.1% of RWKV-7-0.4B) and preserves intra-chunk associative-scan parallelism; end-to-end throughput/latency left to future work.
Section 4.3: baseline on mixed_chat hits NaN around 20M tokens with state norm exceeding 10^19 (Figure 1).
Limitations: validation confined to RWKV-7 0.4B via post-hoc SFT; extension to other delta-rule models and 7B/14B scales is future work.

Appendix A: kernel implementation released at github.com/pass-lin/rwkv_ops; full training hyperparameters (Muon optimizer, LR schedule, batch size 48, chunk size 16) and maj@8/math_verify evaluation protocol specified.
Section 4: no alternative stabilization baseline (e.g., fixed clipping or state normalization) is compared; only SANE variants and the collapsing baseline are evaluated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope language-model architecture paper on RWKV-7 state stabilization for extreme-context extrapolation, touching Transformer Architecture alternatives (RWKV/linear attention/delta-rule), long context, and math-reasoning evaluation, but it does not engage the highest-weight preference areas (LLM-scale systems, agents, RAG, Japanese NLP). Novelty is moderate: tanh soft-capping exists elsewhere (e.g., logit/attention capping), but input-dependent per-head state compression at chunk boundaries plus the diagnosis of 'localized norm explosion atop a relatively sparse substrate' is a fresh, targeted contribution, and the capacity-stability dissociation (numerically stable but functionally dead at alpha>=8) is an interesting finding. Rigor is solid but limited: controlled 11-configuration comparison with identical data/hyperparameters and paired t-tests (Section 4.2, Table 1), yet only one 0.4B model on one architecture, post-hoc SFT rather than pretraining integration, and no comparison against simpler stabilization baselines (e.g., hard clipping or state renormalization). Evidence is weakened by a confound: the 100M-token prefix (mixed_chat) is constructed from DeepMath-103K and Chinese math data (Section 4.1), i.e., in-distribution with the math benchmarks used to test post-prefix reasoning. Generalizability is explicitly unverified beyond RWKV-7 0.4B (Limitations). Reproducibility is partial: released kernels (Appendix A) and detailed training hyperparameters, but no full training/eval pipeline. Overall a competent, honest niche contribution with limited breadth.

primary_link.title: SANE: State Anomaly Neutralization for Stable Extreme-Context Delta-Rule Models

radar.summary: Delta-Rule recurrent models maintain a fixed-size state, enabling $O(1)$ inference memory but potentially becoming unstable under extreme-context extrapolation. By tracking RWKV-7 over sequences of up to 100M tokens, we empirically identify a distinct failure pattern: \textbf{localized norm explosion atop a relatively sparse substrate}, rather than global state saturation. Analysis of the recurrent update suggests that persistent decay keeps weakly updated entries small, whereas uneven injection
radar.summary_zh: Delta-Rule遞迴模型(如RWKV-7)以固定大小的狀態矩陣取代KV cache,推論記憶體為O(1),但在遠超訓練長度的極端情境下可能不穩定。本文追蹤RWKV-7處理長達1億token的序列,發現其失效模式為「相對稀疏基底上的局部範數爆炸」,而非全域狀態飽和:多數狀態元素維持低量級,少數通道累積極端值,至約2,000萬token處發生數值溢位。據此作者提出State Anomaly Neutralization(SANE),在chunk邊界對狀態施加自適應tanh壓縮S̃=τ·tanh(S/τ),門檻τ由當前隱藏表示動態產生;此舉保留chunk內平行結構,僅新增不到0.1%參數。實驗對預訓練RWKV-7-0.4B進行監督式fine-tuning,結果顯示在安全門檻區間3≤α≤5時,11個數學推理基準與基線無統計顯著差異(43.30–44.23對43.88);先餵入1億token前綴(超過訓練長度約24,000倍)後,基線發生數值溢位,SANE仍保有功能性推理(33.46–35.56)。值得注意的是α≥8時模型數值穩定但推理能力近乎歸零,顯示數值穩定不等於功能健康,存在容量與穩定性的取捨,其中α=3為Pareto最佳。限制包括僅驗證0.4B規模、事後fine-tuning導入帶來適應成本,以及在預訓練階段整合的假設尚待驗證。此方法為線性遞迴架構的極端長情境穩定化提供了輕量且具機制解釋的路徑。

links.title: Query-Driven Multimodal Information Extraction from Long Documents

evidence: Abstract and Sec. 1: task requires outputting query-specific textual attribute values plus image bounding boxes, unlike DocVQA which returns textual answers or evidence regions.

Sec. 3.3 / Table 1: ITJoint statistics - 2,455 pages, avg 59.88 pages, 1.77 non-decorative images/page, 316 queries, 910 answer instances; Sec. 3.3 text states 166 1-to-N instances covering 450 images.

Sec. 4: Q2IT three-agent design - Evidence Agent (decomposition, hybrid retrieval, GMM clustering), Page Agent (clue-driven localization with fallbacks), Figure Agent (Grounding DINO detect-then-select, in-page candidate selection).

Sec. 5.1 Metrics: IoU threshold 0.75, Strict vs Soft joint settings, LLM-as-a-Judge binary text correctness, 1-to-0 matching requires empty predicted image set to count as joint-correct; baselines GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview, GLM-4.5V, Qwen3-VL-235B at temperature 0.0.
Table 2: standalone GPT-5.4 scores 0.113 on 1-to-1 and 0.024 on 1-to-N; within Q2IT GPT rises to 0.534 and 0.452; Gemini best standalone (0.482 on 1-to-1) and best within Q2IT (0.563 on 1-to-1).

Table 4: 1-to-0 hallucination gap shrinks under Q2IT (GPT 0.226 to 0.085; GLM 0.324 to 0.113) but is not eliminated (Sec. 5.3).

Appendix A.7 / Table 6: ablations with GPT-5.4 backbone - removing Page Checker drops 1-to-0 from 0.802 to 0.531; removing page search drops Page F1 0.799 to 0.740 and cross-page 0.495 to 0.234; removing Grounding DINO drops 1-to-1 from 0.534 to 0.170 and 1-to-N from 0.452 to 0.078.

Appendix A.6: implementation details (Qwen3-Embedding-8B, FAISS+BM25 top-30 fused, bge-reranker-v2-m3, top-10 chunks, 30-page section window); no code, data, or ITLabel tool release statement appears anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark-plus-agent paper squarely aligned with curator preferences: it defines query-driven image-text joint extraction, builds the ITJoint benchmark (2,455 pages, 316 queries, 910 instances; Sec. 3.3), and proposes Q2IT, a three-agent workflow (Evidence/Page/Figure) using VLM backbones, hybrid retrieval, and Grounding DINO (Sec. 4). It hits Agents & Tool Use, Multimodal AI, RAG/retrieval, long-context document understanding, and LLM-as-judge evaluation, so it is not a pure domain-application or pure-Vision paper despite domain-specific corpora. Novelty is moderate: the task definition, two-level taxonomy, and the text-present/image-absent negative setting are genuinely new, but Q2IT largely assembles known components (planner/integrator/checker agents, FAISS+BM25 retrieval, open-set detector), and no non-trivial agentic or methodological baseline beyond its own workflow is compared. Rigor is decent but imperfect: metrics are carefully specified (IoU 0.75, Strict/Soft Joint, hallucination accounting for 1-to-0 instances, Sec. 5.1) and ablations (Page Checker, page search, Grounding DINO removal; Appendix A.7) support component necessity, yet the dataset is small (~41 documents, 316 queries), no inter-annotator agreement is reported, the LLM-as-judge model is not identified, ablations use only GPT-5.4 as backbone, and no simpler or existing DocVQA-style baselines are adapted. Evidence strength is solid: Tables 2-4 consistently show standalone VLMs failing (e.g., GPT 0.113 on 1-to-1) and Q2IT improving all backbones (e.g., Gemini Joint 0.507 to 0.722, Table 3), with honest acknowledgment that most categories remain below 0.60 (Sec. 5.2). Generalizability is limited by acknowledged small scale, nearby-page skew, and boundary ambiguity (Limitations). Reproducibility is hampered by no code/data/ITLabel release statement, though temperature 0.0, DPI, retriever, and reranker details are given (Appendix A.6).

primary_link.title: Query-Driven Multimodal Information Extraction from Long Documents

radar.summary: In domain-specific multimodal long documents, images and text jointly convey complex knowledge that cannot be fully captured by plain text alone. However, existing paradigms like DocVQA primarily focus on generating textual answers or localizing evidence regions, rather than outputting query-specific textual attribute values and corresponding images. To address this gap, we propose query-driven image-text joint extraction from long documents, requiring models to output query-requested textual at
radar.summary_zh: 既有DocVQA類任務多半只回傳文字答案或定位證據區域,無法輸出使用者查詢所需的文字屬性值與對應圖片。本文定義新任務「查詢驅動的圖文聯合擷取」:給定查詢與長文件,模型須回傳查詢要求的文字屬性值及對應圖片的邊界框。作者從使用者意圖與文件內容兩方面分析挑戰,設計查詢層與實例層的兩級分類法,並建構首個高品質人工標註基準ITJoint,涵蓋醫療、農業、考古、生物與藝術等領域共2,455頁文件、316個查詢與910個答案實例。方法上,作者評測四個代表性視覺語言模型(VLM),並提出Q2IT多代理協作框架,由Evidence Agent、Page Agent與Figure Agent依序完成證據蒐集、頁面定位與目標圖片定位。聯合評估顯示獨立VLM難以勝任,Gemini最佳(單實例正查詢0.447);Q2IT大幅提升表現,Gemini升至0.692,GPT-5.4更由0.099躍升至0.608。分析指出頁面定位遠易於圖片定位,文字正確與圖片正確未必構成聯合正確,且1-to-0案例揭露模型會幻覺配對不存在的圖片;消融實驗證明Page Checker與Grounding DINO至關重要。限制包括人工標註成本使資料規模有限、相鄰頁案例占比偏高,且框架依賴各階段中間結果品質。此工作為多模態長文件擷取確立新任務與評測標準,凸顯現有VLM與代理系統仍有大量改進空間。
radar.title: Query-Driven Multimodal Information Extraction from Long Documents
radar.title_zh: 長文件中查詢驅動的多模態資訊擷取

links.title: When Does Visual Generation Help Visual Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models?

evidence: Abstract: introduces 'VGAU-Diag', a fine-grained evaluation framework using 'Oracle-Assisted Reference Protocols'; code stated available at https://github.com/zyb1029/VGAU-Diag

Section 3.1: six task families (Maze, Sokoban, Path, Onet, Parking, Klotski), 100 instances each with easy/medium/hard splits; Section 3.3 adopts solver-based task-level evaluation reporting optimal/feasible accuracy

Section 4.2 Insight 2: 'among 48 task-level comparisons from 8 open-source UMMs across 6 tasks, only 12 cases fall below their Oracle-GtA upper reference', supporting the visual-understanding-bottleneck claim
Section 4.4 with Table 4: removing the optimal-step prior drops Show-o2 Self-VCoT Parking accuracy from 56.6% to 0.0% and LLaDA2.0-Uni from 40.0% to 0.0%, evidencing protocol-induced prior leakage

Table 3 (Section 4.3): controlled grid over Qwen scale (0.8B-27B) and visual-aid fidelity (Gaussian noise, mismatch image, Qwen-Image, Qwen-Image-Edit, Nano Banana 2, oracle) supporting the three-stage transition claim
Appendix A.1.7, Tables 5-6: structural statistics (walkable cells 20.30 to 39.12; branch and corridor nodes increasing) validate that the length-based difficulty split reflects structural complexity
Section 6 Limitations: framework 'limited to static two-dimensional planning environments' and relies on procedurally generated tasks that 'may reduce visual diversity'
Internal inconsistency: Table 1 reports Qwen3.5-9B Direct Sokoban easy optimal accuracy 25.0 while Table 8 reports feasible accuracy 0.0 for the same setting, which violates feasible >= optimal

Appendix A.4: greedy decoding temperature 0, max_new_tokens 8192, three independent runs averaged for UMMs, implementation based on lmms-eval; prompts for all protocols provided in Appendix Tables 12-35
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal reasoning-evaluation paper, not pure CV: it benchmarks unified multimodal models and frontier VLM/LLM systems (GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.1-Pro, Qwen3.6-Plus) under chain-of-thought-style reasoning protocols, matching Reasoning/CoT, Multimodal AI, and Evaluation preferences, though it is not LLM-core and has no Japanese NLP content. Novelty is moderate: the oracle-assisted decoupling of generation from understanding and the discovery of optimal-step prior leakage in Self-VCoT evaluations are genuinely new diagnostics within a crowded benchmark space (MME-Unify, RealUnify, Uni-MMMU, UniG2U-Bench). Rigor is fairly strong: solver-based verification, difficulty stratification validated by structural statistics, controlled model-scale/fidelity grid, three-run averaging, and a single-image-input confound check; weakened by small per-task samples (100), no significance testing, and self-generation protocols evaluated only on easy cases. Evidence for the four insights is largely supported by the tables, but internal inconsistencies (e.g., Table 1 Qwen3.5-9B Direct Sokoban optimal 25.0 vs Table 8 feasible 0.0) and very low absolute accuracies reduce confidence. Generalizability is limited by acknowledged restriction to static 2D procedural planning puzzles. Reproducibility is decent: released code, exhaustive prompt appendix, decoding details; closed-source models and manual interleaved calls limit full replication.

primary_link.title: When Does Visual Generation Help Visual Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models?

radar.summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) can perform both understanding and generation, raising a central question: can visual generation improve understanding? Existing evaluations provide mixed evidence, but confound task difficulty, reasoning paradigms, and the closed-loop interaction between generation and understanding. We introduce VGAU-Diag, a fine-grained evaluation framework for vision generation-assisted understanding. It stratifies samples by difficulty, enables unified evaluation of multiple
radar.summary_zh: 統一多模態模型（UMM）能否透過視覺生成來提升視覺理解，是備受關注的問題，但現有評估常混淆任務難度、推理範式與生成—理解之間的封閉迴路互動。本文提出細粒度評估框架 VGAU-Diag：以六種可驗證的視覺規劃任務（迷宮、推箱子、路徑、連連看、停車與華容道）為測試平台，依最優解長度將樣本分為容易、中等與困難三級，統一比較 VCoT、GtA 與 VR 三種生成輔助推理範式，並引入 Oracle 輔助參照協定，將生成品質與理解能力解耦，另採求解器驗證。實驗顯示：生成視覺輔助在簡單樣本上有明顯增益，但隨難度上升迅速變得不穩定；即使提供忠實的 Oracle 視覺輔助，多數開源 UMM 仍近乎零分，顯示主要瓶頸在視覺理解端而非視覺生成端；生成輔助呈三階段轉移——與任務無關的雜訊造成干擾、看似合理但錯誤的影像造成誤導，唯有高保真且對齊任務的影像才真正提供助益。研究亦發現先前 Self-VCoT 評估存在最優步數先驗洩漏，修正後針對性的 GtA 輔助生成更為可靠。限制在於僅涵蓋靜態二維規劃環境且視覺多樣性有限。這些發現對 UMM 的能力診斷與後續發展具重要指引意義。
radar.title: When Does Visual Generation Help Visual Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models?

links.title: Probing How Users Interact with Turn-Level Design Frictions for AI Chatbots

evidence: Abstract: within-subject study with 24 participants; all six friction probes increased workload, task duration, and perceived ownership relative to a conventional AI chatbot, with more selective effects on recall and recognition.
Section 3.4 Implementation: 'We use GPT-4o via the OpenAI API with in-context learning'; React (Vite) frontend and Node.js backend with interaction logging.
Section 4.3: eight conditions (six frictions, ChatGPT baseline, Write by Yourself) counterbalanced via balanced Latin square; NASA-TLX subscales and a 5-point ownership item collected per sub-task.
Section 4.4 Data Analysis: Friedman test, pairwise Wilcoxon signed-rank with 10,000 replications and Holm correction; recall scored 0/0.5/1 by two researchers with consensus after de-identification.
Appendix E Table E.4: Elenchus Physical Demand row reports ΔM=0.00 with 95% CI [7.25, 11.125] and p=.011, an internally inconsistent entry.
Section 5.4 and Appendix E Table E.7: largest friction recall gain for Elenchus (ΔM=0.40, p=.002); User Echo is the only friction without a significant recall difference (ΔM=0.07, p=.07).
Section 5.6: interaction logs show four adaptation patterns, including bypassing Think Multiplier with repeated characters (P18) and compressing requests under access-restricting probes.
Section 7 Limitations: authors acknowledge short bounded writing tasks, static rather than adaptive friction, and that most frictions can be avoided or worked around.
llm_evaluation.rationale: HCI evaluation of turn-level design frictions for LLM chatbots (GPT-4o with in-context learning), addressing LLM interaction and overreliance/responsible-AI themes, but it contributes interface design and user-study findings rather than language-model methodology. The study is methodologically careful: within-subject, 24 participants, Latin-square counterbalancing, NASA-TLX plus recall/recognition, Friedman/Wilcoxon with Holm correction, and consensus recall scoring. Evidence is credible but bounded (single short English writing task, self-report-heavy outcomes), and Appendix E Table E.4 contains an internally inconsistent row (Elenchus physical demand ΔM=0.00 with CI [7.25, 11.125]) that weakens confidence in reporting quality. Novelty is moderate: the three-mechanism framing and six-probe comparison is a genuine consolidation, but individual probes (word minimum, hold-to-reveal, timer, one-sentence limit, Socratic replies, draft-first) closely mirror cited prior work. No code or data release; probes and prompts are documented well enough for partial reproduction.

primary_link.title: Probing How Users Interact with Turn-Level Design Frictions for AI Chatbots

radar.summary: AI chatbots can help people write faster, but they can also encourage overreliance by making it easy to turn minimal input into usable text. We study turn-level design friction: intentional constraints added to each chatbot exchange that slow, limit, or redirect how users request, access, or use model responses. We designed six friction probes, organized around three mechanisms: eliciting user contribution, restricting access to generated content, and reshaping system output. In a within-subject
radar.summary_zh: AI 聊天機器人讓使用者能以極少輸入換取流暢回應，卻也可能助長過度依賴。本文提出「回合層級設計摩擦」概念：在每次對話交換中刻意加入約束，減慢、限制或改變使用者取得與使用模型回應的方式。作者從 24 篇 HCI 文獻的 73 個設計中歸納三種機制——引導使用者貢獻、限制存取與重塑系統輸出，據此設計 Think Multiplier、User Echo、Hold Reveal、Timer Lockout、Less is More 與 Elenchus 六個介面原型。在一項 24 人受試者內實驗中，參與者完成短篇寫作任務，搭配 NASA-TLX 工作負荷、擁有感評分、回憶與再認測試及半結構式訪談。結果顯示：六種摩擦相對 ChatGPT 基準皆顯著增加工作負荷、任務時長與心理擁有感，但對記憶的影響具選擇性——除 User Echo 外多數提升回憶，僅 Elenchus 與 Less is More 顯著改善再認。參與者也發展出拆解任務、提前提出自身想法、壓縮模型輸出乃至繞過摩擦等適應策略。作者強調沒有普適有效的摩擦：同一約束可能支持或阻礙投入，取決於使用者的目標與時機。局限包括寫作任務短小、摩擦為固定設計且可被規避，未來宜探討更長情境下的可調式摩擦。
radar.title: Probing How Users Interact with Turn-Level Design Frictions for AI Chatbots
radar.title_zh: 探究使用者如何與 AI 聊天機器人的回合層級設計摩擦互動

links.title: LLM Evaluation on Unseen Questions: Contextual Multidimensional IRT Model

evidence: Abstract: claims 'incorporating question embeddings improves prediction relative to model-free baselines' and admits 'generalizability does not necessarily translate into reliable prediction under cross-scenario shift'.

Section 3: benchmark setup 'adopt[ed] ... in [24]', 22 HELM datasets filtered to '11 scenarios', question counts '436 to 29407', embeddings from 'BERT-based language models (26; 21)' (Sentence-BERT, MiniLM), 5-fold cross-validation, question-wise and LLM-wise AUC summarized by 90th percentile.

Section 3.2: three baselines — contextual Rasch model of ref 24, lasso-penalized logistic regression on raw embeddings, and mean baseline; significance via 'paired t-tests' across 5 folds (only 5 paired differences, a weak test).

Section 3.1: diagonal (within-scenario) AUC 'consistently high'; LLM-wise off-diagonal entries 'much closer to 0.5', showing cross-scenario transfer failure; all values only in figures, no numbers in text.

Section 1.1: 'the work most closely related to ours is [24]', differing 'in two key respects' — multivariate latent dimensions and cross-scenario generalization focus, indicating incremental novelty over existing embedding-IRT evaluation.

Appendix A: two-stage estimation — low-rank logistic factorization with centering constraint and balanced-factor regularizer solved by projected gradient descent, then supervised MLP regression for the feature map; but latent dimension r, optimizer hyperparameters, and MLP architecture are unspecified, and no code release is mentioned anywhere.
Section 3: the number of evaluated LLMs ('n LLMs') is never stated in the paper, a material reproducibility gap.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM evaluation methodology paper (LLM + benchmark/evaluation preferences), not a pure domain application. Contribution is an incremental extension of contextual Rasch-style amortized evaluation (Truong et al., 2025, cited as closest work) to a multidimensional bilinear IRT with embedding-based feature maps; the setting and baselines are heavily borrowed from that prior work. Method is clearly specified with an identifiability-aware two-stage estimator (Appendix A), 5-fold cross-validation over 11 HELM scenarios, and paired t-tests against Rasch, lasso, and mean baselines. However, key experimental details are missing (number of LLMs n never stated, latent dimension r and MLP hyperparameters unspecified, no code/data availability claim), and all quantitative results live in unreproducible-from-text heatmap figures. Evidence supports the stated claims, and the honest finding that cross-scenario transfer fails for LLM-wise AUC is valuable, but the negative result also limits the method's practical generalizability. No unsupported claims detected; score reflects solid but modest, incrementally novel work with incomplete reporting.

primary_link.title: LLM Evaluation on Unseen Questions: Contextual Multidimensional IRT Model

radar.summary: Evaluation of large language models (LLMs) increasingly requires predicting how a model will perform on new questions or tasks before collecting large amounts of new annotations. This problem is challenging because question difficulty, scenario, and underlying capability demands can vary substantially. Simple retrospective averages may confound model ability with item characteristics. In this paper, we study a model-based evaluation framework that combines multidimensional item response theory m
radar.summary_zh: 評估大型語言模型（LLM）越來越需要在收集大量新標註前，預測模型在未見問題上的表現，但題目的難度、情境與所需能力差異懸殊，簡單的平均正確率會將模型能力與題目特性混淆。本文提出情境化多維度試題反應理論模型（C-MIRT），以雙線性形式 θ=α+uᵀφ(e) 同時捕捉模型的情境特定基準成功率與多維潛在能力向量，並利用 BERT 類語言模型產生的題目嵌入，經由多層感知器特徵映射推估題目潛在特性，因此可對訓練集外的題目直接預測作答機率。實驗採用 HELM 五個資料庫篩選後的 11 個情境、五折交叉驗證，以題目向與模型向 AUC 的第 90 百分位數評估，並與 Rasch 式情境模型、lasso 邏輯迴歸及平均基準比較。主要發現有三：融入題目嵌入的 C-MIRT 在情境內預測優於無模型基線；多維潛在結構比單維視角更能描述能力差異；跨情境轉移則變異甚大，尤其模型向 AUC 在跨情境時接近 0.5，顯示跨領域泛化仍是開放挑戰。作者提醒預測結果不應視為可靠性的直接證據，嵌入模型亦可能繼承基準資料偏誤。此框架為低成本、可解釋的 LLM 評估提供了具前景的方向。
radar.title: LLM Evaluation on Unseen Questions: Contextual Multidimensional IRT Model
radar.title_zh: LLM 於未見問題上的評估：情境化多維度 IRT 模型

links.title: Beyond What Meets the Eye: Unveiling Situational Illusions for Multimodal Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'Evaluations of 27 model configurations reveal that current MLLMs are highly vulnerable to these illusions and exhibit 6 typical failure modes'; mitigation via 'prompting for closed-source models and supervised fine-tuning for open-source models' improving 'performances by 20% at most'.

Section 3.1/3.5: images scraped from Reddit, Zhihu, BrightSide, Barnorama plus IllusionBench+ extracts; final benchmark of 904 images and 3,723 image-text pairs (1,808 T/F, 1,808 open-ended, 107 action-planning).
Section 3.3/4.2: T/F scored by label matching; open-ended and action-planning judged by Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview (Think) as LLM-as-a-Judge, with pilot study claiming >93% judge accuracy.

Section 4.3/Table 1: closed-source averages 62.63 (T/F), 61.59 (open-ended), 44.67 (action); open-source 54.45/48.37/29.14, supporting the 'below 63%' and 'below 45% for action planning' claims as cross-model per-task averages.
Section 4.5: failure-mode shares quantified only for Grok-4.1-Fast (Think): observation 45.79%, grounding 33.68%, reasoning 20.53% of wrong results.

Section 5.2: SFT uses 1,630 task pairs from 600 MSIBench images plus 400 COCO 2017 images; evaluation on the remaining 304 MSIBench images, i.e., mitigation is validated only on a held-out split of the same benchmark.
Front matter: code at github.com/yangzm1105/MSIBench and dataset at huggingface.co/datasets/yangzm05/msibench; Section 4.1: temperature 0.0 with greedy decoding for reproducibility.
Section 3.4: two-round annotation/review human quality check over Gemini-generated metadata, questions, and action-planning instructions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal LLM robustness benchmark (MSIBench) for 'situational illusions' with a where-what-how taxonomy, 27 model configurations, failure-mode analysis, and prompting/SFT mitigations. In scope (multimodal AI + evaluation/benchmark + partial AI-safety and reasoning relevance), but the core language methodology is thin: mitigation is generic staged prompting and standard SFT rather than a novel language-model technique, and no top-weighted preference (e.g., core LLM methodology, agents, code) is central. Novelty is moderate: the naturally-occurring (vs. constructed) illusion framing is a genuine distinction, but adjacent benchmarks (HallusionBench, IllusionVQA, IllusionBench+, MVI-Bench) already cover much of the space, and the mitigations are standard. Rigor is decent: two-round human QC (Sec 3.4), temperature-0.0 greedy decoding, judge pilot with >93% agreement (Sec 4.2), taxonomy-stratified analysis; weakened by no significance testing, a 107-task action-planning split, web-scraped images with unaddressed contamination risk, and a judge model (Gemini-3.1) related to an evaluated model family. Evidence strength is solid: headline claims (cross-model averages 62.63 T/F, 44.67 action for closed-source) match Table 1, and mitigation gains (+20.4 avg on Qwen3.5-9B) match Table 3, though failure-mode percentages are quantified for only one model. Generalizability is limited by SFT being validated only on a held-out MSIBench split, not external data. Reproducibility benefits from released code/data and fixed decoding, but depends on a proprietary metadata-generation model version.

primary_link.title: Beyond What Meets the Eye: Unveiling Situational Illusions for Multimodal Large Language Models

radar.summary: Real-world situation appearances can deviate from their underlying physical states, challenging the reliability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in practical applications. In this paper, we term this phenomenon situational illusions and investigate: (1) how MLLMs perform under such illusions, and (2) how to mitigate the limitations. We first develop a comprehensive where-what-how taxonomy that characterizes where situational illusions occur, what targets they take, and how they arise.
radar.summary_zh: 真實世界場景的外觀可能偏離其底層物理狀態，例如裝滿牛奶的馬克杯看似倒置，導致模型誤判而規劃出危險動作。本文將此現象命名為「情境錯覺」，並系統性研究多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）在此條件下的表現與改善方法。作者建立「何處—什麼—如何」分類法：四種場景（小型室內、大型室內、都市戶外與自然戶外）、十二種被誤解的目標（屬性、關係與情境脈絡）以及五種形成機制（邊界模糊、角度擾動、透視錯位、維度混淆與經驗驅動偏誤）。據此建構 MSIBench，含 904 張真實錯覺影像與 3,723 個影像—文字對，涵蓋真假判斷、開放式問答與行動規劃三類任務，並附對抗設定進行壓力測試。對 27 個模型配置的評估顯示：整體平均準確率低於 63%，行動規劃更低於 45%；閉源模型普遍優於開源；提高推理努力程度的效益有限且不一致；跨任務表現不易遷移；對抗性錯覺描述普遍降低準確率。作者歸納出觀察、接地與推理三類失敗模式，並提出引導式提示與監督式微調（SFT）兩種緩解策略，分別最高可提升約 20%，其中 SFT 平均提升逾 10 點。侷限在於資料以程序化生成與人工篩選為主，未來可延伸至具身代理人等動態場景。

links.title: HANSARD: A Reference Architecture for Forensic Readiness, Runtime Witnessing, and Graded Attribution in Autonomous Multi-Agent AI Systems

evidence: Abstract: 'HANSARD is proposed, a reference architecture treating accountability as a life-cycle property' — architecture specification only, no system.
Section I, contribution list (a)-(d): attribution laundering, life-cycle architecture with sealed readiness profile and witness boundary, gap-function synergy residual, evidentiary tiers.
Section III (Table I): adversary classes A1-A3 (prompt injection, anticipating agent, colluding recorder) mapped to requirements R1-R7 and countermeasures.
Section IV-E: synergy residual ρ defined via the gap function; paper states 'The statistic is the standard gap function of a cooperative game; the contribution lies in its forensic interpretation.'

Section VI: 'What is proposed in this study is an architecture, not a system'; open problems listed as replay validity, ρ calibration and shadow dispersion false positives, unwitnessed channels, and cost ('whether sealed capture is affordable at production throughput... is unaddressed').
Section V (Table II): evidentiary tiers E0-E3 gated by readiness levels L0-L2; no post-incident retrofit of tiers possible.
No experiments, quantitative results, case studies, code release, or artifact availability statement appear anywhere in the document.
Acknowledgment: Claude AI assistant supported literature search and Fig. 1 schematic, verified by authors — relevant to provenance of the related-work section.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A position/reference-architecture paper on accountability and forensic attribution for autonomous multi-agent (LLM) systems. Strongly aligned with Agents & Tool Use and AI Safety preferences (multi-agent autonomy, delegation, tool calls, prompt injection, covert channels, agent misbehavior), with LLMs as the substrate rather than a methodological contribution. Conceptual novelty is genuine: 'attribution laundering' as a named failure mode, forensic readiness adapted to agentic systems, evidentiary tiers gated by pre-sealed readiness levels, and a synergy residual for laundering detection. However, the core machinery is borrowed (Halpern-Pearl actual causality, Chockler-Halpern responsibility, cooperative-game gap function, certificate-transparency logs), and the paper concedes the residual is a standard statistic with new interpretation. Rigor is limited by the complete absence of implementation, experiments, case studies, or calibration; the paper itself states (Section VI) 'What is proposed in this study is an architecture, not a system,' with replay validity, residual calibration, false-positive behavior, and production cost all unaddressed. Evidence is citation-based only; no quantitative results exist. Generalizability is plausible (model-agnostic, cross-domain, PROV-DM-aligned) but untested, and determinism capsules depend on self-hosted or seed-exposing models. Reproducibility is minimal: formal definitions and Table I/II specifications could be reimplemented, but no code, artifacts, or availability claims appear anywhere. A well-argued, honest agenda-setting paper whose score is capped by zero empirical validation.

Yet, when such a system causes harm, no method can robustly establish what happened, what caused it, or who is accountable. This is because provenance forensics works at the wrong abstraction, formal causality assumes the causal model, and agent auditing trusts self-recording. The target failure mode is, thus,
radar.summary_zh: 當自主多代理AI系統造成損害時，現有方法難以重建事件經過、界定因果或釐清歸責，且紀錄往往由嫌疑人本身產生。本文指出「歸責漂白」是此類系統的特徵性失效模式：將有害行為分散至多個可互換的代理，使個別反事實效應趨近於零。作者提出HANSARD參考架構，將課責視為生命週期屬性：(1)部署前封存就緒設定檔，界定後續調查可主張的範圍；(2)在模型呼叫、工具呼叫、代理間訊息、記憶體寫入與委派五個咽喉點進行代理無法繞過的帶外見證，搭配通道序號與雜湊鏈證明完整性與完備性；(3)運行時累積對齊PROV-DM的型別化因果圖，並以缺口警報、溯源降級事件與結構分散性三類指標閘控監督；(4)事後以修正版Halpern-Pearl定義進行反事實重放，估算補償集大小；(5)引入源自合作賽局理論的綜效殘差ρ，使漂白現象可見。主張以證據層級E0-E3與就緒層級L0-L2界定各項結論的上限。此為架構提案而非實作系統，重放有效性、ρ的校準、未見證通道與運算成本仍為開放問題。其價值在於為EU AI Act等法規所需的證據能力提供技術藍圖，使課責成為可預先設計的屬性。

Section 6.2.2: multimodal favored poem-feeling fit (4.40 vs 3.80, d=0.79), SUS (74.40 vs 67.90, p=.044), UES-SF (3.96 vs 3.71, p=.033); p-values explicitly nominal/unadjusted

llm_evaluation.rationale: An HCI application paper whose technical core is an LLM-driven multi-agent system (Qwen-3 backbone, six dialogue agents/four modules, Section 5.1) with FAISS-based RAG over a curated 99-poem knowledge base and CoT prompt chains (Section 5.5), giving solid overlap with LLM, agent, RAG, prompting, and multimodal preferences, though it proposes no new language-modeling methodology. Evaluation is unusually rigorous for a systems paper: formative pilot (N=60), expert consultation, controlled between-subjects study (N=50) with validated instruments, Holm-corrected primary family, effect sizes, and dual-coded qualitative analysis (Sections 6.1-6.2). Evidence is honestly scoped: large within-condition affective improvements (adjusted p<.001, Section 6.2.1) but null between-condition primary effects, with multimodal benefits on experiential measures only at nominal unadjusted p-values (Section 6.2.2); no non-poetic control limits causal claims about the workflow. primary_link.title: Poetic Heritage for Culturally Grounded Emotional Support: An Interaction Design Framework and Its Multimodal Agentic Instantiation

radar.summary: Digital systems increasingly mediate emotional support, yet their interactions often remain culturally generic. Accordingly, we examine how a poetic tradition can be operationalized as a culturally grounded interactive medium and how generative AI can support such engagement. The resulting interaction design framework translates staged literature-based support and tradition-specific poetic aesthetics into guidance for digital system design. Poemithy instantiates the framework as a multimodal, LL
radar.summary_zh: 數位情緒支持系統常採用通用對話腳本，忽略使用者的文化脈絡與美學傳統。本文提出三層互動設計框架，將詩歌遺產操作化為文化扎根的情緒反思媒介：第一層借鏡詩歌治療RES模型，抽象出相遇、表達、儀式化三階段；第二層以古典漢詩的「三美論」（繪畫美、建築美、音樂美）界定感官不可知的美學構念；第三層區分支持互動功能與多模態介面可供性。經原型測試與專家諮詢後，作者實作Poemithy——以Qwen-3為骨幹的多模態LLM多代理系統，包含六個對話代理與四個功能模組，並建立經人工審校的103筆古典詩標註知識庫。針對50名大學生的受試者間對照實驗顯示：多模態與純文字兩種條件在正負向情緒、狀態焦慮與情緒調節上均有顯著的單場次改善，但條件間差異未達顯著；多模態呈現顯著提升知覺契合度、任務成功感、投入度與系統可用性，並將程序性互動負載自文字對話轉移至介面元件。研究據此提出「內容優先、模態居次」的設計主張。限制包括僅單次實驗室場次、樣本為中國大學生、文化量表僅事後測量。本研究為文化扎根的數位福祉介入與活態文學遺產參與提供可複用的設計結構。

links.title: DeepSAGE: Stage-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Structured CBT Counseling Dialogue

evidence: Abstract: 'We evaluate DeepSAGE against six retrieval-, prompting-, stage-, and policy-based alternatives' and states findings 'demonstrate comparative dialogue-control improvements rather than clinical effectiveness.'

Experimental Setup (Baselines): 'We train DeepSAGE with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) using gpt-4o-mini as the shared LLM backbone for the counselor and client simulators,' with results 'averaged over 100 simulated sessions'; DeepSAGE_R ablation 'replaces the learned dialogue policy with random selection from all seven therapeutic intentions.'

Numerical Analysis & Results (Session Completion and Statistical Significance): 'the learned DeepSAGE policy improves SSR by approximately 10.9% relative to random intention selection while reducing the number of counselor utterances by approximately 9.3%' for simulated AD clients (analogous 8.6%/7.0% for MDD).

Metrics and Reward (Eqs. 1-4, 7-8, 10): SSR is computed from the same goal-success score G(S_i, r_i) (MiniLM semantic similarity + NLI entailment probability) that appears in the reward's relevance term P_NLI(entailment|u_t->g_Si), aligning the headline stage-completion metric with the training signal.
Metrics: expert validation of EID over 60 excerpt pairs by six mental-health experts reports '61.7% judged EID at least moderately appropriate as a practical counseling progress indicator.'

Conclusions & Future Work (limitations): 'the current action space do not incorporate dedicated escalation or crisis referral'; 'several comparisons did not reach significance after Holm correction, particularly for MDD emotional-intensity drop'; evaluation 'is largely automated and model-based.'

Analysis of Expert Evaluation: six evaluators rated 18 randomly sampled conversations; '66.7% of conversations were rated Agree or Strongly agree for resembling real counseling practice' and half were rated positively for recognizable counseling processes.

Reproducibility: no code or data availability statement appears in the provided text; reproducibility rests on appendices (E, F, G, O) for prompt templates, implementation details, and hyperparameters (tau=0.8, alpha=0.5, lambda=0.001), plus a commercial gpt-4o-mini backbone.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Hybrid LLM-DRL framework for stage-structured CBT counseling dialogue: a PPO policy selects therapeutic intentions that prompt an LLM (gpt-4o-mini) counselor against simulated clients. It contains genuine language/dialogue-control methodology (stage gating via semantic similarity + NLI entailment, reward design, learned policy over a 7-intention action space), so it is not a pure out-of-scope domain paper, but its center of gravity is a mental-health application: no LLM training, no core language-model contribution, and the LLM is used purely via prompting. Evaluation is unusually careful for a simulated study (six baselines including a random-policy ablation DeepSAGE_R, Wilcoxon tests with Holm correction, tau/alpha sensitivity analysis, small expert review), but the entire pipeline is model-based: the counselor, client, and metrics are all LLM/classifier scores, the headline SSR metric reuses the same goal-success score G that the reward directly optimizes, and the EID metric's human validation is weak (61.7% judged appropriate). The authors honestly report non-significant MDD comparisons, the absence of crisis escalation, and that results are comparative proxies, not clinical effectiveness. Novelty is a competent but incremental combination of session-level stage modeling, NLI-based stage detection, and RL dialogue policy over known therapist intentions; narrow scope (first CBT session only, two simulated conditions, one primary backbone) and no code release cap generalizability and reproducibility.

primary_link.title: DeepSAGE: Stage-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Structured CBT Counseling Dialogue

radar.summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based counseling agents can generate fluent and supportive responses, but they often lack the structured, goal-directed progression required to conduct a coherent therapeutic session. We present DeepSAGE (Strategic AI Guidance Engine), a hybrid LLM--Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) framework for stage-aware counseling dialogue grounded in the first session of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). DeepSAGE represents the session as eleven stages with explicit therapeutic
radar.summary_zh: LLM諮商代理能生成流暢的支持性回應，卻常缺乏結構化、目標導向的療程推進能力。本文提出DeepSAGE，一個混合LLM與深度強化學習（DRL）的階段感知諮商對話框架，以認知行為治療（CBT）首次會談為基礎。系統將會談建模為十一個具明確治療目標的階段，外部控制器依語意相似度與NLI蘊含分數判斷階段目標是否達成，DRL策略（以PPO訓練）從七種治療意圖中選擇行動，引導LLM生成回應；獎勵函數兼顧回應相關性、個案自我揭露與階段進度效率。在焦慮症與憂鬱症模擬個案的對照評估中，DeepSAGE相較六種檢索、提示、階段與策略基線，於兩種個案條件皆獲得最長的個案發言長度與最高的自我揭露分數；相較移除學習策略的消融版本DeepSAGE_R，階段成功率AD提升約10.9%、MDD提升約8.6%，且諮商師發言數更少。六位領域專家審閱18段對話，66.7%認為貼近真實諮商。限制顯著：評估仰賴模擬個案與模型化指標，MDD情緒強度下降等多項比較經Holm校正後未達顯著；行動空間缺乏危機升級與轉介機制，不可直接部署。本研究展示階段結構結合學習式策略選擇在AI諮商的潛力，臨床有效性仍需真人驗證。

Research quality is above average: paired bootstrap CIs (Sec 4.7, 5.1), input ablations showing both OCR prior and image are necessary (Table 7), and honest detection/correction of its own evaluation artifacts (SARD truncation rerun, Students Essays repetition loops with no_repeat_ngram_size mitigation). Appendix C (Being-H0 adaptation): wrist-anchored variant 'improves ... Being-H0-14B from 84.90 mm to 81.21 mm', which is lower (better) than EMPIRE's 84.53, qualifying the headline SOTA claim.
Appendix B / Tables 7-8 (Human audit): 100 stratified windows, overall quality 4.62/5, 84.0% usable caption-plan pairs, per-partition scores 4.46-4.76.
Table 3 (Planning benefit by task difficulty): mean Delta from -4.6 mm (easy) to -49.7 mm (hard), 89/111 tasks improved, Pearson r=-0.567.
Appendix C (Training Cost, Table 10): 71 hours total (Stage-I 34h + Stage-II 37h) vs 116 hours single-stage baseline on 8x A40.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Embodied vision-language-action paper: explicit language plans as intermediate representations for egocentric hand-motion forecasting, with a VLM planner (PaliGemma-2) and frozen-planner/flow-matching-DiT actor. It has genuine language methodology (structured plan generation, embodied chain-of-thought-style decomposition, VLM fine-tuning), so it is not 'pure robotics', but it is a specialized motion-forecasting application rather than core LLM research, capping preference relevance. Novelty is moderate: plan-then-act with VLMs is established (SayCan, RT-H, Embodied CoT), though the decoupled frozen-planner training, train-on-predicted-plans scheme, and the EMPIRE-651K plan-annotated dataset are new in this subfield. Rigor is solid: component ablations (Table 4), gradient-isolation ablation (Table 5), capacity ablation (Table 6), predicted-vs-GT plan ablation (Table 12), task-difficulty analysis (r=-0.567), and a stratified 100-sample human audit; weaknesses include best-of-8 test-MPJPE selection and no significance testing. Evidence is mixed: the SOTA headline (84.53 vs 105.37 MPJPE, Table 2) holds against the re-implemented VITRA, but Appendix C transparently shows wrist-anchored Being-H0-14B reaches 81.21 mm, better than EMPIRE's overall MPJPE, so 'comparable accuracy' claims rest on the uncompensated comparison. Generalizability is limited to EgoDex-style tabletop manipulation with unseen-task gains shown only within the dataset. Reproducibility is good: released code/dataset, full hyperparameters (Table 9), and reproduced annotation prompts (Appendix A).

primary_link.title: EMPIRE: Explicit Manipulation Planning as a Learnable Intermediate Representation for Egocentric Hand-Motion Forecasting

radar.summary: Forecasting dexterous hand motions from egocentric observations is fundamental to intelligent interactive systems. Existing VLM-based methods typically map observations directly to future motions, overlooking the underlying manipulation process that governs hand-object interactions. Moreover, end-to-end optimization couples manipulation learning with motion synthesis, causing motion-generation gradients to interfere with the pre-learned manipulation-aware representations. To overcome these limit
radar.summary_zh: 從自我中心視角預測靈巧手部動作對機器人學習與虛擬實境應用至關重要。既有基於VLM的方法直接將觀察映射到未來動作，忽略支配手物互動的操作過程，且端對端訓練使動作生成梯度干擾已學得的操作感知表示。EMPIRE提出兩階段架構：第一階段「學會規劃」，以PaliGemma-2為基礎，結合RGB、單目深度、說明文字與視野資訊，預測逐手的顯式操作規劃；第二階段「學會行動」，凍結規劃器，以流匹配DiT依據規劃隱藏表示與當前手部狀態生成雙手未來動作。作者並建構EMPIRE-651K資料集，由EgoDex轉換出650,910個訓練視窗、涵蓋111種任務，以VLM輔助產生說明與操作規劃，經人工稽核品質達4.62/5。在相同評測協定下，EMPIRE達到MPJPE 84.53mm、手指相對誤差38.97mm，較VITRA降低19.8%誤差並縮短38.8%訓練時間，推論速度比Being-H0-14B快83.5倍。消融實驗顯示顯式規劃對高難度與未見任務幫助最大，而凍結VLM避免動作梯度破壞語意表示。限制包括僅於EgoDex桌面任務驗證、依賴單目深度估計，且消融主要在26任務子集進行。此研究證明將顯式操作規劃作為可學習中間表示並解耦訓練，是實現準確且高效的自我中心手部動作預測的有效典範。

links.title: Q-Learning with Stable Infinite-Dimensional Linear Function Approximation

evidence: Abstract: framework uses reconstruction and compression operators on C(L) for a compact latent metric space; two SA algorithms established with sup-norm convergence bounds with leading term O~(n^{-1/2}), with complexity controlled by covering numbers rather than dimension of C(L).

Section 3, Proposition 3.1: under Assumptions 1 and 3, G = K o T o Phi maps Theta into itself and is a gamma-contraction with unique fixed point theta*, plus representation-error bound ||Q* - q*|| <= ||Q* - Phi K Q*||/(1-gamma) (eq. 3.11).

Section 5, Theorem 1 and Section 7, Theorem 2: high-probability last-iterate bounds with factors t_mix, c_wedge^{-1}(1-gamma)^{-2} and log-covering-number terms; Corollaries 1.1/2.1 specialize to finite (log J) and Euclidean (d_L log D) latent spaces; proofs given in Section 6 and Appendix A (including burn-in Lemma 5).

Section 1.1: positions relative to Chen et al. (2023) target-network/truncation linear Q-learning and Gordon (1995)/Stachurski (2008) nonexpansive averaging; claims the contribution is building contraction into positive compression/reconstruction on C(L) and separating convergence to the compressed fixed point from approximation of Q*.

Sections 8.1-8.2: applications (linear-density Q-measure-learning with Gaussian kernel, Lemma 4 verifying Assumption 3; frozen pretrained network with induced metric rho* and covering number N_{rho*}(eps) counting distinct neuron patterns) are operator-level/conceptual illustrations; Section 8.2 states recursions are 'exactly implementable by maintaining the J output coefficients' but no experiment is run.

Whole paper: no benchmarks, numerical results, or code availability statement appear anywhere; Section 8.1 acknowledges that conservative choices of c_wedge slow the unnormalized algorithm (factor at least c_wedge^{-3/2} in the O~(n^{-1/2}) term) and that Theorem 1's step-size condition alpha_U c_wedge (1-gamma) > 1 requires a lower bound on the unknown c_wedge.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A pure reinforcement-learning theory paper on stable Q-learning with infinite-dimensional linear function approximation. It matches the RL (w=1.5) and partially Training/Optimization preferences; the Section 8.2 'frozen pretrained network' application touches pre-trained-model/fine-tuning themes only tangentially (output-layer linear tuning in RL), and there is no LLM, agent, reasoning, or language content, so preference relevance is mid-range. Research quality is high on the theory side: an infinite-dimensional coefficient-field framework with contraction-by-design (nonexpansive reconstruction/compression), two SA algorithms, and complete high-probability last-iterate proofs is a genuinely novel extension of finite-dimensional nonexpansive approximation and Q-measure-learning, with metric-entropy-driven complexity and metric-agnostic adaptivity. Rigor is strong (explicit Assumptions 1-4, full proofs in Sections 6 and Appendices A-C), but theorems require step sizes tied to unknown constants (e.g., alpha_U c_wedge (1-gamma)>1) and cover only linear output layers. Evidence is entirely theoretical: no experiments, no numerical validation of the adaptive-complexity claims, no code; both Section 8 applications are operator-level illustrations. Generalizability is decent within RL (finite/Euclidean/compact latent spaces) but bounded by uniform ergodicity and kernel coverage assumptions. Algorithms are precisely specified, aiding reproducibility, yet depend on unknown quantities and ship no artifacts.

primary_link.title: Q-Learning with Stable Infinite-Dimensional Linear Function Approximation

radar.summary: Q-learning with linear function approximation can be unstable because an arbitrary approximation architecture need not preserve the Bellman contraction. We develop a stable infinite-dimensional linear function approximation framework for Q-learning from a single Markovian behavior-policy trajectory. The learning variable is a coefficient field $θ\in C(\mathbb L)$ on a compact latent metric space $(\mathbb L,ρ)$. The framework uses a reconstruction operator that maps $θ$ to a continuous Q-functio
radar.summary_zh: Q學習搭配線性函數近似可能不穩定，因任意近似架構未必保留Bellman壓縮性質，即所謂「致命三元素」。本文發展一個穩定的無限維線性函數近似框架：學習變數是定義於緊緻潛在度量空間上的連續係數場，透過兩個非擴張算子——將係數場重構為Q函數的重構算子，以及將Bellman更新壓縮回潛在座標的壓縮算子——共同誘導潛在Bellman映射上的壓縮性，得到唯一不動點，其重構在最壞情況下僅相差表示誤差。作者提出兩個隨機近似演算法：免正規化與經驗正規化遞迴，並建立以O~(n^-1/2)為主項的上確界範數高機率收斂界。框架以覆蓋數而非維度刻劃統計難度，壓縮核的平滑性由不動點與迭代繼承，且演算法對度量選擇不可知，可自動適應潛在幾何。具體應用包括線性密度近似的Q測度學習，以及在凍結預訓練網路上訓練輸出層權重，此時覆蓋數對應功能上相異的激活模式數量而非網路寬度。限制在於理論框架的理想化假設、壓縮核下界選擇可能保守，且無限維物件實作仍需近似。此工作為價值型強化學習的穩定函數近似提供嚴謹的設計原則與有限樣本收斂保證。
radar.title: Q-Learning with Stable Infinite-Dimensional Linear Function Approximation
radar.title_zh: 具有穩定無限維線性函數近似的Q學習

links.title: What AstroPT knows about galaxies, and what that can teach us about LLMs

evidence: Abstract: proposes 'astronomical ground truth through AstroPT... as a calibration testbed' where 'the difficulty ordering of concepts and the relations among them are known in advance'.

Section 2: 'Loosely following Pythia... train across model sizes spanning {1M, 21M, 100M} parameters... checkpoints through one epoch on 8.7M galaxy postage stamps from the Smith42/galaxies DESI Legacy Survey dataset'; linear ridge probes with held-out R^2.

Section 2 ('More difficult properties emerge later in our training runs'): 'mag_r rises first and highest, redshift follows, and sSFR stays weak and does not robustly emerge within one epoch'; ordering 'invariant to our tested training objectives' (AR and MAE).
Appendix A.4, Table 1: final-checkpoint 95% bootstrap intervals for R^2 (e.g., AR 100M: R^2(M*) = 0.639 [0.636, 0.641]) and cosine geometry across AR/MAE objectives and sizes.

Section 2 (Limitations): 'our analysis is correlational; our physical labels are catalog-inferred; pre-training is limited to one epoch and a relatively small sweep... linear probes reveal only what is linearly accessible'.
Appendix B, Fig. 12: activation patching 'moves the residual prediction toward the source more often than same-residual and shuffled-probe controls', a causal check on the mass-residual readout.

Section 2 (Limitations and closing): no experiments on actual language models; 'we do not claim here that astronomical data is itself useful for the pre-training of LLMs', so LLM relevance is methodological analogy only.
Section 2: model is autoregressive/masked reconstruction over image patches ('the visual analog of token prediction'), i.e., no language data is involved in any experiment.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A short case study using AstroPT (a GPT/BERT-style transformer over galaxy-image patches) as a ground-truth testbed for probe-based interpretability methodology. The studied artifact is an astronomy image model, not a language model, so the highest-weight LLM preference is matched only by framing and analogy ('what that can teach us about LLMs'); the substantive match is Interpretability & Explainability (linear probes, emergence ordering across training/depth, probe-direction geometry, activation patching), plus partial matches to Transformer Architecture and Training & Optimization. It is not a pure domain application (the paper explicitly disclaims discovering new galaxy laws and frames itself as a calibration sandbox for interpretability methods), so the out-of-scope cap is not applied. Novelty is genuine: difficulty-ordered concept emergence validated against known physical relations with objective (AR vs MAE) and scale ablations. Rigor is moderate: bootstrap CIs, two objectives, three model sizes, and patching controls (Fig. 12), but correlational probes, catalog-inferred labels, one epoch, and no baseline probes on raw pixels or untrained models weaken the difficulty-ladder inference. Evidence is concrete (Table 1 R^2 and cosine CIs) but the central LLM-transfer claim is untested on any language model, limiting generalizability. Reproducibility is decent: public HF dataset (Smith42/galaxies), published AstroPT base, specified probe and bootstrap details, though hyperparameters live in prior work.

primary_link.title: What AstroPT knows about galaxies, and what that can teach us about LLMs

radar.summary: Interpretability research increasingly asks when concepts emerge during training and whether linear probes recover real structure, but in language models these claims are hard to validate because language offers little ground-truth ordering of concepts or relationships among them. We propose the use of astronomical ground truth through AstroPT, a transformer trained on millions of galaxy images, as a calibration testbed. AstroPT is an LLM-like model trained within a domain where the difficulty o
radar.summary_zh: 語言模型的機制可解釋性研究難以驗證，因語言缺乏概念難度與關係的已知順序。本文提出以天文學作為校準測試台：AstroPT是在數百萬星系影像上訓練、架構類似LLM的Transformer，以自迴歸GPT式或遮罩自編碼BERT式目標進行patch重建預訓練。作者在870萬張DESI Legacy Survey星系影像上訓練1M、21M、100M參數模型，於各檢查點與各層凍結表示上擬合線性ridge探針，評估r波段星等、紅移與比恆星形成率的可解碼度。結果顯示星系性質依已知難度順序浮現：幾乎直接寫入像素的量測最早出現且位於淺層，需多波段或光譜推斷的紅移與sSFR較晚且更深；此順序對訓練目標不變，隨模型容量提升幅度但不改變序列。探針方向亦還原已知物理符號結構：光度與恆星質量強對齊、sSFR與質量反向、紅移與質量正向，而給定光度下的質量殘差方向近乎正交於光度，顯示模型將其編碼為獨立因子。限制包括分析屬相關性推論、標籤為目錄推估、僅訓練一個epoch且模型規模有限、線性探針只反映線性可及資訊。此研究示範天文學可作為機制可解釋性方法的受控沙盒，協助校準平日盲用於LLM的探針工具。

links.title: Advanced LLM-Enhanced Intent-Based 5G Network Management using Dynamic Semantic Routes

evidence: Abstract: 'dynamic routes with a semantic router to identify an intent from a network operator's prompt and extract necessary details for intent fulfillment in intent-based 5G+ core networks' establishes LLM/NLP methodology at the core.

Sec. III System Model: strong assumptions stated - user 'will always provide a subject and frequency for notification' (RNR) and only continuous positional references (IRR); only RNR and IRR intents are in scope.

Sec. IV Methodology: dynamic route LLM is 'Mistral 7B model from Ollama's LLM collection'; OA encoder used for dynamic route layer; prompts 'human-written and then augmented using Gemini and ChatGPT'; 40 utterances per route.
Sec. V-B: RNR dynamic route '38 of 39 were correctly extracted... accuracy of 97.4%' with one misclassified sample excluded; IRR accuracy 95% on 40 prompts with both errors in positional statements.

Sec. V-C: prior work achieved 94% static-route accuracy on a 'limited validation study'; this work claims 'collective accuracy exceeding 99% with individual accuracies reaching 100%', but study designs differ so the comparison is not controlled.
Sec. VI Conclusion: intent fulfillment and 'integration with a live 5G+ network is required' and deferred to future work; no code or dataset availability is stated anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric application paper (strong match to LLM and function-calling/structured-output preferences) that upgrades a prior static semantic-router system with dynamic routes for 5GC intent extraction. Relevance is genuine but the contribution is incremental: it packages the open-source Aurelio Semantic Router's dynamic-route feature with Mistral 7B and compares five off-the-shelf encoders. Rigor is modest: binary accuracy on small self-generated prompt sets (40 utterances/route), no significance testing, no non-semantic-router baseline, and misclassified samples excluded from dynamic-route results. Evidence is limited by figure-only accuracy reporting, small test sets (40 RNR/40 IRR), and a single LLM despite claiming LLM choice is a key factor. Heavy input-format assumptions and only two intent types restrict generalizability; no code or dataset release is stated, though component choices (Ollama Mistral 7B, named encoders) are documented.

primary_link.title: Advanced LLM-Enhanced Intent-Based 5G Network Management using Dynamic Semantic Routes

radar.summary: As the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) is becoming common in everyday applications, their ability to interpret natural language has increased significantly. An emerging application of AI is integration with network management and orchestration practices. An instance of this integration is LLM-enhanced intent-based networking, where network operators will control a network using natural language. This work presents the use of dynamic routes with a semantic rou
radar.summary_zh: 現代5G+核心網路的規模與複雜度使以人為本的管理難以為繼，業界目標是零接觸網路與服務管理（ZSM）。本文延續先前以語意路由改善LLM意圖擷取、抑制幻覺的工作，提出以動態語意路由實現意圖式網路管理：語意路由器依編碼器相似度分數選擇路線（定期通知請求RNR、意圖報告請求IRR或預設None），動態路線再以Mistral 7B執行預定義函數，從操作員提示擷取頻率、網路元素或意圖識別碼等關鍵細節並格式化為JSON式schema。作者以人工撰寫並由Gemini與ChatGPT增強的多樣化提示，評測Hugging Face、阿里Qwen、Mistral、OpenAI與混合式五種編碼器在訓練前後的路線選擇表現。結果顯示OpenAI編碼器準確率最高且變異最小，整體靜態路線準確率超過99%、個別達100%；動態路線細節擷取方面RNR達97.4%、IRR達95%，錯誤主要為時間換算與位置敘述等可用後處理修正的問題。限制在於僅涵蓋兩種意圖類型、schema結構簡單、尚未接上實際的意圖履行與5G網路，且LLM需進一步微調。此工作是邁向human-out-of-the-loop全自動網路管理的重要一步。

links.title: Learning from the Test: Self-Referential Differential Testing for Deep RL Agents

evidence: Abstract: Delta 'uncovers an average of 2,518 optimality issues' across five environments, 'outperforming the baseline methods by 50.2%'.

Section 3.2/3.4: two-phase design — Safety Testing adopts CureFuzz while recording trajectories; Optimality Testing trains a challenger via offline RL and flags bugs when R(ca) > R(aut) + delta (Eq. 2).

Section 5 RQ2 (Baseline Methods): 'To the best of our knowledge, Delta is the first work on this topic and there are no direct baselines'; MDPFuzz/CureFuzz/GMT were given the same BCQ-trained challenger oracle, so comparison isolates fuzzing guidance, not oracle alternatives.
Section 5 RQ1/Table 2: BCQ challengers detect most bugs in all environments (e.g., MountainCar 3752.0 vs BC 1243.2, CQL 2144.0); interestingly, CQL's higher reward (Table 1) did not yield more bugs.
Section 5 RQ3/Table 4: ablations — removing Regret drops Acrobot bugs 5450.0→2238.4; removing Diversity halves CartPole distinct bugs 81.0→39.4.
Section 5 RQ4/Table 5: fine-tuning AUT on challenger trajectories raises Walker2D reward 3925.5→4399.3 and reduces CureFuzz re-eval failures (e.g., Acrobot 1183.6→265.0).
Section 6.2: statistical (Mann-Whitney) oracle extension for non-deterministic environments validated on Hopper-Noise; Delta detects 171% more bugs than best baseline.
Section 7 (Threats to Validity): bug counts are 'a sound-but-not-complete lower bound'; Section 6.3 notes dependence on thorough safety testing for dataset diversity.
Section 4: evaluation limited to CartPole, MountainCar, Acrobot, Hopper, Walker2D with DDQN/SAC AUTs from d3rlpy; Section 9 defers real-world domains (e.g., autonomous driving) to future work.
Section 10 (Data Availability): replication package with source code, datasets, and results at https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.29196884.v1.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solid software-engineering methodology paper: Delta repurposes safety-fuzzing trajectories to train an offline-RL 'challenger' (BC/BCQ/CQL) as a self-referential differential-testing oracle for DRL policy optimality. Genuine but modest novelty — the insight that fuzzing data enables competent challengers via offline RL is fresh, though built from existing pieces (CureFuzz, BCQ/CQL, differential testing). Rigor is strong: 5 environments, 75 challengers, 5 runs, 95% CIs, Mann-Whitney U + Cohen's d, ablations (RQ3), downstream repair (RQ4), and a noisy-environment extension (Sec 6.2). Evidence is credible but baselines are safety testers given the same oracle (no alternative-oracle comparison), and bug counts are initial-state granularity, acknowledged as a lower bound (Sec 7). Preference relevance is low: core topic is RL agent testing (RL weight 1.5, partial AI-safety/red-team overlap); 'agents' here are DRL policies, not LLM/tool-using agents; no LLM, NLP, or language methodology. Generalizability limited to low-dim Gym/MuJoCo control with deterministic-policy assumption. Replication package on Figshare (Sec 10) supports high reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Learning from the Test: Self-Referential Differential Testing for Deep RL Agents

radar.summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has achieved significant success in complex decision-making problems. As DRL systems are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, ensuring their quality and reliability is paramount. Current works primarily focus on detecting safety-critical failures, often neglecting policy optimality, which can lead to reduced efficiency, user distrust, and economic losses. This oversight, compounded by the inherent "testing oracle problem" for optimality, leaves a si
radar.summary_zh: 深度強化學習系統的測試長期聚焦於偵測安全關鍵失敗，忽略策略最佳性；而評估最佳性面臨缺乏明確測試oracle的難題，因理論最優解通常未知或難以解析。本文提出Delta框架：第一階段進行安全測試（採用最先進的CureFuzz），同時記錄受測代理（AUT）的互動軌跡形成資料集；第二階段以離線強化學習（BC、BCQ、CQL）在該資料集上訓練「挑戰者」代理，再以差異測試比較挑戰者與AUT：凡挑戰者自相同初始狀態取得更高累積報酬者，即標記為最佳性缺陷。差異模糊測試以多樣性、遺憾與不一致性組成能量函數，引導種子選擇與突變。在CartPole、MountainCar、Acrobot、Hopper與Walker2D五種環境的實驗顯示，BCQ訓練的挑戰者最有效，Delta平均找出2,518個最佳性問題，較MDPFuzz、CureFuzz與GMT等基準多50.2%，且發現的獨特缺陷最多。此外，以挑戰者的優越軌跡微調AUT（AUT-Improved）不僅提升報酬（如Walker2D提升逾12%），也大幅修復安全失敗，最多降低100%。限制包括依賴安全測試的充分探索、以初始狀態為缺陷計數粒度，以及原假設確定性環境（另以統計檢定擴充至非確定性情境）。此研究為DRL品質評估提供統合安全與最佳性的自參照測試典範。
radar.title: Learning from the Test: Self-Referential Differential Testing for Deep RL Agents
radar.title_zh: 從測試中學習：深度強化學習代理的自我參照差異測試

links.title: DiD It in 87 Minutes: A Label-Free Softmax-to-Linear Adaptation of Vision Transformers for Object Detection

evidence: Abstract: conversion completes in ~87 minutes on 4 GPUs, cuts inference latency ~62% and peak memory ~49%; no language-model component is mentioned anywhere in the paper
Section 3.2, Table 1: generic distillation retains 97.5%/97.2% classification accuracy on ImageNet/CIFAR-100 but only 54.0% of DOTA-v1.5 mAP, motivating detector-interface supervision
Section 3.3, Table 2: post-neck/FPN detector-feature supervision reaches 30.7 mAP vs 25.2 for all-layer hidden-state matching under fixed 20k-step conversion
Section 5.3, Table 3: DiD achieves 31.1 mAP (RetinaNet ReLU) vs 28.1 hidden-state distillation, 18.1 generic distillation, 1.7 direct copy; supervised reference is 30.9
Section 5.1: protocol uses 40k AdamW iterations, lr 1e-3 with decay at 4k/32k, global batch 8, three seeds with std in Appendix B (e.g., 31.1 ± 0.1 mAP); no code release is stated
Section 6: authors explicitly limit scope, noting extension 'beyond the ViT-S scale studied here to larger backbones' remains future work
Appendix D, Table C: generalization to Pascal VOC confirms ranking (DiD 60.8 vs 57.5 hidden-state, 66.6 Softmax reference for RetinaNet ReLU)
llm_evaluation.rationale: This is pure computer vision: a label-free Softmax-to-linear attention conversion of ViT backbones for object detection (RetinaNet/Faster R-CNN on DOTA-v1.5 and Pascal VOC). Although linear attention and distillation are techniques shared with language-model research (cited RADLADS, Mamba-in-Llama), the paper contains no language methodology, no LLM experiments, and no NLP application, so it falls under the explicit out-of-scope category (pure computer vision, cap 0.20). Within its domain the work is well executed: a clean diagnostic study identifies detector-interface supervision as the key failure-mode fix (Table 1: generic distillation retains 97.5% ImageNet accuracy but only 54.0% DOTA mAP; Table 2: post-neck/FPN supervision beats hidden-state matching by 5.5 mAP), the main comparisons (Table 3) show DiD at 31.1 mAP vs 28.1 for hidden-state distillation and 33.5 Softmax reference, and ablations cover interface weighting, loss choice, augmentation, source domain, and conversion budget. Novelty is moderate—it assembles known ingredients (linear attention kernels, feature distillation for detection, attention distillation) into an interface-aware objective, with the placement study as the main new insight. Generalizability is limited to ViT-S scale; the authors themselves flag larger backbones as future work (Section 6). No code release is stated, though hyperparameters and pseudocode are detailed enough for reimplementation.

primary_link.title: DiD It in 87 Minutes: A Label-Free Softmax-to-Linear Adaptation of Vision Transformers for Object Detection

radar.summary: While linear attention is a compelling mechanism for high-resolution object detection due to its reduced cost for global token mixing, converting the Softmax-attention ViT backbone of a trained detector into a linear-attention one is not a trivial drop-in replacement. Directly swapping the attention operator leads to severe performance degradation, and generic label-free distillation, though effective for classification, often fails on detection tasks. We argue that the central challenge is \tex
radar.summary_zh: 線性注意力因全域token混合成本隨序列長度線性成長，適合高解析度物件偵測，但將已訓練偵測器的Softmax-attention ViT主幹轉換為線性注意力並非直接替換：直接換入會使效能崩潰，而通用免標籤蒸餾雖能保留分類行為，在偵測上卻只能恢復約一半mAP。本文主張核心挑戰是偵測器介面保留：轉換後主幹必須重現固定下游偵測器所期望的多尺度特徵張量，而非僅模仿內部隱藏狀態。為此提出Detector-Interface Distillation（DiD）：凍結Softmax教師、頸部/FPN與偵測頭，僅訓練線性注意力學生主幹，對齊頸部/FPN輸出、送入偵測頭前的介面張量，並採早期加權的MSE目標。在DOTA-v1.5上，DiD於RetinaNet達31.1 mAP、Faster R-CNN達29.3 mAP，明顯優於直接複製、通用蒸餾、偽標籤蒸餾與隱藏狀態蒸餾，並與有監督的完整線性訓練相當；40k步調適在4張GPU上約87分鐘完成，轉換後推論延遲降低約62%、峰值記憶體降低約49%，並能推廣至Pascal VOC。限制包括僅在ViT-S規模驗證、介面權重次序未必普遍最佳、介面定義隨偵測器架構而異。此研究提供一條簡單的免標籤後訓練路徑，讓已訓練的Softmax偵測器重用為高效線性模型。
