links.title: From Authorial Mathematics to Studio Mathematics:Ecobiontic Forms of Proof after Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'The proposed understanding audit and contribution-authority trace are governance designs, not validated measures. No causal superiority over authorial practice is claimed.'
Section 1: 'The contribution is philosophical rather than predictive. I do not argue that future mathematics will be mostly studio mathematics or that LLMs will replace mathematicians.'
Section 6.1: 'The instrument has not been validated as a measure of mathematical understanding, has no validated pass threshold, and will require field-specific calibration.'
Table 3 / Section 5.1: Danus classified as 'Studio candidate; governance remains undetermined'; Jacobian episode as 'Boundary case illustrating proxy rupture; governance unestablished.'
Appendix S15: 'No benchmark, participant study, or corpus analysis was generated or represented as completed.'

Appendix S11: FCA context contains 'seven objects and eight attributes' yielding 13 concepts; stochastic view uses '2,000 replicates, seed 25082026' and is described as sensitivity representation, not evidence.

Appendix S16: versioned reproducibility archive with CSV ledgers, analysis scripts, and SHA-256 checksums hosted on Google Drive; 'Standard FCA, fuzzy similarity, stochastic perturbation, and RHM outputs can be regenerated without network access.'
Section 13/Appendix S13: staged validation program (instrument pilot, workflow comparison, arXiv gold set of 100-200 papers) is fully prospective with stop rules but no executed results.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A philosophy-of-mathematics paper on how LLMs, proof assistants, and repositories change the unit of proof-production, proposing a 'studio ecobiont' ontology, a five-condition claim-relative governance rule, and an L0-L5 AI-use scale. Topical overlap with LLMs, mathematical reasoning, and multi-agent orchestration (Danus fact-graph system) is real but thematic rather than methodological: no models, experiments, benchmarks, or quantitative LLM results are presented, and the paper itself states 'The contribution is philosophical rather than predictive.' Conceptual novelty is moderate (governed vs. degenerate studio distinction, contribution-authority trace), though it largely recombines distributed cognition and philosophy-of-practice literatures. Internal claim discipline is unusually honest (claim ledger, explicit nonclaims, RHM statuses, objections section), which supports rigor, but the understanding audit and governance protocols are unvalidated by the author's own admission, all four case classifications leave governance 'undetermined' or 'unestablished,' and the only computations are trivial hand-coded FCA analyses on a 7x8 context. Evidence strength is therefore low: literature citations plus secondhand case descriptions. Reproducibility artifacts (CSV ledgers, scripts, seed 25082026, SHA-256 checksums) are disclosed but hosted on Google Drive rather than a versioned archive. Overall a thoughtful, well-hedged conceptual contribution with limited empirical substance for an AI research curator.

primary_link.title: From Authorial Mathematics to Studio Mathematics:Ecobiontic Forms of Proof after Large Language Models

radar.summary: Mathematics has often been organized around an authorial subject: one person, or a small group, composing proofs through language, notation, and judgment. Large language models, proof assistants, formal libraries, and repositories now make another production unit technically credible: a human-machine assemblage. This article calls that unit a studio ecobiont and asks when it is epistemically legitimate. Its governance thesis is that human participation is substantive only when the system preserv
radar.summary_zh: 數學長期以作者型主體組織：由個人或小群體透過語言、記號與判斷撰寫證明。大型語言模型、證明助理與形式化函式庫使「人機組裝體」成為技術上可信的生產單位。本文提出工作室數學概念，並追問其何時具備知識論正當性。作者以CIMA生態共生體（耦合計算、推斷、建模、行動四功能）作為描述性本體論，並提出治理命題：只有當系統保留可追溯的來源、可重建的人類勝任能力、質疑結果的能力、停止或撤回的實效權限與公開責任時，人類參與才算實質。透過比較Polymath、Liquid Tensor Experiment、Danus擬矩陣實驗與Jacobian反例事件，論證協作、形式化、技術編排與知識治理是四個獨立維度：分散式作者權不必然是工作室，技術編排不必然蘊含治理。文中亦定義「退化工作室」，即人類監督僅具儀式性卻仍宣稱為治理後的人類數學成果。所提出的理解稽核與貢獻—權威追溯屬治理設計而非已驗證量測，作者明確不主張因果優越性。限制包括個案分類依賴公開紀錄、工具尚未經實證驗證。此文重要性在於為LLM時代數學實踐的能動性、信任與責任組織方式提供可操作的規範框架，主張在作者型、治理工作室與退化工作室之間保持制度多元。
radar.title: From Authorial Mathematics to Studio Mathematics:Ecobiontic Forms of Proof after Large Language Models
radar.title_zh: 從作者型數學到工作室數學：大型語言模型之後的生態共生式證明型態

links.title: Token-Level Likelihood-Array Regression for Membership Inference and AI-Generated Text Detection

evidence: Abstract: reports mean held-out AUCs of 0.914-0.983 for membership inference and 0.985-0.996 for AI-generated text detection across five scoring models per task.
Section 5.1, Table 1: LAR-2 reaches 0.953-0.983 AUC on WikiMIA versus strongest baseline ReCaLL at 0.765-0.871 across Pythia-1B/6.9B/12B, LLaMA-2-7B, Falcon-7B.
Section 4, Theorems 1-2: establishes matching minimax lower and upper prediction bounds at rate {log(en)/n}^{nu/(nu+1)} for the within-path quadratic model, with proofs in Supplement S1.3-S1.4.
Section 5.3, Figure 1/Table S6: shorter-context cells yield out-of-fold AUC 0.907 vs 0.802 for full-context cells (LAR-1, WikiMIA Pythia-1B), and 0.988 vs 0.937 (AI detection, DeepSeek-7B).
Section 5.2, Table 2: LAR-1 AUCs 0.985-0.996 exceed AdaDetectGPT (0.660-0.773), Fast-DetectGPT, RADAR (0.839), and StatDetectLLM (0.980) on the GPT-4o benchmark.
Supplement S2.3, Tables S4-S5: results replicated with Claude-3.5-Haiku and Gemini-2.5-Flash generators (LAR AUCs 0.978-0.996 and 0.979-0.992).

Data availability statement: WikiMIA (Hugging Face) and AdaDetectGPT data are publicly available; Section 3.4 specifies G=24, d_u=12, d_v=6, d_h=102, R=1024, lambda=0.01, but no code link for LAR itself is provided.

Section 6: acknowledges limitations including computational cost of array construction, need for threshold calibration, and that the analysis covers prediction/ranking rather than calibrated decisions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A statistically sophisticated methodology paper squarely aimed at LLM auditing: membership inference (privacy/AI-safety relevant) and AI-generated text detection, using Pythia/LLaMA-2/Falcon/Qwen3/DeepSeek/OLMo/GPT-4o as scoring or generating models, so it aligns strongly with LLM, AI-safety, and evaluation preferences. The likelihood-array representation (nested left-context windows aligned across documents, Section 3.1) and within-path quadratic model with matching minimax bounds (Theorems 1-2) are genuinely novel relative to prior scalar likelihood scores (Min-K%, ReCaLL, Fast-DetectGPT). Rigor is high: complete proofs, ablations over channels and array support, 20 repeated splits with standard deviations, sample-size curves, sensitivity and simulation studies. Evidence is strong but bounded by WikiMIA's proxy creation-date labels and paired generated-text construction; gains are large and consistent across 10 scoring models and 3 generators. Generalizability is tempered by the requirement of white-box token-level logits and supervised labels, and reproducibility is good for data/specification (G=24, R=1024, lambda=0.01) but no explicit LAR code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Token-Level Likelihood-Array Regression for Membership Inference and AI-Generated Text Detection

top5.summary: Membership inference asks whether a text was used to train a language model, whereas AI-generated text detection asks whether it was generated by a language model rather than written by a human. Existing likelihood-based methods typically compress token-level probabilities into a few prespecified scores, most often using only probabilities conditioned on the full preceding context. We propose likelihood-array regression (LAR), which evaluates each target token under nested left-context windows a
top5.summary_zh: 本論文針對兩項大型語言模型稽核任務——會員推論(判斷某段文字是否用於訓練)與 AI 生成文字偵測(判斷文字由模型或人類產生)——提出概似陣列迴歸(LAR)。既有概似法多將詞元機率壓縮為少數預設分數,僅使用完整前文脈絡的條件機率;LAR 則讓固定的評分模型在多個巢狀左文脈視窗下評估每個目標詞元,將概似導出的特徵組織成結構化陣列,並在對齊不同長度的文本後,學習偵測資訊如何隨脈絡規模、詞元位置與概似特徵變化。LAR-1 聚合各對齊格位的一階貢獻;LAR-2 再加入同一目標詞元跨脈絡長度的二階特徵。理論上,作者為路徑內二次模型建立相符的極小極大預測上下界,速率為 {log(en)/n}^{ν/(ν+1)},並刻劃有限維近似與隨機平方投影帶來的誤差。實驗上,在五個評分模型上,會員推論的平均 AUC 達 0.914–0.983,AI 偵測達 0.985–0.996,大幅超越概似基線;分析顯示較短脈絡概似含有完整脈絡機率之外的資訊,二階特徵主要增益會員推論。限制包括建構概似陣列的計算成本與閾值校準等實務課題。此框架為模型稽核提供了兼具效能與統計保證的新途徑。
top5.title: Token-Level Likelihood-Array Regression for Membership Inference and AI-Generated Text Detection
top5.title_zh: 詞元層級概似陣列迴歸:會員推論與 AI 生成文字偵測

links.title: Iteration Without Elaboration: A Simple ReAct Architecture Suffices for Text-to-SQL Generation

evidence: Abstract: ReAct-SQL achieves 84.5% on corrected BIRD mini-dev and 73.9% on EHR-SQL 'matching substantially more elaborate baselines while running up to 8× faster'

§3.2.2 and Table 1: model never generates SQL directly; actions restricted to a typed DSL of 12 relation-building plus 3 read-only probing operations over an immutable Relation DAG with compile-time column validation
§4.2 and Appendix D: official BIRD strict-equality scoring replaced by a fixed Gemini 2.5 Flash (temperature 0) LLM-as-judge applied uniformly to every system; full judge prompt reproduced

§6, Table 4, Appendix A: ablation shows +26.2 pts from iteration alone on EHR-SQL (McNemar p<10^-45) but only +0.6 on BIRD, while the DSL adds +5.4 on BIRD (p=0.006) and +1.7 (n.s.) on EHR-SQL, supporting the grounding-vs-composition claim

§4.3 and Table 2: all five baselines (CHESS, RSL-SQL, DSR-SQL, DIN-SQL, MAC-SQL) run on Gemini 2.5 Flash with identical hints and judge; Table 3 shows cross-backbone gains of +15.0 to +36.5 on a 200-question EHR-SQL subset including Claude Sonnet 4.6
Appendix G, Table 7: full latency distributions with min/median/mean/max/CV, and median justified over mean due to right-skewed API stalls
Limitations: weaker models 'hallucinate non-existent operations or emit malformed DSL calls', enterprise-scale schemas untested, and formal DSL completeness 'remains future work'
Ethical considerations: 'We will release ReAct-SQL as open-source code for research use' — a future commitment with no repository link provided in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-agent methodology paper squarely matching high-weight preferences: ReAct-style agentic tool use with a typed DSL action space for text-to-SQL (Agents & Tool Use, Code/text-to-SQL, Reasoning, LLMs). Not a pure domain application despite the EHR-SQL benchmark. Strengths: controlled comparison of six systems under an identical backbone and judge, an incremental ablation (baseline → +iteration → +DSL) with McNemar tests and bootstrap CIs, cross-backbone validation across two model families, and unusually complete cost/latency reporting including distribution statistics. Weaknesses: core techniques (ReAct loops, execution feedback, constrained decoding/DSL action spaces à la PICARD/CodeAct) are established, so the contribution is an incremental combination plus an efficiency-first evaluation framing; the LLM-as-judge replaces the official strict-execution metric (numbers not comparable to leaderboards, and the judge is the same model family as the primary backbone, a self-preference risk only partially mitigated by symmetric application); no accuracy variance across runs is reported; and no Spider or enterprise-scale-schema evaluation. Prompts, price schedule, and statistical methodology are reproduced, but code release is only promised. Solid, well-instrumented, moderately novel systems work.

primary_link.title: Iteration Without Elaboration: A Simple ReAct Architecture Suffices for Text-to-SQL Generation

top5.summary: Modern text-to-SQL systems have become increasingly elaborate, relying on schema-linking modules, retrieval-augmented prompting, candidate generation, and multi-stage refinement pipelines. While effective, these additions introduce substantial latency and engineering overhead. To this end, we present \textbf{ReAct-SQL}, a simple yet effective zero-shot ReAct-style framework built solely on iterative reasoning and a constrained action space defined by a typed Domain-Specific Language (DSL) of 15
top5.summary_zh: 本論文指出現代 text-to-SQL 系統日益複雜,仰賴 schema 連結、檢索增強提示與多階段管線,卻帶來高昂延遲與工程負擔。作者提出 ReAct-SQL,一個零樣本的 ReAct 式代理框架:模型從不直接生成 SQL,而是透過 think→act→observe 迴圈,在由 15 個關聯式操作組成的型別化 DSL(12 個建構 Relation 的操作加上 3 個唯讀探測)界定的受限動作空間中逐步建構查詢,以編譯期驗證攔截錯誤的欄位引用,並利用執行結果觀察迭代修正。在修正版 BIRD mini-dev 與 EHR-SQL 上,ReAct-SQL 分別達到 84.5% 與 73.9% 準確率,與遠更繁複的基線(如 CHESS、DSR-SQL)相當,但速度最高快 8 倍;在臨床 schema 上準確率降幅最小,並優於依賴 BIRD 檢索範例、移轉後準確率大跌的 RSL-SQL。消融實驗分離出兩個正交瓶頸:迭代主要解決接地(grounding)問題,EHR-SQL 上單加迭代即提升 26.2 點;DSL 則解決組合(composition)問題,在 BIRD 上貢獻 5.4 點。論文並倡議以準確率—成本—延遲三者共同評估系統。限制包括對基礎模型指令遵循能力的依賴、僅測試中等規模 schema,以及 DSL 完備性尚缺數學證明。
top5.title: Iteration Without Elaboration: A Simple ReAct Architecture Suffices for Text-to-SQL Generation
top5.title_zh: 迭代而無需繁複:簡單的 ReAct 架構即足以勝任 Text-to-SQL 生成

links.title: Is Your Neighborhood Safe? Place-based Stigma in Large Language Models' Urban Safety Judgments

evidence: Section 4.1: three information conditions (coordinates-only, name-only, name+coordinates) with exact prompt text isolate the name channel from geography
Section 5.1/Table 1: coordinates-only SD 0.01-0.15 for six of seven models vs name-channel SD up to 1.674; GPT-4o's coordinate channel reaches 0.67-0.91, so the name-only claim is scale-dependent

Section 5.4/Table 3: Los Angeles demographic coefficient net of crime and income negative with CIs excluding zero for all seven models (e.g., GPT-4o -0.49 [-0.67,-0.31]); 28 crime-matched pairs decisive while Chicago n=8 is underpowered

Section 5.2 and Appendix D/Table A5: enforcement-elasticity decomposition shows caution tracks homicide partials (-0.18 to -0.74) not discretionary offences, replicating in LA where homicide and discretionary rates are nearly independent (r=0.18)

Limitations section: English-only single-turn templates, recorded crime is an endogenous proxy, matching controls crime but not income (income SMD -0.55 after matching), cross-model gradient underpowered (n=6 Chicago, n=5 LA)

Section 9 Reproducibility Statement: OpenRouter model IDs, temperature 0, top-20 logprobs, DeepSeek pinned to CoreWeave-only, ACS table IDs B01003/B11001/B19025/B03002, Socrata 2nrs-mtv8; 'code and derived data will be released' (promise only)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM audit: seven instruct-tuned LLMs (Llama, Qwen, GPT-4o/mini, DeepSeek) are probed for demographic bias in safety judgments, squarely matching the LLM (2.5) and AI Safety/bias-fairness (2.0) preferences, with secondary matches to evaluation and prompting. The condition-ablation design (coordinates-only vs name-only vs name+coordinates) is a genuinely novel probe that dissociates name-borne signal from geography, and the enforcement-elasticity decomposition, name transplant, and crime-matched pairs add methodological originality. Rigor is high: ten prompt-robustness templates, two name-prominence controls (Wikipedia pageviews, Dolma/infini-gram corpus frequency), 2,000-resample bootstrap CIs, Hungarian matching with balance diagnostics, and candid acknowledgment that Chicago's r=0.75 crime-demographic collinearity blocks identification there. Evidence is strongest in Los Angeles where level regression, name ablation, and 28 matched pairs all agree for all seven models; cross-model knowledge-scaling correlations rest on n=7 and are admitted to be underpowered. Generalizability is bounded by two US cities, English, single-turn ratings. Reproducibility is above average (model IDs, temperature 0, top-20 logprobs, DeepSeek provider pinning, ACS/LAPD dataset identifiers, appendix templates) though code is only promised, not released. Not penalized as a domain application: the object of study is LLM behavior itself.

primary_link.title: Is Your Neighborhood Safe? Place-based Stigma in Large Language Models' Urban Safety Judgments

top5.summary: Large language models are increasingly used to inform safety decisions in cities, such as where it is safe to walk, rent, or travel. We ask whether such judgments track measured risk or the patterns attached to an urban neighborhood's name. We probe seven instruct-tuned models under three conditions that dissociate name from geography: coordinates-only, name-only, and name+coordinates, across 186 neighborhoods in Los Angeles and Chicago, joined to violent crime and American Community Survey data
top5.summary_zh: 本論文探討大型語言模型在都市安全判斷上,是依據實測風險,還是反映依附於社區名稱的地域污名。作者設計三種資訊條件——僅座標、僅名稱、名稱加座標——對芝加哥 77 個社區與洛杉磯 109 個社區,請七個指令微調模型評分夜間獨行安全,並對齊暴力犯罪紀錄與美國社區調查的人口結構資料。主要發現有三:其一,七個模型中有六個在僅座標條件下評分近乎不變,名稱承載幾乎所有社區間變異,且該變異與實測犯罪率呈中度校準;僅前沿規模模型(如 GPT-4o)的座標通道才有實質振幅。其二,名稱對在地主要邊緣化群體占比較高的社區(芝加哥的非裔占比、洛杉磯的西裔占比)降分更多;芝加哥因人口與犯罪相關 r=0.75 而難以分離,但在洛杉磯,控制犯罪與所得後效應於全部七個模型皆顯著,並以犯罪配對設計在項目層級獲得確認;執法彈性分解顯示過度謹慎追蹤近乎全報案的兇殺,而非取決於警力部署的裁量性犯罪。其三,效應隨地理知識增強而放大,並非受其閘控。關鍵在於名稱同時承載真實犯罪訊號與人口刻板印象,遮蔽名稱會同時移除偏差與準確度,因此無法單靠隱藏名稱修復。此研究對 LLM 部署於建議與決策支援場景的公平性深具啟示。
top5.title: Is Your Neighborhood Safe? Place-based Stigma in Large Language Models' Urban Safety Judgments

links.title: Learning Generalizable Behaviors for Terminal Agents

evidence: Abstract: River achieves 106% and 30% larger average RL gains on Terminal-Bench-Lite and Terminal-Bench-v2.1 using fewer than 30% of TMax environments across 2B-27B models
Sec 4.1 Table 1: River-8B avg 19.4±1.2 vs strongest baseline OpenThinker-8B-RL 17.8±0.7, four benchmarks, mean±std over 3 seeds
Sec 5.1: RSA analysis shows skill-skill structure preserved after RL (ρ=0.83) while task-task structure changes substantially (ρ=0.27) with Mantel permutation test
Sec 5.2: behavior-feature model AUC rises 0.64→0.74 from SFT to RL while skill-presence model stays near 0.55 (15 seeds, 5-fold CV)

App C.2 Table 7: independent Claude Opus 4.8 blind re-judge agrees with GPT-5.4 on 83.3% binary Clean/defective labels but only 40% conditional agreement on Clean labels; authors state clean rates may be optimistic
Sec 5.4 Table 2: RL trained on only Debug+System domains still improves untrained domains (e.g., Numerical 45.5→57.6, Data 29.2→47.7) on ~300-task held-out set
Sec 5.3 Fig 7: Diverse-SFT reduces early-termination reward hacking under partial rewards while Narrow-SFT degrades OOD performance during RL
App A.2 Table 4: full GRPO hyperparameters; 8×H200 node, ~60 hours for 400 RL steps; no explicit code or model release statement found in the paper
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant agentic-LLM paper: RL post-training of LLM terminal agents (Qwen3/3.5/3.6 2B-27B) with GRPO/DPPO, SFT stage, verifier-quality filtering of synthetic environments, and reward-hacking analysis. Core contributions: (1) 'agentic compositional generalization' hypothesis extending known single-turn SFT/RL complementarity (Kong et al., Yuan et al.) to multi-turn agents; (2) River recipe (rubric-based environment filtering + GPT-5.4 oracle pass@k filter + repetition-penalty advantage shaping). Novelty is solid but incremental: verifier-quality matters was noted by prior work (He et al. 2025, cited in Sec 2), and the recipe is simple; the mechanism analysis is the main novel piece. Rigor is good: 4 benchmarks, 3 seeds with std, matched-harness baselines, controlled random-TMax-3.5K comparison (Table 8: 17.7 vs 19.4), SFT data-size controls (Diverse-DS-SFT), 8/6/4/2-domain RL ablations, and unusually honest audit validation (App C.2: only 40% conditional agreement on Clean labels, explicitly flagged). Evidence supports but does not causally establish the hypothesis; the paper appropriately hedges ('consistent with'). Margins over the best baseline are modest on some benchmarks (e.g., otbl 21.8±2.9 vs 18.4±1.5). Fig 4 TMax comparisons adopt numbers from another report with a changed sandbox setup, a mild confound. Reproducibility: exhaustive hyperparameters (App A) but no explicit code/model/data release statement; filtered set depends on proprietary GPT-5.4 audits.

primary_link.title: Learning Generalizable Behaviors for Terminal Agents

top5.summary: Terminal agents are a compelling application of large language models (LLMs), with the potential to integrate deeply into users' daily workflows. Reinforcement learning (RL) is a key technique for improving their capabilities, making scalable training environments a central challenge. Since public real-user interaction data are scarce, synthetic environments provide a practical alternative, but often suffer from domain gaps and limited fidelity, leading to poor generalization. Existing work main
top5.summary_zh: 本論文研究強化學習(RL)如何改善終端機代理,並提出「代理組合泛化」假說:RL 並非從零教導特定領域的新技能,而是主要塑造高階決策行為(如先探索再行動、完成前驗證、放棄失敗路徑),用以組合與調度預訓練及 SFT 階段已習得的低階原子技能。此觀點意味著,相較於擴增訓練環境的數量與多樣性,提供行為塑形訊號的驗證器品質更為關鍵。據此作者提出 River 訓練配方:先以規準審核加上 oracle 代理 pass@k 過濾低品質合成環境(發現 TMax 收藏中超過 60% 的環境存在至少一項品質問題),再以行為層級的優勢塑形(懲罰重複互動迴圈)增強結果獎勵。實驗上,River 訓練的 8B 模型在四個終端代理基準上為受評開源 RL 模型中最佳;使用不到 30% 的 TMax 環境,即讓 2B 至 27B 模型在 Terminal-Bench-Lite 與 Terminal-Bench-v2.1 上的 RL 增益平均分別提升 106% 與 30%,且跨模型家族、規模、harness 與 RL 目標皆可泛化。分析支持假說:行為特徵預測任務成功的 AUC 達 0.74,而技能出現與否接近隨機(約 0.55);RL 大致保留技能—技能結構(ρ=0.83)卻重組任務—任務結構(ρ=0.27)。此外,涵蓋多樣原子技能的 SFT 亦有助減少獎勵駭取。限制在於環境審核可能產生誤判,以及假說的跨模型梯度檢定力有限。

links.title: BLADE: Bilevel Low-rank Augmented-Lagrangian Erasure for LLM Unlearning

evidence: Abstract & Section 1: claims 6%/9%/7% average composite improvements on TOFU/MUSE Books/KnowUndo over strongest baselines.
Section 4.2 Table 1: BLADE HM 0.808/0.800/0.803 across TOFU 1B splits vs PDU 0.690/0.740/0.797, 5 seeds with stds.
Section 4.3: honestly concedes PDU leads on MUSE News HM (0.577 vs BLADE 0.544).
Section 4.6 Figure 3: BLADE HM stays 0.523-0.552 under 4x scaling and 4 sequential unlearning steps while PDU collapses (HM=0.005 at 4x).
Section 4.8 Table 4: ablations - ALM off HM=0.233, swapped bilevel HM=0.506, no LoRA HM=0.459, full BLADE HM=0.823; notes K=3 vs K=0 marginal on Books (0.823 vs 0.819).
Appendix B: Propositions 1-2 with proofs that clamped-entropy loss is bounded with exactly-zero gradients in the deadzone.
Appendix E.3: re-learning attack degrades BLADE HM by 69% on average (single seed).
Section 6 Limitations: text-only, factual/knowledge-level unlearning only, untested on multimodal or representation-level removal.
Appendix C.3/C.6 Tables 6, 9, 10: full hyperparameters (7 of 9 fixed), wall-clock 1.5-2x slower but 2-5x lower memory, ~450 GPU-hours total.
Footnote 1: code and configs released at github.com/tzpranto/blade; experiments run in the open OpenUnlearning framework.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper (machine unlearning for Llama-3.2/2 models) with strong AI-safety relevance (privacy, copyright, adversarial extraction/jailbreak/MIA/GCG). Well-aligned with LLM, safety, training-optimization, and evaluation preferences. Novelty is moderate: clamped entropy, ALM, and bilevel LoRA are each known; the contribution is their specific combination plus an asymmetric dual 'ratchet' and a repair-first (retain-in-inner-loop) inversion, which the ablation (Table 4: swapped bilevel HM 0.506, ALM off HM 0.233 vs full 0.823) partly substantiates. Rigor is strong: 5 seeds with stds, three benchmark families, component ablations, 120-run hyperparameter sweeps, theoretical propositions with proofs, and disclosed LLM-judge protocol. Evidence is largely verifiable from tables; headline gains check out (Table 1: BLADE HM 0.808/0.800/0.803 vs PDU 0.690/0.740/0.797; Fig. 3 stress tests). Notably honest: concedes second place to PDU on MUSE News (0.544 vs 0.577), acknowledges ablation K=3 vs K=0 is marginal on Books, and reports 69% HM degradation under re-learning attack. Generalizability is decent (three corpora, 1B-7B models) but limited to text-only, factual/knowledge-level unlearning. Reproducibility is high: public code link, full hyperparameter tables, OpenUnlearning framework, compute budget (~450 GPU-hours) disclosed. Score ~0.78 reflects a competent, well-evidenced synthesis rather than a fundamental advance.

primary_link.title: BLADE: Bilevel Low-rank Augmented-Lagrangian Erasure for LLM Unlearning

top5.summary: Existing LLM unlearning methods struggle with robustness: unbounded forget losses degrade model coherence, fixed-weight balancing cannot adapt as retain difficulty shifts mid-training, and methods that work on one benchmark falter under scaling or repeated application. We propose BLADE, a constrained bilevel framework whose three mechanisms give smooth, predictable control over the optimization landscape: a clamped-entropy forget loss whose gradient is exactly zero once a token reaches sufficien
top5.summary_zh: 本論文針對 LLM 機器遺忘的穩健性問題提出 BLADE,一個受限雙層最佳化框架。既有方法有三類反覆出現的失敗模式:無界遺忘損失摧毀模型連貫性、固定權重無法適應訓練中途保留難度的變化、未截斷的熵損失持續推動已遺忘的詞元。BLADE 以三個互補機制應對:其一是截斷熵遺忘損失,當詞元熵達 τ·logV 的充分不確定水準後梯度恰好為零,消除過度遺忘;其二是非對稱增廣拉格朗日,一旦違反保留約束便永久拉高乘數形成棘輪,以自適應自校正取代靜態權衡;其三是將雙層結構限制在 LoRA 介面卡上,內迴圈在每次遺忘步驟前修復保留損害,外層以小步幅推進遺忘。在 TOFU、MUSE Books 與 KnowUndo 上,BLADE 相較最強基線平均提升複合分數 6%、9% 與 7%,LLM 評審亦確認近零的語意洩漏;在 MUSE News 的 4 倍規模擴張與 4 次連續遺忘壓力測試下維持穩定,而最強對手 PDU 完全崩潰。訓練動力學呈現可預測的三階段模式(暖身、尖峰拉昇、平滑收斂)。消融實驗證實各元件缺一不可,唯有有界且自飽和的遺忘損失能與受限雙層最佳化相容。限制包括未測試概念或表徵層級的領域移除、易受再學習攻擊,以及僅限文字模型。此工作為部署中模型的合規刪除提供穩健可控的路徑。
